chapters.title: Chapter 151: Who Are You?! (1)
paragraphs: However, they then discovered the bloodstains on the red notes!
They also discovered Zhu Shoucheng, who had been beaten up so badly that even his mother could not recognize him!
“A ghost!” The security guards immediately shouted.
Right on the heels of that, Director Zhu’s weak voice sounded. “I... I’m Zhu Shoucheng. Quickly catch that kid outside.”
The office door was open. Zhang Huaiyao looked inside and immediately saw Director Zhu, who had completely changed. How was this human? He was clearly a pig.
She turned to look at Chen Yun and the corners of her mouth twitched. “Didn’t you... say that you wanted to reason with him? How did this happen?”
Chen Yun shrugged. “That’s none of my business. Look at my hands. There’s no blood. If I say that he hit his head against the wall, do you believe me?”
Zhang Huaiyao was speechless. She hurriedly held Chen Yun’s hand. “Run.”
“Stop right there!”
Before they could take a step forward, Chen Yun and Zhang Huaiyao were stopped by the security guards.

This was the office area. Although there were no students, all the teachers and interns in the academy were there. When they saw the commotion here, they surrounded them and completely blocked the corridor.
“It’s him. He was the one who hit me.” Director Zhu leaned against the wall and pointed at Chen Yun.
“F*ck, who’s this pig head? He’s so ugly.”
“His name tag says Zhu Shoucheng. Could he be Director Zhu?”
“It’s really Director Zhu. How did he become like this? Has Zhu Bajie revealed his true form?”
At this moment, everyone looked shocked when they saw Director Zhu. At first, they did not know who he was. It was only when someone saw his name tag that they realized his identity.
“Go, take him down.”
After receiving Director Zhu’s instructions, the security guards swarmed forward and pounced on Chen Yun.
Zhang Huaiyao was shocked and quickly wanted to stop him, but Chen Yun gently pulled her behind him. He turned around and winked at her. “Don’t worry, I’m here.”
In the next moment, Chen Yun did not retreat but advanced, charging at the five security guards.
“Do you want to die?!”
The security guards were furious. How could he be so arrogant after hitting someone? It was simply unreasonable.
However, when they really fought Chen Yun, they realized that they were wrong. He was arrogant and indeed had the right to be arrogant.

Chen Yun’s movements were very fast. He kicked two security guards and changed his move in midair. He stepped on the wall to borrow strength and slashed down with his other foot, enveloping the remaining three security guards and kicking them to the ground.
In the blink of an eye, the five aggressive security guards were overturned. Everyone was dumbfounded. This action and combat strength were simply like a movie.
Zhang Huaiyao looked at Chen Yun’s back and suddenly felt safe.
“If you attack again, you’ll be this pig-headed person’s accomplices. I don’t mind being ruthless,” said Chen Yun to the security guards as he pointed at Director Zhu.
The security guards hurriedly nodded. They did not dare to continue attacking Chen Yun. The two parties were not on the same level at all. There was no need to die for Zhu Shoucheng.
Meanwhile, Director Zhu did not expect Chen Yun to be so fierce. He was so frightened that he hid in the corner and did not dare to move.

After the surrounding interns saw Chen Yun’s violence, they could not help but make way for him. If this man who had beaten Director Zhu into a pig’s head was unhappy and even beat them up, it would not be worth it.
In particular, the internship teacher, Zhou Fang, hid far away, afraid that Chen Yun would discover her traces.
At this moment, she realized how blissful it was to have been teased by Chen Yun. Otherwise, she would have suffered the same consequences as Zhu Shoucheng.
“Although this person is violent, he’s so handsome.”
“Huaiyao said that he’s her childhood friend. I think he’s her boyfriend.”
“However, it’s a pity that he hit Zhu Shoucheng. Huaiyao’s promotion will definitely be canceled. Moreover, she will be expelled from the school immediately.”
Some interns who were on good terms with Zhang Huaiyao discussed in low voices. They were envious and regretful.
At this moment, Chen Yun stood on the spot and looked at the screen in front of him.
[Host, please complete the check-in mission.]
Chen Yun pressed the check-in button.
[Congratulations to the host for completing the check-in mission.]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining one billion yuan!]
Then, the Random Double Skill appeared and simply reached a multiplier of eight!
He received eight billion!
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining 70% of the Shi’en University shares.]
Huh? Chen Yun looked in front of him. Had he obtained 70% of the Shi’en University shares?
This was interesting.
After a while, a call came in. Needless to say, he knew who it was.

At this moment, others did not know what was happening upstairs. Downstairs, a middle-aged man in a suit was waiting. Then, he looked at the Audi A6 that had stopped in front of him and quickly went up to him.
“Chief Lei, you’re here.”
“I’m sorry, Dean Li. Did you wait too long?” A lean middle-aged man got out of the car. Although he said that he was sorry, there was no apology on his face.
Who would dare to denounce him here?!
At this moment, Dean Li was accompanying Lei Xing with a smile on his face. “Chief Lei, I heard that you were invited to the biotechnology conference today, right? You must have gained a lot.”
“I didn’t just gain a lot. I’ve never seen such a scene in my life,” said Chief Lei with an arrogant expression.
This expression immediately made Dean Li, who was beside him, feel disdain.
What scene had he never seen in his life? Wasn’t it just some biological science results?
Would he be able to move through space, or would he be able to regain his youth?
It made him so excited that it was as if he had never seen the world.
However, his expression fell into Chief Lei’s eyes, making him immediately sneer. “Director Li, it seems that you don’t care about what I say.”
“No, no, I wouldn’t dare!” Dean Li immediately lowered his body, and cold sweat seeped out of his forehead.

“Forget it. I shouldn’t tell you about this, but it just so happens that I have nothing to do today. It’s fine to talk to you. Otherwise, you and I will still be living at the bottom and won’t be able to see the scenery of the upper echelons. Let me tell you, all the high-ranking officials and nobles were here today for a 20-year-old young man, Director Chen!”

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Who Are You?! (2)
paragraphs: The more Chief Lei spoke, the more excited he became. Beside him, Dean Li’s eyes gradually widened. He could not believe what he had heard! Who was this person?!
At the age of 20, he already had tens of billions of assets. Sacred Heaven was under his control!
Furthermore, he had such a magical medicine. He even rejected a collaborative investment worth five billion yuan on the spot!
He even boasted that he did not lack the five billion yuan. He asked the Park Corporation to use the five billion yuan and send beggars away!
This!
What kind of f*cking ruthless person were they?!
In comparison!
They were really frogs in a well!
They had never seen how vast the sky was!
Gradually, Dean Li became numb. The two of them watched and talked as they went upstairs. Unknowingly, they had already arrived at the fifth floor.

However, the noisy scene in front of them instantly interrupted the conversation between the two of them. Chief Lei looked at the scene in front of him and his originally smug mood while speaking was completely gone. He looked at Dean Li beside him and sneered. “Dean Li, your place is really glorious!”
“Well ...”
He had clearly instructed that Chief Lei from the Education Bureau of Shi’en City was coming today, so everyone had to follow his orders.
What was going on?!
At that moment, he could only smile apologetically at Chief Lei. Then, he shouted at the people in front of him, “What are you all doing?! How can you be like this?!”
As he spoke, Dean Li rushed over. He didn’t walk, but ran!
When everyone saw this person, they were stunned and revealed respectful expressions.
Zhu Shoucheng’s eyes lit up, as if he had seen his savior. He suddenly pounced towards that person and hugged his leg, screaming, “Wuwuwu... Dean, help!”
However, as soon as he squeezed into the crowd, a pig-headed person hugged his thigh, scaring him.
“F*ck, what the hell!”
Dean Li was so frightened that he cursed. He kicked the “pig head” at his feet in the face, causing the “pig head” to stagger.
The pig-headed man lay on the ground and cried bitterly. He pointed at his face and said, “Director, I’m Zhu Shoucheng!”
“Zhu Shoucheng?!”
Dean Li exclaimed and observed the pig head in front of him. At first, he felt that it was familiar. Then, he took a closer look and realized that it was really Zhu Shoucheng.
A living person had actually been beaten into a living pig. The person who did it was too ruthless.
Although Zhu Shoucheng’s character was not good, he was the Director of Teaching and could be considered an elder of the academy. He was very valued by the academy.
Now, the Director of Teaching at the academy had been beaten up like a pig. Faced with such a situation, Dean Li was very angry. This was simply provoking their academy and disrespecting Dean Li.

If he did not deal with this matter today, not only would the interns in the academy not be convinced by him in the future, but other peers would also look down on him and treat this matter as a joke.
Dean Li’s expression was ugly. He said to Zhu Shoucheng in a low voice, “How did you end up like this? Who did this?”

“Dean, you have to stand up for me.” Zhu Shoucheng cried bitterly. He opened his fat lips and whimpered as he cried for justice. “Boohoo... Intern Zhang Huaiyao actually brought her boyfriend to hit me in order to become a regular employee. Look at me now. My shoulder blade is broken. Even if I’m cured, it will affect future surgeries. Moreover, my face has changed. How can I face others in the future?!”

Zhu Shoucheng tried his best to make himself sound miserable. He squeezed out a few tears and continued, “Not only that, but that person also beat up the security guards. I now suspect that he’s very likely a professional fighter hired by Zhang Huaiyao. Otherwise, why would he be so fierce? These two people are simply disregarding the law and don’t take you seriously, Dean.”
Zhu Shoucheng complained about his grievances and wailed.

After hearing Zhu Shoucheng’s words and looking at his miserable appearance, Dean Li was extremely angry. He said angrily, “There’s actually such a person. That intern named Zhang Huaiyao must be expelled. The person who injured you must be severely punished!”
“Dean, the perpetrator must be arrested and imprisoned for eight to ten years. Let him know the consequences of harassing the order of our academy.”

Seeing Dean Li flare up, Zhu Shoucheng seemed to have received a huge encouragement. His words became much more unyielding, and a sinister glint flashed across his eyes. He secretly glanced at Chen Yun, who was standing outside the crowd. His gaze seemed to be saying, “Kid, if you dare to hit me, you’re dead.”

Dean Li was very frustrated because Chief Lei had come today and saw such a scene. After being provoked by Zhu Shoucheng, he said angrily, “That person actually dared to cause trouble in the academy. I won’t let him off. There’s also an intern, Zhang Huaiyao. After she’s expelled, she has to be held accountable.”
Seeing this, the surrounding interns knew that Dean Li was in a bad mood. It was best not to provoke him.
However, the internship teacher in the crowd, Zhou Fang, rolled her eyes and stood up. “Sean, this matter is really infuriating. Zhang Huaiyao will do anything to become a full-time employee.”
“Oh? What did she do to you again?”

Dean Li frowned and turned to look at Zhou Fang. The disgust in his eyes flashed. If not for the fact that the Deputy Dean who Zhou Fang sought favor with had contributed a lot to the academy, he would have long kicked this notorious internship teacher out of the academy.

When Zhou Fang saw Dean Li looking over, she sighed and said, “The matter of Zhang Huaiyao becoming a regular employee not only required Director Zhu’s signature, but also mine. Although he didn’t hit me, he forced me to take photos of me taking bribes. He even asked me to recite a paragraph from a piece of paper and record it. He forged evidence of me taking bribes to threaten me to agree to Zhang Huaiyao becoming a regular employee.”
“Was there really such a thing?!”
Dean Li’s expression changed. If the other party really did this, he would be too cunning.
Zhou Fang put on a righteous expression and said, “Director, if I say this, they will definitely publicize the fake evidence and affect me. However, I’m right. Why would I be afraid of rumors?”
Was she upright?

Looking at Zhou Fang’s expression, the surrounding interns could not stand it anymore. This woman relied on the Deputy Dean’s support and was usually sarcastic, domineering, and unreasonable. She actually had the cheek to say that she was upright. This was not just shameless. She had simply thrown her shame away.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Who Are You?! (3)
paragraphs: Moreover, it was obvious that Zhou Fang was afraid that the other party would publicise the recording and photos, so she said this first. Did she think that everyone could not see her motive? Although Dean Li also could not stand Zhou Fang, this was not the time to discuss her character.

After hearing Zhou Fang’s story, he was so angry that his body was trembling. He roared, “There’s actually such a thing? This person hit others and threatened them. Zhang Huaiyao and her accomplice are simply lawless.”
“Do you even take the academy seriously? Do you take the school seriously? Do you take the law seriously?!”

“Dean, it’s not that I’m spouting nonsense, but Zhang Huaiyao is incompetent at work and often screws things up. There were a few times when there were almost teaching accidents. She doesn’t have the conditions to become a regular employee at all. However, she actually threatened us and hit us. You have to stand up for me and the academy.”

Zhou Fang distorted the truth and shouted passionately. A smug smile appeared on her lips. She thought that the bribery matter was finally over and she did not have to worry about being scammed. As for Zhang Huaiyao and that kid, they would be arrested by the police.
Seeing that Dean Li was furious, Zhu Shoucheng encouraged, “Dean, you must help us seek justice and let them receive the punishment they deserve!”
Dean Li snorted coldly. He narrowed his eyes and said in a low voice, “Where’s Zhang Huaiyao and her boyfriend? I want to see which intern is so bold to bring people to cause trouble in my academy!”
Upon hearing this, the interns present quickly dodged and shifted their gazes toward Zhang Huaiyao. They revealed sympathetic expressions which said, “You provoked Dean Li. No one can help you.”

Zhu Shoucheng and Zhou Fang sneered and glared at Zhang Huaiyao. So what if her boyfriend was good at fighting? With Dean Li’s network, he could send them to jail for the rest of your lives in minutes.

Everyone looked at Zhang Huaiyao and felt that she and her boyfriend were doomed. Suddenly, everyone felt a sense of pity. Zhang Huaiyao’s teaching ability was very strong, but she was coveted by Zhu Shoucheng and hated by Zhou Fang. Now, not only was she going to be expelled, but she might also face jail time.

Seeing Dean Li look over, Zhang Huaiyao frowned and gritted her teeth. She took a step forward and stood in front of Chen Yun. She shouted at Dran Li, “Dean Li, these things are all my fault and have nothing to do with my friend. If you want to arrest anyone, get the police to arrest me!”
Although it looked like Chen Yun had completely messed up, Zhang Huaiyao still stood up for him without hesitation.
She did not want Chen Yun to be punished by the law because of her. Moreover, Chen Yun was the one who wanted to help her now. Even if his methods were a little extreme, he was not wrong.
However, Dean Li did not seem to hear Zhang Huaiyao’s shout at this moment. He stared straight ahead and sneered.
“Even now, you still want to cover up for the perpetrator!”
“A mere intern has such guts. If you become a regular employee in the future, how amazing will that be?!”
“It seems like you really don’t take me seriously! You’re really lawless!”
Every harsh reprimand stunned everyone present.
Even those old teachers had never seen Dean Li so angry.

The reason why he was like this was firstly because he was angry. Second, it was because Chief Lei was here. In the end, such a thing happened. If he did not deal with it seriously, putting aside the chance of climbing up, what good impression would he have in front of Chief Lei?!
However, in the next moment, a cold snort suddenly sounded. “Dean Li, you really know how to talk. Just a small intern?”
“Come! Tell me how small an intern can be!”
“Tell me how big a Dean can be!”
“Did you say that we didn’t take you seriously? Who do you think you are? How can you catch my eye?!”
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone was stunned. The hair on their bodies stood on end. They looked at Chen Yun and could not believe what he had said!
“Who do you think you are? How can you catch my eye?!”
These sentences!
He simply did not take the Dean seriously!

sentences.text: Moreover, it was obvious that Zhou Fang was afraid that the other party would publicise the recording and photos, so she said this first.
Did she think that everyone could not see her motive?
Although Dean Li also could not stand Zhou Fang, this was not the time to discuss her character.
After hearing Zhou Fang’s story, he was so angry that his body was trembling.
He roared, “There’s actually such a thing?
This person hit others and threatened them.
Zhang Huaiyao and her accomplice are simply lawless.”
“Do you even take the academy seriously?
Do you take the school seriously?
Do you take the law seriously?!”
“Dean, it’s not that I’m spouting nonsense, but Zhang Huaiyao is incompetent at work and often screws things up.
There were a few times when there were almost teaching accidents.
She doesn’t have the conditions to become a regular employee at all.
However, she actually threatened us and hit us.
You have to stand up for me and the academy.”
Zhou Fang distorted the truth and shouted passionately.
A smug smile appeared on her lips.
She thought that the bribery matter was finally over and she did not have to worry about being scammed.
As for Zhang Huaiyao and that kid, they would be arrested by the police.
Seeing that Dean Li was furious, Zhu Shoucheng encouraged, “Dean, you must help us seek justice and let them receive the punishment they deserve!”
Dean Li snorted coldly.
He narrowed his eyes and said in a low voice, “Where’s Zhang Huaiyao and her boyfriend?
I want to see which intern is so bold to bring people to cause trouble in my academy!”
Upon hearing this, the interns present quickly dodged and shifted their gazes toward Zhang Huaiyao.
They revealed sympathetic expressions which said, “You provoked Dean Li.
No one can help you.”
Zhu Shoucheng and Zhou Fang sneered and glared at Zhang Huaiyao.
So what if her boyfriend was good at fighting?
With Dean Li’s network, he could send them to jail for the rest of your lives in minutes.
Everyone looked at Zhang Huaiyao and felt that she and her boyfriend were doomed.
Suddenly, everyone felt a sense of pity.
Zhang Huaiyao’s teaching ability was very strong, but she was coveted by Zhu Shoucheng and hated by Zhou Fang.
Now, not only was she going to be expelled, but she might also face jail time.
Seeing Dean Li look over, Zhang Huaiyao frowned and gritted her teeth.
She took a step forward and stood in front of Chen Yun.
She shouted at Dran Li, “Dean Li, these things are all my fault and have nothing to do with my friend.
If you want to arrest anyone, get the police to arrest me!”
Although it looked like Chen Yun had completely messed up, Zhang Huaiyao still stood up for him without hesitation.
She did not want Chen Yun to be punished by the law because of her.
Moreover, Chen Yun was the one who wanted to help her now.
Even if his methods were a little extreme, he was not wrong.
However, Dean Li did not seem to hear Zhang Huaiyao’s shout at this moment.
He stared straight ahead and sneered.
“Even now, you still want to cover up for the perpetrator!”
“A mere intern has such guts.
If you become a regular employee in the future, how amazing will that be?!”
“It seems like you really don’t take me seriously!
You’re really lawless!”
Every harsh reprimand stunned everyone present.
Even those old teachers had never seen Dean Li so angry.
The reason why he was like this was firstly because he was angry.
Second, it was because Chief Lei was here.
In the end, such a thing happened.
If he did not deal with it seriously, putting aside the chance of climbing up, what good impression would he have in front of Chief Lei?!
However, in the next moment, a cold snort suddenly sounded.
“Dean Li, you really know how to talk.
Just a small intern?”
“Come!
Tell me how small an intern can be!”
“Tell me how big a Dean can be!”
“Did you say that we didn’t take you seriously?
Who do you think you are?
How can you catch my eye?!”
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone was stunned.
The hair on their bodies stood on end.
They looked at Chen Yun and could not believe what he had said!
“Who do you think you are?
How can you catch my eye?!”
These sentences!
He simply did not take the Dean seriously!

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Am I Qualified Now?!
paragraphs: When Dean Li heard Chen Yun’s words, he gritted his teeth and said, “Alright, alright, alright! Very good! Where are the security guards? Are you all useless?! Hurry up and take him down and hand him over to the police!”
The next moment, footsteps sounded. Everyone looked over and saw Chief Lei running over from afar!
Dean Li was shocked and thought to himself, “This is bad.”
“Chief Lei! I’ve made a fool of myself today. Don’t worry, I’ll definitely deal with this matter strictly...”
Before he could finish speaking, Chief Lei pushed him away. Then, he came in front of Chen Yun and could not help but tremble. He bowed 90 degrees!
“Director... Director Chen.”
Director Chen?!
What kind of title was this?!
For a moment, everyone was stunned, including Zhang Huaiyao.
Dean Li was pushed. Then, he looked at the scene in front of him and his mouth widened. What was this?!
Director Chen?!
Which Director Chen?!
However, in the next moment, he recalled what Chief Lei had said to him previously and looked at Chief Lei’s current actions.
It couldn’t be!
This must be the Director Chen he was talking about!
Then, Dean Li looked at Chen Yun’s face. He was so young!
There was no mistake!
At that moment, Dean Li’s body turned limp and he almost collapsed to the ground!
This was a person with a net worth of more than 20 billion yuan!
What did he say in front of this big shot just now?!

Zhu Shoucheng immediately looked at the scene in front of him and hurriedly said, “Dean, you’re the head of our academy. This person actually said in front of you that you’re nothing and can’t catch his eyes at all. He actually didn’t give you respect. He’s simply arrogant.”
“What do you know? F*ck your mother, do you know who the person bowing is?! That’s Chief Lei from the Education Bureau!”
Unexpectedly, Dean Li turned around and glared at Zhu Shoucheng. His face was filled with disgust as he growled.
Damn it!
What kind of person was Director Chen?!
He was the person standing at the top of Jiang City!
Who did Dean Li think he was? How could he catch the eye of this person?!
There was no need for more. With a word from him, he would be chased out of Shi’en!
Zhu Shoucheng and Zhou Fang were completely scamming him!
When Zhu Shoucheng and Zhou Fang heard Dean Li’s words, their hearts trembled and they were almost scared out of their wits.
It was Chief Lei! He actually bowed to Chen Yun!
In that case, what kind of person was the other party?!
Meanwhile, Chief Lei was silent for a moment. Seeing that Chen Yun did not react after he had bowed for so long, his heart instantly turned cold.
This was bad!
He immediately turned to look at Zhang Huaiyao with a kind smile. “You’re Zhang Huaiyao, right?”
Zhang Huaiyao was still in a daze. She was stunned for a moment before answering, “Yes.”

“You’re indeed a good girl. Just by looking at your appearance, I think you’re a good intern.” Chief Lei praised her and continued, “So, I’ve decided that from today onwards, you’re a regular employee of this academy. As for the official document, I’ll give you special approval.”
“R-really? Thank you!”
Zhang Huaiyao didn’t expect happiness to come so suddenly.
Right on the heels of that, Chief Lei turned to look at Dean Li, Zhu Shoucheng, and Zhou Fang. His expression darkened as he shouted, “What’s going on?! Speak!”

Zhu Shoucheng and Zhou Fang’s faces turned pale. When they heard the reprimand, they walked up fearfully and panicked. The two of them did not expect Chen Yun to be so impressive and awesome that even Chief Lei had to look at his mood.
At that moment, they told him everything they had done. There were some parts they wanted to cover up, but they were all pointed out by the interns who jumped out beside them.
Bit by bit!
Hearing this, Chief Lei’s expression was extremely gloomy!
“Good! Good!” Chief Lei’s eyes widened. “Dean Li, your subordinates are all good people!”
Dean Li was not a fool. He immediately looked at Zhou Fang and Zhu Shoucheng. “The two of you, get lost! Get out of the academy!”
These words made the two of them turn pale. If they left the academy, they would really have nothing left.
There would have no reimbursement for public expenses, no public health checkup, no insurance, no money, no convenience, and no power to call the shots!
Then, Zhu Shoucheng gritted his teeth, “Dean!”

“We’re associate teachers. Moreover, you don’t have the right to expel us, right? You don’t have the right, and Chief Lei doesn’t have the right. If anyone wants to expel us, it can only be the principal or the board of directors!”
These words immediately choked Chief Li.
However, in the next moment, Chen Yun immediately sneered.
“Dean Li, I think that they’re not the only ones who should get lost. As the Dean, with your actions, you don’t have to work anymore.”
These words made everyone’s eyes widen. Chen Yun actually made Dean Li stop working!

At that moment, Dean Li was also furious. He sneered and said, “Director Chen, didn’t you hear that just now? Only the principal and the board of directors can fire us. So what if you call the shots outside? This is ultimately a matter that has occurred in this ivory tower. If you want to interfere, you can’t!”
“Even if you’re rich, you can’t cover up the truth!”
After saying this.
Behind them, the hurried footsteps of a group of people could be heard.
Dean Li turned around and his entire body began to tremble.
The leaders of the school arrived in unison!

“Principal... Principal Zhang.” Dean Li looked at the person in front of him and his voice began to tremble. He did not understand why all the leaders in the school were here now. It had to be known that Principal Zhang had never received someone like Chief Lei.
At this moment, the thin man in the lead walked over. He swept his gaze across the crowd and almost immediately saw Chen Yun. Then, he hurriedly walked over.

His anxious face instantly softened. He even squeezed out a smile and looked at Chen Yun like a mouse seeing a cat. He quickly walked to Chen Yun and reached out his hand. “Director Chen, I’m the principal of Shi’en University.”
Then, he turned to look at the leaders in the school. “What are you waiting for? Hurry up and greet Director Chen. Director Chen is the new director of our school.”
Principal Zhang frowned and looked at everyone. Everyone immediately smiled bitterly in their hearts. They were only stunned just now. They did not expect Chen Yun to be too young!
He was so young, yet he had so many shares!
It was simply too shocking.
At that moment, they all bowed to Chen Yun!
“Hello, Director Chen!”
Their voices reverberated throughout the entire floor. At the same time, it surged in everyone’s minds.
“Hello, Director Chen!”
This sentence almost made Dean Li’s eyes pop out of their sockets. Director Chen was the new director of the school!
At the same time, Zhu Shoucheng and Zhou Fang also had looks of disbelief.
At that moment, their bodies began to tremble.
Chen Yun looked at them, his eyes filled with coldness. “Tell me, am I qualified now?”
“Tell me, am I qualified now?!”
The last sentence made Dean Li and the other two collapse to the ground, their faces as if they had lost their parents!

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Are You Fine with Zhang Huaiyao Taking the Position?
paragraphs: Meanwhile, everyone was still at a loss. Chief Lei walked in front of Principal Zhang and whispered to him for a while. After a while, Principal Zhang’s expression changed drastically. His originally smiling face suddenly became extremely gloomy!
What kind of identity did Chen Yun have?!
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
He was the top figure in Jiang City!
Moreover, he was a director of Shi’en University and occupied 70 to 80% of the shares!
How did this group of blind people provoke Chen Yun?!
If Chen Yun was unwilling, not only would they be fired, but even he might be kicked away from his position!

“Security! Where are the security guards!” Principal Zhang roared for a moment. “Go! Throw them out. Secretary Liu, investigate them carefully. One by one, one by one! You can’t let them off. I want to see how they can hide the truth from the school!”
Principal Zhang shouted the last sentence.
It made Secretary Liu, who was beside him, start to tremble.
The security guards obeyed and dragged them away.
After settling the matter, Principal Zhang looked at Chen Yun and put on a humble smile. “Director Chen, do you think it’s appropriate for me to handle the situation like this?”
“There’s a problem with your management.” Chen Yun’s words made cold sweat break out on Principal Zhang’s forehead. He nodded repeatedly. “Yes, yes. I’ll start dealing with these things now.”
“That won’t be necessary.”

“Establish a special section specially set up to deal with such unhealthy behavior in the school. As for the management personnel, Zhang Huaiyao will be in charge. Do you have any objections?” Chen Yun looked at him. Principal Zhang felt a huge pressure on his body for a moment. He had never felt such pressure before.
Chen Yun had such a huge aura, such a huge aura!
At that moment, he could only nod quickly. “I have no objections. What Director Chen said is also what I wanted to say.”
“Director Chen, do you have time now? I’ll report the situation to you,” said Principal Zhang to Chen Yun, who nodded.
After informing Zhang Huaiyao, Chen Yun went downstairs with everyone.
However, the entire fifth floor was still immersed in silence.
After a while, everyone’s gaze landed on Zhang Huaiyao.
“Huaiyao, is that boy really just your childhood friend? How much money did he invest in the school? Even Principal Zhang is so respectful to him.”
“Does he have a girlfriend? If you don’t mind, can you introduce him to me?”
“Huaiyao, I’ll follow you from now on. With Principal Zhang protecting you, no one in the entire school will dare to provoke you.”

The few medical staff who were on good terms with Zhang Huaiyao spoke at once, their eyes filled with envy. They wondered why they couldn’t meet such a handsome, impressive, and awesome childhood friend.
As for those who usually didn’t like Zhang Huaiyao, they cried and regretted it. If they had known that Zhang Huaiyao had such a powerful background, they would have fawned over her long ago.
As the center of attention, Zhang Huaiyao was in a daze, as if she was dreaming.
Even she could not believe what had happened.
After all, she and Chen Yun knew each other very well. Chen Yun’s family was not very rich. Why did he directly invest in the school?
If not for Principal Zhang’s actions, she would have thought that Principal Zhang had recognized the wrong person.
However, no matter what, she was still extremely excited. She had not only been promoted from a minor intern to a regular employee, but she had also taken on a heavy responsibility in school.
After chatting for a while, Chen Yun walked out of the office under the respectful escort of the school leaders. Zhang Huaiyao was already waiting outside.
“Huaiyao, you must be anxious from waiting.”
Zhang Huaiyao suddenly shook her head. “There’s no hurry. Chen Yun, why did you think of investing in the school?”
Chen Yun smiled. He really did not have any intention of investing in the school now. However, he could not stand the free lunch that fell from the sky.
He didn’t want to either and was in despair.
If Zhang Huaiyao knew what Chen Yun was thinking, she would definitely give him 1,000 points for showing off.
However, she did not have such a divine power.
Seeing that Chen Yun was silent, she thought that he had asked something he shouldn’t have, so she immediately changed the topic.

“Chen Yun, my father just told me that there was a dinner gathering tonight. After that, he heard that you’re also in Shi’en and asked me to call you. Are you free tonight?” Zhang Huaiyao asked carefully. Chen Yun naturally had no objections.
However, he was a little puzzled. “Why is Uncle Zhang here in Shi’en?”

“My father contacted an old classmate of his at a class reunion previously and reached a long-term collaboration, so he came over. Coincidentally, I’m also doing an internship here, so my mother came over to take a look too.”
“Since she knew that you’re here, my mother asked me to tell you to go over too.”

“Oh? Is Auntie here too?” Chen Yun missed the times when their families were in the courtyard during their childhood. At that time, they would gather together to play all day long. If any family cooked a good meal, they would gather together.
Therefore, when they were young, they had gained a lot of weight together for a period of time. They only lost weight during their adolescence.
At night, at the entrance of the Heavenly Horse Hotel beside the Shi’en People’s Square.
Chen Yun and Zhang Huaiyao came over in a taxi. As soon as they got out of the car, Father and Mother Zhang saw the two of them. Chen Yun waved at them. “Uncle Zhang, Auntie Zhang.”

“Haha, Xiao Yun!” Uncle Zhang quickly took two steps forward and arrived in front of Chen Yun. He patted his shoulder with both hands. “How long has it been since we last met? Look at how promising you’ve become. You’ve really inherited Brother Chen and your mother’s good genes.”

“That’s right, that’s right.” Auntie Zhang looked at Chen Yun with surprise in her eyes. “Xiao Yun, it’s said that women change 18 times when they grow up. It looks like young men are the same. I didn’t recognize you just now. In my impression, you still look like that chubby boy from back then.”
Chen Yun also smiled. He had been very fat for a period of time back then.
“Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang are still as elegant as ever.” Chen Yun’s words made the two of them wave their hands repeatedly. “We’re all old. We’ll have to rely on you in the future.”
“Dad, who are you waiting for? Shall we go in?” Zhang Huaiyao asked. Uncle Zhang shook his head. “Wait, I invited Uncle Yu’s family tonight. They should be here soon.”

“It just so happens that you haven’t seen Uncle Yu yet. Uncle Yu is in Shi’en and his business is not small. You have to be polite tonight. However, his daughter used to be in the same school as you. You might know her.” As Uncle Zhang spoke, he looked at the trunk of the car and thought of the gifts inside. He sighed in his heart. He invited Uncle Yu tonight for no other reason than to use his strength to make his daughter become a regular employee in school.
After a while, a Jaguar stopped not far from them and a few figures got out.
“Brother Yu.”
Uncle Zhang walked up and shook hands with the middle-aged man opposite him.
Yu Qingfeng looked at Uncle Zhang and nodded. Then, he introduced, “This is my daughter, Yu Ran. This is Ranran’s boyfriend, Li Jiayi. Ranran, Huaiyao, do the two of you know each other?”

“Yes, Huaiyao used to be an influential figure in our school.” Yu Ran looked at Zhang Huaiyao. Although she was smiling, her eyes were filled with disdain. Previously, she and Zhang Huaiyao were junior high school classmates.
At that time, Zhang Huaiyao had just shown her looks and good grades. Naturally, she was sought after by a group of boys.
However, looking at her now, she didn’t seem like much. Zhang Huaiyao’s father still had to be respectful to them and ask for their help.
Moreover, looking at Zhang Huaiyao’s plain clothes, they simply could not compare to her branded clothes.
At that moment, her eyes were filled with disdain. After all, she was no longer on the same level as Zhang Huaiyao.
The poor had class restrictions. They were short-sighted and had insufficient horizons.
If she hung out with such a person, Yu Ran was afraid that her horizons would be lowered.
Beside him, Li Jiayi, who was in a suit, looked at Zhang Huaiyao beside him with a stunned expression.
The appearance that Zhang Huaiyao revealed was something that none of the women he had met had.
For a moment, a strange gaze flashed across his eyes, but he hid it very well.

Then, he looked at the car driven by Zhang Huaiyao’s father and the dressing of this family. He laughed in his heart and the desire in his eyes intensified. Then, he looked at Chen Yun and suddenly felt a sense of danger. He was also deep in thought.
Everyone had their own thoughts and entered the hotel together.
As the meal ended, everyone’s chatterbox slowly opened.
Yu Qingfeng looked at Chen Yun and said to Uncle Zhang, “Brother Zhang, is this your son-in-law?”

“No, he’s the son of a friend of mine. He and Huaiyao were childhood friends. He’s studying at the Jiang City University of Science and Technology now.” Uncle Chen introduced Chen Yun, but his eyes were shining. Among the people in their neighborhood, Chen Yun could be said to have attended the best university.
Haha.

“The Jiang City University of Science and Technology is not bad.” Yu Qingfeng looked at Chen Yun. They were already so intimate. Wasn’t he his son-in-law? If he wasn’t his son-in-law, why would he bring him here?
“How’s business recently?” Uncle Zhang then asked Yu Qingfeng, who waved his hand. “What’s so bad about my small business? I was able to have a place in Shi’en because of my son-in-law’s ability.”
Oh?

Uncle Zhang looked at Li Jiayi, who was beside him. Li Jiayi met his gaze and puffed out his chest slightly. “Uncle Yu, you flatter me. I only became the general manager of Zhenghai’s chain swimming club.”
Beside him, Mother Yu laughed. “Little Li, don’t be so humble. What do you mean by that? By the way, we haven’t heard you explain in detail.”
As soon as these words were spoken, Mother Yu’s face turned red as she looked at Li Jiayi.
Li Jiayi also put on the appearance of a successful person and spoke.

“The Zhenghai Swimming Club mainly served high-end customers. Currently, there are already more than 50 chain stores distributed in five-star hotels in various cities in the country. We can use the flow of hotel customers and the environment to effectively develop our customer base. The company is still developing. In the future, I will add more high-end projects. I believe that in at most five years, the company will reach a market value of one billion.”
This!
As soon as these words were spoken, Uncle Zhang’s eyes widened. A billion yuan!
He couldn’t tell!
He was able to become the general manager of such a company at such a young age!
The younger generation really surpassed them!
“I really didn’t expect this.” Uncle Zhang praised him.
Yu Qingfeng laughed. “We’re already old. Even these children can’t catch up.”

Then, Li Jiayi glanced at Chen Yun in disdain and chuckled. “Uncles, you’re flattering me. I actually relied on my Stanford education to enter back then. I only got promoted after accepting a few big orders.”

“By the way, I heard that Brother Chen is currently studying at the Jiang City University of Science and Technology. Coincidentally, a few of my colleagues graduated from the Jiang City University of Science and Technology.”
When Auntie Zhang heard this, she took the opportunity to say, “Isn’t that just nice? Xiao Yun is about to graduate. Xiao Li, look, can you...”

Before she could finish speaking, Li Jiayi interrupted, “This, Auntie, I really can’t do it. After all, I’m just a general manager and work for others. Moreover, the bottom-level people here all have graduate degrees from universities under the 211 Project. I’m afraid with Brother Chen’s educational background, it’s a little difficult.”
“Moreover, our company only recruits elites.”
“Hehe, I’m clumsy with my words. I wonder if Uncle and Auntie understand what I mean.” Li Jiayi chuckled. “I’m not targeting Brother Chen. I’m just helpless.”
As soon as he said this, Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang’s faces suddenly darkened. Even the polite smile on Zhang Huaiyao’s face gradually froze.

sentences.text: Meanwhile, everyone was still at a loss.
Chief Lei walked in front of Principal Zhang and whispered to him for a while.
After a while, Principal Zhang’s expression changed drastically.
His originally smiling face suddenly became extremely gloomy!
What kind of identity did Chen Yun have?!
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
He was the top figure in Jiang City!
Moreover, he was a director of Shi’en University and occupied 70 to 80% of the shares!
How did this group of blind people provoke Chen Yun?!
If Chen Yun was unwilling, not only would they be fired, but even he might be kicked away from his position!
“Security!
Where are the security guards!” Principal Zhang roared for a moment.
“Go!
Throw them out.
Secretary Liu, investigate them carefully.
One by one, one by one!
You can’t let them off.
I want to see how they can hide the truth from the school!”
Principal Zhang shouted the last sentence.
It made Secretary Liu, who was beside him, start to tremble.
The security guards obeyed and dragged them away.
After settling the matter, Principal Zhang looked at Chen Yun and put on a humble smile.
“Director Chen, do you think it’s appropriate for me to handle the situation like this?”
“There’s a problem with your management.” Chen Yun’s words made cold sweat break out on Principal Zhang’s forehead.
He nodded repeatedly.
“Yes, yes.
I’ll start dealing with these things now.”
“That won’t be necessary.”
“Establish a special section specially set up to deal with such unhealthy behavior in the school.
As for the management personnel, Zhang Huaiyao will be in charge.
Do you have any objections?” Chen Yun looked at him.
Principal Zhang felt a huge pressure on his body for a moment.
He had never felt such pressure before.
Chen Yun had such a huge aura, such a huge aura!
At that moment, he could only nod quickly.
“I have no objections.
What Director Chen said is also what I wanted to say.”
“Director Chen, do you have time now?
I’ll report the situation to you,” said Principal Zhang to Chen Yun, who nodded.
After informing Zhang Huaiyao, Chen Yun went downstairs with everyone.
However, the entire fifth floor was still immersed in silence.
After a while, everyone’s gaze landed on Zhang Huaiyao.
“Huaiyao, is that boy really just your childhood friend?
How much money did he invest in the school?
Even Principal Zhang is so respectful to him.”
“Does he have a girlfriend?
If you don’t mind, can you introduce him to me?”
“Huaiyao, I’ll follow you from now on.
With Principal Zhang protecting you, no one in the entire school will dare to provoke you.”
The few medical staff who were on good terms with Zhang Huaiyao spoke at once, their eyes filled with envy.
They wondered why they couldn’t meet such a handsome, impressive, and awesome childhood friend.
As for those who usually didn’t like Zhang Huaiyao, they cried and regretted it.
If they had known that Zhang Huaiyao had such a powerful background, they would have fawned over her long ago.
As the center of attention, Zhang Huaiyao was in a daze, as if she was dreaming.
Even she could not believe what had happened.
After all, she and Chen Yun knew each other very well.
Chen Yun’s family was not very rich.
Why did he directly invest in the school?
If not for Principal Zhang’s actions, she would have thought that Principal Zhang had recognized the wrong person.
However, no matter what, she was still extremely excited.
She had not only been promoted from a minor intern to a regular employee, but she had also taken on a heavy responsibility in school.
After chatting for a while, Chen Yun walked out of the office under the respectful escort of the school leaders.
Zhang Huaiyao was already waiting outside.
“Huaiyao, you must be anxious from waiting.”
Zhang Huaiyao suddenly shook her head.
“There’s no hurry.
Chen Yun, why did you think of investing in the school?”
Chen Yun smiled.
He really did not have any intention of investing in the school now.
However, he could not stand the free lunch that fell from the sky.
He didn’t want to either and was in despair.
If Zhang Huaiyao knew what Chen Yun was thinking, she would definitely give him 1,000 points for showing off.
However, she did not have such a divine power.
Seeing that Chen Yun was silent, she thought that he had asked something he shouldn’t have, so she immediately changed the topic.
“Chen Yun, my father just told me that there was a dinner gathering tonight.
After that, he heard that you’re also in Shi’en and asked me to call you.
Are you free tonight?” Zhang Huaiyao asked carefully.
Chen Yun naturally had no objections.
However, he was a little puzzled.
“Why is Uncle Zhang here in Shi’en?”
“My father contacted an old classmate of his at a class reunion previously and reached a long-term collaboration, so he came over.
Coincidentally, I’m also doing an internship here, so my mother came over to take a look too.”
“Since she knew that you’re here, my mother asked me to tell you to go over too.”
“Oh?
Is Auntie here too?” Chen Yun missed the times when their families were in the courtyard during their childhood.
At that time, they would gather together to play all day long.
If any family cooked a good meal, they would gather together.
Therefore, when they were young, they had gained a lot of weight together for a period of time.
They only lost weight during their adolescence.
At night, at the entrance of the Heavenly Horse Hotel beside the Shi’en People’s Square.
Chen Yun and Zhang Huaiyao came over in a taxi.
As soon as they got out of the car, Father and Mother Zhang saw the two of them.
Chen Yun waved at them.
“Uncle Zhang, Auntie Zhang.”
“Haha, Xiao Yun!” Uncle Zhang quickly took two steps forward and arrived in front of Chen Yun.
He patted his shoulder with both hands.
“How long has it been since we last met?
Look at how promising you’ve become.
You’ve really inherited Brother Chen and your mother’s good genes.”
“That’s right, that’s right.” Auntie Zhang looked at Chen Yun with surprise in her eyes.
“Xiao Yun, it’s said that women change 18 times when they grow up.
It looks like young men are the same.
I didn’t recognize you just now.
In my impression, you still look like that chubby boy from back then.”
Chen Yun also smiled.
He had been very fat for a period of time back then.
“Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang are still as elegant as ever.” Chen Yun’s words made the two of them wave their hands repeatedly.
“We’re all old.
We’ll have to rely on you in the future.”
“Dad, who are you waiting for?
Shall we go in?” Zhang Huaiyao asked.
Uncle Zhang shook his head.
“Wait, I invited Uncle Yu’s family tonight.
They should be here soon.”
“It just so happens that you haven’t seen Uncle Yu yet.
Uncle Yu is in Shi’en and his business is not small.
You have to be polite tonight.
However, his daughter used to be in the same school as you.
You might know her.” As Uncle Zhang spoke, he looked at the trunk of the car and thought of the gifts inside.
He sighed in his heart.
He invited Uncle Yu tonight for no other reason than to use his strength to make his daughter become a regular employee in school.
After a while, a Jaguar stopped not far from them and a few figures got out.
“Brother Yu.”
Uncle Zhang walked up and shook hands with the middle-aged man opposite him.
Yu Qingfeng looked at Uncle Zhang and nodded.
Then, he introduced, “This is my daughter, Yu Ran.
This is Ranran’s boyfriend, Li Jiayi.
Ranran, Huaiyao, do the two of you know each other?”
“Yes, Huaiyao used to be an influential figure in our school.” Yu Ran looked at Zhang Huaiyao.
Although she was smiling, her eyes were filled with disdain.
Previously, she and Zhang Huaiyao were junior high school classmates.
At that time, Zhang Huaiyao had just shown her looks and good grades.
Naturally, she was sought after by a group of boys.
However, looking at her now, she didn’t seem like much.
Zhang Huaiyao’s father still had to be respectful to them and ask for their help.
Moreover, looking at Zhang Huaiyao’s plain clothes, they simply could not compare to her branded clothes.
At that moment, her eyes were filled with disdain.
After all, she was no longer on the same level as Zhang Huaiyao.
The poor had class restrictions.
They were short-sighted and had insufficient horizons.
If she hung out with such a person, Yu Ran was afraid that her horizons would be lowered.
Beside him, Li Jiayi, who was in a suit, looked at Zhang Huaiyao beside him with a stunned expression.
The appearance that Zhang Huaiyao revealed was something that none of the women he had met had.
For a moment, a strange gaze flashed across his eyes, but he hid it very well.
Then, he looked at the car driven by Zhang Huaiyao’s father and the dressing of this family.
He laughed in his heart and the desire in his eyes intensified.
Then, he looked at Chen Yun and suddenly felt a sense of danger.
He was also deep in thought.
Everyone had their own thoughts and entered the hotel together.
As the meal ended, everyone’s chatterbox slowly opened.
Yu Qingfeng looked at Chen Yun and said to Uncle Zhang, “Brother Zhang, is this your son-in-law?”
“No, he’s the son of a friend of mine.
He and Huaiyao were childhood friends.
He’s studying at the Jiang City University of Science and Technology now.” Uncle Chen introduced Chen Yun, but his eyes were shining.
Among the people in their neighborhood, Chen Yun could be said to have attended the best university.
Haha.
“The Jiang City University of Science and Technology is not bad.” Yu Qingfeng looked at Chen Yun.
They were already so intimate.
Wasn’t he his son-in-law?
If he wasn’t his son-in-law, why would he bring him here?
“How’s business recently?” Uncle Zhang then asked Yu Qingfeng, who waved his hand.
“What’s so bad about my small business?
I was able to have a place in Shi’en because of my son-in-law’s ability.”
Oh?
Uncle Zhang looked at Li Jiayi, who was beside him.
Li Jiayi met his gaze and puffed out his chest slightly.
“Uncle Yu, you flatter me.
I only became the general manager of Zhenghai’s chain swimming club.”
Beside him, Mother Yu laughed.
“Little Li, don’t be so humble.
What do you mean by that?
By the way, we haven’t heard you explain in detail.”
As soon as these words were spoken, Mother Yu’s face turned red as she looked at Li Jiayi.
Li Jiayi also put on the appearance of a successful person and spoke.
“The Zhenghai Swimming Club mainly served high-end customers.
Currently, there are already more than 50 chain stores distributed in five-star hotels in various cities in the country.
We can use the flow of hotel customers and the environment to effectively develop our customer base.
The company is still developing.
In the future, I will add more high-end projects.
I believe that in at most five years, the company will reach a market value of one billion.”
This!
As soon as these words were spoken, Uncle Zhang’s eyes widened.
A billion yuan!
He couldn’t tell!
He was able to become the general manager of such a company at such a young age!
The younger generation really surpassed them!
“I really didn’t expect this.” Uncle Zhang praised him.
Yu Qingfeng laughed.
“We’re already old.
Even these children can’t catch up.”
Then, Li Jiayi glanced at Chen Yun in disdain and chuckled.
“Uncles, you’re flattering me.
I actually relied on my Stanford education to enter back then.
I only got promoted after accepting a few big orders.”
“By the way, I heard that Brother Chen is currently studying at the Jiang City University of Science and Technology.
Coincidentally, a few of my colleagues graduated from the Jiang City University of Science and Technology.”
When Auntie Zhang heard this, she took the opportunity to say, “Isn’t that just nice?
Xiao Yun is about to graduate.
Xiao Li, look, can you...”
Before she could finish speaking, Li Jiayi interrupted, “This, Auntie, I really can’t do it.
After all, I’m just a general manager and work for others.
Moreover, the bottom-level people here all have graduate degrees from universities under the 211 Project.
I’m afraid with Brother Chen’s educational background, it’s a little difficult.”
“Moreover, our company only recruits elites.”
“Hehe, I’m clumsy with my words.
I wonder if Uncle and Auntie understand what I mean.” Li Jiayi chuckled.
“I’m not targeting Brother Chen.
I’m just helpless.”
As soon as he said this, Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang’s faces suddenly darkened.
Even the polite smile on Zhang Huaiyao’s face gradually froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Is One Billion a Lot? (1)
paragraphs: No one was a fool!
How could they not understand?!
First, he showed off his Stanford education.
Then, he said that they only wanted graduate students.
What did he mean by only wanting elites?
The meaning behind his words was self-evident!

At the side, Yu Ran also smiled. “I’ve been to Jiayi’s company. The people there are all energetic. Thinking about it, how can a company with a market value of one billion yuan want someone from the bottom?”
“A thousand-mile dam can be destroyed by an ant nest. Perhaps the company’s foundation will be eaten away.”

These words made Uncle Zhang’s expression extremely gloomy. If it were any other time, he would have long lost his temper. However, today, he had a favor to ask of them and had to look at the other party’s expression. He could only prepare to deliberately change the topic and look at Chen Yun comfortingly.
Today, it was his fault.
He would definitely make it up to Chen Yun in the future.
However, before he could speak, Chen Yun sneered. “Is a market value of a billion yuan a lot?”
Was a market value of one billion yuan a lot?!
These words fell into everyone’s ears.
It was like an explosion!
Was a market value of one billion yuan a lot?!
It was already a lot!
Yu Ran looked at Chen Yun and immediately found it funny. Did he know what he was talking about?
“Yo, what a big tone. Do you want to learn from others? Set a small goal and earn 100 million yuan first, okay?”

Beside her, Li Jiayi also said disdainfully, “Ranran, don’t say that. It’s not like Brother Chen hasn’t stepped into society yet. When he does, he’ll know. Without money, a man is nothing. The people under me who came from universities under the 211 Project will probably only be able to buy a toilet after working for a year.”
Meanwhile, Uncle Zhang coughed. “Xiao Yun was just joking, just joking.”

Li Jiayi looked at Uncle Zhang’s expression and thought to himself that something was wrong. He wanted to trick Zhang Huaiyao into sleeping with him too. He could not go overboard tonight. Now was the right time. He had a smile on his face. “Uncle Zhang, perhaps my words just now were a little rash. I’m a straightforward person. Please don’t take offense.”

“How about this? I’ll punish myself with a cup. I’ll treat you to dinner tonight and go pay the bill later. Uncle Zhang, don’t snatch it from me,” said Li Jiayi generously. These words made him look much better.

At that moment, he looked at the changes in everyone’s expressions and sneered in his heart. He was familiar with these words and the technique of controlling people’s hearts. He thought that he could achieve 90 points with his actions!
This time, not only did he step on Chen Yun, but he also did not destroy his image. It was simply killing two birds with one stone.

Seeing that Li Jiayi also wanted to pay the bill, Mother Yu couldn’t help but frown. She felt very embarrassed and asked, “Xiao Li, doesn’t your swimming club also collaborate with this hotel? Why do you still have to pay? Can’t you just greet them?”

Li Jiayi explained, “Auntie, I share the revenue from the swimming club with the hotel in a 3:7 ratio. Therefore, regardless of whether it’s the hotel or me, if we spend here or at the swimming club, we have to pay the bill.”
“Do you have to give 70% to the hotel? That’s too shady,” muttered Mother Yu.

Li Jiayi said, “There’s nothing I can do about that. The hotel provided the venue. Many swimming clubs want to open a pool here. The hotel doesn’t lack partners, so the hotel has to take the bulk of the profits by running this swimming club in the hotel.”
Mother Yu said enviously, “You’re in charge of the renovation, management, and staff. However, the hotel is the one earning money. It’s too profitable for the hotel.”

Li Jiayi had the intention to show off. He continued, “Auntie, don’t underestimate this swimming club. It can generate a net profit of at least five million yuan a year. Even if I give the hotel 70%, I can still get more than a million yuan with these results. This is not a small sum. Moreover, I spent a lot of effort to open a swimming club in this hotel. Otherwise, among so many swimming clubs and managers, the hotel wouldn’t have chosen to cooperate with me.”
Uncle Zhang was more interested in doing business. He asked, “Oh, tell me about it. How did you get the cooperation rights for your swimming club?”

Li Jiayi looked at Chen Yun, who was sitting at the side without saying a word, in disdain. His face revealed a hint of pride as he said, “The boss of the hotel is called Qian Wei. He’s a rather capable boss in Shi’en. Other than this hotel, he has many other real estate projects and has assets of at least three billion yuan. The reason why I could obtain the cooperation rights to the swimming club is through Qian Wei’s driver.”

Uncle Zhang and Yu Qingfeng nodded. “Drivers are often the closest people to the boss. With Boss Qian’s driver around, it won’t be a problem for you to get the cooperation rights for the swimming club. It’s not easy for you to come into contact with Boss Qian’s driver in Shi’en.”

Li Jiayi said proudly, “It’s indeed not easy. I spent a lot of effort to gain the driver’s trust. Moreover, to be honest with you, Uncle, I promised to give him half of the annual profits. That’s why he ran around and helped me settle this matter.”
Hearing this, Yu Qingfeng nodded and praised, “Sharing benefits can last long. It seems that although you’re young, you have a very thorough understanding of the ways of the world.”
“Uncle, you flatter me. I also fell many times to achieve my current achievements,” said Li Jiayi in a boastful manner.

When Mother Yu heard these words, her eyes were filled with admiration. She looked at Chen Yun, who was looking around and not listening to their conversation carefully. She frowned and said, “Little Chen, Huaiyao, you should learn more from Li Jiayi. In the future, when you enter society, even if you don’t become a general manager like Li Jiayi, you can’t be too bad.”
Li Jiayi waved at the waiter waiting for them outside the glass of the private room. The waiter quickly walked over. Li Jiayi said to the waiter, “Give me the bill.”
The waiter pressed the machine in his hand. After a while, the cashier at the front desk entered the private room.
The cashier revealed a friendly smile and said, “General Manager Li, the total amount spent is 3,800 yuan.”

When they heard that it was 3,800 yuan, Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang were a little speechless. They had not looked at the price when they ordered the dishes previously. There were only a few ordinary dishes and there were no delicacies, but the cost was already so high. It was indeed a big hotel. This was too expensive.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Is One Billion a Lot? (2)
paragraphs: When he heard that there was only this amount of money, Li Jiayi took out red notes from his wallet. After counting them, he said, “Here’s 4,000 yuan. The remaining 200 yuan is for your expenses.” However, just as Li Jiayi was about to pay, the cashier added, “General Manager Li, someone has already paid your bill just now.”
What? Had his bill been paid for?
Hearing this, everyone was stunned. They looked at each other, not knowing who paid for this.

Li Jiayi frowned and thought to himself, “I didn’t pay. Could it be that Chen Yun gave the money? That’s impossible. He’s a poor student. From the looks of it, this 3,000 yuan is enough for his living expenses for three months. How could he have paid for it? No one else has left the private room.”
Li Jiayi put away the wallet he had just taken out and looked at the cashier. “Do you know who paid?”
The cashier said, “General Manager Li, it’s Manager Yang.”
Manager Yang?

Li Jiayi thought about it and suddenly came to a realization. Manager Yang was Boss Qian’s driver, Yang Hang. In order to flatter Yang Hang, he asked the staff to call him Manager Yang, which made Yang Hang very pleased.
However, Li Jiayi couldn’t understand. Yang Hang was someone he needed to seek favor with. Why did he suddenly react? What kind of benevolence did Yang Hang show? He actually helped him pay the bill!
Li Jiayi didn’t think too much about it and asked the cashier, “Where’s Manager Yang? Where is he?”
“Manager Yang went upstairs just now. He seems to be accompanying a guest.”
When he heard that Yang Hang had left, Li Jiayi could not help but be a little disappointed because he had lost another chance to show off.
Of course, this did not stop him from bragging in front of everyone.
As Li Jiayi had expected, Mother Yu asked, “Xiao Li, who is Manager Yang?”

Li Jiayi smiled and pretended to be calm. “Manager Yang is Boss Qian’s driver. His real name is Yang Hang. Although he’s only a driver, because of his special identity, President Qian’s subordinates call him Manager Yang.”

When she heard that Manager Yang was Boss Qian’s driver, Mother Yu said in surprise, “Xiao Li, it seems that you have a good relationship with him. He helped you pay the bill and left without saying goodbye. He’s really giving you enough respect.”
“Auntie, you flatter me. We’re all here to do business. We’re all helping each other,” said Li Jiayi proudly.
Looking at Li Jiayi’s smug expression, Zhang Huaiyao was unhappy. “Dad, it’s getting late. We should leave.”
Seeing that it was about time, Li Jiayi couldn’t say anything and could only get up.

However, in the next moment, a woman in a professional suit hurriedly walked in. Her head was covered in sweat. Seeing that everyone was about to leave, she hurriedly said, “Dear guests, our boss asked us to send two bottles of wine over, but the key to the wine cellar was broken. It’s our fault for only bringing it over now.”
The manager spoke apologetically as she broke out in cold sweat.
“This hotel is not bad. They actually gave us wine.”

Mother Yu smiled. She picked up the red wine on the table and looked at it. The smile on her face immediately stiffened as she exclaimed, “This... This wine is too good. It’s dried red wine from the special garden of the Romanée-Conti Winery!”

At the same time, Yu Qingfeng, who had picked up the other bottle of wine, also said in surprise, “Your bottle of red wine is nothing. The bottle of baijiu [1. a strong distilled spirit unavoidable at Chinese social functions] in my hand is actually a bottle of 1949 Maotai. There are only 100,000 bottles of this in the country. It’s worth at least hundreds of thousands. This hotel is really too generous.”
When they realized that the two bottles of wine were good wine, everyone present was shocked.

The dishes on this table only cost more than 3,000 yuan, but the two bottles of wine given by the hotel were worth hundreds of thousands. What was going on? Everyone could not wrap their heads around it.
Uncle Zhang carefully sized up the baijiu in his hand and muttered, “This wine... can’t be fake, right?”
Mother Yu rolled her eyes at him and sneered. “How can such a big hotel give fake wine? Isn’t this ruining their own reputation?”
Beside him, Yu Qingfeng also said in disbelief, “We only ate more than 3,000 yuan worth of dishes, but they gave away hundreds of thousands of yuan worth of wine. What do you think is going on?”

Mother Yu thought for a moment and her gaze landed on Li Jiayi. Her eyes immediately lit up and she said, “I understand. The reason why we have such special treatment is definitely because of Xiao Li.”
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded and thought that this should be the case. Otherwise, why would the hotel give these two bottles of wine worth hundreds of thousands of yuan?
Actually, Li Jiayi was very nervous. He knew best how capable he was.

It was already surprising enough that the driver, Yang Hang, helped him pay the bill at the swimming club. Now, he actually gave him hundreds of thousands of yuan worth of wine for dinner. He believed that he definitely did not receive this much respect from Yang Hang.

However, since everyone thought so, he could only brace himself and pretend to be calm. “I think Manager Yang must have gotten someone to send it over. Uncle and Auntie, let’s not leave in a hurry. Why don’t we try this wine? I can only repay Manager Yang’s kindness later.”
Yu Qingfeng said, “Yes, yes, yes. He values you so much. You can’t neglect him.”

Li Jiayi smiled and opened both bottles of wine. The women drank the red wine while the men drank the baijiu. Uncle Zhang got someone to add a few more dishes for everyone to continue tasting the wine.

“It’s indeed a little wasteful. Usually, we wouldn’t drink this kind of wine. This time, it’s all thanks to Li Jiayi.” Mother Yu smiled and became more and more satisfied with Li Jiayi.

Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang also nodded with a sigh. This wine was much better than the wine they usually drank. Although they did not know how to taste it, they could still taste the most basic taste.

Upon receiving praise, Li Jiayi was overjoyed. He immediately sought favor with them and said, “It’s fine. As long as the two uncles like this wine, I can often give it to you to drink in the future.”
At this moment, the door of the private room was knocked on. A middle-aged man in casual clothes walked in with a warm smile on his face.
