chapters.title: Chapter 158: Do You Deserve a Lot of Respect?!
paragraphs: The middle-aged man was originally pacing outside. Then, he looked at Li Jiayi inside and was shocked. Then, he quickly came in and said, “General Manager Li, you’re really dishonest. You didn’t even inform me when you arrived at the hotel. No matter what, I have to treat you well.”
Li Jiayi took a closer look. Wasn’t this Qian Wei’s driver, Yang Hang? However, he used to be arrogant. Why was he so enthusiastic today? What was going on?

Previously, when Li Jiayi wanted to obtain the collaboration rights for the swimming club, he could be said to have flattered Yang Hang to the extreme. If not for the promise of half the profits, Yang Hang would not even look at him.
However, today, Yang Hang’s attitude had changed drastically. Moreover, he had changed from calling him “Little Li” to “General Manager Li”, making Li Jiayi a little confused.
However, Li Jiayi had been in society for a long time after all. He did not panic. He smiled and went up to him. “Brother Yang, come, come, let’s drink together.”
“That’s why I’m here.”
Yang Hang did not decline and sat down beside Li Jiayi.
Li Jiayi introduced him to everyone. “This is Manager Yang, whom I mentioned just now. He’s a forthright person. He helped me a lot in my business. He’s my benefactor.”
When they heard that the person in front of them was the driver of the big boss, Qian Wei, no one dared to underestimate him. They all smiled and greeted Yang Hang.
However, Yang Hang lowered his posture. He stood up and bowed to them. “Uncle, Auntie, are you satisfied with the two bottles of wine today?”
Seeing the other party’s attitude, the few of them were flattered. They quickly smiled and nodded in satisfaction.

When Li Jiayi saw this, he had long thrown the problem in his mind to the back of his mind. He acted like a successful person and said to Yang Hang, “Brother Yang, you’re really too polite. You helped me pay the bill at the swimming club just now. Now, we’re just having a simple meal, but you actually gave me two bottles of such expensive wine. I’m a little embarrassed.”
Yang Hang quickly waved his hand and said, “Don’t be embarrassed. I didn’t pay the bill at the swimming club, and I didn’t send this wine.”
“Oh? It’s not from you?”
Li Jiayi’s eyes flashed with surprise. Since it was not sent by Yang Hang, who could it be? Among the people he knew, other than Yang Hang who was related to the hotel, there was no one else.

Upon hearing Yang Hang’s words, Uncle Zhang and Mother Yu also looked at Yang Hang in confusion. Just now, even the cashier at the swimming club said that he paid the bill. Why was he saying that it wasn’t him?
Yang Hang smiled and revealed a respectful expression. He explained, “My boss instructed me to settle the bill and these two bottles of wine.”
His boss? Did he mean Qian Wei?
When they heard this, the others were only surprised, but Li Jiayi was already stunned.

However, Yang Hang did not notice everyone’s expressions and continued, “Just now, the boss and I entered the hotel. When we passed by here, the boss saw you through the glass and immediately instructed me to pay the bill first.”

“Later, when I went upstairs, the boss was worried and asked me to inform the hotel to send two bottles of wine over. However, even so, the boss still felt that he had not done a thorough job. He specially instructed me to come down and wait outside. When you’re done eating, go up and call him.”
Yang Hang did not say anything else. In fact, he had disobeyed his boss’s orders. His boss asked him to wait outside, but he came in directly.

The boss had previously pointed at the private room and told him that it was filled with VIPs, especially that young man. He must not neglect the young man. At that time, he looked in the direction and happened to see Li Jiayi. His understanding of Li Jiayi immediately refreshed. Now, he went against the boss’s words and came in to toast Li Jiayi.

At this point, Yang Hang smiled and looked at Li Jiayi. “General Manager Li, I really didn’t expect that even my boss would value you so much. Previously, you actually gave me a dividend for the cooperation rights of a mere swimming club. You’re simply teasing me. I, Yang Hang, will say this today. The profits of the swimming club are all yours. I don’t want a single cent.”

Yang Hang was not stupid. It seemed that during the period of cooperation, Li Jiayi must have met his boss by chance. Otherwise, it would be impossible for his boss to ask him to serve Li Jiayi well, even though Li Jiayi had to request for cooperation rights previously.
After hearing Yang Hang’s words, Li Jiayi was not only stunned, but he was also dumbfounded. He had never even met Qian Wei before. He could not figure out why Qian Wei valued him so much.
The bill at the swimming club had been settled, and they had been given two bottles of wine that cost hundreds of thousands each. Now, they were being served by Yang Hang.
This was not a matter of money, but of Qian Wei’s attitude. This meant that the people sitting at this table were definitely VIPs among VIPs to Qian Wei.
Just as Li Jiayi was puzzled, Yang Hang stood up and poured wine for everyone present. He said readily, “Everyone, feel free. I’ll toast first.”
With that, Yang Hang finished the wine in one gulp. It was as if he had come to this table to seek favor with everyone present.
Li Jiayi had done this to Yang Hang in the past. Now that they had swapped roles, he looked at the moment Yang Hang finished the wine and felt extremely good.

Yang Hang filled his glass again and said to Li Jiayi, “General Manager Li, my boss asked me to apologize to you. He said that he didn’t know that you were coming. Otherwise, he would definitely leave the top floor to you. I hope you don’t mind.”
Li Jiayi shuddered and thought to himself, “What the hell is going on? But who cares? Since he came knocking on my door, why shouldn’t I take this opportunity to show off?”
With this thought in mind, Li Jiayi immediately felt relieved. He revealed a proud expression and said to Yang Hang, “Manager Yang, even if you didn’t say it, I wouldn’t mind.”

“General Manager Li is indeed open-minded.” Yang Hang gave him a thumbs up. Then, an apologetic expression flashed across his face. “General Manager Li, I really didn’t know that you would transform into a dragon when faced with a storm. Please forgive me for offending you previously.”
Upon hearing this, Li Jiayi recalled the matter of seeking favor with Yang Hang previously and felt that his chance to vent his anger had finally come.
He pointed at the wine glass and said with a fake smile, “Come, Manager Yang, drink three glasses. From now on, I’ll let bygones be bygones.”
“Okay.”
Yang Hang’s alcohol tolerance was very good. He immediately poured three glasses and gulped them down.
After drinking it, a trace of displeasure flashed across his eyes, but he remembered his boss’s instructions and quickly hid it.
After Yang Hang finished his wine, Li Jiayi felt smug. He looked at Chen Yun provocatively and waited for Zhang Huaiyao’s admiring expression.

Due to Yang Hang’s participation in the meal, the atmosphere became hotter and hotter. Moreover, Yang Hang’s attitude was very humble. He was very respectful to Yu Qingfeng and his wife. From time to time, he would flatter them, making the two of them enjoy it. The smile on their faces became stronger and stronger.
In comparison, Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang’s meal became more vexing.
Li Jiayi was very proud. He wanted to use Yang Hang to attack Chen Yun, so he secretly hinted about Zhang Huaiyao at Yang Hang.

Although Yang Hang was only a driver, he had followed Qian Wei for many years and had long been trained by Qian Wei to be a smart person. He immediately understood what Li Jiayi meant and looked at Zhang Huaiyao. “Miss, since you’re friends with General Manager Li, I’ll set up a party later. Let’s go to KTV to play. You must come.”
“Chen Yun, are you going?” Zhang Huaiyao immediately sought Chen Yun’s opinion, but Chen Yun shook his head. “That place is messy. I don’t want to go.”
“Alright, I won’t go either.” Zhang Huaiyao looked at Yang Hang. “I’m sorry.”
For a moment, the scene instantly became awkward.

Yang Hang looked at Li Jiayi and saw that Li Jiayi’s expression was not good. Although his eyes were filled with anger, he still said carefully, “Little brother, go take a look. The environment here is still very good.”
“I’m not going.”
“Brother, are you not giving me, Yang Hang, respect?” When Yang Hang heard Chen Yun’s words, he immediately couldn’t hold it in anymore and immediately said to him.
Chen Yun placed his fingers on the table and smiled. “Do you deserve a lot of respect?”
Do you deserve a lot of respect?!
These words immediately made the scene awkward.
Yu Qingfeng immediately slammed the table and stood up. “What are you talking about!”

Then, he looked at Uncle Zhang. “Brother Zhang, let me give you a piece of advice. On certain occasions, some people can be brought along, but some can’t! Don’t tell me you came for this meal today to embarrass me!”
For a moment, Uncle Zhang’s expression froze. He did not know what to say.
Mother Yu and Yu Ran also pointed at Chen Yun and mocked him.
Chen Yun sat there as if he was being criticized by everyone.
Just as the situation was awkward...
Not far from the private room, a few voices sounded.

“Boss Qian, you’re really dishonest. You didn’t even tell us that Director Chen was here,” said a middle-aged man sourly to Qian Wei. He was even more jealous. He had originally competed with Qian Wei and the two of them were evenly matched. However, now, Qian Wei, this sly old fox, actually wanted to curry favor with Director Chen.
If Qian Wei were to curry favor with Director Chen, the middle-aged man’s business would be ruined.
What kind of person was Director Chen?!
Since the Su family was in his way, he took down the entire Su family and threw them out of Jiang City!
Such a small fry was nothing in front of Director Chen!

However, now that it had already happened, he could only come shamelessly and prepare to seek favor with Chen Yun. However, in terms of effect, the effect that he brought about would definitely not be as good as that of Qian Wei, who came first.

Qian Wei also knew this, so he wasn’t afraid of bringing him here. If they had the ability, they could come. They didn’t give Director Chen anything anyway, while he had already given Director Chen hundreds of thousands of yuan worth of wine.

Then, they opened the door of the private room and rushed in. Qian Wei said, “I’m sorry, I’m sorry. Yang Hang, how do you do things? Didn’t I tell you to wait outside and call me immediately after the esteemed guests have eaten?! Why did you come in first?! Do you know how to do things?!”

Qian Wei learned from the attendant that Yang Hang had already entered the private room and immediately rushed to Chen Yun’s private room. When he saw Yang Hang’s cold expression and the solemn scene, he asked curiously, “Yang Hang, what happened?”
“Boss.”
Seeing that it was Qian Wei, Yang Hang quickly bowed.
When they heard how Yang Hang addressed Qian Wei, everyone present revealed solemn expressions, especially Li Jiayi. He even stood up, afraid that he would neglect the real big boss in front of him.
Qian Wei glanced at Yang Hang and asked again, “What exactly happened?”

Yang Hang pointed at Chen Yun and mocked, “Boss, I followed your instructions and treated General Manager Li well, but this kid spouted nonsense and disrespected me. Moreover, Boss, this is not only disrespecting me, but also disrespecting you.”

Qian Wei had just walked into the private room and was not in a daze. At this moment, he followed Yang Hang’s finger and realized that Yang Hang was pointing at Chen Yun, whom he had instructed to treat well!
Immediately, he was shocked and his eyes widened.

Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang looked at Qian Wei’s expression and thought to themselves that something was wrong. They smiled apologetically at Qian Wei and said, “Boss Qian, that’s not what my nephew meant. He’s just not used to that kind of environment. Moreover, young people speak a little rashly. He doesn’t mean to slap your face. Don’t take it to heart.”
“That’s right. Actually, it was just a joke.”

Yang Hang had the intention to help Li Jiayi. He immediately sneered and said, “Hehe, this young man’s joke is really not funny at all. Why don’t you take a look at who he is? Now that Boss Qian is here, we’re all standing. How dare you sit down! Who do you think you are!”
As soon as these words were spoken!
The corners of Qian Wei’s mouth twitched. He turned around and slapped Yang Hang’s face.

“Chen Yun, are you going?” Zhang Huaiyao immediately sought Chen Yun’s opinion, but Chen Yun shook his head.
“That place is messy.
I don’t want to go.”
“Alright, I won’t go either.” Zhang Huaiyao looked at Yang Hang.
“I’m sorry.”
For a moment, the scene instantly became awkward.
Yang Hang looked at Li Jiayi and saw that Li Jiayi’s expression was not good.
Although his eyes were filled with anger, he still said carefully, “Little brother, go take a look.
The environment here is still very good.”
“I’m not going.”
“Brother, are you not giving me, Yang Hang, respect?” When Yang Hang heard Chen Yun’s words, he immediately couldn’t hold it in anymore and immediately said to him.
Chen Yun placed his fingers on the table and smiled.
“Do you deserve a lot of respect?”
Do you deserve a lot of respect?!
These words immediately made the scene awkward.
Yu Qingfeng immediately slammed the table and stood up.
“What are you talking about!”
Then, he looked at Uncle Zhang.
“Brother Zhang, let me give you a piece of advice.
On certain occasions, some people can be brought along, but some can’t!
Don’t tell me you came for this meal today to embarrass me!”
For a moment, Uncle Zhang’s expression froze.
He did not know what to say.
Mother Yu and Yu Ran also pointed at Chen Yun and mocked him.
Chen Yun sat there as if he was being criticized by everyone.
Just as the situation was awkward...
Not far from the private room, a few voices sounded.
“Boss Qian, you’re really dishonest.
You didn’t even tell us that Director Chen was here,” said a middle-aged man sourly to Qian Wei.
He was even more jealous.
He had originally competed with Qian Wei and the two of them were evenly matched.
However, now, Qian Wei, this sly old fox, actually wanted to curry favor with Director Chen.
If Qian Wei were to curry favor with Director Chen, the middle-aged man’s business would be ruined.
What kind of person was Director Chen?!
Since the Su family was in his way, he took down the entire Su family and threw them out of Jiang City!
Such a small fry was nothing in front of Director Chen!
However, now that it had already happened, he could only come shamelessly and prepare to seek favor with Chen Yun.
However, in terms of effect, the effect that he brought about would definitely not be as good as that of Qian Wei, who came first.
Qian Wei also knew this, so he wasn’t afraid of bringing him here.
If they had the ability, they could come.
They didn’t give Director Chen anything anyway, while he had already given Director Chen hundreds of thousands of yuan worth of wine.
Then, they opened the door of the private room and rushed in.
Qian Wei said, “I’m sorry, I’m sorry.
Yang Hang, how do you do things?
Didn’t I tell you to wait outside and call me immediately after the esteemed guests have eaten?!
Why did you come in first?!
Do you know how to do things?!”
Qian Wei learned from the attendant that Yang Hang had already entered the private room and immediately rushed to Chen Yun’s private room.
When he saw Yang Hang’s cold expression and the solemn scene, he asked curiously, “Yang Hang, what happened?”
“Boss.”
Seeing that it was Qian Wei, Yang Hang quickly bowed.
When they heard how Yang Hang addressed Qian Wei, everyone present revealed solemn expressions, especially Li Jiayi.
He even stood up, afraid that he would neglect the real big boss in front of him.
Qian Wei glanced at Yang Hang and asked again, “What exactly happened?”
Yang Hang pointed at Chen Yun and mocked, “Boss, I followed your instructions and treated General Manager Li well, but this kid spouted nonsense and disrespected me.
Moreover, Boss, this is not only disrespecting me, but also disrespecting you.”
Qian Wei had just walked into the private room and was not in a daze.
At this moment, he followed Yang Hang’s finger and realized that Yang Hang was pointing at Chen Yun, whom he had instructed to treat well!
Immediately, he was shocked and his eyes widened.
Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang looked at Qian Wei’s expression and thought to themselves that something was wrong.
They smiled apologetically at Qian Wei and said, “Boss Qian, that’s not what my nephew meant.
He’s just not used to that kind of environment.
Moreover, young people speak a little rashly.
He doesn’t mean to slap your face.
Don’t take it to heart.”
“That’s right.
Actually, it was just a joke.”
Yang Hang had the intention to help Li Jiayi.
He immediately sneered and said, “Hehe, this young man’s joke is really not funny at all.
Why don’t you take a look at who he is?
Now that Boss Qian is here, we’re all standing.
How dare you sit down!
Who do you think you are!”
As soon as these words were spoken!
The corners of Qian Wei’s mouth twitched.
He turned around and slapped Yang Hang’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Check-in Reward — 500 Shops!
paragraphs: Qian Wei shouted, “What are you talking about? I asked you to serve him, but you’re doing this. Are you crazy?”
The sudden slap not only stunned Yang Hang, but everyone present was also stunned.
Why did Qian Wei suddenly slap Yang Hang?
Yang Hang touched his painful cheek and explained with an aggrieved expression, “Boss, you asked me to serve General Manager Li. This person doesn’t get along with General Manager Li. I’m...”
Qian Wei interrupted, “General Manager Li? Which General Manager Li?”
Li Jiayi quickly said shyly, “Boss Qian, it’s Li Jiayi, a partner of the swimming club in your hotel.”
“Who are you?” Qian Wei looked Li Jiayi up and down, his eyes filled with disdain.
Yang Hang: “Boss, he’s General Manager Li. Didn’t you ask me to serve him well?”
Qian Wei glared at him and said, “Serve him? F*ck you. I don’t even know him.”
He didn’t know Li Jiayi?!
Everyone was stunned and looked puzzled. If he didn’t know Li Jiayi, why did he help Li Jiayi pay the bill? Why did he give Li Jiayi wine?
Yang Hang frowned and cowered. “Boss, didn’t you point at him and say that that young man with an extraordinary temperament needs to be served well? Why are you saying that you don’t know him now?”
“Bastard, how can someone like him be called extraordinary? Do you have eyes or not?”
Qian Wei glanced at Li Jiayi and snorted. He pointed at Chen Yun, who was sitting calmly on the chair, and said respectfully, “Take a closer look. Director Chen has an extraordinary aura.”
What? Director Chen?!
Everyone’s gaze fell on Chen Yun as if they understood something.
Qian Wei called him Director Chen Yun. In other words, the VIP treatment just now was all because of Chen Yun and not because of Li Jiayi!
“Director Chen? Boss, what are you talking about? He’s Director Chen? Which Director Chen?” Yang Hang asked in shock.
Haha.

Beside Qian Wei, the middle-aged man who was competing with him sneered. “Which Director Chen? Who else in Jiangbei could it be? He’s naturally the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, the number one person in Jiang City! He’s Director Chen, who has tens of billions of yuan!”
“Boss Qian, it seems like you didn’t teach your subordinates well. They don’t even know Director Chen. Now, they’re even slapping Director Chen’s face.”
“Director Chen came to you to spend money because he was giving you respect. Now, you’re slapping Director Chen in the face. I think your business is coming to an end.”
As soon as these words were spoken, Qian Wei’s face instantly turned pale. He could not help but tremble and look at the man resentfully.
He was adding insult to injury!
He actually used such a vicious move!
F*ck your mother!
However, he did not dare to say a word now. He looked at Chen Yun and was about to cry from fear.
Everyone was stunned when they heard this.
What?
Director Chen?
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
The number one person in Jiang City!
He had tens of billions of yuan!
Every title was so big that it scared people to death!
It made everyone’s bodies start to tremble!
This background was too powerful!
This excessively young man actually had such a powerful background!
Then, everyone looked at Li Jiayi with disdain. It was clearly not his credit, but he kept showing off and almost deceived everyone.
Yang Hang’s expression changed drastically. Only then did he realize that he had recognized the wrong person. He glared at Li Jiayi fiercely. “Li Jiayi, how dare you lie to me.”
Hearing Yang Hang’s berating, Li Jiayi was already dumbfounded. He never expected that Chen Yun, whom he did not take seriously, would even be treated respectfully by Boss Qian.

Yang Hang recalled how Li Jiayi had shown off in front of him just now and even caused him to be slapped by his boss. He was furious and slapped Li Jiayi’s face. He scolded, “You bastard, you’re pretending to be mysterious. You actually sowed discord between me and Director Chen. You’re simply courting death.”
With a slap, Li Jiayi felt dizzy.
Qian Wei also widened his eyes and looked at Li Jiayi. “Kid, did you just say that you’re a partner of my hotel’s swimming club?”
Li Jiayi thought that Qian Wei would treat him differently because of this, so he quickly nodded and said, “Yes!”
“Oh, in that case, you can get lost in the future. I won’t work with you anymore.”
“What? You won’t work with me?”

Li Jiayi’s expression changed drastically. He did not expect Qian Wei to terminate the contract so easily. He looked resentful and said, “Boss Qian, you have to pay 30 million yuan for terminating the contract.”
“Thirty million yuan? Alright, call your boss over. Let’s see if he dares to ask me for 30 million yuan! If he dares, he has to get lost!”
Qian Wei roared angrily and then said to Yang Hang, “Yang Hang, take him out. No, break his limbs and throw him out!”
Break his limbs!
Throw him out!
These two sentences made everyone’s hearts skip a beat!
At this moment, Li Jiayi’s eyes widened in shock. In front of Boss Qian Wei, he, the general manager of the Zhenghai Swimming Club chain, had no status at all.
At that moment, he collapsed to the ground and looked at Yu Ran. “Ranran, Ranran! You don’t want to see me crippled, do you, Ranran?!”
Yu Ran also became anxious in an instant. She looked at her parents. “Dad, Mom, quickly think of a way.”
When Yu Qingfeng and his wife heard that they were going to break Li Jiayi’s limbs, they were also anxious, but was there any other way now?
They could only beg Chen Yun!

However, Yu Qingfeng was not familiar with Chen Yun. Moreover, he had even slammed the table and stood up previously to target Chen Yun. Immediately, he looked at Uncle Zhang. “Brother Zhang, look, this matter has blown up today. Why don’t you talk to Director Chen and let this matter go?”
Uncle Zhang hesitated for a moment before looking at Chen Yun. “Xiao Yun, about this...”
Before he could say anything, Chen Yun knocked on the table. “Boss Qian, your subordinates are not efficient.”
This sentence made everyone fall silent!
Qian Wei also kicked Yang Hang. “What are you waiting for?! Just you wait. From today onwards, you get lost too! Security, where are the security guards!”
A few seconds later, a few security guards rushed over and dragged Li Jiayi out. Then, a painful howl could be heard, making Yu Ran and Yu Qingfeng feel a chill run down their spines.

Then, Qian Wei quickly went in front of Chen Yun and toasted him one glass after another. Chen Yun’s glass did not even touch his lips, while Qian Wei drank nearly half a bottle of Maotai. If one did not know that he was apologizing, one would have thought that he was drinking Maotai for free.
At the table, everyone was watching Qian Wei’s performance and did not dare to move.
In the end, Chen Yun looked at Qian Wei, whose face was red. He snorted and stood up.
“Uncle, Auntie, let’s go.”
“Alright, alright.” Uncle Zhang looked at Chen Yun and realized that he was no longer the child in his impression. The current Chen Yun had already grown into a towering giant!
When they returned to the hotel at night, Uncle Zhang’s family was still silent. After a long time, Uncle Zhang clapped his hands. “I forgot, I forgot!”
Zhang Huaiyao and Aunt Zhang immediately looked at him.

“Didn’t we invite Yu Qingfeng tonight so that he could help Huaiyao become a regular employee? I didn’t expect Xiao Yun to have such a status. Then wouldn’t Huaiyao’s job be settled if he opened his mouth?”
At that moment, Zhang Huaiyao looked at her father. “Dad, so you invited them because of this?”
“I originally planned to tell you tonight. Chen Yun has already helped me arrange my work.”
Then, she told them everything about today and Chen Yun. When Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang heard this, they gasped. They could not believe what they had heard!

Chen Yun was actually a director of Shi’en University. Even the principal had to be respectful to him. As soon as he opened his mouth, he turned Zhang Huaiyao into the highest-leveled leader of the special department.
This...
Moreover, when they recalled the words of the boss beside Boss Qian Wei, they were immediately shocked.
How great were Chen Yun’s achievements?!
It was said that a golden fish in a pond could become a dragon after encountering a storm.
This was what it truly meant to transform into a dragon after encountering a storm!

Uncle Zhang smoked his cigarette and said melancholically, “Back then, I even chatted with Brother Chen and wanted the two of you to get engaged. If I had known, I would have been more serious. Perhaps Chen Yun would already become our son-in-law.”
“Dad! What are you talking about?!” Zhang Huaiyao stomped her feet when she heard this.

“Don’t I know what you’re thinking? Don’t you like Xiao Yun? Among your group of friends, other than Mengjun, you’re the closest to Xiao Yun. Furthermore, with the current Chen Yun, aren’t you tempted?” Uncle Zhang asked.
For a moment, Zhang Huaiyao’s face turned red. Her mind was filled with Chen Yun’s every move today.
Seeing that her daughter was silent, Aunt Zhang also came over. “Daughter, to enjoy the benefits of a favorable position...”
Before she could finish speaking, Zhang Huaiyao rushed out. Her parents were so annoying!
Did they think that she wasn’t thinking about this?
It was useless!
Chen Yun was famous for not eating the grass beside his nest. Mengjun had given Chen Yun a chance when he was 16 or 17 years old, but he was a blockhead!
However, he ignored her!
It directly confirmed his character of not touching his neighbors. After so many years, it was still getting worse.
Seriously!
At that moment, Zhang Huaiyao could not help but take out her phone and call Chen Yun.
“Chen Yun, have you returned to the hotel?”
“No, I’m looking at the scenery by the East Lake.” Chen Yun looked at the vast lake in front of him. No one appreciated such good scenery with him.
What a waste.
[Host, please check in.]
Chen Yun pressed the check-in button.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a shop gift bag.]

[Shop Gift Bag: Includes 500 shops in Jiangbei. Each of these shops is in the traffic center along the various commercial streets, which is a conspicuous location. Furthermore, each shop has a space of no less than 500 square meters.]
For a moment, Chen Yun was stunned.
This thing was a little fierce.

The prominent locations on the commercial street should be in the city center. Although the housing prices in various cities in Jiangbei were extraordinary, the average price of such a place was definitely not too much. One square meter cost 50,000 yuan, so 500 square meters cost 25 million yuan!
He had 500 shops.
They were worth 12.5 billion!
Moreover, it had to be known that these shops could not be bought with money.
Chen Yun returned to his room and called Zhou Jingyi directly to explain the matter to her.
When Zhou Jingyi heard this, she was stunned. This...
Five hundred shops!
Each of them was at the traffic center of the commercial streets in various cities!
In such a place, they would definitely make a profit no matter what they sold!
As the saying went, even pigs could fly at the top of the waves.
Then, Chen Yun asked Zhou Jingyi to make a plan to see how the 500 shops were distributed.
Zhou Jingyi hung up the phone and covered her chest. She naturally knew how heavy the burden on her shoulders was. One had to know that there were 500 shops!
They were worth 12.5 billion!
Moreover, it was a conservative estimate.
If the plan was done well, their money would be able to return in half a year. In a year, Chen Yun’s assets would soar to an extremely terrifying level.
Perhaps the title of the number one person in Jiangbei would be given to Chen Yun!

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Unyielding!
paragraphs: The next day, Chen Yun returned to Jiang City early in the morning and went straight to Cauldron Dragon Security. At this moment, Jiang Shouheng and Lin Yuhan were drinking tea upstairs.
“Brother Lin, do you think Director Chen is going to ask you to set up a security company?” Jiang Shouheng looked at Lin Yuhan in front of him. He felt a little uncomfortable.
After all, he, Chen Yun, and Zheng Yuan were known as the three giants of Jiang City. However, he and Zheng Yuan knew very well that the two of them were still far inferior to Chen Yun.

After all, what kind of material goods did Chen Yun have? Just the shares of Sacred Heaven Entertainment made him many times richer than the two of them, let alone the popular items like the East Mountain Villa and Heavenly Spirit Water.
He looked at Lin Yuhan with worry in his eyes.
Now that Chen Yun had suggested setting up a security company, it seemed like he was going to abandon him. However, he did not understand why Chen Yun had asked Lin Yuhan to tell him.
If Chen Yun wanted to establish a security company, he could directly establish it and snatch business from him.
Lin Yuhan took a sip of tea and looked at Jiang Zhengyu’s worried expression. He smiled in his heart, but he did not explain directly. Instead, he nodded. “We do want to set up a security company.”
Thump!
Jiang Zhengyu’s heart suddenly sank to the bottom.
“However...”

Lin Yuhan looked at Jiang Zhengyu. “CEO Jiang, don’t worry. My brother isn’t that kind of person. I heard that you helped my brother topple the Su family previously. Brother Yun has always been loyal. You don’t have to worry about him abandoning you after you have served your purpose.”
“Then you guys are...”

“This is the information Brother Yun gave me today. Our security company is only used to protect Brother Yun’s interests. The main thing is to protect his shops and deal with future emergencies. It’s not used for commercial purposes,” said Lin Yuhan slowly. In the past few days in Cauldron Dragon, he had seen many high-ranking officials and nobles. In terms of aura, he was already familiar with it. He was not at all inferior to Jiang Zhengyu.

“Shops?” Jiang Zhengyu waved his hand. “Brother, I’ll speak frankly. As far as I know, Director Chen doesn’t have any shops. His main means of income are Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Tianyun Live-Stream, and the Heavenly Spirit Water.”
“Are you sure?”
He turned on his phone and placed it in front of Jiang Zhengyu.
“This was sent by Brother Yun yesterday. He has 500 shops in the center of the commercial streets, located across 13 cities in Jiang City.”
What?
These words made Jiang Zhengyu’s eyes widen. He simply could not believe what he had heard!
They were distributed in 13 cities in Jiang City!
He had 500 shops!
The shops were in the center of the commercial street!
How much did this cost?!
At that moment, he grabbed the phone in front of him. Cold sweat broke out on his forehead. This, this, this!
The addresses of each shop were clearly displayed on it!
The shops were worth more than ten billion yuan!
What was this?!
“Therefore, the establishment of our security company is to protect these shops. It won’t affect Cauldron Dragon Security’s business.”
Lin Yuhan spoke.
Jiang Zhengyu, who had been thinking about how many shops Chen Yun could have and how he needed to open a security company, was instantly embarrassed.
Chen Yun was so domineering. What was Jiang Zhengyu in comparison?
“Does Director Chen have any requirements for bodyguards? Is there anything I can do to help?” Jiang Zhengyu asked. Lin Yuhan nodded. “I need to transfer some security personnel from you.”
“However, Brother Yun said that he will only use your people to support him. The people we’re looking for and are going to nurture aren’t such people.”

“What kind of person are you looking for? Don’t tell me Director Chen wants to recruit mercenaries?” Jiang Zhengyu asked in a low voice. He recalled the dangerous situation that Chen Yun had encountered last time. It was not surprising that he wanted to recruit mercenaries.
“No, he wants to recruit hooligans from Jiang City.”
“Huh?”
After Jiang Zhengyu was puzzled, Lin Yuhan drank the tea in his hand in one gulp and began to recruit people with Jiang Zhengyu.

A day later, Zhou Jingyi handed the plan to Chen Yun. Among the 500 shops, 300 shops were used for the establishment of First-Grade Restaurant branches and 100 shops were used for the sale of luxury goods. Meanwhile, the remaining 100 shops were split up and used for different purposes.
After Chen Yun saw this, he naturally had no choice but to hand these shops to Zhou Jingyi to manage.
Zhou Jingyi’s mission was already more important than Ma Ke’s. She was not the only one who took on this mission. To be precise, it should be the team in her hands.
Back in Jiang City.

Today, the main store of First-Grade Restaurant was closed for the day. At this moment, Lin Yuhan was standing in front of the store. Behind him was a group of young people. Every one of them had a buzz cut. There were no punks or people standing crookedly. There were dozens of them. They looked very impressive!
At this moment, a young man approached Lin Yuhan. “Brother Han, can we really see Brother Yun?”
“Are we Brother Yun’s men from now on?”
Lin Yuhan nodded. “Of course. We’re Brother Yun’s brothers from now on. We’re family.”
When the group of young men in their twenties heard this, their hearts trembled.
At the side, Jiang Zhengyu looked at these young men and sneered in his heart. A group of brats could not be compared to his bodyguards. He simply did not understand why Chen Yun wanted these people.

However, many years later, when he looked back at today, he would realize how ridiculous he was back then. In the future, this team would become a sharp sword in Chen Yun’s hand. Wherever the sword pointed, it would be invincible!
After a while, Chen Yun drove over.
The moment they got out of the car, everyone’s bodies trembled. They looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun!”
“Brother Yun!”
Everyone looked at the skinny young man with sparkling eyes, as if they had seen the God in their hearts.
How could they not have heard of Chen Yun’s legend? He crippled Gai Lingjie, beat up Tan Zekun, threw Su Yuncheng out, destroyed the Su family, and established huge businesses!
Each and every one of them deified Chen Yun in their hearts.
Chen Yun looked at the group of youths and waved his hand. “We’re all brothers. There’s no need to be reserved.”
His brother’s words almost made all the young men cry.

These young people either had parents who had passed away or came from single-parent families. They did not have the care of their relatives. After entering junior high and senior high school, they entered society and mixed around.
Now, be it on the surface or in secret, Chen Yun’s reputation had reached the point where hundreds of people responded to him.

Lin Yuhan used Chen Yun’s reputation to greet them, and they naturally joined in the greeting. These young men did not look strong, but they were very dark-hearted. Their attacks were even more ruthless.
After entering the First-Grade Restaurant and eating, everyone gradually relaxed. It was rare for Chen Yun to be unrestrained as well. He drank with them table by table.
“Brother Yun! Let me toast you!”
When Chen Yun arrived at another table, a young man stood up and drank the wine in his hand in one gulp.
Chen Yun also finished drinking. Then, he looked at him. “Zhidong, is your mother’s illness better?”
These words stunned the young man. He looked at Chen Yun, his eyes filled with shock. “Brother Yun, do, do you know me?”
“Of course I do.”
“Brother Yun, what about me?”
“You’re Qiangzi.”
“What about me? What about me...”
People kept coming over and asking Chen Yun. Chen Yun called out their names one by one. He also knew the situation in their homes, making everyone speechless and teary-eyed.
After that, a young man walked up to Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, thank you. If it weren’t for you, my mother...”
“Alright, we’re all brothers.”
“Brother Yun, I’m Zou Runbei. My life will be yours in the future.”
“Brother Yun, we’re all following you!”
For a moment, the commotion shook the heavens!

At the side, Jiang Zhengyu felt a little uncomfortable when he saw this scene. He looked at these young people and compared them to his bodyguards. Although the bodyguards in his hands were much stronger than these young boys, they were all people who did things according to the rules. Moreover, there were times when they could not let go.

However, the courage displayed by the young men in front of him was something he had never seen before. They had really handed their lives to Chen Yun. There was no need for more. He immediately felt that if the bodyguards in his hands fought these people, it was really uncertain who would win.
The bold ones were afraid of the stupid ones, and the stupid ones were afraid of those who didn’t care about their lives.
The people in front of him were all f*cking suicidal!
The way he looked at Chen Yun immediately changed again.

chapters.title: Chapter 161: If People Offend Me, We’ll Eliminate The Roots!
paragraphs: That night, even Chen Yun became drunk and simply slept in the First-Grade Restaurant with a group of young people.
Xu Bin looked at the situation in front of him with a helpless expression. He could only call Zhou Jingyi.
After a while, Zhou Jingyi came over and called Jiang Zhengyu’s bodyguards to send everyone to the hotel.
“Director Chen, slow down.” Zhou Jingyi helped Chen Yun into the room and gently helped him onto the bed.
“Director Chen, call me if you need anything.”
After Zhou Jingyi said this, she saw that Chen Yun didn’t react. Her eyes darted around, then she tiptoed over and gently nudged Chen Yun. “Director Chen? Director Chen?”
Then, she bit her lip and looked around. Then, she looked at Chen Yun angrily.
“Heh, this man!”
“You treat me as a tool all day long. You threw this project at me and asked me to take care of that project. You don’t know how to care about me. You only know how to make me work all day long!”
“Today, I’ll definitely ask you for some interest!”
Zhou Jingyi muttered to herself. The timid expression on her face changed, as if she had a reason. Then, she leaned towards Chen Yun.
Then, she planted a kiss on his face.
In an instant, Zhou Jingyi’s face turned red and her heart raced as if it could not stop. She panted heavily and clutched her chest. Then, she had no choice but to walk to the bathroom outside.
The next day.

Chen Yun slowly woke up and looked at the decorations beside him in confusion. He recalled what happened yesterday and thought to himself that he really could not drink too much wine. He directly blacked out.
Then, he went to the washroom and looked at the mirror. At first glance!
Chen Yun was speechless.
He was confused.
What was with the lipstick on his face?
What the f*ck!
Who was it?! Who was it?!
What a scam...
Chen Yun called Xu Bin. “Old Master Xu, who sent me back yesterday?”
“Director Chen... Let me think, it seems to be Manager Zhou.”
Chen Yun was speechless. Zhou Jingyi...
It seemed like he could not drink too much in the future. He did not expect his most trusted subordinate to crave his body.
After washing up, Chen Yun pulled Vigor out of the Dimensional Space.
Then, he arrived at the Heavenly Dragon Security Building.

In the building, Lin Yuhan had already stood up with a group of youths. They were all young men in their twenties. Coupled with the fact that they had drunk good wine last night, they naturally did not feel hungover. Everyone was in high spirits.
“Brother Yun!”
“Brother Yun!”
Seeing Chen Yun come over, all the youths smiled. However, in the next moment, they looked at the person standing beside Chen Yun and their eyes widened. They could not believe what they were seeing!
It was a burly man nearly two meters tall!
Even the black suit could not cover the bulging muscles below!
It was obvious that he was a ruthless person!
Just by looking at this person’s size, eight or nine of them would probably be no match for him.
Actually, they did not know that even if they attacked together, they would only be instantly killed by Vigor.
Chen Yun looked at Vigor. This bodyguard robot was good, but it could only be used to protect him and could not take the initiative to attack.
“Training starts today.”
Chen Yun’s words made everyone nod.
“Brother Yun, feel free to train us. We definitely won’t complain about being hardworking or tired.”
“That’s right!”
“We can suffer anything!”
Chen Yun looked at the youths and nodded. “Follow me.”
Everyone arrived at the basement level. This used to be a parking lot, but Chen Yun had used more than a day to transform it into a combat and marksmanship training ground.
Everyone looked over and was stunned.
Then, Chen Yun brought them in front of a box and Lin Yuhan immediately opened it.
The next moment, everyone looked at the thing in front of them and the corners of their mouths twitched.
“This!”
What was in the box were none other than guns!
Even Lin Yuhan’s expression changed drastically.
“A QBZ-95!”
“It’s a Colt Python!”
He had been in the military before, so he was naturally familiar with these guns.
Chen Yun looked at the youths. “What I want you to train is not only your bodies, but also these.”

Previously, be it the Three Spirits Financial Group or the Su family, they had their own guards, especially the Three Spirits Financial Group. They also had their own decapitation team. There was no need to mention the other families. As long as they had some power, they had the means to protect their assets.
Chen Yun had already experienced the feeling of being pointed at by a group of people with guns once. He did not want to experience it again!
As for him, he wanted to learn from these families. However, he had to surpass them!
If people didn’t offend him, he wouldn’t offend them. However, if people offended him, he would eliminate them completely!
“Let me show you something else.”

Chen Yun looked over and gestured. A young man opened the water tank on the other side. Then, they looked at the blue and somewhat demonic liquid in front of him and were stunned. The young men behind him came forward.
However, no one knew what it was.
The next moment, a voice came from behind. “Is this the Heavenly Spirit Water?”
The Heavenly Spirit Water?
Everyone looked at the young man and asked, “Brother Bei, what is the Heavenly Spirit Water?”

“I also heard from a friend who’s a driver for a boss that the Heavenly Spirit Water came from Brother Yun. It has the effect of removing the negative effects of cells and activating cells. To put it simply, this thing can be called divine water.”
“Outside, the price has already reached 500,000 yuan per 100ml!”
What?
One could only obtain 100ml for 500,000 yuan!
However, there were dozens of liters here.
How much was this worth?!

“Alright, let’s start training. I’ve pasted the reward details here. If you train well, you’ll have the Heavenly Spirit Water to drink. If you don’t, don’t blame me. Those who have the ability can eat meat. Those who don’t have the ability won’t even be able to drink soup!” As Chen Yun spoke, he looked at Vigor. He had already changed Vigor to the instructor mode, allowing him to teach everyone.
With this sentence, everyone rubbed their palms together.

Chen Yun did not leave either. Although he had the Gun King Skill Pack and his physique far exceeded that of ordinary people, his combat skills were still insufficient. He immediately practiced with everyone.

For five to six days in a row, Chen Yun trained with them. Vigor taught fighting skills, while Chen Yun taught marksmanship. Meanwhile, Lin Yuhan used to be a scout. Now, he was teaching reconnaissance skills. In addition to the Heavenly Spirit Water, in just a few days, this team of 72 people grew rapidly.

Putting everything else aside, in terms of ability, they were comparable to Jiang Zhengyu’s bodyguard, who earned hundreds of thousands of yuan a year. This was the result of five to six days of training.
During this period, shops everywhere were also renovating in full swing.
The next day, Chen Yun arrived at the First-Grade Restaurant at noon and listened to Zhou Jingyi’s report. At this rate, in at most three days, shops everywhere would open one after another.
Just as he was about to finish listening, there was a knock on the door.
“Come in.”
“Director Chen, there’s a guest downstairs who insists on seeing you. We don’t dare to let him up, so we can only ask you for instructions. Please take a look.”
“Whoever it is, ask them to wait below first.”
With that, Chen Yun gestured to Zhou Jingyi, who continued to report.
“This...” When the waiter heard this, he had no choice but to leave. However, he was a little nervous. After all, the person below looked rich and could not be trifled with.

If you train well, you’ll have the Heavenly Spirit Water to drink.
If you don’t, don’t blame me.
Those who have the ability can eat meat.
Those who don’t have the ability won’t even be able to drink soup!” As Chen Yun spoke, he looked at Vigor.
He had already changed Vigor to the instructor mode, allowing him to teach everyone.
With this sentence, everyone rubbed their palms together.
Chen Yun did not leave either.
Although he had the Gun King Skill Pack and his physique far exceeded that of ordinary people, his combat skills were still insufficient.
He immediately practiced with everyone.
For five to six days in a row, Chen Yun trained with them.
Vigor taught fighting skills, while Chen Yun taught marksmanship.
Meanwhile, Lin Yuhan used to be a scout.
Now, he was teaching reconnaissance skills.
In addition to the Heavenly Spirit Water, in just a few days, this team of 72 people grew rapidly.
Putting everything else aside, in terms of ability, they were comparable to Jiang Zhengyu’s bodyguard, who earned hundreds of thousands of yuan a year.
This was the result of five to six days of training.
During this period, shops everywhere were also renovating in full swing.
The next day, Chen Yun arrived at the First-Grade Restaurant at noon and listened to Zhou Jingyi’s report.
At this rate, in at most three days, shops everywhere would open one after another.
Just as he was about to finish listening, there was a knock on the door.
“Come in.”
“Director Chen, there’s a guest downstairs who insists on seeing you.
We don’t dare to let him up, so we can only ask you for instructions.
Please take a look.”
“Whoever it is, ask them to wait below first.”
With that, Chen Yun gestured to Zhou Jingyi, who continued to report.
“This...” When the waiter heard this, he had no choice but to leave.
However, he was a little nervous.
After all, the person below looked rich and could not be trifled with.

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Every Time I See It, I’ll Smash It!
paragraphs: When Chen Yun reached the bottom, he saw a fatty eating heartily.
“Um, Old Master, give me another boiled cabbage.”
“Give me one of the Buddha Jumps Over The Wall Soup too.”
“There’s more.”
Beside him, there were already a few empty plates.
This appetite stunned the waiters beside him, let alone Old Man Xu.
At this moment, Chen Yun looked at the fatty below. What the hell?
He was wondering who it was, but it turned out to be this fellow.
“Qian Duo.”
“Hey, hey, Brother Yun, are you done?” When Qian Duo heard Chen Yun’s words, he turned to look at him. He quickly touched the oil on his mouth, but Chen Yun glanced at him in disdain.
“Come, let’s go upstairs to eat.” Chen Yun waved his hand. Qian Duo quickly stood up and looked at the waiter beside him. “Hello, can you help me bring up these unfinished dishes?”
“Yes, sir.”
“Yes, yes. The membership card is here.” Qian Duo took out the membership card. Chen Yun sighed and said, “Do you still need to swipe your card to eat at my place? Just eat whatever you want.”
“Hehe, I’m just being nice.” Then, Qian Duo followed Chen Yun to the private room upstairs.

“Why did you think of coming to my place today?” Chen Yun looked at Qian Duo. This fellow was really new to him. Last time, he was still putting on airs at the Jiang City banquet, but now, he did not even care about his most basic image in front of him.
When Qian Duo heard Chen Yun’s words, he said, “Brother Yun, my sports club in Ling City is about to open for business.”

Chen Yun nodded. Ling City was the provincial capital of Jiangbei. Its economy was much more developed than Jiang City’s. In the entire Jiangbei, only Ling City and Jiang City were listed. He had nearly 80 shops in Ling City.
“So?”
“Brother Yun, I’d like to borrow your Bugatti Veyron.”
Chen Yun was speechless.
Wasn’t the Qian family known as the richest family in Jiangbei?
Wasn’t he the young master of the Qian family?!
Did he need to borrow Chen Yun’s car?!

Looking at Chen Yun’s gaze, Qian Duo smiled awkwardly. “Brother Yun, you don’t know this, but my family controls my money very tightly. The only thing I can afford is a Ferrari worth ten million yuan. Don’t worry, don’t worry. I’ll just borrow it for three to four days. At most, I’ll consider it a rental. Brother Yun, no matter what, you have to help me support the scene.”
After calling him Brother Yun a few times, Qian Duo’s natural friendliness was revealed. At that moment, Chen Yun did not waste his breath and directly gave him the key to the Bugatti Veyron.
“Thank you, Brother Yun.” Qian Duo thanked him first, then looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, you’ve been doing quite a lot recently.”
“Tsk tsk, all of your 500 shops are in the center of the prosperous commercial streets in Jiangbei. The total value is probably above 13 billion yuan. You’ve really spent a lot this time.”
According to Qian Duo’s estimation, Chen Yun should only have so much money on hand. He did not expect him to take it all out and invest in such a place.

It had to be known that these 500 shops were located in the entire Jiangbei. Some places were beyond Chen Yun’s reach. Even if he was a powerful dragon, there were times when he could not beat the local snakes.
In Qian Duo’s opinion, such an investment was extremely irrational.
“How about this? I won’t borrow your car for nothing. In the future, I’ll help you take a look at your place in Ling City. I still have some influence in Ling City.”
“Sure.”
Chen Yun nodded.
However, in the next moment, Zhou Jingyi rushed in.
“Director Chen, bad news. Nearly 60% of the shops we’re renovating in various cities have been destroyed. There’s not a single shop left in Ling City. They’ve all been destroyed.”
These words made Qian Duo slam the table and stand up. “What did you say?!”
Chen Yun also narrowed his eyes.
Good.
Very good.
How bold of them to dare to ruin his place.
He wanted to see who was so bold!

At this moment, in the commercial street in the center of Ling City, a shop that was being renovated was in a mess. In a Rolls-Royce sedan at the entrance, a young man held a glass of red wine in his hand. He looked at the mess in the shop and laughed.
He laughed without restraint!
Then, he got out of the car and walked into the shop. “Who’s your manager? Come out.”
Then, a trembling man walked up to the young man.
“Who are you? Why did you destroy our shop?!”
“What you’re doing is illegal!”
Pa!
With a crisp sound, the young man slapped the manager’s face and pulled his collar. “Are you telling me that it’s illegal? Are you joking?”
“Listen carefully. My name is Song Jixing. I have a few words for Chen Yun.”

“Tell Chen Yun that he’s a country bumpkin from Jiang City. He should stay in Jiang City obediently. He has reached out so far and will be cut down. Tell him to take a piss and take a look at himself.”
“Feel free to renovate this place. Every time you renovate it, I’ll smash it. In Ling City, my territory, it’s not up to you country bumpkins to behave atrociously.”
“Is that clear enough?”
Song Jixing patted the manager’s face in front of him and waved his hand. A few burly men in black immediately walked towards him.

“All of you, listen up. From today onwards, watch carefully. If they dare to renovate, smash them! If they dare to renovate, smash them once. I want to see if Country Bumpkin Chen’s shop can be opened.”
Then, a young man got out of another car and looked at Song Jixing. He said in fluent Chinese, “Young Master Song is indeed a rich man in Ling City.”
This young man was none other than Park Jae-hyung, the Chinese person-in-charge of the Park Corporation, who wanted to cooperate with Chen Yun after the biotechnology conference.

Song Jixing looked at Park Jae-hyung and thought to himself that this Korean was quite fluent in Chinese. However, he also liked Park Jae-hyung’s words. At this moment, he puffed out his chest. “According to my estimation, Chen Yun only has so many assets in his hands. As long as his shops can’t open, Sacred Heaven won’t be able to withstand a little storm.”

“At that time, we will be able to destroy him easily. At that time, he will be a soft persimmon that can be rubbed by anyone. The formula of the Heavenly Spirit Water in his hands will simply be at our fingertips.”

When Park Jae-hyung heard Song Jixing’s words, he nodded excitedly. As long as they had the formula for the Heavenly Spirit Water, they would be able to obtain assets worth tens of billions or even hundreds of billions!
Even if the formula was shared, be it the Song family or the Park Corporation, they would be able to obtain extremely rich profits and stand at the top of the world!

Song Jixing’s thoughts were the same as Park Jae-hyung’s. Moreover, behind him stood the huge Song family. He had great confidence. At this moment, his eyes were extremely cold. What he had to do now was to crush Chen Yun and defeat him!
He would make Chen Yun crawl under his feet like a bereaved dog!
Otherwise, how could his hatred for being humiliated be resolved?!

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Song Jixing Is Dead For Sure Today!
paragraphs: Thinking back to that day, Song Jixing’s eyes were extremely cold. In his entire life, who had not been arrogant and respectful when they saw him? However, Chen Yun actually dared to reject him. He simply had a death wish!
He wanted to see how long Chen Yun could last without the funds of these shops!

At this moment, in the First-Grade Restaurant, Chen Yun gently placed his hand on the table. Zhou Jingyi took the manager’s call and relayed it to Chen Yun. Every word fell into Chen Yun and Qian Duo’s ears.
“F*ck!” Qian Duo’s eyes darkened as he nodded. “Brother Yun, just you wait. I’ll go back and get someone to kill that bastard Song Jixing.”
How could they think of such despicable methods!
“You don’t have to worry about this.” Chen Yun stood up. “I’ll settle it myself.”
“Brother Yun...”
Qian Duo wanted to say something, but Chen Yun had already walked out.
Then, he also stood up and walked out.
On the way, the driver looked at Qian Duo’s expression and asked carefully, “Young Master, what’s wrong?”
“That bastard Song Jixing actually played tricks in private. When I go back, I’ll definitely get the guards to smash him.”
“However, Young Master, the guards are in the hands of the Old Master. You have no right to mobilize them.”

“I don’t need you to tell me!” Qian Duo glared at him. “Do I look like I don’t know about this?! That’s why I want to go back and look for the Old Master. If he doesn’t give it to me, I’ll spend money to find someone to cripple Song Jixing myself.”
“Drive faster!”

Before Qian Duo could return to Ling City, a chartered plane had already landed at Hua’an Airport in Ling City. More than 70 people alighted from the plane. It was none other than Chen Yun and the others.

“Brother Yun, it will take a few hours for the items to be transported over from Lu City,” said Lin Yuhan to Chen Yun. Then, he looked at Zou Runbei. “Xiaobei, you’ve stayed in Ling City before. Bring a team to investigate first.”
“You have to figure it out.”
“Brother Han, don’t worry. I’ve been in Ling City since I was young for more than ten years. I’m very familiar with it.”
Then, Zou Runbei led seven or eight brothers to the side. Meanwhile, Chen Yun and the others arrived at the place they had just bought before boarding the plane.
A few hours later.
A car stopped in front of the place where Chen Yun and the others were at. Then, Lin Yuhan brought people up with two boxes.
Meanwhile, Zou Runbei also walked in.
“Brother Yun, I was lucky and caught a guy. This guy is Song Jixing’s subordinate. It seems like he’s in a good mood after ruining our place today. He even went to fool around.”
Then, two young men brought a person with blood on his face to Chen Yun.
That person had clearly been beaten up quite a bit. His body was covered in wounds. After letting him go, that person could no longer stand and lay on the ground.
However, he still looked up at Chen Yun resentfully.

Chen Yun sneered and squatted down. He patted the man’s head a few times. “I’ll ask you a few questions. You have to answer properly. Don’t make me angry. If I’m angry, I’ll do anything. Remember this clearly first.”
The person swallowed and glared at Chen Yun without saying anything.
Chen Yun did not care about this. He pointed a finger. “Firstly, I want to know if Song Jixing was the one who got people to smash the shops in other places in Jiangbei.”
The man nodded.
“Very good.” Chen Yun smiled. “Secondly, how many people does Song Jixing have?”
With that, Chen Yun stared fixedly at that person.
The person panted. The aura of Chen Yun gave him a lot of pressure. He did not dare to look straight at him and said in a low voice, “I don’t know.”
Chen Yun shook his finger in front of him and said coldly, “I don’t like enemies who are tough nuts to crack.”
The next moment.
Bang!
Chen Yun shot through the man’s leg.
“Ah!”
The man screamed in pain and rolled on the ground. Chen Yun stepped forward and stepped on the man’s chest to stabilize him. “I wonder if you know now.”
“I told you, I don’t know!”
Bang!
Another shot landed on his hand. One’s fingers were connected to one’s heart, causing the man to faint from the pain.
Chen Yun looked down and said, “Wake him up.”
Then, a basin of cold water was poured on the man.

That person woke up in a daze and looked at Chen Yun in fear. At this moment, the Chen Yun in his eyes was like a demon that had just crawled out of hell. Just looking at him made one’s heart tremble!
“Do you know? If you still don’t know, I’ll cripple your arm if you say it once, and I’ll cripple your leg if you say it twice.”
“Furthermore, you will definitely not die quickly.”
Chen Yun’s words made Lin Yuhan and the others break out in cold sweat because they knew that Chen Yun would definitely be able to do what he said.
The man closed his eyes and asked slowly, “If I tell you, can you let me go?”
“No, but I can make your death a little more quick. Take your pick.”
Lin Yuhan looked at Chen Yun strangely, thinking that Brother Yun could not say this so clearly. It was strange that that person could tell the truth after hearing it.

However, that person looked at Chen Yun and nodded. “Alright, as the rumors say, Director Chen of Jiang City is not an ordinary person. I’m convinced. However, let me tell you, it’s simply wishful thinking for you to touch Young Master Song. This time, Old Master Song allocated nearly a hundred people to Young Master Song.”
“These people are all elites.”
“The others who smashed the shops are just small fries.”

“This time, Young Master Song wants to destroy you!” The more the person spoke, the more excited he became. Chen Yun looked at him and fired the third shot. After a gunshot, there were no more annoying sounds.
Zou Runbei walked forward. “Brother Yun, we found out that Song Jixing is at a manor in the suburbs. Recently, he’s been calling a few female celebrities over.”
“Bring your weapons and let’s go.” With Chen Yun’s order, everyone put their things into their backpacks and took a car towards the manor in the suburbs.

When they arrived, Chen Yun looked at the huge manor in front of him and sneered. Song Jixing really knew how to play. He had found such a good place to bring female celebrities to have fun every night. However, his good days would be over tonight.
Chen Yun was about to bring people in when he was stopped by Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei.
“Brother Yun, let’s do it. The few of you, protect Brother Yun. The rest of you, follow me.”
After saying that, the two of them took the lead and walked forward.

Lin Yuhan walked in front while Zou Runbei followed closely behind. They slowly moved forward. There were two guards standing on both sides of the door, fighting their sleepiness with their heads lowered. They did not notice that the two of them were already hiding behind two trees on both sides of the door.
Zou Runbei stuck his head out to take a look. Then, he raised two fingers at Lin Yuhan and retracted another one. Lin Yuhan understood what he meant. Each of them would take down one guard.
Lin Yuhan nodded and pointed at himself. Then, he wiped the side of his palm across his neck. Zou Runbei smiled and darted towards one of the guards. He slashed the guard’s neck.

When the guard beside him heard the sound, he opened his eyes and was instantly splashed with blood. He opened his mouth and was about to shout when Lin Yuhan went forward to cover his mouth and placed a knife on his neck with his other hand.
“If you want to live, don’t shout!”
Lin Yuhan glared at him and spoke fiercely.
The guard was so frightened that he almost peed his pants. He did not know why two people who killed without batting an eyelid would come. When he heard Lin Yuhan’s words, he nodded blankly.
Lin Yuhan placed his hand on hers. “Where’s Song Jixing?”
The guard trembled and said in a trembling voice, “I can’t say. If I say it, Young Master Song will kill my entire family.”
Lin Yuhan sneered. “Song Jixing is dead for sure tonight. If you don’t tell me, you’ll die now!”
“At this time, Young Master Song will be on the third floor with a woman accompanying him.”
Lin Yuhan looked into the guard’s eyes. Human eyes would not lie. He immediately turned the knife in his hand and stabbed it into the guard’s throat.

If you still don’t know, I’ll cripple your arm if you say it once, and I’ll cripple your leg if you say it twice.”
“Furthermore, you will definitely not die quickly.”
Chen Yun’s words made Lin Yuhan and the others break out in cold sweat because they knew that Chen Yun would definitely be able to do what he said.
The man closed his eyes and asked slowly, “If I tell you, can you let me go?”
“No, but I can make your death a little more quick.
Take your pick.”
Lin Yuhan looked at Chen Yun strangely, thinking that Brother Yun could not say this so clearly.
It was strange that that person could tell the truth after hearing it.
However, that person looked at Chen Yun and nodded.
“Alright, as the rumors say, Director Chen of Jiang City is not an ordinary person.
I’m convinced.
However, let me tell you, it’s simply wishful thinking for you to touch Young Master Song.
This time, Old Master Song allocated nearly a hundred people to Young Master Song.”
“These people are all elites.”
“The others who smashed the shops are just small fries.”
“This time, Young Master Song wants to destroy you!” The more the person spoke, the more excited he became.
Chen Yun looked at him and fired the third shot.
After a gunshot, there were no more annoying sounds.
Zou Runbei walked forward.
“Brother Yun, we found out that Song Jixing is at a manor in the suburbs.
Recently, he’s been calling a few female celebrities over.”
“Bring your weapons and let’s go.” With Chen Yun’s order, everyone put their things into their backpacks and took a car towards the manor in the suburbs.
When they arrived, Chen Yun looked at the huge manor in front of him and sneered.
Song Jixing really knew how to play.
He had found such a good place to bring female celebrities to have fun every night.
However, his good days would be over tonight.
Chen Yun was about to bring people in when he was stopped by Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei.
“Brother Yun, let’s do it.
The few of you, protect Brother Yun.
The rest of you, follow me.”
After saying that, the two of them took the lead and walked forward.
Lin Yuhan walked in front while Zou Runbei followed closely behind.
They slowly moved forward.
There were two guards standing on both sides of the door, fighting their sleepiness with their heads lowered.
They did not notice that the two of them were already hiding behind two trees on both sides of the door.
Zou Runbei stuck his head out to take a look.
Then, he raised two fingers at Lin Yuhan and retracted another one.
Lin Yuhan understood what he meant.
Each of them would take down one guard.
Lin Yuhan nodded and pointed at himself.
Then, he wiped the side of his palm across his neck.
Zou Runbei smiled and darted towards one of the guards.
He slashed the guard’s neck.
When the guard beside him heard the sound, he opened his eyes and was instantly splashed with blood.
He opened his mouth and was about to shout when Lin Yuhan went forward to cover his mouth and placed a knife on his neck with his other hand.
“If you want to live, don’t shout!”
Lin Yuhan glared at him and spoke fiercely.
The guard was so frightened that he almost peed his pants.
He did not know why two people who killed without batting an eyelid would come.
When he heard Lin Yuhan’s words, he nodded blankly.
Lin Yuhan placed his hand on hers.
“Where’s Song Jixing?”
The guard trembled and said in a trembling voice, “I can’t say.
If I say it, Young Master Song will kill my entire family.”
Lin Yuhan sneered.
“Song Jixing is dead for sure tonight.
If you don’t tell me, you’ll die now!”
“At this time, Young Master Song will be on the third floor with a woman accompanying him.”
Lin Yuhan looked into the guard’s eyes.
Human eyes would not lie.
He immediately turned the knife in his hand and stabbed it into the guard’s throat.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Who Are You?!
paragraphs: The two of them looked behind and waved at the people behind them. They said to Chen Yun, “Brother Yun, Song Jixing is on the third floor. What do you think we should do now?”
The third floor?
Chen Yun nodded. “Cut the weeds and eliminate the roots. Don’t let anyone off.”
“Okay!”
Everyone nodded. Chen Yun got a team of people to stay at the periphery. First, they would receive everyone later. Second, he would not let the people inside escape.
Chen Yun then led Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei inside.
After dealing with a few guards along the way, everyone entered the hall.
Chen Yun took out his pistol and pointed with his finger.
“Kill!”
Then, he kicked open the door and led the way in.
On the first floor, Chen Yun rushed in and raised his gun to shoot. For a moment, blood splattered. The few teams behind dispersed and rushed in.

This was a commotion in the villa. When Song Jixing’s men heard the gunshots, they didn’t know what was going on. They walked out of the room in a daze, but the moment they came out, they were attacked by the people lying in ambush at the door or were shot in the head.
Someone was the first to shout, “Oh no, the enemy is launching a sneak attack.”
Only then did Song Jixing’s men wake up from their daze. They picked up their weapons and came out of the room to fight with Chen Yun’s men.

On Chen Yun’s side, there were many people and they had come prepared, making their opponents dizzy. However, Song Jixing and the others were not hooligans. All of them were heroic and belligerent. They resisted tenaciously, and the ground was filled with injured people.
At this moment, Song Jixing also heard the gunshots outside. His eyes widened. Beside him, the three women also shouted in unison.
“What’s going on?!”
Song Jixing Easy put on his clothes and walked out. He looked at the flustered crowd in front of him. “F*ck! What’s going on!”

“Young Master Song, we don’t know who the other party is either, but they’re very fierce and came prepared. We’re in the suburbs now. If we want to call for help from the Old Master, it’s impossible for them to rush over in a short period of time.”

“Then kill them for me! You bunch of good-for-nothings, f*ck!” Song Jixing loaded the gun in his hand and slapped the person in front of him. “Are the guys in your hands all fire sticks?! Beat them down!”
Seeing Song Jixing flare up, although the person in front of him had a cold look in his eyes, he still walked forward.
However, in the next moment, the sound of glass shattering sounded. Then, a gunshot was heard, accompanied by blood splattering on the wall. Song Jixing’s eyes widened.
At that moment, Song Jixing looked at this posture and knew who was here. He held his gun and left.

On the second floor, under the cover of Chen Yun and the others, Song Jixing’s men gradually could not withstand their powerful attacks and retreated step by step. Some people were forced to retreat to their rooms and had nowhere to escape. They were beaten up.
Those who did not die shouted. The entire manor was filled with people fighting.
“Brother Yun!”
Lin Yuhan leaned in front of Chen Yun. “There are too many people at the stairs on the third floor. We don’t dare to show our faces.”
Chen Yun looked across and gestured to Zou Runbei, who was on the other side. The latter nodded and took out a smoke bomb with the team behind him. He threw it at the crowd blocking the corridor.
Zou Runbei led a team of people forward and swept across the area. Almost no one was standing.
The entire third floor was filled with smoke and wails.
Song Jixing and his subordinates were stunned. They had never expected Chen Yun and the others to have this!
However, Chen Yun had tens of billions of yuan in his hands. He could have as many such things as he wanted. With money, they could make ghosts do anything!

Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei walked at the front. They cleaned the rooms on the third floor one by one. When they opened one of the doors, Song Jixing jumped out and was about to shoot Lin Yuhan in the head.
With a gunshot, one of Song Jixing’s arms flew out.
“That’s him!”
Chen Yun held a gun in his hand. With a command, Zou Runbei stepped forward and slapped Song Jixing’s neck, knocking him out and taking him away.
Chen Yun and the others left and lit a fire. The entire manor immediately turned into a sea of fire!

When the Song family received Song Jixing’s call for help, they were the first to rush over. They looked at the sea of flames in front of them. Even Old Master Song narrowed his eyes. He looked in front of him and clenched his fists until they cracked. However, there was nothing he could do. The Song family had done too many shameful things. At that moment, he could only use the Song family’s power to suppress this matter!
At this moment, Chen Yun and the others had already returned to their hotels and dealt with their injured brothers.
At this moment, Song Jixing slowly woke up and looked at Chen Yun in front of him. “F*ck your mother, Chen Yun.”

As soon as he said this, Zou Runbei stepped forward and punched Song Jixing in the face, knocking out half of his teeth. Then, a few iron knees made Song Jixing bleed from the corner of his mouth and he began to tremble.
“How dare you speak to Brother Yun like this? You must be tired of living!”

Song Jixing fell to the ground like a dead dog. He looked at Chen Yun, who was walking over, as if he was looking at a demon. All these years, he was the only one who had slaughtered and bullied others. Who would dare to bare their fangs at him?
However, today, for the first time, Song Jixing felt afraid. He had already become meat in Chen Yun’s hands. Chen Yun could do whatever he wanted.

At this moment, Chen Yun squatted down and loaded the gun in his hand. He pressed it against Song Jixing’s head. “Do you still remember what you said previously? What did you say I was? Did you say that I was country bumpkin from Jiang City?”
“Do you think you’re worthy of the stinky bird eggs in your hand?”
“Didn’t you say that you’ll smash my shops every time I renovate them? Why don’t you have this arrogance now? Huh?” Chen Yun pointed the gun in his hand at Song Jixing’s head and exerted force.
Song Jixing felt the coldness of the gun and his entire body trembled. It was as if a basin of ice water had been poured over his head. A chill rose from his heart.
At this moment, he looked at Chen Yun and was no longer as domineering as before. “Director... Director Chen, I won’t dare to do it again. Please let me go. Please let me go!”
“I was just joking with you. I really didn’t mean that.”
“You didn’t mean that?” Chen Yun stood up and kicked Song Jixing’s face. Then, he fired a few shots and crippled Song Jixing. Amidst wails, the last gunshot sounded.
