chapters.title: Chapter 165: Check-in Reward — Golden Ferrari Pegasus Worth Two Billion!
paragraphs: After a night, Ling City was still the same as usual. There were no waves, but the entire upper echelons of Ling City knew what had happened.
In the Qian family, Qian Duo was stunned when he heard the news. His eyes widened, and he could not believe what had happened.
Just as he was about to look for someone, Chen Yun attacked first.
It was fine if he did not attack, but once he attacked, it was like a thunderbolt!
Chen Yun had said, “You don’t have to worry about it. I’ll do it myself.” This sentence still lingered in Qian Duo’s ears.

“F*ck, what kind of ruthless person is this?” Qian Duo sat there, his eyes beginning to tremble. Yesterday, he had learned from the news that the Song family had invested a lot this time. The Song family’s old master had directly approved nearly a hundred elite guards to Song Jixing, but even so, the entire Song family had been wiped out.
As for the Song family, they did not even dare to fart!

That was true. Now, half of the Song family’s guards were gone. Furthermore, they had suffered huge losses. It was already good enough that they could stabilize the situation and protect themselves. With their shameful business, who knew who would suffer if it was exposed?
Not only was Qian Duo shocked, but even the disciples of the large families in Ling City were shocked when they heard this news.
The day before, Song Jixing got someone to smash Chen Yun’s shop and said ruthless words!
The next day, Song Jixing and the hundred guards of the Song family were directly reduced to ashes!
This...
Chen Yun’s name instantly resounded throughout the upper echelons of Ling City!
Moreover, the news kept spreading. Even the high-ranking officials and nobles of Ling City knew about Chen Yun. The news spread like wildfire.
However, the Song family did not dare to pursue the matter.
The other families could only treat this matter as a topic of conversation.

Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at Lin Yuhan and still asked him to bring his brothers back to train. Although their combat strength was already very powerful, they had yet to reach the level of fighting ten people alone, let alone a higher level.

At the same time, Chen Yun also gave Jiang Zhengyu an order. In order to prevent the shops from being destroyed again, he asked Zhou Jingyi to place a huge order with Jiang Zhengyu. This made Jiang Zhengyu feel relieved for a moment. At the same time, he promised to support the Heavenly Dragon Team formed by Chen Yun’s seventy-odd subordinates.
“Brother Yun, then we’ll go back. If you’re in Ling City, will the Song family harm you?”

This time, they had dealt a heavy blow to the Song family and slapped them in the face. Not only did they kill the Song family’s young master, Song Jixing, but they also destroyed the Song family’s team.
It was hard to guarantee that the Song family would not attack Chen Yun out of desperation.

However, Chen Yun shook his head. He was not afraid of this. He had Vigor by his side. Not to mention the small Song family, even the top killers in the world could not do anything to him. After all, no matter how powerful they were, they were just mortals. Vigor was a real terminator.
It was even stronger than the Terminator.

He did not return to Jiang City because he wanted to take a look at the situation in Ling City. After all, Ling City was the most prosperous area in Jiangbei. He could reap the greatest benefits here. Secondly, Qian Duo insisted that he attend his luxury car club here.
This made him a little worried. After all, Qian Duo had borrowed the best car he had. He now suspected that Qian Duo had deliberately made him stay.
Just as he was thinking about this, Qian Duo called. “Brother Yun!”
After a crisp voice sounded.

“Brother Yun, you must be there when I open for business. Now that you’re already an influential figure in Ling City, those top young masters are preparing to get to know you,” said Qian Duo excitedly. “It’s really too satisfying.”
Chen Yun coughed. “Who told you that I did it?”

“Brother Yun, not to mention what you told me yesterday, the upper echelons of Ling City, be it rumors or reasonable inferences, all agree that you did it.” After Qian Duo finished speaking, he did not hear Chen Yun’s answer and did not comment. He immediately changed the topic.

“Brother Yun, if you don’t have a car in Jiang City, why don’t I lend you my car tomorrow? After all, we’re brothers.” Qian Duo patted his chest on the other end of the phone. He even weighed the Bugatti Veyron key in his hand, looking like he needed a beating.
Chen Yun snorted. “Don’t make me angry. I’ll destroy your place and get the car back in front of all the young masters.”
He only spoke one sentence.
Qian Duo immediately begged for mercy. “Brother Yun, don’t. If that happens, I won’t have the face to continue living in Ling City.”
Then, he thought for a moment. “I’ll pick you up, Brother Yun.”
“No need. I can go over myself tomorrow. Send me an address.”
“Okay.”
Qian Duo hung up the phone and threw it aside. Then, he looked at the Bugatti Veyron key in his hand. No matter how he looked at it, he liked it. What was this? It was a car worth 45 million yuan!
Although he was rich, his old man did not buy it for him.
With this car, he would be able to stand out in the entire Ling City circle. After all, the others would at most have Ferraris or Lamborghinis.
Moreover, he could suppress Brother Yun tomorrow. It was simply too satisfying.
This was despite the fact that he had borrowed the car from Brother Yun.
At that moment, Qian Duo looked forward to the opening of his sports club more and more.
Chen Yun took a sip of tea and was about to go to the shop to take a look when he immediately realized that it was difficult to not have a car. He was about to call the manager here to pick him up.
The next moment.
[Host, please complete the check-in mission.]
Chen Yun pressed the button.
[Check-in Quest completed. Congratulations to the host for obtaining a Golden Ferrari Pegasus.]
“A Golden Ferrari Pegasus?”
“What’s this?”
Chen Yun was stunned for a moment. He had really never heard of this car.
[The Golden Ferrari Pegasus was custom-made by the people of Dubai at the Ferrari carpark. Its total value is two billion yuan. It’s the only one in the world.]
[The car owner’s information has been changed. The relevant procedures have been modified.]
[The Golden Ferrari Pegasus is already outside the house. Host, please drive it without worry.]
Chen Yun raised his eyebrows. What nonsense was this? Did a car cost two billion? What kind of car was this? Was it made of gold?
He opened the door and looked out. In the next moment, even Chen Yun narrowed his eyes.
The sun shone on the sports car outside, emitting a dazzling golden light that made people unable to open their eyes!

The next moment.

Chen Yun pressed the button.
[Check-in Quest completed.
Congratulations to the host for obtaining a Golden Ferrari Pegasus.]
“A Golden Ferrari Pegasus?”
“What’s this?”
Chen Yun was stunned for a moment.
He had really never heard of this car.
[The Golden Ferrari Pegasus was custom-made by the people of Dubai at the Ferrari carpark.
Its total value is two billion yuan.
It’s the only one in the world.]
[The car owner’s information has been changed.
The relevant procedures have been modified.]
[The Golden Ferrari Pegasus is already outside the house.
Host, please drive it without worry.]

What nonsense was this?
Did a car cost two billion?
What kind of car was this?
Was it made of gold?
He opened the door and looked out.
In the next moment, even Chen Yun narrowed his eyes.
The sun shone on the sports car outside, emitting a dazzling golden light that made people unable to open their eyes!

paragraphs: This...
Chen Yun walked down and the corners of his mouth could not help but twitch.
What a good Golden Ferrari Pegasus. The shell of the car was really made of gold!
It was made of pure gold!
Moreover, it had an extremely perfect streamlined shape!
It was as if it was carved by the heavens. It was incomparably perfect!
What was even more heroic was that the shell of the car was actually embedded with diamonds. There were thousands of diamonds on the car.

The Ferrari logo in front was also made of pure gold. However, compared to ordinary Ferrari logos, other than changing the logo to pure gold, there were wings made of a few dazzling diamonds the size of coins on both sides of the logo.
The pair of wings was made of huge diamonds.
Every diamond was worth money that ordinary people could not earn in a few lifetimes.
At a glance, the entire car looked extremely heroic!
It was the Golden Ferrari Pegasus!
It really deserved its name!
Chen Yun entered the car. The interior was also made of pure gold. The seat was made of crocodile skin and was extremely soft.

After getting out of the car, Chen Yun nodded. The rich people in Dubai knew how to play. They spent two billion yuan to build such a luxury car. Needless to say, if this car was scratched and one or two diamonds fell, it would probably cost more than a million yuan.
He returned to his room.
Zhou Jingyi called via video call. Chen Yun picked up the call. Zhou Jingyi was sitting at her desk and looking at Mac in front of her.

“Director Chen, I’m preparing for Vigor to promote the First-Grade Restaurant recently and have increased the investment in advertising. After all, our shop will be renovated very soon and the scale will be huge.”

Zhou Jingyi asked Chen Yun. After all, the First-Grade Restaurant was no longer the same as before. Previously, the First-Grade Restaurant only existed in Jiang City and Yanwei, and there were only a few. However, now, the First-Grade Restaurant would be opened in 200 cities in the entire Jiangbei. At this moment, the importance of advertisements could be seen.
Chen Yun nodded. “You can handle these things.”
“This time, I plan to invite a popular celebrity. I’ll also arrange for Mengmeng and Xiao Xue to participate in this advertisement. After all, this can also make them famous. What do you think?”
“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded. “I’ll tell them.”
Then, Chen Yun called the two little girls. After talking to them, he closed his eyes and rested, preparing to attend the opening ceremony of Qian Duo’s sports club tonight.
At this moment, in the Dajiang Car Wash Shop in Ling City, Qian Duo’s voice sounded.
“All of you, wash the cars properly. Don’t shave off the paint.”
Beside him, the manager and a young man came over.
“Young Master Qian, are you here to wash your cars too?”
The young man came over and nodded at Qian Duo. Then, he turned around and his eyes widened. “F*ck! Young Master Qian, you...”
What was in front of him?
It was the Bugatti Veyron!
This car!
It would cost at least 40 million yuan!
“Young Master Qian, when did you buy a new car? This car is really beautiful. This streamlined car is really worthy of being a top supercar.”

The young man almost leaned on the Bugatti Veyron to take a look. His eyes were filled with envy as he praised it endlessly. Not only did he do this, but even the manager beside him was shocked when he saw the Bugatti Veyron. He quickly instructed his subordinates to be careful and not to rub against it.

Qian Duo looked at the two of them and could not help but feel smug from the praise. “Haha, I just bought this car not long ago. Isn’t this to support my image for my sports club? It’s not worth mentioning.”

“It’s said that the Qian family has the strictest control over money among the younger generation. Now that I look at it, it’s simply nonsense. Young Master Qian, how long has it been since you bought that Ferrari of yours? You’ve changed it to a Bugatti Veyron.” The young man shook his head. “I can’t do it anymore. I only have an Audi R8. I’m simply inferior to you.”
“Hey, what’s wrong with that? I’m just relying on the money at home.” Although Qian Duo said that, his face was filled with pride.
However, he felt a little guilty. After all, he had borrowed this car from Brother Yun.
Meanwhile, the young man looked at it for a while more before saying reluctantly, “Young Master Qian, I’ll leave first. See you tonight.”
“Alright!”
After washing the car, Qian Duo filled the gas tank. After all, he was borrowing Brother Yun’s car. If he did not wash Brother Yun’s car well and fill the gas tank, it would be too unreasonable.
After all, Brother Yun was free to choose whether to lend the car to him, and he did so out of goodwill. Furthermore, this was such an expensive car.
At night.
The top of Yunding Mountain in Ling City was brightly lit, illuminating the surroundings.
Qian Duo’s club was here.
It was just past seven o’clock, but there were already many luxury cars arriving one after another.
Every car was a luxury car worth more than a million yuan.
There was a McLaren P1.
There was a Porsche.
There was a Lamborghini.
Cars would usually attract a lot of attention on the road, but today, they seemed to be dim. All the supercars in the huge square in front of the club were overshadowed by a car.
That car was the Bugatti Veyron, which was like a ghost at the entrance of the club.
At this moment, Qian Duo was standing beside the Bugatti Veyron, his face filled with pride.
“Young Master Qian, when did you buy this car?”
“Damn! It’s so handsome, Brother Qian.”
“He’s indeed worthy of being called the young master of the Qian family, which is the richest among the five great families.”

“Beautiful, it’s simply too beautiful. My Porsche is simply incomparable. This time, the Jiangbei Supercar Club can be considered to have a world-class sports car. Let’s see if those poor people from Jiangnan dare to say anything else.”
Every sentence made the smile on Qian Duo’s face grow wider.
“You’re too kind.”
Behind him, a voice sounded. “Brother Qian!”
Qian Duo looked at the young man behind him and greeted, “Brother He.”

The people around him looked at the young man and automatically made way for him. Their eyes were filled with respect. This person was none other than He Yang, the young master of the He family, one of the five major families in Jiangbei.
“I heard that Director Chen will be here tonight to hold the fort for you. You’re really something, Brother Qian.”
Director Chen?
Which Director Chen?!
Everyone looked at He Yang in front of them, at a loss.
“Young Master He, who’s Director Chen?”
“Don’t you know Director Chen of Jiang City?!” He Yang’s words woke everyone up from their daze.
Director Chen of Jiang City!

The director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment had tens of billions of assets in his hands. It was rumored that because the Song family had destroyed his shop yesterday, he had brought people to blow up the Song family’s villa last night and killed the ruthless young master of the Song family, Song Jixing.
In an instant, everyone became excited. They did not expect to see such an amazing person tonight.
“Young Master Qian is really amazing.”
“I didn’t expect Director Chen to come too.”
“This time, I really have to pay a visit.”
Everyone discussed this spiritedly, yearning in their hearts.
Then, He Yang went to Qian Duo’s side. “I heard that the guests from Jiangnan seem to be bringing people over to cause trouble tonight.”
Hm?

Qian Duo was stunned. Then, he looked at the Bugatti Veyron in front of him and sneered. “Brother He, why are you panicking? The car is right here. How can those people from Jiangnan drive a better car than this car, which costs 45 million yuan? They’re just asking to be humiliated.”
The people around him also snorted coldly.
“That’s right. Young Master Qian’s Bugatti Veyron is here.”
“Who are those people from Jiangnan to cause trouble?”
“If they dare to come, it’ll be a slap to their own faces. We don’t have to panic at all.”

Hearing their words, He Yang was still a little worried. He had a concerned expression on his face. After all, it was rumored that this time, among the four major families in Jiangnan, other than the Lu family, the other three families would come.
Before he could say anything, rumbling sounds came from the square, followed by the screams of a group of delinquents.
“What’s wrong?” Qian Duo pushed through the stunned crowd and looked over with He Yang. Then, his eyes widened in disbelief.
Beside him, He Yang also gasped in shock. F*ck!

On the square, three cars stopped. All of them were perfectly streamlined. The leader was a silver sports car, and behind it were two luxury cars. One was black and the other was white, as if they were protecting the car in the lead.
“It’s a Lamborghini Hermes.”
“There are also two limited edition Ferraris.”
He Yang could not help but mutter, feeling a little confused.
Qian Duo was also stunned.
There was a Lamborghini Hermes worth 380 million yuan!
There were also two limited edition Ferraris worth 120 million yuan each!
Any one of these three cars was enough to instantly kill the Bugatti Veyron he had borrowed from Brother Yun.
At this moment, a young man in a pink suit alighted from the Lamborghini Hermes. He tidied his mohawk before looking at the cars and people around him with a sneer.

Behind him, the owners of two limited edition Ferrari cars also got out. The three of them looked around disdainfully, as if the cars parked around them were not luxury cars, but trash. The people standing there were not rich young masters and young ladies, but country bumpkins who had crawled out of the mountains.
Their gazes were simply insufferably arrogant.

Then, Jiang Shaowei, who was in the lead, looked at the Bugatti Veyron parked at the entrance of the club and clicked his tongue. “Aiyo, I heard that the number one young master in Jiangbei, Young Master Qian, opened a club and enlisted the luxury cars in Jiangbei, so I came to take a look.”
“However, I really didn’t expect this. What’s this? It’s a Bugatti Veyron that costs 45 million yuan. How dare you put it in the middle?”

“It seems that the richest man in Jiangbei is just all talk. Come, come, come. Where’s Young Master Qian? Hurry up and drive your lousy car away. I’m here to support you today. Coincidentally, I’ll lend you a car to hold the fort today! Otherwise, how can you take the title of the number one young master in Jiangbei?”
“I’m f*cking embarrassed for you!”

As Jiang Shaowei spoke, the two young men behind him laughed out loud. One of them even spat to the side. “What a good young master of Jiangbei. How dare you drive such a lousy car? I think that’s all there is to Jiangbei.”
“It’s not that I want to criticize you, but you guys are called a supercar club. So no matter what car it is, you can join as long as you have a sports car style?”

“Take a look for yourself. There’s an Audi R8, a BMW A8, a Mercedes-Benz sports car, and a Porsche. What are these? In Jiangnan, sports cars worth less than ten million yuan are not even qualified to enter the category of sport cars. However, these junk are treated as treasures here.”
The two people behind them shouted, making the young masters from Jiangbei beside them furious. However, they did not dare to refute.
Most importantly, what could they use to refute?
What cars were the other party driving?
Each of the three cars was a world-class supercar worth hundreds of millions!
Any one of them was enough to buy dozens or even a hundred of their cars!
How would they dare to say anything now? They could only look at Qian Duo.
At this moment, Qian Duo walked up to the three of them. “You’re here to destroy my place today, right?”

“Yo, what’s wrong, Young Master Qian? We’re here to support you, aren’t we?” The leader, Jiang Shaowei, came to Qian Duo and said in a low voice with a smile, “Let me tell you, I came today to let you know the difference between Jiangbei and Jiangnan. A poor guy like you is not even worth a fart in Jiangnan. You’re even arrogant.”
“To put it bluntly, Jiangbei is just a country bumpkin’s nest. You’re just a bigger country bumpkin inside.”
“If you know what’s good for you, drive your broken car away. Tonight’s venue is mine.” Jiang Shaowei threw the cigarette in his hand to the ground and crushed it.
Qian Duo’s eyes widened. He was furious, but he was helpless.
The car opposite him was indeed much better than his.
What was even more ironic was that he had borrowed this car from Brother Yun.
At this moment, he could not say a word.
“Hurry up, hurry up. What are you waiting for?” Jiang Shaowei sneered and was about to accept the worship of the people beside him.
Then, a wave of voices suddenly sounded.
That voice was simply incomparably fierce, causing everyone present to look sideways.
Everyone looked at the car that sped over and drifted before stopping. Their eyes almost popped out.
Even Jiang Shaowei and the others trembled. They looked at the car in front of them in shock.
Qian Duo was also shocked.
This!
This car!

Two billion!

What a joke!

“Are you guys worthy? Are you worthy enough?”

Were they worthy enough?!

He immediately looked at Qian Duo. “Alright, alright, alright. Young Master Qian, you have the ability and actually invited such a car. I’m impressed.”
“Let’s go!”

For a moment, boos sounded from all directions, causing the faces of the three young men to darken again, especially Jiang Shaowei, who was in the lead. His expression was extremely gloomy.

Today, he had received news that there were no good cars here and had specially come to cause trouble. However, now, he had failed to slap Qian Duo’s face and had even been slapped hard by someone else. He had simply embarrassed himself at the Jiangbei Supercar Club.
Faced with the boos, they had no choice but to quickly drive the sports cars away.
After everyone left, the young masters and young ladies of the rich families in the entire venue cheered. They all came forward to look at the Golden Ferrari Pegasus in the middle of the venue.
What was this?
This was a car worth two billion yuan!
There was only one in the world!
They came forward, but they consciously kept a few meters away from the Golden Ferrari Pegasus. They could only watch from afar and not play with it.
After watching for a while, their eyes were almost blinded by the gold and the diamonds on it. They immediately respected Chen Yun even more. One by one, they looked at Chen Yun and cheered.
“Brother Yun!”
“Brother Yun!”
“Brother Yun!”
Cheers sounded, making Chen Yun reach an extremely high level in everyone’s hearts.
At the side, Qian Duo pursed his lips when he saw this scene. It seemed that his title as the number one young master in Jiangbei was about to be snatched away. However, he felt the best tonight!
If Chen Yun did not come, he would not be able to raise his head in front of those bastards from Jiangnan.
Now, the reputation of his supercar club could not only span Jiangnan and Jiangbei, but also the entire China.
After all, which supercar club could have such a Golden Ferrari Pegasus?!
“Brother Yun, I’m just waiting for you to start the event.” Qian Duo also walked towards Chen Yun and pointed at the row of fireworks beside him.
Chen Yun nodded and walked over to light the fireworks. For a moment, the sky was dazzling! It was unlike the mortal world!

chapters.title: Chapter 168: You Guys Really Know How to Play!
paragraphs: The fireworks bloomed in the air, and the Golden Ferrari Pegasus also reflected the streams of light in the sky. It was simply incomparably gorgeous, making everyone intoxicated.
This was the magic of money!
This was the power of money!
Today, all the young masters present had seen what true heroism was!

Chen Duo even set up a banquet. Everyone drove here and could not drink alcohol. They could only use tea as wine. Even so, everyone came towards Chen Yun. As long as they were young masters or young ladies with status, they would come over and toast Chen Yun. The others also knew that with their status, they could not come into contact with such a person.
Therefore, they did not come over.
In one night, Chen Yun became completely famous among the young masters of Ling City with this Golden Ferrari Pegasus.
The next day, Chen Yun woke up and looked at the time. It was only seven o’clock.
Outside, someone knocked on the door.
Chen Yun opened it and a figure pounced over.
“Brother!”
“Are you here?”
Chen Yun patted Chen Mengmeng’s head, his face filled with love.
“Brother Yun.”
Han Xue spoke charmingly from the side.
“Where’s Sister Menghan?” Chen Yun took a look. Wang Menghan was actually not here. Wasn’t she going to film the advertisement for the First-Grade Restaurant today?
“We don’t know either. Sister Menghan discussed it with Sister Jingyi yesterday and asked the two of us to come over. Sister Menghan didn’t come.”
It was Zhou Jingyi’s decision.

Chen Yun thought for a moment. That was true. Although Wang Menghan was now famous all over the country with the four songs Chen Yun had given her back then, they had invited another popular celebrity this time. If Wang Menghan came and stole the limelight from these two girls, Zhou Jingyi’s original intention would be gone.
This was good too.
Chen Yun looked at the two of them. “Let’s go. Let’s prepare and go there.”
“Okay.”
An hour later, at the First-Grade Restaurant in Ling City, the venue had been cleaned up.
In the middle of the venue, there was a young man with dyed white hair and fashionable clothes. He also had fair and tender skin. He was surrounded by more than ten people.

These people surrounding him were busy with the young man in the middle. They were either tidying his hair, putting on makeup for him, fanning him, or putting on earrings for him. There were even two stylists tidying his clothes.
Furthermore, there were two female assistants kneeling on one knee to wipe the dust off his shoes.
This was despite the fact that the surface of his shoes was already very clean, and there was no need to wipe them anymore.
If a university girl were to look at the young man in front of her, she would definitely recognize him at first glance. This person was the recently rising celebrity, Qu Yikai!

Qu Yikai became famous overnight because of talent variety shows. Half a year ago, at the end of the year, he had even appeared on the Spring Festival Gala on local television stations and the New Year’s Eve gala on short video websites. In addition, he had received offers for a few good variety shows and was supported by the company behind him. He could be said to be very popular now.
He was extremely popular. It could be said that almost all the female students knew him. Even if they had never seen his face, they must have heard of his name.

At this moment, he looked at his surroundings, then at his shoes. He said to the two female assistants, “The two of you, wipe them properly. How unlucky. I wonder what Sister Na is up to. She actually made me come to such a place to film an advertisement. She simply doesn’t take me seriously.”

Although he said that, he had some considerations in his heart. After all, he had heard that he was collaborating with Wang Menghan to film an advertisement this time. Everyone knew Wang Menghan. Now, the popular people on the Internet also had to be divided into tiers.

In the first tier were Liu Xin and Wang Menghan. One of them had obtained the title of the God of Luck on the Internet. Just the number of hardcore fans that made up the God of Luck Family Army alone numbered in the tens of millions. As for Wang Menghan, there was no need to mention her. A month ago, she had relied on four songs to become popular on the Internet and became a new star after Liu Xin.

As for him and some other popular celebrities, they were in the second tier or even further back. After all, they did not have any unyielding skills, unlike Liu Xin, who was so lucky, and Wang Menghan, who had such singing and lyric-writing skills.
These people relied on their looks and marketing.
They also relied on the support of the company and spent money to get on various rankings.
However, as long as they could become popular, who cared how they became popular?
Even though he did not have any hard skills, he still had many die-hard fans.
This time, he also planned to ride on Wang Menghan’s popularity and improve himself. If he could take the opportunity to get Wang Menghan or have some scandals, his popularity would increase.
Qu Yikai calculated in his heart. In the next moment, he immediately felt pain. He suddenly turned to look at the hairstylist standing at the side. “What are you doing?! Do you know how to work?!”
“Who do you think you are? How can you become a hairstylist? Get lost, get lost.”
The hairstylist standing behind Qu Yikai had an ugly expression. Her face was full of awkwardness.
Her hands, which were holding the hairdryer and hair gel respectively, froze in the air, not knowing how to move.
Then, a woman in high heels slowly walked in beside him. Then, she looked at Qu Yikai. “Yikai.”
“Sister Na.” Qu Yikai did not dare to be arrogant towards his manager, Zhang Na. He immediately nodded at her. After all, Zhang Na had supported him single-handedly.
Then, he looked at Zhang Na. “Sister Na, what kind of place is this? Why did you find such a place for me to film an advertisement?”
Upon hearing his complaint, Zhang Na immediately snorted coldly.

“Be content. We were supposed to go to the First-Grade Restaurant in Jiang City to film. Didn’t you say that you didn’t want to go over and that the production team could only come over? What else do you want? The other party has already made a huge concession.”
When Qu Yikai heard this, his eyes were filled with disdain.
Who was he? He was a popular celebrity now. The other party should do this!
Then, a middle-aged man came over. “Sister Na, is Yikai not ready yet?”
“Over there, our director has been waiting for you for almost 20 minutes. You really can’t dawdle any longer.”
“What are you talking about?!”
Qu Yikai looked at the middle-aged man and sneered. “What kind of attitude is this? Do you know who I am?!”
With that, he crossed his arms, turned his face sideways, and sat down.

The middle-aged man wilted on the spot and stood there petrified. He could not leave or stay. He was only the assistant director of this advertisement and did not have much power. He could not afford to offend a popular celebrity like Qu Yikai.
Helpless, he could only look at Qu Yikai’s manager, Zhang Na.
As an experienced manager who had been in the entertainment industry for so many years, Zhang Na naturally had a way to deal with such a situation.
She looked at the middle-aged man. Although he was only an assistant director and did not have much power, what was behind him? It was Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
Sacred Heaven Entertainment had soared to become one of the top entertainment companies in China in a short period of time!
Therefore, she had to deal with the other party carefully. She could not go too far.

“Assistant Director, I’ll talk to him. We’re not ready yet. Please forgive us.” Zhang Na said apologetically, “Please apologize to the director for me first. I’ll treat everyone to dinner tonight as compensation.”
“Okay.”
Seeing that Zhang Na had said so, the middle-aged man could not say anything else and could only leave.
As soon as the middle-aged man left, Zhang Na came to Qu Yikai’s side.
“Yikai, you can’t treat them like this. The other party invited us here to give us respect.”
“Just now, although that person was only an assistant director, the party behind him was Sacred Heaven Entertainment. I don’t need to tell you more about Sacred Heaven Entertainment, right?”

“Moreover, you have to figure out your position. You’re not relying on your ability now, but with your face. You’re also relying on your popularity. If you continue being so arrogant, I think there’s no need for the company to support you.”

Qu Yikai sat there with his legs crossed and looked at Zhang Na. “Sister Na, you’re going too far. It’s not like you don’t know how many fans I have on Weibo now. There are more than five million! Just by waving my hand now, a large number of die-hard fans will send me money.”
“Moreover, so what if they’re from Sacred Heaven? Isn’t Huayi Entertainment behind us? Huayi has been established longer than Sacred Heaven and has more foundation...”
These few words made Zhang Na sigh. In the past, Qu Yikai still listened to her words. Ever since he became popular, he even dared to say such things.
Click.
The next moment, the door of the room suddenly opened. Then, a man in his thirties slowly walked in.
“Director Sun.” Zhang Na looked at the man and knew why he was here. She immediately smiled apologetically. “Director Sun, we’re already ready. Is Miss Wang Menghan already here?”

“Miss Wang won’t be coming here anymore. We’ve changed the cast to two young actresses, who will shoot this advertisement with Qu Yikai.” After he finished speaking, he looked behind him and two beautiful figures walked out.

They were none other than Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, who had already put on makeup and looked like a pair of immortals who had descended to the mortal world. They looked at Qu Yikai in front of them without any passionate expressions. Instead, they looked a little dissatisfied.

After all, everyone had been waiting outside for too long. The current temperature, coupled with the fact that the First-Grade Restaurant had just been renovated and the air-conditioning system had not been fully activated, made the staff sweat profusely. Everyone was waiting for this person.
Did he say that Wang Menghan was not coming?
Had they changed the cast?

Qu Yikai and Zhang Na looked at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, who were standing at the side. They looked at each other and confirmed their thoughts. These two were definitely new faces in the entertainment industry. They had never seen these girls before.
At this moment, Qu Yikai was sitting on a chair with his hand on the backrest. He looked at the people in front of him with a teasing expression. “Director Sun, isn’t this a little inappropriate?”

“You used Wang Menghan to trick me into coming here. It’s even better now. Not only did Wang Menghan not come, but you also found two newbies to freeload on my popularity. You guys really played this trick well.”
These words made Director Sun’s face turn cold.

Didn’t you say that you didn’t want to go over and that the production team could only come over?
What else do you want?
The other party has already made a huge concession.”
When Qu Yikai heard this, his eyes were filled with disdain.
Who was he?
He was a popular celebrity now.
The other party should do this!
Then, a middle-aged man came over.
“Sister Na, is Yikai not ready yet?”
“Over there, our director has been waiting for you for almost 20 minutes.
You really can’t dawdle any longer.”
“What are you talking about?!”
Qu Yikai looked at the middle-aged man and sneered.
“What kind of attitude is this?
Do you know who I am?!”
With that, he crossed his arms, turned his face sideways, and sat down.
The middle-aged man wilted on the spot and stood there petrified.
He could not leave or stay.
He was only the assistant director of this advertisement and did not have much power.
He could not afford to offend a popular celebrity like Qu Yikai.
Helpless, he could only look at Qu Yikai’s manager, Zhang Na.
As an experienced manager who had been in the entertainment industry for so many years, Zhang Na naturally had a way to deal with such a situation.
She looked at the middle-aged man.
Although he was only an assistant director and did not have much power, what was behind him?
It was Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
Sacred Heaven Entertainment had soared to become one of the top entertainment companies in China in a short period of time!
Therefore, she had to deal with the other party carefully.
She could not go too far.
“Assistant Director, I’ll talk to him.
We’re not ready yet.
Please forgive us.” Zhang Na said apologetically, “Please apologize to the director for me first.
I’ll treat everyone to dinner tonight as compensation.”
“Okay.”
Seeing that Zhang Na had said so, the middle-aged man could not say anything else and could only leave.
As soon as the middle-aged man left, Zhang Na came to Qu Yikai’s side.
“Yikai, you can’t treat them like this.
The other party invited us here to give us respect.”
“Just now, although that person was only an assistant director, the party behind him was Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
I don’t need to tell you more about Sacred Heaven Entertainment, right?”
“Moreover, you have to figure out your position.
You’re not relying on your ability now, but with your face.
You’re also relying on your popularity.
If you continue being so arrogant, I think there’s no need for the company to support you.”
Qu Yikai sat there with his legs crossed and looked at Zhang Na.
“Sister Na, you’re going too far.
It’s not like you don’t know how many fans I have on Weibo now.
There are more than five million!
Just by waving my hand now, a large number of die-hard fans will send me money.”
“Moreover, so what if they’re from Sacred Heaven?
Isn’t Huayi Entertainment behind us?
Huayi has been established longer than Sacred Heaven and has more foundation...”
These few words made Zhang Na sigh.
In the past, Qu Yikai still listened to her words.
Ever since he became popular, he even dared to say such things.
Click.
The next moment, the door of the room suddenly opened.
Then, a man in his thirties slowly walked in.
“Director Sun.” Zhang Na looked at the man and knew why he was here.
She immediately smiled apologetically.
“Director Sun, we’re already ready.
Is Miss Wang Menghan already here?”
“Miss Wang won’t be coming here anymore.
We’ve changed the cast to two young actresses, who will shoot this advertisement with Qu Yikai.” After he finished speaking, he looked behind him and two beautiful figures walked out.
They were none other than Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, who had already put on makeup and looked like a pair of immortals who had descended to the mortal world.
They looked at Qu Yikai in front of them without any passionate expressions.
Instead, they looked a little dissatisfied.
After all, everyone had been waiting outside for too long.
The current temperature, coupled with the fact that the First-Grade Restaurant had just been renovated and the air-conditioning system had not been fully activated, made the staff sweat profusely.
Everyone was waiting for this person.
Did he say that Wang Menghan was not coming?
Had they changed the cast?
Qu Yikai and Zhang Na looked at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, who were standing at the side.
They looked at each other and confirmed their thoughts.
These two were definitely new faces in the entertainment industry.
They had never seen these girls before.
At this moment, Qu Yikai was sitting on a chair with his hand on the backrest.
He looked at the people in front of him with a teasing expression.
“Director Sun, isn’t this a little inappropriate?”
“You used Wang Menghan to trick me into coming here.
It’s even better now.
Not only did Wang Menghan not come, but you also found two newbies to freeload on my popularity.
You guys really played this trick well.”
These words made Director Sun’s face turn cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Supreme-Grade Check-In Mission
paragraphs: “You guys really played this trick well.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the surrounding people were stunned. Even Zhang Na’s eyes were filled with disbelief. She did not expect Qu Yikai to say this in front of Director Sun.
Just as she was about to explain, Director Sun’s expression darkened. “Qu Yikai, what do you mean?”

“What do you mean? Wasn’t I clear enough?” Qu Yikai stood up and took two steps forward. He stared at Director Sun in front of him. “Let me tell you, I’ll give you two choices today. The first is to call Wang Menghan over. The second is to increase my remuneration. Otherwise, I won’t serve you today.”
“You’re using this price to get two newbies to come and ride on my popularity. It’s really a little funny.”
When Han Xue and Chen Mengmeng heard this, they did not say anything.
After all, they did not know what to say.
From the looks of it, they were really taking advantage of Qu Yikai’s popularity.
Director Sun nodded. “It’s impossible for Wang Menghan to come this time. Tell me, how much do you want?”
“Six million.”
What?
Six million!

These words shocked Director Sun, let alone Zhang Na, who was beside him. Her eyes widened. The two million yuan that Sacred Heaven had offered Qu Yikai was already shockingly high. After all, it was just a small advertisement. How could they offer two million yuan?
When Zhang Na looked at the two million yuan again, she realized that Sacred Heaven probably felt guilty and offered such a price to compensate him.
However, at this moment, Qu Yikai had actually tripled this astronomical price!
It directly reached six million yuan!
It was six million yuan!
It was enough for those capable movie stars and even the Best Actors and Best Actresses to film many television dramas!
This!
Zhang Na did not say anything. She stood at the side and could not say anything.
At this moment, a young man slowly walked in.
“Hey, Yikai, what’s going on?”

“Young Master Tian.” Qu Yikai looked at the young man and immediately smiled. Who was the other party? He was the young master of the Tian family in Ling City. The Tian family had billions of assets in their hands. Young Master Tian was even one of the top young masters in Jiang City. How could he not be respectful?
Qu Yikai leaned over to Young Master Tian. “Young Master Tian, why are you here?”
“I came to support you today while taking a walk. I happened to see you. What’s wrong? Did you have a conflict?”
“They want me to shoot an advertisement with two million yuan and even let two brats ride on my popularity. Do they really think I’m a fool?”
“Two million yuan?” Young Master Tian did not know the market price in the entertainment industry. However, it was just an advertisement. Did it require so much money?
Just as the two of them were talking, a female voice sounded.
“Why are you still dawdling? What are you doing?”
A few figures immediately walked in. Zhou Jingyi was the first to enter. She looked at the director in front of her with dissatisfaction. What was he doing? He had been dawdling for so long!
What was he doing?!
“Manager Zhou.” Director Sun had a respectful expression on his face. “I don’t have any choice...”
Then, he told her the whole story without adding any details.
After hearing this, the atmosphere immediately fell silent.
“In that case, let’s change the cast. I’ll call Ma Ke later. His name is Qu Yikai, right? Go back to your hometown. Young man, the entertainment industry is not a place you can stay in.”

Behind them, a voice suddenly sounded, causing everyone to look sideways. They saw the young man, who was in a white suit and standing in the middle of the few young men, say something that shocked everyone until their eyes almost popped out.
Haha.
As soon as he said this, Qu Yikai immediately chuckled. Then, he looked at Chen Yun with disdain in his eyes. “Who are you? What right do you have to speak to me like this?”
He looked at Chen Yun as if he was looking at an idiot. What a fool’s dream!
He now had five million fans on the Internet, but this person wanted him to leave the entertainment industry.
Young man!
What the hell was he thinking?!
As he spoke, Young Master Tian’s eyes widened and he walked forward.
Qu Yikai thought that Young Master Tian was going to speak up for him. He smiled and said, “Young Master Tian, do you think this person is dreaming?”
However, in the next moment.
Pa!
A crisp sound rang out as Young Master Tian slapped Qu Yikai’s face, causing Qu Yikai to be stunned.
The force was so great that two of his teeth fell out and blood flowed from the corner of his mouth.
What did actors rely on to make a living? They relied on their looks.
Now that he had become like this, how could he earn?
At that moment, he looked at Young Master Tian resentfully.
However, Young Master Tian slapped him again. “F*ck your mother, what are you looking at?!”
“Who do you think you are? Who do you think you are?!”
Then, he turned to look at the person standing on the other side and bowed 90 degrees.
His face was pale and bloodless.
After a long time, he slowly straightened his body and greeted the person in front of him.
“Director Chen.”
“Young Master Qian.”
“Young Master He.”

One by one, he greeted the young masters. In the end, Young Master Tian smiled apologetically. “I only know this person. There’s nothing between us. Young Master He, Young Master Qian, Director Chen, please don’t misunderstand.”

Qu Yikai was in a daze. He looked at Young Master Tian in front of him. Young Master Tian was usually high and mighty, and looked insufferably arrogant. When had he ever acted so politely like a grandson?

Beside him, Zhang Na could not understand either. Then, she looked at Young Master Tian and said coldly, “Young Master Tian, what are you doing? How can Yikai survive in the entertainment industry in the future if you beat him up like this? You’re going too far.”
“Did I go too far?” Young Master Tian sneered. “Does this guy want to continue working in the entertainment industry in the future? What are you thinking?”
“Tell me, can a small actor like you withstand the He family from the five major families in Jiangbei?!”
Young Master Tian paused for a moment before continuing.
“Can he withstand the Qian family, one of the five major families in Jiangbei?!”
“Or can he withstand the anger of the number one person in Jiang City, Director Chen of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!”
These three sentences shocked Zhang Na and Qu Yikai. Their eyes almost popped out as they looked at the people in front of them.
Young Master He.
Young Master Qian.
Director Chen of Jiang City!
Any one of these people had a terrifying background.
At this moment, Qu Yikai, who was originally excited, immediately trembled. His face turned pale, as if he was a dead person.
Qu Yikai suddenly collapsed to the ground, unable to believe what had happened...
“Throw him out.” Qian Duo ordered. The two burly men behind him immediately went forward and carried him out.
“Jingyi, continue filming the advertisement. Call Menghan over,” said Chen Yun to Zhou Jingyi.
Chen Yun was about to leave.
The screen in front of him suddenly lit up.
[A supreme-grade check-in mission has been activated.]
[A week later, at Mount Shennong.]
[Additional Missions: It will be released at random times within a week.]
[Reward: Unknown.]

chapters.title: Chapter 170: A Thug in a Suit!
paragraphs: Chen Yun looked at the screen.
Was this a supreme-grade check-in mission?
However, he had to go to Mount Shennong.
Mount Shennong was also in Jiangbei, but it was quite remote and was in the northwest corner of Jiangbei.
Legend had it that Shennong1 tasted hundreds of herbs there, which was why it was called Mount Shennong.
Of course, the mountains and rivers there were lush, so it was naturally a good place to produce medicinal herbs. However, in recent years, that place had been treated as a tourist spot.
However, it was the off-season for tourism.
It seemed like he really had to make a trip there.
After making the arrangements, Chen Yun watched Chen Mengmeng and the others film the advertisement.

A few hours later, Wang Menghan also rushed over from Jiang City. Zhou Jingyi looked at Wang Menghan with an embarrassed expression. “Menghan, I didn’t expect such a thing to happen. I even invited you over from Jiang City. You must be tired on the way.”
“Jingyi, it’s okay.”
Wang Menghan looked at Zhou Jingyi without any intention of blaming her. First, they had spent some time together. Second, Wang Menghan naturally knew Zhou Jingyi’s current responsibilities.
She was the Manager of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s Operations Department!
She still held the management power of the First-Grade Restaurant and so many shops. Moreover, Chen Yun was constantly increasing her strength.
The three of them who had gone out to sea with Chen Yun back then had developed greatly.

Xiao Xin became the God of Luck on the Internet and had tens of millions of fans. Meanwhile, Wang Menghan became famous overnight with the four songs Chen Yun had given her. She became popular all over the Internet and her popularity did not decrease. As for Zhou Jingyi, she had the closest relationship with Chen Yun among the three of them and was also the most important.
Of course, if Zhou Jingyi was not capable, she would not have come to such a position.
Then, after putting on makeup and explaining the scenes, Wang Menghan brought Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue to shoot the advertisement.

Xu Bin also rushed from Jiang City and made a table of dishes that were like the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast. They looked, smelled, and tasted good, especially the color. Old Man Xu also knew that the dishes were going to be on television, so he emphasized their color.
After all, the audience in front of the television could not smell this fragrance.
When the dishes were served, the staff beside them smelled the fragrance and were hungry. They had lived for so long, but they had never smelled such a fragrance. It was simply too tempting.
Chen Yun watched from the side as the staff swallowed their saliva. He immediately said, “It’s almost noon. Everyone, hang in there. After filming, we’ll eat here.”
As soon as he said this, the staff immediately cheered, as if they had received an extraordinary reward. The young masters beside them also cheered.
Qian Duo’s eyes lit up. “Hehe, Brother Yun, we have to eat a good meal today.”
The filming process of the advertisement was also extremely smooth. After all, they simply had to show the truest side of the First-Grade Restaurant.
The entire advertisement was shot.
Then, everyone began to eat heartily.
In three to two days, Chen Yun arranged the matters in Jiang City and Ling City before boarding the flight to Mount Shennong.
Mount Shennong was a tourist attraction.
However, after getting off the plane, he still had to take a bus over.
Chen Yun did not trouble the managers of the local shops and simply took a bus.
As soon as Chen Yun got into the bus, he immediately caused many exclamations.

At this moment, Chen Yun was wearing black sunglasses and a white suit with gold trimmings. Under the suit, his slightly bulging muscles could be seen. His every move was filled with characteristics of an ideal boyfriend.
Moreover, even though his eyes were not exposed, the other parts of his face were still shocking. The others looked forward to his entire face under the sunglasses.
As soon as he got into the bus, someone came up to Chen Yun to ask for his WeChat, but he rejected them.
In the back row, the two girls also saw Chen Yun. The girl by the window pushed her best friend beside her. “Yuwan, look. There’s a handsome man there.”
“What handsome man?” Zhang Yuwan looked up slightly. In the next moment, her eyes widened as she looked at Chen Yun, who was walking towards them. She was immediately stunned.
He was really handsome!
He was extremely handsome!
Moreover, he exuded the aura of a working adult, like a domineering CEO.
The male students in the school did not have such an aura, so the two girls could not take their eyes off him.
“Yuwan, look, this handsome man is coming towards us.” Wang Meiqing was so excited that her face turned red.
Chen Yun simply sat behind them.
“Hello, my name is Wang Meiqing.”
As soon as Chen Yun sat down, the girl in front of him quickly turned around and greeted him.
Chen Yun glanced at the other party’s age. She was about 17 or 18 years old, about the same age as Chen Mengmeng.
“My name is Chen Yun.”
Chen Yun nodded slightly and took off his sunglasses.

However, in the next moment, the girl beside Wang Meiqing suddenly turned around and looked at Chen Yun’s face, as if she was confirming something. Then, she called out softly, “Are you Brother Chen Yun?”
Brother Chen Yun?
With these words, Wang Meiqing was at a loss. Yuwan was usually not a frivolous girl. Why did she call him brother?
However, Chen Yun looked at Zhang Yuwan and frowned. “Are you Xiao Yuwan?”
“A woman really changes when she grows up. I didn’t recognize you at first.”
“What’s going on? What’s going on?” Wang Meiqing looked at the two people, who knew each other, and quickly asked.
During the conversation, Wang Meiqing realized that this person was Chen Mengmeng’s brother.

Chen Mengmeng was Zhang Yuwan’s classmate and her best friend who had played with her since she was young. Chen Mengmeng, Han Xue, and Zhang Yuwan had played with one another since they were young and were classmates. However, she seemed to have heard that Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue had gone to Jiang City to take the art exam. Their results seemed to be not bad and they had already begun to enter the entertainment industry.
Just thinking about it made one envious.
In the entertainment industry, they could easily earn hundreds of thousands of yuan.
If they became popular, they would earn even more.

Chen Yun looked at the two girls. Wang Meiqing’s appearance was already considered above average, but Zhang Yuwan had already become a true beauty from the little girl in his impression. She had a peerless face and beautiful eyes. She was not inferior to his sister and Xiao Xue at all.
Chen Yun was speechless. Was their courtyard producing beauties? Needless to say, even Fang Mengjun and Zhang Huaiyao had such good fortune.

However, it was no wonder that Chen Yun did not recognize her previously. This little girl had followed Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue when she was young. When she was bullied, she would cry loudly. From time to time, she was willing to follow behind him like a little follower.
Speaking of the past, Zhang Yuwan’s face turned red. “Brother Yun! Let’s not talk about what happened when we were young. I’ve already grown up!”
“Meanwhile, Brother Yun, you’re really handsome now. I didn’t recognize you at first. By the way, Brother Yun, I heard from Mengmeng that you’re doing well in Jiang City, right?”
“I’m just doing some business,” said Chen Yun with a smile.
Zhang Yuwan did not believe it. She had seen Chen Mengmeng’s post. He had such a huge villa!
Moreover, he seemed to have a sports car!
According to Chen Mengmeng’s post, she and Xiao Xue were living very comfortably in Jiang City.
Beside him, Wang Meiqing looked at the opportunity and leaned over. “Brother Chen Yun, since you’re also here to play, why don’t we go together?”

Wang Meiqing blinked her big eyes, which were filled with anticipation. It was not that she had a good impression of Chen Yun. After all, he was her classmate’s brother. However, it was very dangerous for the two girls to go out, especially since Zhang Yuwan was so beautiful. It would be difficult if they encountered a hooligan. Moreover, she heard that there were many poisonous insects on the mountain.

Originally, many boys were willing to accompany them, but they were all rejected by Zhang Yuwan. After all, Zhang Yuwan was a strong contender for the title of the school belle in school. She had many suitors and had always been praised.
However, Zhang Yuwan was not interested in them at all. She pulled her best friend out.
Therefore, it was inevitable that she would be arrogant.
However, in front of Chen Yun, she was as obedient as a little sheep, making Wang Meiqing say that everyone had their weaknesses.
Chen Yun was about to reject her when Zhang Yuwan also looked at him. “Brother Chen Yun, is there anything else you’re here for? If there is, we won’t disturb you. If not, let us come with you.”
Then, she took out her phone. “Look, Mengmeng said the same thing.”
Chen Yun looked at his phone. Zhang Yuwan had already contacted Chen Mengmeng. He could only nod. This girl was really good at scamming her brother.

Then, after putting on makeup and explaining the scenes, Wang Menghan brought Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue to shoot the advertisement.
Xu Bin also rushed from Jiang City and made a table of dishes that were like the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast.
They looked, smelled, and tasted good, especially the color.
Old Man Xu also knew that the dishes were going to be on television, so he emphasized their color.
After all, the audience in front of the television could not smell this fragrance.
When the dishes were served, the staff beside them smelled the fragrance and were hungry.
They had lived for so long, but they had never smelled such a fragrance.
It was simply too tempting.
Chen Yun watched from the side as the staff swallowed their saliva.
He immediately said, “It’s almost noon.
Everyone, hang in there.
After filming, we’ll eat here.”
As soon as he said this, the staff immediately cheered, as if they had received an extraordinary reward.
The young masters beside them also cheered.
Qian Duo’s eyes lit up.
“Hehe, Brother Yun, we have to eat a good meal today.”
The filming process of the advertisement was also extremely smooth.
After all, they simply had to show the truest side of the First-Grade Restaurant.
The entire advertisement was shot.
Then, everyone began to eat heartily.
In three to two days, Chen Yun arranged the matters in Jiang City and Ling City before boarding the flight to Mount Shennong.
Mount Shennong was a tourist attraction.
However, after getting off the plane, he still had to take a bus over.
Chen Yun did not trouble the managers of the local shops and simply took a bus.
As soon as Chen Yun got into the bus, he immediately caused many exclamations.
At this moment, Chen Yun was wearing black sunglasses and a white suit with gold trimmings.
Under the suit, his slightly bulging muscles could be seen.
His every move was filled with characteristics of an ideal boyfriend.
Moreover, even though his eyes were not exposed, the other parts of his face were still shocking.
The others looked forward to his entire face under the sunglasses.
As soon as he got into the bus, someone came up to Chen Yun to ask for his WeChat, but he rejected them.
In the back row, the two girls also saw Chen Yun.
The girl by the window pushed her best friend beside her.
“Yuwan, look.
There’s a handsome man there.”
“What handsome man?” Zhang Yuwan looked up slightly.
In the next moment, her eyes widened as she looked at Chen Yun, who was walking towards them.
She was immediately stunned.
He was really handsome!
He was extremely handsome!
Moreover, he exuded the aura of a working adult, like a domineering CEO.
The male students in the school did not have such an aura, so the two girls could not take their eyes off him.
“Yuwan, look, this handsome man is coming towards us.” Wang Meiqing was so excited that her face turned red.
Chen Yun simply sat behind them.
“Hello, my name is Wang Meiqing.”
As soon as Chen Yun sat down, the girl in front of him quickly turned around and greeted him.
Chen Yun glanced at the other party’s age.
She was about 17 or 18 years old, about the same age as Chen Mengmeng.
“My name is Chen Yun.”
Chen Yun nodded slightly and took off his sunglasses.
However, in the next moment, the girl beside Wang Meiqing suddenly turned around and looked at Chen Yun’s face, as if she was confirming something.
Then, she called out softly, “Are you Brother Chen Yun?”
Brother Chen Yun?
With these words, Wang Meiqing was at a loss.
Yuwan was usually not a frivolous girl.
Why did she call him brother?
However, Chen Yun looked at Zhang Yuwan and frowned.
“Are you Xiao Yuwan?”
“A woman really changes when she grows up.
I didn’t recognize you at first.”
“What’s going on?
What’s going on?” Wang Meiqing looked at the two people, who knew each other, and quickly asked.
During the conversation, Wang Meiqing realized that this person was Chen Mengmeng’s brother.
Chen Mengmeng was Zhang Yuwan’s classmate and her best friend who had played with her since she was young.
Chen Mengmeng, Han Xue, and Zhang Yuwan had played with one another since they were young and were classmates.
However, she seemed to have heard that Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue had gone to Jiang City to take the art exam.
Their results seemed to be not bad and they had already begun to enter the entertainment industry.
Just thinking about it made one envious.
In the entertainment industry, they could easily earn hundreds of thousands of yuan.
If they became popular, they would earn even more.
Chen Yun looked at the two girls.
Wang Meiqing’s appearance was already considered above average, but Zhang Yuwan had already become a true beauty from the little girl in his impression.
She had a peerless face and beautiful eyes.
She was not inferior to his sister and Xiao Xue at all.
Chen Yun was speechless.
Was their courtyard producing beauties?
Needless to say, even Fang Mengjun and Zhang Huaiyao had such good fortune.
However, it was no wonder that Chen Yun did not recognize her previously.
This little girl had followed Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue when she was young.
When she was bullied, she would cry loudly.
From time to time, she was willing to follow behind him like a little follower.
Speaking of the past, Zhang Yuwan’s face turned red.
“Brother Yun!
Let’s not talk about what happened when we were young.
I’ve already grown up!”
“Meanwhile, Brother Yun, you’re really handsome now.
I didn’t recognize you at first.
By the way, Brother Yun, I heard from Mengmeng that you’re doing well in Jiang City, right?”
“I’m just doing some business,” said Chen Yun with a smile.
Zhang Yuwan did not believe it.
She had seen Chen Mengmeng’s post.
He had such a huge villa!
Moreover, he seemed to have a sports car!
According to Chen Mengmeng’s post, she and Xiao Xue were living very comfortably in Jiang City.
Beside him, Wang Meiqing looked at the opportunity and leaned over.
“Brother Chen Yun, since you’re also here to play, why don’t we go together?”
Wang Meiqing blinked her big eyes, which were filled with anticipation.
It was not that she had a good impression of Chen Yun.
After all, he was her classmate’s brother.
However, it was very dangerous for the two girls to go out, especially since Zhang Yuwan was so beautiful.
It would be difficult if they encountered a hooligan.
Moreover, she heard that there were many poisonous insects on the mountain.
Originally, many boys were willing to accompany them, but they were all rejected by Zhang Yuwan.
After all, Zhang Yuwan was a strong contender for the title of the school belle in school.
She had many suitors and had always been praised.
However, Zhang Yuwan was not interested in them at all.
She pulled her best friend out.
Therefore, it was inevitable that she would be arrogant.
However, in front of Chen Yun, she was as obedient as a little sheep, making Wang Meiqing say that everyone had their weaknesses.
Chen Yun was about to reject her when Zhang Yuwan also looked at him.
“Brother Chen Yun, is there anything else you’re here for?
If there is, we won’t disturb you.
If not, let us come with you.”
Then, she took out her phone.
“Look, Mengmeng said the same thing.”
Chen Yun looked at his phone.
Zhang Yuwan had already contacted Chen Mengmeng.
He could only nod.
This girl was really good at scamming her brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Be Careful of Going Bankrupt!
paragraphs: When they arrived at Mount Shennong, Chen Yun looked up. The continuous Mount Shennong was covered in a faint mist, making it look like a paradise on earth.
Beside him, Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing were looking at the guide they had prepared.
“Brother Chen Yun, are you also here to watch the Shennong Ceremony?” Zhang Yuwan leaned over and asked.
“The Shennong Ceremony?” Chen Yun was at a loss. “What’s that?”
“Huh?” Wang Meiqing, who was beside him, was stunned. “Brother, don’t you know? The Shennong Ceremony happens once every ten years.”
“However, it won’t start for a few days. Let’s go to the Chinese medicine antique street first and take a look,” said Zhang Yuwan excitedly.
Chen Yun was a little helpless. He had come over purely to check in. He did not have any plan at all. He was unlike the two little girls, who were really here to travel.
Now, he was being led away by the two little girls. Chen Yun looked at them and was fine with anything.

When they arrived at the Chinese medicine antique street, Chen Yun looked at the things in front of him. He did not expect there to be such an antique market here. However, after looking for a while, he lost interest. The scene here was like Panjiayuan in the capital, but it was not as formal as Panjiayuan. It could be said that there were all kinds of people here.
It was not that there were no good things among them, but it depended on one’s judgment. There were some things that even the shop owner did not know if they were good things.
If one had the ability, one could naturally choose the good things inside. This was the so-called act of searching for treasures.
However, if one didn’t have the ability, then it was a pity. It was very likely that the decades or even centuries-old ginseng that they spent a lot of money to buy was made from a little carrot.
It was not like such things did not happen.

Moreover, this was also because one party was willing to fight, while the other party was willing to suffer. They knew that they had been scammed, but after paying and obtaining the goods, who cared about them?
Chen Yun was not even interested in activating the Eye of Truth. He took a few glances and stopped looking.
At the side, Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing were looking at the goods with relish. They even had the urge to buy something.

However, when they asked about the price, no matter what it was, it would cost at least a few hundred or a thousand yuan. They were instantly in a dilemma. With the money in their hands, they could only buy some souvenirs. How could they afford such things?
After shopping for a while, they were about to go back when a girl who brushed past them suddenly turned around and looked at Chen Yun. “Xiao Yun? Are you Xiao Yun?”
Chen Yun was slightly stunned. He looked at the city girl in front of him who was wearing a sunhat and dressed innocently. She felt very unfamiliar.
“Who are you?”

“I’m Li Wenjing, your cousin’s roommate and best friend. Don’t you recognize me?” The city girl took off her hat, revealing a small face with a smile. She was quite good-looking and was not much different from Wang Meiqing.
“Oh, it’s Sister Wenjing.” Chen Yun finally remembered.

This girl was the university roommate of his elder cousin, Chen Han. He had seen her a few times in the past, but he was not very familiar with the friends of his extended family. Thus, he didn’t remember her for a moment.
Chen Yun looked at Li Wenjing and thought of Chen Han.
Chen Han was the daughter of his uncle and was like his elder sister. She had already entered the family business to work.

The family of Chen Yun’s father was also quite famous in and around the village. After all, the old master of the family was now the village chief. In addition, the village’s plans in the past few years had caused their entire family to expand violently. It could be said that their wealth in the village was monstrous and they were even expanding.

However, because the village chief was from the direct line of descent, Chen Yun and the other collateral relatives did not receive any benefits. Every New Year, they could only watch those people show off.

Currently, in Chen Yun’s opinion, such a family was equivalent to an upstart family. A connection with them was not even comparable to a connection with Li Xiao, let alone that of with the families he had met and the current him.
Therefore, Chen Yun did not have a sense of belonging. When he met Li Wenjing, he naturally did not feel particularly close to her.
However, he still maintained the most basic respect. “Sister Wenjing, why are you here at Mount Shennong?”

Li Wenjing didn’t seem to be able to tell the distance in Chen Yun’s tone. She widened her eyes and placed her hands on her hips. She looked at Chen Yun angrily. “Do you still have the cheek to ask me? I’m the one asking you.”
“If you’re here to travel, so be it. Why are you here? Do you know how many fake goods there are here? Aren’t you afraid of being scammed?”

She had lingering fears about such things. After all, when she was shopping just now, she saw a person go bankrupt after buying an antique. In the end, it was fake. That person hit the wall on the spot and wanted to commit suicide. They didn’t know if he was dead or not, but he was pulled away by an ambulance.
There were many of such things. Therefore, since she had met Chen Yun, she did not dare to let him shop by himself. Otherwise, what if something happened?
Although he knew that Li Wenjing had good intentions, Chen Yun felt a little embarrassed to be scolded like a child.

At the side, Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing even covered their mouths and snickered. Clearly, they did not expect Brother Chen Yun, who had a serious and indifferent expression and a brilliant aura, to experience such a scene.
“Eh? You actually brought two beautiful girls here. Tell me, which one is your little girlfriend?”
At this moment, Li Wenjing looked at Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing with a hint of surprise in her eyes.

Although their clothes were simple and did not have a few branded clothes like hers, they were young, their skin was tender, and their big eyes were watery. They looked very cute. They were simply like hibiscuses that came out of clear water and were naturally carved.
Chen Yun waved his hand. “Neither.”
The two girls also blushed for a moment, looking like they were trying to hide something.
They even prayed in their heart and wondered if their best friend’s brother would lay his hands on them...
“Oh, I see.”
Although Li Wenjing said this, she had a knowing expression on her face.

She sighed inwardly. Young people nowadays were really impressive. Chen Yun was only 20 years old, but he brought their little girlfriend to such a place. Weren’t they afraid of being scammed? If they bought some fake goods to show off, wouldn’t they suffer a huge loss?
At this moment, the friends beside Li Wenjing also walked over. One of the men who seemed to be very close to Li Wenjing frowned and said, “Wenjing, who are these people?”

Including Li Wenjing, there were three men and two women. Clearly, they were all from a big city. When they saw Chen Yun and the others, especially Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing, they could not help but be stunned. The three boys’ eyes immediately revealed stunned expressions.
They introduced themselves.
Then, Li Wenjing looked at everyone. “This is my best friend’s younger brother. I didn’t expect to meet him here.”

“Since you know each other, why don’t you come with us to play?” Zhao Yang asked generously as he wrapped his arm around Li Wenjing’s waist. At this moment, he was dressed in branded clothes. The clothes he was wearing were from Versace. Even his belt was a limited edition Gucci belt. His watch was from Cartier, which cost 50,000 to 60,000 yuan. He also had the car keys of a BMW at his waist. Clearly, his family was extraordinary.
As he spoke, he looked at the two people beside him.

The two boys looked at Chen Yun and were also unhappy. Damn it, this kid was really lucky. He had occupied two top-notch beauties alone. Coincidentally, there were three men and two women. If the two sides gathered together, they would have a chance to attack Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing.

“That’s right. Let’s go together. It just so happens that Brother Yang runs an antique shop at home. If we follow him, won’t we be able to sweep through this place? We might even be able to find something good.”
A boy flattered Brother Yang.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Are You a Big Shot?
paragraphs: Zhao Yang enjoyed it very much and said proudly, “The things here are all unorthodox. Even if there are some real things, you can’t earn much money from them. They’re different from my family’s antique shop. Sometimes, the real items that you buy from my family’s shop can be sold. The money will be enough to buy a house.”
As soon as Zhao Yang said this, the other two men and one woman nodded. “That’s right. Brother Yang, you’ve been influenced since you were young. Today, we got rich because of you.”

“Hey, what’s there to get rich about? Didn’t I tell you just now?” Zhao Yang waved his hand, but a young man shook his head. “Brother Yang, you don’t know, but there’s a new way of playing here. I guarantee it’ll be straightforward.”
Oh?
These words piqued everyone’s interest. The young man continued, “There’s a casino here to appraise antiques. We can take a look.”

“Is there such a place?” Zhao Yang looked at the young man and had a plan. This time, he could not let his two brothers play without any girls. Immediately, he warmly greeted Chen Yun and the other two. Li Wenjing was also afraid that Chen Yun would be tricked and pulled him along. Chen Yun could only follow.
They arrived at a wooden building.

Chen Yun and the others arrived relatively late. Firstly, they were stopped by a few burly men in black at the door. Naturally, they could not enter such a private casino just because they wanted to. Firstly, they had to see who you were. Secondly, the guests had to pay for the tickets.
Just the tickets alone cost 1,000 yuan per person.

Zhao Yang readily paid for them. It was a total of 8,000 yuan, which stunned Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing. Each ticket cost 1,000 yuan, which was almost equivalent to their monthly living expenses. However, had Zhao Yang just spent it like that?
After entering the wooden building, waves of heat surged over.

Chen Yun looked over and saw that it was already half full. There were hundreds of people. This round of gambling had yet to begin and there was a song and dance performance on the stage. At this moment, the singer was actually a slightly famous second-rate singer. However, everyone’s attention was not on her at all.

Then, the next round of treasures went on stage. There were a few porcelain plates. The rules of the bet were also simple. Treasures would be placed among these porcelain plates. In the end, the professionals here would announce the results.
Such a bet depended on each person’s ability. If they were capable, they would profit. If they were not, they would lose everything.
Everyone stood up and surrounded these porcelain pieces to look at them. However, they could not touch them. They could only confirm if they were real or fake by looking at them.
Then, they could place their bets.

There was a betting slip on the plate at the side. If one liked any of the treasures, one could place a bet. They could just sign a check on the spot. The competition organizers were not afraid that one would go back on your word. If anyone dared to go back on their word, they would dare to knock on this person’s door and kidnap them for money.
They would definitely not be able to leave Shennong Mountain.
Seeing this, Chen Yun shook his head slightly.

In such a competition, it was obvious that they could not earn much money by relying on tickets and alcohol. The bulk of the money was in the gambling pool. It looked like there was a lot of money flowing here. It was probably close to 100 million yuan a day.
“How is it? Do you want to play?” Zhao Yang smiled at them with the betting slip.
Then, he bet 100,000 yuan on a porcelain plate. The others more or less bet tens of thousands. Even Li Wenjing was made to bet 10,000 yuan by her boyfriend.
At this moment, only Zhang Yuwan, Chen Yun, and Wang Meiqing were left.
When Zhang Yuwan saw that the lowest bet was 10,000 yuan per person, she quickly shook her head in fear.
Zhao Yang smiled and said, “It’s fine. If you don’t have money, Brother Zhao will lend it to you first. When you win, you can return it to Brother Zhao.”
As he spoke, he looked at Chen Yun.

He knew that young people were the most hot-blooded at this time and could not tolerate others provoking them. Furthermore, in front of girls, even if they did not have money, they had to borrow money.
Unexpectedly, Chen Yun was like an old Buddha who was unmoved.

Meanwhile, Zhang Yuwan seemed to be a little tempted. She and Wang Meiqing were not from families with high-ranking officials, so they valued money very much. However, seeing that Chen Yun did not move, she did not dare to interrupt casually and sat obediently beside Chen Yun.
Zhao Yang smiled. He knew that she still needed some time, so he didn’t mind.
Soon, the results were announced. The porcelain plate Zhao Yang had bet on was real!

At that moment, many people were unconvinced. The entire scene appeared to be in a crazy state. There were even people who shouted crazily after going bankrupt. However, they were “invited” out by the burly men in black.

Then, there was another round. Everyone displayed their abilities. Some people’s eyes turned red. Some people followed the experts and placed their bets. The winners were in high spirits and generously placed their bets, while the losers’ eyes turned red. They wished they could bet all their assets next and turn the tables in one go.
“We won again. We earned at least twice as much this time. Brother Zhao, you’re really awesome.”
A young man suddenly jumped up and waved his fist with all his might. He looked at Brother Zhao excitedly.

Brother Zhao also smiled proudly. After all, he was an expert and could tell a little about such things. Therefore, under his guidance, the chances of everyone winning were very high. After a few rounds, they had earned at least a hundred thousand yuan. Whether it was Li Wenjing or the others, everyone looked at Brother Zhao differently.
Even Zhang Yuwan could not help but feel her heart palpitate. The money these people earned was enough to buy half a house.
At this moment, Zhao Yang encouraged them again.
“Chen Yun, Sister Yuwan, Sister Meiqing, are you going to place a bet?”
“We’re here to pick up money for free. Don’t worry, I’ll lend you the betting fee. When you earn money, just return the betting fee to me.”
“Okay.” Zhang Yuwan hesitated for a moment before gritting her teeth and nodding.
Zhao Yang could not help but reveal a smug smile in his eyes. He could not help but look at the two young men beside him. They could see the excitement in each other’s eyes.
The fish was finally going to take the bait.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun watched coldly from the sidelines. He knew exactly what was happening, but he had no intention of speaking. He wanted to see how these people wanted to play.
