chapters.title: Chapter 173: I Don’t Want to Give You Respect
paragraphs: At night, everyone made a lot of money. Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing lost less and won more. They had already earned tens of thousands of yuan. This was equivalent to their tuition and living expenses for a year or two. How could they not be excited?
However, when the young men suggested going to a nightclub so late at night, the two girls quickly rejected them and left with Chen Yun.

Zhao Yang and the others were not in a hurry. They knew that it was not time yet. In the next few days, they also brought Chen Yun and the others to play. However, later on, Zhang Yuwan and the others seemed to have discovered that Zhao Yang and the others had other motives. They only followed everyone and occasionally placed bets for a few rounds. They followed Chen Yun the entire time, making Zhao Yang and the others feel more and more displeased with Chen Yun.
Chen Yun did not mind. In his eyes, these people were of little importance.

“There’s an auction tomorrow. Let’s go together,” said Zhao Yang. Then, he looked at Zhang Yuwan and the others. “I have a friend who can help us get admission tickets. Even if we don’t buy anything, it’s still an experience to go in and take a look. How about that?”

He and the two young men chuckled. When the two girls saw their true wealth, they would definitely submit obediently. After all, how many women nowadays did not love money, especially high school and university students? Their desire for money was even stronger.
“Moreover, this auction is just in time for the Shennong Ceremony. We might encounter treasures or top young masters and young ladies here.”
“Oh?”
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone was immediately interested. Even Chen Yun raised his eyes slightly and nodded in agreement.
The next day.
Everyone arrived at the auction venue.

The scene of the auction was much more spectacular than the previous casino. It was held in a manor. Although this manor was not as big as the East Mountain Villa in Chen Yun’s hands, it was still quite large. The pavilion and waterside pavilion had some charm.
Chen Yun and the others walked in the manor. The remaining few people looked at the surrounding scenery and their eyes were about to pop out.
They had never seen such a scene before. The Classical Gardens of Suzhou were just so-so in comparison. This was simply too exquisite.
“It’s all thanks to Brother Zhao that we can see such a scene.” A young man laughed loudly. His eyes were filled with envy. Clearly, he was envious of Zhao Yang’s family background.
Zhao Yang waved his hand. “It’s not worth mentioning.”

Although he was speaking humbly, the pride on his face became even greater. Then, he looked at Chen Yun and the others. “Enjoy the scenery here. We’re going to enter the auction house later. The people inside are all big shots.”
Upon hearing the mention of a big shot, everyone hurriedly finished looking at the scenery and followed Zhao Yang in.

Before they could enter, a few shouts came from the side. Everyone went over and saw that everyone was making way for a man and a woman. The man was about 30 years old. He was wearing a long robe and had an arrogant expression on his face. He looked at the surrounding people who were trying to please him and simply looked down on them.

The girl beside him looked to be in her early twenties. She was gentle and elegant. She was wearing a moon-white long robe and black casual pants. She wore red sandalwood prayer beads on her wrist. Although she was not too beautiful, her temperament was gentle, like a painting.
“Oh my god, why are these two here?!”
Zhao Yang looked at the two of them in shock and exclaimed.

At the side, many men and women in formal clothes were also shocked. “This man is Qi Chen from the Qi family of Shennong Mountain, right? The Qi family is a family pf Chinese medicine practitioners to begin with. It’s rumored that Qi Chen has studied the Holy Bible of Medicine since he was young. He started treating illnesses when he was seven or eight years old. Now, he’s even known to have the Sacred Hand. In China’s Chinese medicine world, he’s comparable to a few big shots.”
“Does anyone know this woman? From the looks of it, she’s probably from the Lu family of Jiangbei.”
Everyone was discussing this softly, but Zhao Yang was already petrified. Everyone looked at him and asked softly, “Are these two people very powerful?”

“Yes, they’re quite powerful.” Zhao Yang’s voice trembled with excitement. “This man’s family is the Qi family. The Qi family is a family of Chinese medicine practitioners. Everyone in the family has medical skills. The Qi family spans two provinces and has a huge power in Jiangbei and Tianxi Province. Their connections can be said to be widespread.”

“I know that girl. She’s Miss Lu Yan from the Lu family. The Lu family can be said to be the number one family in Mount Shennong. They’re also famous in the entire Jiangbei. They rely on the retailing of medicinal herbs.”

The young man beside him chuckled and said, “Brother Zhao, isn’t your family doing this too? Aren’t they doing well too? You shouldn’t be much worse than them. Why are you praising them while undermining your power?”
“Shh!”

Zhao Yang’s expression suddenly darkened as he looked at the young man. “You can eat whatever you want, but you can’t say whatever you want. Although my family does this too, we’re nothing in front of the Lu family. We’re just picking up the leftovers that the Lu family doesn’t like.”

As soon as he said this, he felt even more sorrowful. Back then, when his father toasted the Lu family, the other party did not even care about him, let alone talk to him. This was the power of the Lu family.

The Lu family might not be comparable to the five great families in Jiangbei, but in Mount Shennong, no one was better than them. Mount Shennong was isolated and relied on medicinal herbs to survive. It could be said that the Lu family was like the sky in Mount Shennong. Everyone relied on them to survive.
Hearing Zhao Yang’s words, everyone’s hearts tightened again, and the way they looked at the two people changed again.
Then, a few people came over one after another, making everyone exclaim. They were all Chinese medicine masters from Jiangbei.

Zhao Yang introduced them one by one as if he was showing off. He told them their names and their achievements. The others looked at these old men with reverence. After all, they might only be able to see such famous Chinese medicine doctors once in their lives.
Chen Yun looked at them one by one, his eyes calm.

However, in the next moment, he chuckled. Among these people, there was someone he knew. It was Zhang Ming. However, it made sense. Why wouldn’t he attend such a grand even that involved Chinese medicine?

Chen Yun and the others stepped in and sat down at the back. However, even at the back, everyone’s eyes were filled with excitement. After all, they had only seen auction scenes in movies. Now that they were experiencing it for themselves, how could they not be excited?
After a while, everyone sat down and the auctioneer went on stage. The entire auction officially began.

In the beginning, they were all decades-old medicines. The starting price of each medicine was above a million yuan. Even Zhao Yang could not help but be speechless, let alone the people beside him. Their eyes widened as if their hearts had been shocked.
This...
Was this what rich people were like?
Next was a hundred-year-old ginseng. The starting price was two million yuan. In the end, the price soared to four million yuan.
“F*ck! Four million yuan!” Zhao Yang’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch as he muttered, “Damn it, four million yuan is enough for my living expenses for a few years.”
The people beside him were even more shocked. Four million yuan!
It would probably take them decades to save up!
Just this medicinal herb was worth so much!
Then, a few more people called out their bids. Finally, a voice sounded. “The final price is 4.7 million.”
“The final price is 4.7 million!”
This time, everyone gasped again.

Everyone present also looked at the person who spoke and realized that it was none other than Zhang Ming. At that moment, they had no intention of bidding anymore. Firstly, the price was indeed about right. Secondly, who wanted to offend the Divine Doctor? After all, who could guarantee that they would not be sick or suffer a calamity in the future? At that time, if he did not respect them and treat them, they could cry.

At this moment, seeing that everyone was silent, Zhang Ming’s face became smug. He cupped his hands in the surroundings and said loudly, “Thank you for giving me respect. Then, it’s impolite for me to reject this medicinal herb.”
Then, the auctioneer on the stage began to count down.
Everyone understood the situation. No one said anything.
Zhao Yang shook his head and smiled bitterly.
“Divine Doctor Zhang has already made a move. Who would dare to compete with him?”
“Who in Jiangbei wouldn’t give him respect?”
“It looks like this hundred-year-old ginseng is taken.”
The few people beside him nodded continuously.
Just as everyone fell into silence and only Zhang Ming’s laughter was left.
Suddenly, a voice slowly sounded from behind. “Five million.”

chapters.title: Chapter 174: The Final Treasure!
paragraphs: Under the incredulous gazes of Zhao Yang, Li Wenjing, and the others, Chen Yun slowly raised his hand.
In an instant, the gazes of the entire auction house gathered here.
“You’re crazy! Put your hand down quickly!” Zhao Yang shouted in a low voice.
Didn’t he see what occasion this was?
There were so many high-ranking officials and nobles here, and none of them fought with Divine Doctor Zhang for the items. Yet, Chen Yun simply disrespected Divine Doctor Zhang.
Besides, it was five million yuan!
This was easy to say, but could he really pay up?!
He offered five million yuan for a stalk of ginseng. He was really generous!
At this moment, if Chen Yun could not pay out or offended Divine Doctor Zhang, Zhao Yang might even be implicated.
At the thought of this, Zhao Yang’s gaze was extremely ruthless. From his gaze, it was as if he really wanted to chop Chen Yun into meat paste.
Li Wenjing and the others also turned pale. Just as they were hesitating if they should pull Chen Yun’s hand down, Zhang Ming slowly turned around and looked at them with an unfriendly expression.

That gaze was cold. Zhao Yang and the others felt as if their bodies were completely frozen. They did not even dare to move a finger. They only wanted to run as far as possible and leave Chen Yun’s vicinity, trying their best to cut ties with him.
The people beside Chen Yun thought the same.
For a moment, the people around Chen Yun and the others scattered. Only Chen Yun, Zhang Yuwan, and Wang Meiqing were left. Even Li Wenjing was quickly pulled away by Zhao Yang.
At this moment, the two little girls looked at Chen Yun. Their eyes were wide open and they were still in a daze.
Among the surrounding people, Zhao Yang ran the fastest.

He was instantly frightened when Zhang Ming looked over just now. What kind of person was Zhang Ming? He was the Divine Doctor. He was a rare and top figure in Jiangbei and even in the entire Chinese medicine circle in China.
Chen Yun sat there, as unmoving as a mountain. There was a teasing smile on his face as he endured the gazes of everyone present.
Beside him, Zhang Yuwan reacted and desperately pulled Chen Yun’s sleeve. She cried. “Brother Chen Yun, what are you doing? Put your hand down quickly.”
Chen Yun smiled at her.
The people beside him looked at the smile on Chen Yun’s face and thought to themselves that this person was simply crazy. When they saw Zhang Ming stand up, the cold smile on their faces deepened.

However, in the next moment, the coldness on Zhang Ming’s face turned into a spring breeze. He laughed out loud at Chen Yun and subconsciously bowed. “Little Divine Doctor, so you’re here too. Why didn’t I see you just now? Otherwise, I would have welcomed you personally.”
Little... Little Divine Doctor?!
In an instant, everyone present was stunned.
Zhao Yang’s eyes almost popped out. The people beside him were petrified on the spot.
What was going on?!
Was that Zhang Ming with a warm smile on his face?
Legend had it that Zhang Ming never smiled and was extremely serious. Even his family rarely saw his smile.
However, now, he was actually smiling apologetically and calling Chen Yun “Little Divine Doctor”.
He addressed Chen Yun politely!
He was extremely respectful!
Who was Chen Yun?!
At that moment, everyone was curious.

Beside Zhang Ming, an old man chuckled and said, “Old Zhang, you’re really getting worse the more you live. You actually called him the Little Divine Doctor. Why? Could it be that his medical skills are better than yours?”

Zhang Ming stared at him coldly. “In front of the Little Divine Doctor, my medical skills are not even comparable to that of a student’s. The people beside him looked at Chen Yun and their eyes changed. Since Divine Doctor Zhang had said so, how capable was this person?

If they hadn’t left just now and stayed with Chen Yun...

But now...
Zhao Yang lost all his strength.

What a joke. He had probably cured Zhang Ming by coincidence or after obtaining some prescription.

They thought so too. This thing was incomparably precious. It was rumored that there was insufficient supply of this in the eastern part of Jiangbei. Who would be stupid enough to reveal all kinds of secrets to them?
They did not expect to encounter this here.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: A Price of 150,000 Yuan Per Gram!
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at the bottle in front of him and immediately chuckled. This thing was none other than the Heavenly Spirit Water.
However, there was a lot of Heavenly Spirit Water in front of him. It looked like there were ten bottles of it, which was two liters.
He could not help but laugh. This thing was probably gathered by a few families.
“The starting price of this treasure is 20 million.”
Hiss!
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone gasped on the spot. Twenty million!
No one knew what this thing was. Who would be stupid enough to bid?
Everyone thought so with disdain in their eyes. However, in the next moment, Zhang Ming suddenly raised his sign. “I bid 20 million!”
Zhang Ming was in Jiang City, so he naturally knew how precious this thing was. This thing was rare.
“I think Divine Doctor Zhang has gone senile. He actually spent 20 million yuan to buy such a thing.”
“That’s right. What can this thing do? I don’t even dare to drink it when I see that color. It’s the same as the Blue Moon detergent.”
“It’s no wonder he called that kid the Little Divine Doctor previously. I’m afraid he’s really senile.”

As everyone spoke, there were also voices that reached Zhang Ming’s ears. However, he did not care. Instead, he mocked this group of bumpkins beside him in his heart. How did they know how good this thing was?
He had seen the effect of this thing with his own eyes at the biotechnology conference back then.
Just as the surrounding people were mocking him, Lu Yan also raised the sign in her hand. Then, she apologized to Zhang Ming, “Elder Zhang, I’m sorry. The Lu family is determined to get this thing.”
At the side, Qi Chen looked at Lu Yan and chuckled. He also raised the token in his hand. “What a coincidence. The Qi family is also determined to get this item.”
At that moment, the price rose from 20 million to 30 million.
Then, it reached 50 million. After a few rounds of bidding, the price directly soared to 100 million!
A hundred million!
It could be said to be astronomical!
Although this auction house was not small and had a huge reputation on Mount Shennong, it had never sold any item for more than a hundred million yuan. Today, they broke their record.

As everyone watched the battle between the two large families, their thoughts slowly changed. They were not fools. Now, their expressions when they looked at the Heavenly Spirit Water on the stage changed drastically.
How could something that could make two large families fall out with each other be bad? It was just that they did not know their stuff.
At that moment, although they also wanted to investigate, they were helpless. After all, the price had already reached more than 200 million!
Moreover, the two families had no intention of letting go!
“You’re a seven-foot-tall man. How dare you snatch something from a little girl like me? Don’t you know about shame?”

“Hehe, you’re still a little girl. Who doesn’t know that no one dares to provoke the Lu family in the entire Shennong Mountain? Many medicinal halls were innocent, yet they were targeted because of your family’s jealousy. Your family snatched the old medicine and even expelled them from Shennong Mountain. Their families were destroyed.” Qi Chen sneered.
Meanwhile, Lu Yan’s eyes turned cold when she heard Qi Chen’s words. “Do you think the Qi family is anything good?”
The more the two of them spoke, the more excited they became. The price became higher and higher, and it had already broken through the 300 million mark.
The people behind them fell silent when they saw this scene. They did not even dare to breathe loudly.
Then, a chuckle sounded from behind everyone.
Everyone looked over and saw Chen Yun shaking his head and chuckling.
For a moment, an old man stood up and looked at Chen Yun. “What are you laughing at!”
“How dare you! You old man, who do you think you are? How dare you speak rudely to the Little Divine Doctor!” Zhang Ming suddenly stood up and scolded loudly.
Chen Yun’s laughter naturally attracted Lu Yan and Qi Chen’s attention. At this moment, Qi Chen looked at Chen Yun and said coldly, “Little brother, were you laughing at us just now?”

“Yes, but not entirely.” Chen Yun leaned against the backrest and smiled. “I just didn’t expect that the thing I priced at 300,000 yuan per 100ml would actually be priced at 15 million per 100ml by you. It seems that my price is still too low.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the expressions of the two people who were originally covered in frost changed. They immediately asked, “You’re saying that this thing...”

“That’s right. The Heavenly Spirit Water came from the Little Divine Doctor. The Heavenly Spirit Water that circulates in the upper echelons of the eastern part of Jiangbei was all supplied by the Little Divine Doctor.”
Zhang Ming spoke from the side with a proud expression.
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire venue was in an uproar.
Zhao Yang and the others behind were shocked!
They simply could not believe what Zhang Ming had said. The Heavenly Spirit Water that circulated among the entire upper level of Jiangbei’s eastern region was supplied by Chen Yun!
Moreover, the price at this auction alone was 15 million per 100ml, which was equivalent to 150,000 yuan per milliliter. It cost about 150,000 yuan per gram!
This thing cost 150,000 yuan per gram. What kind of concept was that?!
Gold only cost three to four hundred per gram!
Diamonds were at most worth 10,000 yuan per gram!
However, this thing, this water!
It cost 150,000 yuan per gram!
It was hard to imagine how much profit Chen Yun would earn from supplying so many higher-ups!
He would earn hundreds of millions!
Zhao Yang and the others recalled everything that had happened in front of Chen Yun over the past few days. If there was a crack in the ground here, they would have directly crawled in!
It was simply as if they had taught their grandmother how to suck eggs!

At this moment, Lu Yan did not care about the auction on the stage. She went straight to Chen Yun and bowed to him. “I failed to recognize such a famous person. Please don’t blame me, Little Divine Doctor.”

Then, her eyes darted around. “Little Divine Doctor, I wonder if the formula for the divine water in your hand can be shared with the Lu family? The Lu family will invest two billion yuan and promise that as long as the Little Divine Doctor is on Mount Shennong, you can have whatever you want. The Lu family has the confidence to say whatever we want on Mount Shennong!”

“Miss Lu Yan, two billion yuan? How can you take out such a small sum of money? Moreover, can the Lu family be considered to be in charge here? In that case, where is the Qi family?” Qi Chen’s arrogance towards Chen Yun immediately changed. “Little Divine Doctor, the Qi family will invest four billion yuan. Moreover, you will be a distinguished guest of the Qi family in the future. How about that?”

As Qi Chen spoke, his eyes were burning. If he could obtain the formula for the Heavenly Spirit Water, the Qi family could simply be called a towering tree. In a few years, they would be ranked among the big families in Jiangbei. Moreover, they would cross two provinces and have a huge reputation in both provinces!
Four billion!
An honored guest!
For a moment, everyone in the auction hall looked at Chen Yun enviously.
Usually, the Lu family and the Qi family were high and mighty. Not to mention ordinary people, they ignored divine doctors like them. Now, they were all begging a young man.
Zhao Yang’s eyes turned red. He never expected such an outcome.
Just as everyone thought that Chen Yun would agree to the Qi family’s request, Chen Yun shook his head and said, “It’s enough for me to supply this alone.”
What a joke. Back then, even the Park Corporation, which had offered five billion yuan, was ignored by Chen Yun, let alone these people.
Everyone was shocked. No one had expected Chen Yun to abandon the olive branches offered by the Lu family and the Qi family. Those were the Lu family and the Qi family!
One of them dominated Mount Shennong, while the other was rich and overbearing!
At this moment, Lu Yan looked at Qi Chen gloatingly. She could accept this outcome. At the very least, neither the Lu family nor the Qi family obtained it.

At this moment, although Qi Chen still had a smile on his face, a trace of gloominess could not help but flash across his eyes. This was the first time in his life that he had been rejected in person.
Many people at the side looked at Chen Yun and shook their heads and sighed.
“It looks like this kid is in trouble. How can the Qi family and the Lu family be kind? Do you really think Qi Chen will let you off?” Many people muttered coldly in their hearts.

The rise of the Qi family and the Lu family was similar. They both rose from small families and became towering giants around Mount Shennong. With eery step they took, they brought with them the blood and tears of others. Over the years, they had snatched countless medicinal herbs and destroyed countless medicinal halls. They had used iron-blooded methods to establish their status step by step.
How could these two families let go of someone like Chen Yun, who looked easy to bully and was carrying golden bricks?
The people at the side who also had their eyes on Chen Yun sighed secretly.
Now that Chen Yun was targeted by the two families, how could they snatch him? Sigh.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Trying to Snatch It by Force?
paragraphs: One day later, at the Shennong Ceremony!

The day before, Chen Yun had already sensed that many people had already targeted him when he went out. However, this was also within Chen Yun’s expectations. After all, he controlled the Heavenly Spirit Water.

In addition, the people here were far away from central Jiangbei and probably knew very little about his reputation. Otherwise, they would not dare to wander around his hotel even if they were given ten thousand guts.

Zhang Yuwan and the others also felt strange gazes from time to time. At this moment, they looked at Chen Yun worriedly. “Brother Chen Yun, why do I feel that someone beside us is looking at us strangely?”
“It’s as if they want to attack us.”
“Shall we go?”
Zhang Yuwan looked at Chen Yun and reminded him carefully. However, Chen Yun smiled. “It’s fine. If they like to look at us, you can let them look at us.”
It was fine to take a look. However, if they attacked, Chen Yun’s eyes darkened. He could not let them off!
Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing nodded obediently.
After packing up, they walked towards Mount Shennong.

During the Shennong Ceremony, one could not enter the inner hall unless they had an invitation. Originally, Zhang Yuwan and the others could only watch the incense offering ceremony on a platform that was more than a thousand square meters large. However, it was different now. Zhang Ming had an invitation in his hand. In addition, Chen Yun had left a deep impression on everyone that day. So what if they did not have an invitation?

At this moment, Zhang Ming was following beside Chen Yun. From time to time, he would introduce the origins of the Shennong Ceremony. As soon as he introduced the ceremony, he spoke eloquently, making the two girls immediately feel relaxed and listen attentively.
Many people beside him also came over to greet Chen Yun.
“Little Divine Doctor, you’re here.”
“Little Divine Doctor, I’m...”
However, more big shots and experts from the medical world were still watching and did not get too close to Chen Yun.
Everyone in the inner hall could overlook the ceremony on the platform.

At noon, the villagers of a few villages on Mount Shennong arrived. There were thousands of them. They stopped every three steps and bowed every nine steps. They walked all the way to the statue of Shennong and bowed to it, as if they were worshiping the god in their hearts. A holy aura suddenly spread out, causing the tourists who were taking photos to involuntarily put down their cameras.
They wanted to engrave this scene in their minds forever.

Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing also covered their mouths. They were stunned by the grand scene in front of them. Meanwhile, Zhang Ming, who was beside them, could not help but be speechless. Such a scene was seen once every ten years.
He had already come to several consecutive sessions. Every session, he felt a different sense of shock and different feelings.
Looking at the dark-faced men kneeling in front of him, Zhang Ming could not help but shake his head. These people were all honest farmers whose backs faced the sky.
Every family here relied on planting medicinal herbs to survive. In their hearts, Shennong gave them an opportunity to survive and gave this land a different meaning.
In the hearts of the older generation, they still had special feelings for Shennong.

However, Zhang Ming sighed. These farmers were just being exploited. He often came to Mount Shennong to buy medicinal herbs. For example, a good ginseng could only be bought for a few thousand yuan from these people. However, after the Lu and Qi families resold it, it could be sold for ten thousand yuan or even tens of thousands.

Moreover, these two families had a monopoly here. If anyone dared to sell the herbs in private and was caught, or if they did not sell it to them, it would be embarrassing. With a word from these two families, no one would dare to take their herbs. Their herbs could rot in the ground.
As they walked through the hall, the scene became even more majestic and grand. Chen Yun also nodded from time to time.
An hour later, the ceremony ended.
A commotion immediately sounded at the entrance of the inner hall.
“Is Divine Doctor Qi here?”
“Oh my god, how many years has it been since I last saw Divine Doctor Qi? I didn’t expect to see him today.”
“As expected of the Shennong Ceremony. Only such a grand ceremony can make a figure like Divine Doctor Qi come out of seclusion.”

As the crowd dispersed, an old man with a slightly white beard and hair entered the venue accompanied by Qi Chen. Not only was Divine Doctor Qi’s medical skills impressive, but he had also supported the Qi family and was also the second-in-command of the Qi family. His status was important in Mount Shennong and even in the pharmaceutical world of China.
Immediately, everyone hurriedly came over to greet him.
“I didn’t expect Divine Doctor Qi to come too.” Zhang Ming sighed.
Beside him, Zhang Yuwan looked at Zhang Ming. “Divine Doctor Zhang, is there anything different about Divine Doctor Qi? Aren’t you both called Divine Doctors?”
Haha.

When Zhang Ming heard Zhang Yuwan’s words, he waved his hand. “We’re different. We’re very different. I’m really nothing in front of them. The Qi family is a medical family to begin with. Their entire family is skilled in medicine. Meanwhile, Divine Doctor Qi is a prominent figure in the Qi family.”

“There are two important figures in the Qi family. First, there’s Qi Xuan, the current head of the Qi family. His methods are iron-blooded and extremely exploitative. The other person is Divine Doctor Qi Zhen. These two people have made the entire Qi family span two provinces. They’re famous in both provinces.”
“Oh.”
Zhang Yuwan nodded as if she understood.
At this moment, there were many people in suits beside Divine Doctor Qi. As soon as these people entered, they walked towards Chen Yun.
This action made everyone’s hearts sink when they say this.
“Looks like the Qi family won’t let this matter rest.”
“A man’s wealth is his own ruin. There’s nothing we can do about it.”
“That’s right. How many old medicines are in their hands? In my opinion, under the pressure of the Qi family, this kid won’t be able to escape today.”
As everyone spoke, many people began to gloat.
At this moment, Divine Doctor Qi came in front of Chen Yun and the others and said calmly, “Are you Chen Yun? Are you the one who has the formula for the Heavenly Spirit Water?”
“That’s right.” Chen Yun looked up and spoke.

“Do you know that the formula of the Heavenly Spirit Water in your hand is actually a treasure of the Qi family?” Divine Doctor Qi shook his head and said, “The Heavenly Spirit Water was founded by the Qi family’s ancient method and the Park Corporation. It was created by combining the methods from the East and the West. However, our results were stolen. We searched for it many times, but we couldn’t find anything.”
“What?”
This sentence shocked everyone.
Many people looked at Chen Yun with pity. Everyone naturally knew that Divine Doctor Qi was most likely saying this to find an excuse.
Beside him, a man in a suit also nodded. “That’s right. The Park Corporation has searched everywhere but to no avail. However, we were indeed the ones who developed this thing.”
The Park Corporation!
The Qi family!

When faced with these two giants, many people looked at Chen Yun and began to question him. “He’s just a young man. How could he develop such a good thing? What Little Divine Doctor? I think it’s all nonsense.”

“That’s right. We’ve been practicing medicine for so many years, but we can’t produce such a good thing. If this kid can also create it, won’t our years of bitter medical cultivation be like bubbles?”
“I think this person stole the results of the Qi family and the Park Corporation.”

These words immediately pushed Chen Yun into the center of the storm. There was no lack of people who did it on purpose. They naturally knew the power of the Qi family and the Park Corporation. What could they not obtain?
Chen Yun was considered unlucky today. Then, they would definitely add icing to the cake and step on Chen Yun again.
However, at this moment, Chen Yun looked up and sneered. “So?”

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Destroy You!
paragraphs: “Sigh, it’s also our mistake.” Divine Doctor Qi looked sad and said sincerely, “Fortunately, Qi Chen met you yesterday and told us about the situation. Only then did we know that it was you who helped us find it. If you return the formula of the Heavenly Spirit Water, our Qi family is willing to invest 200 million yuan to express our gratitude.”
“As for the profits you obtained previously, they naturally belong to you. We won’t pursue it anymore.”
These words seemed extremely magnanimous, but everyone sneered in their hearts.
The Qi family was simply starting to rob them openly. They offered 200 million yuan, hehe...
However, they did not dare to say it out loud.
Beside them, many people echoed.
“The Qi family is indeed a big family. They’re extremely magnanimous.”
“Kid, hurry up and take it out. Don’t push your luck.”
“That’s right. He relied on other people’s research to obtain so much profit and still dares to show off in front of us.”
Hearing their words, Chen Yun looked in front of him. “What if I say that I won’t give it to you?”

“Then you’ll be making an enemy of the Qi family and the Park Corporation!” Divine Doctor Qi’s expression changed and he said firmly, “How dare you steal the Qi family’s things? I guarantee that you won’t be able to leave Mount Shennong or this place!”
“It’s the same for the rest of the people with you!”
With just a single sentence, his original immortal aura completely disappeared. Instead, his eyes were filled with killing intent, and his light became even brighter.

In an instant, the entire inner hall was silent. Many big shots and divine doctors stopped talking. The other divine doctors, who had been currying favor with Chen Yun and calling him Little Divine Doctor, were also standing at the side with their arms crossed, looking like they were watching the fire from the other side.
Chen Yun was left alone to face the anger of the Qi family and the Park Corporation.
“In that case, do you want to kill me?” Chen Yun narrowed his eyes.

At the side, Qi Chen leaned over and looked at Chen Yun. “Mr. Chen, the Qi family still respects you very much. As long as you can return our formula, the promise I made yesterday still counts. You’ll still be a distinguished guest of our Qi family. However, forget about the four billion yuan.”

Divine Doctor Qi stood at the side and also looked silent. Of the two of them, one was playing the good cop and the other was playing the bad cop. In the end, they still wanted to force Chen Yun to hand over the formula for the Heavenly Spirit Water.
Chen Yun took a step forward and walked in front of the two of them. “I asked, if I don’t hand it over, are you planning to kill me?”
This sentence made everyone present break out in cold sweat. They simply could not believe what they had heard!
Chen Yun actually wanted to fight the Qi family head-on!
Behind him, Zhang Yuwan looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Chen Yun.”
Even Zhang Ming’s expression changed. “Little Divine Doctor, you can’t...”

However, before he could finish speaking, Divine Doctor Qi looked at Chen Yun and sneered. “That’s right! This is the Qi family’s territory. So what if I kill you?! Look, who dares to say anything here?!”
When everyone heard this, their hearts turned cold. They subconsciously turned their faces away, as if it had nothing to do with them.
At this moment, the sneer on Divine Doctor Qi’s face intensified. “Kid, I advise you to adapt to the situation...”
Pa!
A crisp sound suddenly sounded. Chen Yun slapped Divine Doctor Qi’s face. Then, he grabbed Divine Doctor Qi’s neck and lifted him up.
He slammed him against the pillar behind him.
For a moment, Divine Doctor Qi, who was already bleeding from his mouth and nose, turned weak like a dead dog.
“How dare you touch Divine Doctor Qi?!”
“Kid, how dare you? Hurry up and put Divine Doctor Qi down.”
“Do you know whose territory this is? How dare you be so bold!”
For a moment, many people clamored. However, Chen Yun’s gaze made everyone present shut up.
They looked at Chen Yun’s eyes and simply did not know how to describe them. His eyes were like furious ancient ferocious beasts, as if they could tear them apart in the next moment.
Qi Chen looked at his second uncle being beaten up and snorted. He looked at the young man beside him. “Mr. Park, what are your people waiting for?!”
In the next moment, the young man nodded and said something in Korean. The burly men behind him immediately walked towards Chen Yun.
Chen Yun looked at them and threw Divine Doctor Qi out of his hand, smashing him into a few burly men. Then, Chen Yun reached into his pocket and a wisp of silver immediately appeared.
A few burly men were sent flying by Divine Doctor Qi. Just as they were about to step forward, they saw a black muzzle pointing at them.
In an instant, everyone exclaimed.
This was!
It was a gun!

The burly men were also shocked. The young man from the Park family even cursed in his heart for being careless. He originally thought that Chen Yun was already fish on the chopping board, so he did not ask his subordinates to bring their weapons. However, from the looks of it, the situation had reversed.
“You... Chen Yun! What are you trying to do? How dare you take out your gun! Try firing! This is Mount Shennong, not the eastern part of Jiangbei!”
Qi Chen shouted loudly, his eyes filled with fear as he kept roaring.
Bang!
A gunshot suddenly sounded, and a bloody hole appeared in Qi Chen’s leg.
“Ah!”
A scream sounded. Everyone saw Qi Chen fall to the ground and wail continuously.
The gun was fired!
Chen Yun!
He actually fired!
Moreover, he shot the eldest young master of the Qi family!
This!
Not only did he not take the Qi family seriously, but he was simply going to fight the Qi family to the death!
When Divine Doctor Qi saw this scene, coupled with the pain in his body, his eyes were already bloodshot. However, he was helpless when he looked at the gun in Chen Yun’s hand.
He could only get up in a sorry state.

His body trembled slightly as he said, “Alright, alright, alright. Little friend, you’re really bold. I didn’t expect you to dare to use a gun on such an occasion. Even the Qi family doesn’t have the guts.”
“However, don’t forget that my Qi family is a family that spans two provinces. If you fight with us, both sides will suffer. Why don’t we stop and make peace?”
“What happened today can be considered as the Qi family’s fault. The Qi family should apologize.”

After saying that, his eyes lit up as he looked at Chen Yun. The hatred in his eyes had not disappeared at all. He thought to himself, “Kid, when I go down Mount Shennong, I’ll definitely tell the family head. At that time, the Qi family will come with all their might. You won’t have a place to run even if you want to!”
“Even if I have to dig three feet into the Shennong Mountain and turn it upside down, I will find you, crush you, and destroy you!”
“Make peace?”
Chen Yun looked at Divine Doctor Qi and sneered. He suddenly aimed the gun in his hand at him.
“You want to make peace, but you haven’t asked me!”
“How dare you!” Divine Doctor Qi’s eyes widened as he looked at Chen Yun in front of him and shouted.
His voice was loud, but it was not louder than the gunshot. With a gunshot, a hole appeared between Divine Doctor Qi’s eyebrows.
His body slowly fell down, and there was still disbelief in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Blind Thing!
paragraphs: Divine Doctor Qi was dead!
He was the second-in-command of the Qi family, a figure who carried the burden!
As for the Qi family, they spanned across two provinces. Their power was so great that it could be said that they could cover the sky with one hand on Mount Shennong!
If one offended the Qi family, they would definitely suffer!
In fact, it was not an exaggeration to say that they would not let the perpetrator leave Mount Shennong!
However, no one expected Chen Yun to kill him so decisively!
“Second Uncle!”
Qi Chen collapsed to the ground in a daze. He even forgot about the pain and could not believe what was happening in front of him.
At the side, many big shots and divine doctors were silent. When Chen Yun shot Qi Chen just now, they were only shocked. But now, he had even killed the second-in-command of the Qi family!
Everyone was completely shocked!
How was this person a young man? He was simply a demon king!
He disregarded everything and did whatever he wanted without caring about the rules!
If anyone provoked him, it was useless no matter how powerful their background was.
At this moment, Chen Yun looked around.
“Who else is unconvinced?!”
This time, everyone lowered their heads and did not dare to look at him again.
Even the young man from the Park family and Qi Chen lowered their heads deeply. All their glory and splendor were trampled under Chen Yun’s feet and turned to ashes.
“Since you’re convinced, it’s time to go!”
Chen Yun looked at Qi Chen and the young man from the Park family in front of him. Then, he spoke coldly.

For a moment, the two of them looked up at Chen Yun. Qi Chen’s eyes were filled with disbelief. “You, Chen Yun, killed my second uncle. Do you still dare to kill me? My father is the head of the Qi family! If you kill me, you’ll fight the Qi family to the death!”

“We’ll fight to the death. Does the Qi family have the right to say such things?”
Everyone looked over and saw a middle-aged man with a girl. Behind them were two rows of burly men in black.
This!
In an instant, everyone gasped.
Why was such a person here?!
This person was none other than the head of the Lu family and Lu Yan’s father, Lu Jingshan!
Everyone in Mount Shennong knew how ruthless his methods were. Otherwise, how could the Lu family compete with the Qi family?

However, this person had not come to the previous Shennong Ceremonies. He did not often appear at the upper echelons’ banquets. He was a mysterious figure. No one could figure out why he had deigned to come today.

At that moment, just as everyone was about to greet him, they saw Lu Jingshan walk quickly to Chen Yun. He bowed 90 degrees and bowed to Chen Yun. “Director Chen, I didn’t know you were here at Mount Shennong. Sorry for not welcoming you!”
“Director Chen, please don’t blame us!”
Director Chen?
When these two words entered everyone’s ears, their hearts suddenly trembled.
What? Director Chen?
Then, Lu Jingshan looked at Divine Doctor Qi’s corpse beside him and snorted. “You blind thing. You deserve to die.”
Then, he squatted down in front of Qi Chen and patted his face. “Looks like the Qi family has come to an end. You even dared to provoke Director Chen.”
“Director Chen is the number one person in Jiang City and the director of Sacred Heaven. He has more than 20 billion yuan in assets and has connections in Jiangbei.”
“How is the Qi family compared to the Su family in Jiang City? Even the Su family in Jiang City was overthrown by Director Chen. The entire Su family was kicked out of Jiang City!”
What?
Was he the one who brought down the Su family?!
This!
At this moment, Qi Chen collapsed to the ground, his eyes filled with disbelief.
Not only did he collapse, but the big shots and divine doctors beside him also trembled. Everyone seemed to have been possessed and did not even dare to breathe loudly.
The number one person in Jiang City!
The chairman of Sacred Heaven!
His assets were worth 20 to 30 billion!
He held the Heavenly Spirit Water in his hand!
He destroyed the Su family!
Every word was like a heavy hammer that ruthlessly hammered their chests.
They finally understood why Chen Yun dared to kill Divine Doctor Qi directly. Even the entire Qi family was nothing in front of Chen Yun, let alone Divine Doctor Qi!
Many divine doctor big shots who had mocked Chen Yun before immediately trembled. They could not even stand still.
Their faces turned even paler.
They knew what kind of person Lu Jingshan was. He was the head of the Lu family. His words were definitely not baseless!
At this moment, Lu Jingshan looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, what should we do with these people?”
Chen Yun did not answer him with words. Instead, he fired two shots, causing blood to splash out of the foreheads of Qi Chen and the young man from the Park family.
“Ah!”

Lu Yan watched from the side. She couldn’t help but cover her mouth and cry out softly. She looked at the fallen young man of the Park family and saw blood dripping from his forehead. It flowed down his face and down his neck, staining the dragon tattoo with wings on his neck.
Chen Yun’s actions stunned Lu Jingshan. He did not expect Chen Yun to be so decisive and not hesitate at all.
Then, Chen Yun slowly walked out. “Get rid of the remaining people, as well as the corpses and blood on the ground.”
“If the Lu family doesn’t have such strength, I think the Lu family won’t be able to survive in Mount Shennong in the future. It’s not worth giving you marketing rights.”
Lu Jingshan hurriedly stood up and bowed to Chen Yun. “Director Chen, don’t worry. I understand! I’ll definitely do it well!”
“Where are you going?”
“The Qi family. I want the Qi family to give me an explanation.” With these words, Chen Yun left, leaving everyone else in the hall.
At this moment, Lu Yan looked at Lu Jingshan, not understanding why he wanted to help Chen Yun deal with it. Lu Jingshan calmed down a little, but his eyes were still filled with excitement.
The meaning of Chen Yun’s words could not be clearer. What other marketing rights could there be?
He was naturally talking about the marketing rights of the Heavenly Spirit Water!
With the Heavenly Spirit Water and the fact that the Qi family had provoked Director Chen, the Lu family would definitely be the boss in Mount Shennong in the future!
Immediately, he waved at the burly men behind him. The group of burly men immediately walked forward and surrounded them, especially the group of people brought by the Park Corporation.

At this moment, Lu Jingshan looked at everyone. “Everyone, I think Director Chen has already made it very clear. There’s no need for me to explain what can be said, what can’t be said, what can be done, and what can’t be done, right?”
“If anyone here doesn’t understand, I don’t mind explaining it to him.” As he spoke, Lu Jingshan clenched his fists and sneered.
Everyone looked at Lu Jingshan in front of them and trembled. They smiled apologetically. “Patriarch Lu, I’m here to attend the ceremony today. The ceremony is not bad. It’s very good.”
“Yes, I’ve been looking at the platform all along too.”
“That’s right. The weather is good today, and the scenery is good. It attracted all of us.”
Everyone spoke one after another with smiles on their faces. They turned a blind eye to the matter in front of them

chapters.title: Chapter 179: The Qi Family Is So Mighty!
paragraphs: Zhang Ming, who was shocked, opened his mouth and sighed deeply. He pulled Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing beside him and laughed. “We’re naturally here to discuss our medical skills.”
The two little girls beside him also nodded numbly.
Lu Jingshan looked at the people in front of him and smiled. “Alright, the ceremony is over. Everyone has seen it. Why don’t we go back now?”
“Okay, okay, okay.”
“That’s right. It’s time.”
“Then, Patriarch Lu, we’ll meet again.”
One by one, the big shots and divine doctors hurriedly bade farewell. It was as if this was hell. They did not want to stay here for a second longer.

Everything that happened today would form a huge trauma in their hearts. At the same time, they established an image of a ruthless person in their hearts. He was Director Chen, who stood at the top of Jiang City and commanded everyone!

Zhang Ming left the place and thought about what had happened today. He was shocked, but on second thought, he had his own thoughts. After settling Zhang Yuwan and Wang Meiqing down, he drove towards the Qi family.
The Qi family spanned two provinces, but in order to compete with the Lu family, they still built the main villa not far away.
In less than two hours, Zhang Ming arrived at the foot of the hill where the Qi family’s villa was located.
At this moment, he looked in front and saw two figures standing.
It seemed like they had just arrived.

One of them was Chen Yun. Beside him was an extremely burly man nearly two meters tall. Just a glance at him made people involuntarily hide to the sides. After all, such a physique was too terrifying.
He walked over. “Little Divine Doctor.”
“Huh?” Chen Yun looked at Zhang Ming in surprise. “Why are you here?”

“I was worried about the Little Divine Doctor being alone, so I settled the two girls down and rushed over.” Zhang Ming spoke as if he was taking credit for his achievements. However, Chen Yun also nodded. After all, Zhang Yuwan and the others had been frightened today.
Chen Yun looked up and chuckled. “I didn’t expect the Qi family villa to be so majestic.”

Zhang Ming also looked up and saw a group of villas that resembled manors on the mountainside. The surroundings were surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the scenery was beautiful. This place was not something ordinary people could afford, not even if they were rich.

Zhang Ming nodded and introduced, “I’ve heard of the Qi family’s reputation. The Qi family is a family of traditional Chinese medicine practitioners. In their family, there are a few people with a huge reputation in Jiangbei and even China, so there are many people who come here to beg them for treatment. You know that when people are sick, they don’t treat money as money at all.”
“When comparing money and one’s life, one’s life is naturally more important. Thus, the Qi family is not short of money.”

“I heard that the Qi family has some strange habit. If you want them to treat you, you can’t just have money. Many rich people have been rejected by them. I don’t know what they’re thinking.” Zhang Ming curled his lips.
“Then let’s go up and take a look today. What’s wrong with the Qi family? Do they dare to reject me too?” As Chen Yun spoke, the coldness in his eyes rose.

The two of them, together with Vigor, walked up. After walking for a while, they saw people waiting there. There were quite a number of them. All of them were dressed in suits and leather shoes. They were either wearing branded clothes or had big bellies. Their faces were oily. Clearly, they were some big shots and high-ranking officials.
However, even if their identities were unusual, they were stopped now and could not do anything.

At this moment, a middle-aged man was speaking humbly to the young man who was ten to twenty years younger than him. “Look, I’ve come from afar. I’ve visited many places, but they have no way to treat my illness. Thus, I’d like you to make an exception and let me go up to meet the Qi family’s head, okay?”

“No, no. The family head is currently receiving important guests upstairs. He doesn’t have time to see you.” The young man waved his hand impatiently and looked at the man. He snorted and had a cold expression on his face.
“Besides, what illness do you have?”
The man said in a muffled voice, “It’s an illness in that aspect.”
The young man almost slapped him. Did he want to see their family head for such an illness?
His expression turned even colder.

Seeing that he had been defeated, the man immediately understood. He reached into his pocket and took out a bank card. He handed it to the young man. “Brother, look. There’s 500,000 yuan on this card. I didn’t bring anything for you. Please don’t mind.”

When the young man heard about the 500,000 yuan, his expression immediately changed. He immediately smiled and looked at the middle-aged man. “Alright, I didn’t expect you to be so sincere. It’s not like there’s no way out.”
“Is there a way?”
The middle-aged man hurriedly asked.

“Do you need our family head to treat your illness? At most, you can find a collateral relative to treat it. Moreover, the Qi family has rules. If you want to seek treatment, you need to bow every nine steps from here all the way up.”
The people beside him also came over to listen. Then, they looked up. If they bowed throughout the journey, wouldn’t their knees be scraped?
At that moment, many people wanted to retreat.
The middle-aged man thought about his difficulties and nodded with a sigh. “Alright, I’ll bow!”
With that, he bowed.
The young man nodded approvingly, his eyes filled with smugness.
The Qi family had set this rule to let these people experience the Qi family’s prestige. Otherwise, they would really think that the Qi family would treat them for money.
In that case, they would be no different from those wild doctors outside.
“Wow, he’s really kneeling.”
“Does he have an incurable disease?”
“I don’t know. In any case, I don’t think ordinary people can do it. It’s hard to say if his body can take it or not. The key is that it’s easy to be embarrassed.”
When the people around them saw this situation, they spoke one after another.
At this moment, Chen Yun looked at the smug young man in front of him, then at Zhang Ming. “You’re right. The Qi family really has a lot of problems.”
“What did you say?!” When the young man heard this, his expression turned cold. “Do you know what this place is? How dare you be impudent here!”
The people beside him also looked at Chen Yun and sneered.
“How dare you question the Qi family’s rules? It’s obvious that you’re not here to seek treatment with a sincere heart.”
“Just wait. Since he said such arrogant words, I’m afraid it’s useless even if he kneels later.”
“Why don’t we just chase him down the mountain? That’s not bad either.”
The surrounding people discussed animatedly. Many people shook their heads and sighed.
Chen Yun looked at everyone and sneered. “Who said that I’m here to ask the Qi family for treatment?”
Hm?

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone was stunned, including the young man who had been clamoring just now. At this moment, he frowned and said coldly, “Then why are you here at the Qi family villa? Hurry up and get lost!”
Pa!

Chen Yun slapped the young man’s face, immediately causing half of his teeth to fall out. His body was sent flying a few meters and he fell to the ground. He was breathing heavily and looked at Chen Yun resentfully.
Chen Yun glanced at him and said in a low voice, “I’m here to take the head of the Qi family and decapitate him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 180: I’m Here to Take the Head of the Qi Family and Decapitate Him!
paragraphs: These words shocked everyone present. Their eyes widened, and they simply could not believe what they had heard.
This kid was crazy. He actually dared to boast so shamelessly!

Even Zhang Ming, who was beside Chen Yun, was shocked when he heard this. He wanted to beat a retreat, but he knew that he could not leave now. However, Chen Yun had only brought one bodyguard with him. How dare he boldly declare that he would decapitate the head of the Qi family?
Did he think the Qi family was made of clay?
This, this, this!
At that moment, he did not dare to say anything. He could only follow Chen Yun up.
At this moment, in the Qi family villa.
In the living room, two figures were sitting at the head of the table and sipping tea.
One of them looked to be in his fifties, but he was hale and hearty. His face was rosy as he drank tea. He looked at the man opposite him and asked, “Mr. Park, is this tea delicious?”
“Not bad, not bad,” said the man opposite him in stiff Chinese. Then, he looked at his Patek Philippe watch. “It seems that they should have obtained the formula too.”
“Probably. Now, Mr. Park, you can’t forget your promise to us.”

“Hehe, don’t worry. How could I forget?” The middle-aged man said, “You’re on the edge of Jiangbei, so you can’t imagine the strength of the Park Corporation in Jiangbei or even the entire China. It’s not without reason that China is the second development area of the Park Corporation.”
“Moreover, do you know about the Three Spirits Financial Group?”
The Three Spirits Financial Group?!

The Qi family’s head naturally knew that the Three Spirits Financial Group was one of the pillars of Japan. It was said that they had such a huge business in China on the surface and had a lot more power in secret. Even the few large families in Jiangbei did not dare to ignore them.

Moreover, the power of the Three Spirits Financial Group was not in Jiangbei but in North China. However, for some reason, their power had begun to enter Jiangbei recently. It seemed that the person in charge of Jiangbei of the Three Spirits Financial Group had been killed in Jiang City.
He didn’t know much about this news, but he knew one thing. The power of the Three Spirits Financial Group in Jiangbei was definitely much stronger than it was a month ago.

With the power of these two companies, people simply did not dare to resist.
Even if a few large families joined forces, they would probably not be able to do much.

“We and the Three Spirits Financial Group are gathering our strength in Jiangbei. Of course, in China, our strength is definitely not something you can imagine. You’ve helped us this time, so we’ll naturally give you the corresponding promise. In the future, the Qi family might be able to match the few families in Jiangbei.”
As soon as he said this, the Qi family’s head immediately stood up and bowed to the man.
After the man finished his tea, he chuckled and asked, “I heard that the Qi family seems to have the snake head of the Old Summer Palace bronze heads, right? Can you let me take a look?”
Patriarch Qi looked around and immediately nodded. He got someone to bring the snake head over.
He had snatched this thing from an old farmer back then. It was said that the old farmer’s ancestor was a guard. Of course, after snatching it, the old farmer naturally disappeared from the world.
Ever since he snatched it, Qi Chuanyao had not easily shown it to others.
After a while, two young men carried the snake head out.

The man stood up and looked at the snake head in front of him. He could not bear to part with it. At that moment, Qi Chuanyao opened his mouth and said, “Mr. Park, since you like such things, why don’t I give it to you?”

“Then... Alright, since Master Qi is so sincere, it’s impolite for me to refuse.” The man quickly took it and a smile appeared on his face. “Alright, alright, alright. The Qi family will be good friends with the Park Corporation in the future.”
“It’s my honor.” Although Qi Chuanyao’s heart ached, he felt that this deal was worth it.
The next moment, a figure ran in in a panic and scrambled.
“What’s going on? What’s wrong with you?!”

Qi Chuanyao suddenly roared. However, that person fell to the ground and cried. “Uncle, there’s news. My father has been killed, and Brother Qi Chen has also been killed. Everyone who went has been dealt with.”
“He’s not an ordinary person. He’s Director Chen from Jiang City!”
“He single-handedly chased the Su family out of Jiang City. He’s even famous in the east of Jiangbei. It’s rumored that he’s the number one young master in Jiangbei!”
What?
This!
Qi Chuanyao suddenly stood up, his eyes filled with disbelief. He lifted the young man up. “Is what you said true?!”
“It’s absolutely true. How could I dare to say such things without thinking!”
When he heard that his son was dead, Qi Chuanyao’s entire body turned limp. He was filled with sorrow. Then, he looked at the man. “You guys have harmed the Qi family!”
If it was really as his nephew had said, then the Qi family would cause trouble in the entire world!
Beside him, Mr. Park was also stunned. As he listened to the young man’s story, he was also shocked.
Just as Qi Chuanyao was feeling sad, a sound was heard. The door of the Qi family villa was suddenly kicked open and a few figures slowly walked in.
The person in the lead was Chen Yun.
At this moment, the young man on the ground looked at Chen Yun and recognized him. He looked agitated. “Chen Yun, you killed my father and still dare to come to the Qi family?”
“Why? Is the Qi family villa a forbidden area? Why can’t I come?” Chen Yun slowly pulled out the Tang Sword in his hand. Under the sunlight, a cold light shone in everyone’s eyes.
“Don’t be rude!” Qi Chuanyao looked at Chen Yun and suppressed the anger in his heart. “You’re Director Chen, right? Good, good, good. How impressive. I wonder why you’re here today?”
“Are you stupid? The Qi family brought people to secretly plot against me and wanted to snatch my formula. I came to the Qi family to demand an explanation and an apology,” said Chen Yun calmly.
“You! Although my brother and son wanted to snatch your formula, you killed them too. Do you actually want my Qi family to apologize to you?”
Qi Chuanyao was furious, and his eyes were bloodshot.
“Then tell me! What do you want!”
“Not much. I only want your head.”
These words made the expressions of everyone from the Qi family and the guards turn cold.
This tone!
It was too big!
He didn’t just come looking for him!
He even said that he wanted to take the head of the Qi family’s master!
Who did he think the Qi family was?!
Was the Qi family a soft persimmon that could be kneaded by others?!

At that moment, everyone’s expressions changed. Beside him, Mr. Park looked at Chen Yun and said coldly to Qi Chuanyao, “Why are you still talking to him? Since he came knocking on our door, don’t blame us for taking revenge for our people with our numbers!”
He waved his hand, and the burly man behind him immediately walked towards Chen Yun.
“It seems that you don’t want to apologize.”
Chen Yun sneered and simply pulled out the Tang Sword in his hand!

chapters.title: Chapter 181: It Seems Like You Don’t Want to Apologize!
paragraphs: “It seems that you don’t want to apologize!”
Chen Yun pulled out the Tang Sword in his hand and looked at the people in front of him.
“It’s not that we don’t want to apologize, but you’ve gone too far!” Qi Chuanyao looked at Chen Yun with bloodshot eyes.
What did Chen Yun think the Qi family was?!
Was the Qi family a soft persimmon that could be kneaded by others?!
He had just killed the second-in-command and the eldest young master of the Qi family before turning around and looking for them!
He directly asked for his head!
This! This was too much!
At this moment, Qi Chuanyao had long forgotten that they were the ones who attacked first and pulled out the saber first. Everything that happened now was their fault!
“Patriarch, why are you still talking to him? Since this kid came knocking on our door, don’t blame us for taking revenge for my father and Brother Qi Chen with our numbers.”
At the side, the young man also roared angrily. With a wave of his hand, the Qi family’s guards followed the burly men in black from the Park Corporation towards Chen Yun.
“Are you relying on your numbers?”

The corners of Chen Yun’s mouth curled into a cold smile. He tapped the ground with the Tang Sword in his hand. For a moment, the sound of gold and jade could be heard. The tip of the Tang Sword in his hand drew sparks on the ground.
When that sound fell into everyone’s ears, it was like a roar from a Satanic demon that had crawled out of hell.
In the next moment, they roared and charged at Chen Yun.
Chen Yun took a step forward and suddenly darted forward. He tapped the Tang Sword in his hand and flipped his wrist.
Whoosh!
One slash!
Blood splattered!
The Tang Sword directly slashed across the neck of the burly man in black in front of him!
There was no pause at all!
It was done in one go!
It was smooth and natural!
At this moment, cold air suddenly rose in everyone’s hearts. They did not expect Chen Yun to be so powerful. He killed him immediately!
At that moment, many people wanted to retreat.
However, they did not dare to retreat. After all, the head of the Qi family, Qi Chuanyao, was watching from behind. If they retreated now, they would probably not be able to survive in the future.
Qi Chuanyao was also stunned by this. He stomped his feet and shouted, “Are you all trash? What are you afraid of? There are so many people. Can’t you defeat him?!”
At this moment, Qi Chuanyao did not care about anything else. He was furious and did not care about Chen Yun’s identity. Now, he only wanted to tear him into pieces!
As for the rest, he would think about it after he killed Chen Yun!
These words were like a needle that pierced into everyone’s hearts, making them immediately rush towards Chen Yun.
Chen Yun and Vigor rushed forward.

Vigor blocked in the surroundings while Chen Yun attacked. The two of them worked together. In an instant, many guards and burly men in black were killed by Chen Yun. There were countless broken limbs!
Chen Yun fought while bathed in blood. With every slash, blood splattered. Someone fell and killed with every step!
There was no one who could stop him from advancing!
Even if it was just for one second!
“Chen Yun, how dare you be so ruthless!”

Qi Chuan was so dazzled that his eyes turned red. In this split second, the guards of the Qi family and their families suffered heavy losses. The sword in Chen Yun’s hand could be said to be a peerless weapon. It cut off a person’s arm was like it was cutting through freshly made tofu. As long as one came into contact with it, they would either die or be injured. It was really too terrifying!
He could travel 3,000 miles in one go!
A single blade could block a million troops!
This phrase could not be more appropriate to describe Chen Yun, who was in front of him.

At this moment, Chen Yun had already arrived in front of Qi Chuanyao and Mr. Park. He looked at them and smiled. “If you want to kill me, you have to be prepared to be killed by me. It’s getting late. It’s time to go.”
“You... Do you know who I am? I’m from the Park Corporation! You can’t kill me. I’m from Korea!” Mr. Park’s legs were trembling as he barely stood up. He looked at Chen Yun and simply roared.
The next moment, the long saber in Chen Yun’s hand slashed across Mr. Park’s neck.
“I want to kill you, regardless of who you are.”
“Instead of staying in Korea, a Korean dared to come to China and cause trouble. He deserves to die.”
As Chen Yun spoke indifferently, he looked at Qi Chuanyao in front of him. Seeing that he wanted to beg for mercy, Chen Yun immediately stabbed his saber into his chest.
When the surrounding Qi family members saw this scene, they were all incomparably shocked.

They originally thought that Chen Yun had killed his way in to boast shamelessly, but they did not expect that not only had Chen Yun killed so many people, but he had also directly killed Mr. Park and their family head.
At that moment, everyone was in a dilemma.

Then, the Lu family barged in. Lu Jingshan brought people over. As soon as he entered, he saw the scene in front of him. His eyes and his subordinates widened. They could not believe what they were seeing.
All these years, they had seen a lot of the world and had even seen a lot of blood. However, this was the first time they had seen such a scene. It was simply shocking!
Even he felt a little nauseous now. He could not believe that Chen Yun had killed all of them alone. Immediately, Chen Yun’s status in his heart increased again, reaching a high level.

Moreover, he was glad that he did not attack rashly. If he had attacked Chen Yun like the Qi family, the Qi family’s patriarch would not be the only one who would fall here now. He would also be involved!
“Director Chen.”
With Lu Jingshan’s arrival, everyone gradually knew Chen Yun’s identity and the whole story. They immediately thought that the family head was muddle-headed.
Who was the other party?!
He was Director Chen of Jiang City!
He had a wide network!
He was a tycoon with tens of billions in his hands!
This time, it was simply as if they were asking a tiger for its skin!
To be honest, they deserved to die!
At this moment, Chen Yun was sitting at the head of the table. He wiped the blood on the Tang Sword with a piece of paper and looked down. “Who has the final say in the Qi family?”
When everyone heard Chen Yun’s words, their hearts trembled. They quickly dodged, revealing the third-in-charge.

The third-in-charge’s name was Qi Chuanfeng. He was Qi Chuanyao’s third brother, but he usually did not do much. Compared to the family head and second-in-charge, he was much less useful. He was usually idle.
At that moment, when Qi Chuanfeng saw that everyone had revealed him, he was about to pee his pants. He quickly walked to Chen Yun’s side and couldn’t help but tremble.
He did not know what Chen Yun was going to do, so how could he not be afraid? After all, his eldest and second brothers had learned their lesson.
“Director... Director Chen, are you looking for me?”

“In the future, you’ll be in charge of the Qi family. How about that?” The corners of Chen Yun’s mouth curled into a cold smile as he looked at Qi Chuanfeng. The latter was stunned for a moment before his heart skipped a beat and he was overjoyed.
This!
This was like a pie falling from the sky.
Previously, although he was the third son, he was alienated by his eldest and second brothers. In addition, he fell short of expectations. Thus, he could only idle around and do nothing.
Usually, he was also looked down on by his eldest and second brothers.
However, he did not expect that he would actually be chosen by Chen Yun at this moment. Moreover, according to Chen Yun, Chen Yun wanted him to be the head of the Qi family.

At that moment, he was not a fool. He bowed to Chen Yun. “Director Chen, it’s my honor that you like me. I... I’ll definitely take good care of the Qi family and follow Director Chen’s lead in the future!”

chapters.title: Chapter 182: This is an Authentic Piece by Tang Yin
paragraphs: The Qi family looked at the third-in-charge with humiliation in their eyes, but they knew that there was nothing they could do.
After all, it was the family head who provoked the other party first. Who was the other party?!
He was Director Chen of Jiang City!
He was someone who had single-handedly pushed the entire Su family out of Jiang City!
How was the Qi family compared to the Su family?
At most, they could only look at the Su family’s back.
To put it bluntly, as long as Chen Yun wanted to, they could end up like the Su family or even worse.
They did not want to lose everything they had now.
It was easy to go from frugal to extravagant, but difficult to go from extravagant to frugal.
These people were used to being rich. Why would they want to experience hardship?
At that moment, they quickly walked not far from Chen Yun and bowed 90 degrees. “Director Chen, we’ll follow your lead!”
Chen Yun nodded.
Then, a light screen popped up.
[Additional Mission: Take away the snake head.]
[Reward: High Storage Density Battery Blueprint.]
Oh?
This battery could be used with the super silicon. Of these two, one had super high power generation efficiency, and the other had super high storage efficiency.

Then, he looked at the snake head beside him. This thing was lost when the Eight-Nation Alliance attacked Yuanming Garden. After so many years, although many people in China had bought or found some through other methods, there were still a few statues which whereabouts were unknown. This snake head was one of them.
Chen Yun did not expect to encounter the snake head here.
He immediately looked at Qi Chuanfeng. “Where did the Qi family get this?”
When Qi Chuanfeng heard Chen Yun’s words, he naturally told him everything he knew.
He told him everything, from the time his family snatched it from the older farmer, to the time when the family head gave it to Mr. Park.
When Chen Yun heard this, he sneered. “I’ll take this with me.”

“Of course, of course.” Qi Chuanfeng looked around and looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, Qi Chuanyao used to like to collect things. Other than this thing, there are also many good things. Shall I bring you to take a look?”
Chen Yun nodded. Then, Qi Chuanfeng brought Chen Yun to an attic. After opening it, boxes were placed inside.
Qi Chuanfeng took the items out as if he was presenting treasures.
“Director Chen, look. This is an authentic piece by Tang Yin.”
“This is a piece of ice crack porcelain from the Five Great Kiln.”
“This is an authentic piece by Zheng Banqiao.”
“This is a teapot made by Gu Jingzhou.”
“Legend has it that this was a screen that a king offered to the Qianlong Emperor back then. There are large Southern Pearls embedded on it.”

Each and every one of them shocked Chen Yun. Qi Chuanyao was impressive. This was no longer as simple as liking to collect. Any one of these things was enough to cause a commotion. Moreover, if they were auctioned, they would cost almost hundreds of millions.

“Give me an address for these things. I’ll personally escort them to your house tomorrow.” At this moment, Qi Chuanfeng was like a lackey. He took out all the good things from the Qi family. He gave away antiques, herbs, and even
What was going on?

Qi Chuanfeng was not a fool. It was Director Chen’s kindness that the Qi family could survive this time. Otherwise, he would probably have to beg on the streets, let alone be the head of the Qi family.
How could he dare to be disrespectful to Chen Yun?
Chen Yun nodded. This time, he had obtained many good things.
[Additional mission completed. You have obtained a high-density battery blueprint. It has been sent to a different dimension.]
Chen Yun went downstairs and looked at the snake head.
He should donate this thing.

This thing was different from the other things. It recorded the national shame of China. As long as the twelve bronze heads were not gathered, this portion of the national shame could not be washed away at all.
As for other things, such as the jade seal, Chen Yun had no intention of donating them.
First, he was the one who had bid for that item.
Second, the price of that treasure was not only because of the good jade used to carve the jade seal, but also the magical pearl. The value of that pearl was definitely higher than the jade seal.

Then, how could Lu Jingshan let go of such a good opportunity? When he saw Chen Yun walk out of the attic, he quickly came over and said, “Director Chen, the Lu family has a hot spring. Why don’t you wash up and change your clothes?”
Chen Yun looked at himself. His entire body was covered in blood. His black suit was stained with blood, making it look even deeper in color. Chen Yun took it off and threw it aside.
This suit was worth three million yuan. The buttons on it were all inlaid with diamonds.

When he arrived at the Lu family villa, Chen Yun soaked in the hot spring. Clothes had already been prepared outside. Each piece cost less than a few hundred thousand yuan. Although it was not as good as what Chen Yun had worn previously, it was still passable.

When Chen Yun came out, Lu Jingshan had already brewed tea. At this moment, Lu Jingshan looked at Chen Yun and said respectfully, “Director Chen, I’ve already sent someone to clean up the scene at Mount Shennong and the Qi family villa. I won’t let anyone know.”

“This is a top-notch Da Hong Pao. It’s from the mother tree on Wuyi Mountain. I happened to obtain some by chance and haven’t been willing to drink it. Today, Director Chen is here. It’s time to show its value.”
The group of people at the side smelled the fragrance of the tea and were intoxicated. This thing was not something ordinary people could drink. This was something that was specially provided.
Chen Yun took a sip and nodded. “Not bad.”
“In a few days, I’ll go to Jiang City to look for Sacred Heaven’s CEO, Ma Ke, and ask him for the marketing rights of the Heavenly Spirit Water in this area.”
“Hey, hey, okay, Director Chen.” When Lu Jingshan heard this, he beamed with joy and felt a little smug. After all, what did Chen Yun promise?
He promised the right to sell the Heavenly Spirit Water!

Once he obtained this right, he would be able to manage the sales and distribution of the Heavenly Spirit Water on the entire Mount Shennong. With the value of the Heavenly Spirit Water, countless high-ranking officials, nobles, and even influential people from other cities and provinces would come to befriend him.
With this alone, he could foresee the future of the Lu family. In a short period of time, there would definitely be a huge rise. The entire Lu family would rise in his hands.
Thinking back to what had happened in the past few days, it was all thanks to his quick-wittedness. Otherwise, if he was like the Qi family, would the Lu family have such benefits?!
Dream on!
Not only would there be no benefits, but he would also follow in Chuanyao’s footsteps!
Beside him, Lu Yan and the rest of the Lu family were also extremely excited. They could not help but smile.
“Director Chen, why don’t I gather all the dignitaries of Mount Shennong tonight to meet you? Many people want to meet you, but they haven’t had the chance.”

“I have to rush back to Jiang City tonight. Let’s talk about it in the future.” Chen Yun waved his hand. He already had the Qi family and the Lu family in his hands at Mount Shennong. It did not matter if the others met him or not.
The next moment.
The screen popped up again.
[Host, please complete the supreme-grade check-in mission.]
Dazzling golden words suddenly flashed, making Chen Yun narrow his eyes.
Then, he pressed the button.
