chapters.title: Chapter 183: Supreme-Grade Check-in Reward!
paragraphs: A golden light bloomed again.
In the next moment, golden balls of light rushed out.
Chen Yun clicked on the first one.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining five billion yuan.]
Then, the Random Double dice appeared. The number froze at eight. In an instant, the five billion turned into 40 billion and entered Chen Yun’s pocket.
He clicked on the second one.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining 100 packets of Heavenly Spirit chlorella seeds. Moreover, you will be rewarded with 10 packets of chlorella seeds every day.]
He clicked on the third one.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a Vigor Evolution Card.]
He clicked on the fourth one.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the laser arms research and development blueprint.]
Rewards came one after another. Every one of them was supreme-grade, causing the corners of Chen Yun’s mouth to twitch.
He had four rewards. Furthermore, the first reward was a reward of 40 billion yuan!
It had to be known that the funds and real estate in Chen Yun’s hands now added up to less than 30 billion yuan. This directly doubled his assets.
Secondly, with this reward, the Heaven Spirit Water could be mass-produced. Moreover, he could also carry out his plan.
As for the Vigor Evolution Card, Chen Yun did not understand it.

“What’s the Vigor Evolution Card?” Chen Yun asked. Currently, Vigor was already very powerful. His current physical fitness was 80, while ordinary people had a physical fitness 10. Chen Yun was already extremely terrifying compared to ordinary people, but Vigor was even more terrifying. He was 100 times stronger than Chen Yun, which resulted in a physical fitness of 8,000!
In other words, it was as if he could defeat a million masters alone!
How could such a Terminator-level bodyguard robot be further strengthened?

[Vigor Evolution Card: Currently, Vigor can only passively block attacks. After using the Vigor Evolution Card, after a period of upgrading and evolution, Vigor will have the ability to actively attack. Moreover, Vigor’s strength can be strengthened again, and all kinds of accomplishments will be improved.]
Oh?
Chen Yun’s eyes lit up. This felt good.
If Vigor could take the initiative to attack, it was obvious how terrifying a force Chen Yun would have.
“Use the Vigor Evolution Card.”
[Are you sure you want to use the Vigor Evolution Card?]
[After using it, Vigor will be immediately recalled to upgrade and evolve. The shortest upgrade time: two months.]
Chen Yun was speechless.
Alright.
Chen Yun pressed the confirmation button and Vigor was summoned back.
At this moment, Chen Yun looked at the last reward and nodded. He realized that he had already gathered all three sets.
It was a laser arms blueprint!
What was the most important thing about laser arms? It was energy!
Chen Yun happened to have super silicon in his hand. It was 50 times more effective than ordinary solar panels.
It was not enough to just have energy. One had to know that to activate laser arms, one needed a huge battery to supply them with energy. However, Chen Yun had a high density battery in his hand.
In other words, the current Chen Yun was completely capable of creating a weapon that could change the era and the form of war!
It would be a lie to say that it was not shocking.

Lu Jingshan looked at Chen Yun, who was in a daze after taking a sip of tea. He thought that Chen Yun was savoring it and did not disturb him rashly. Then, he looked at Chen Yun’s actions and sighed. “Alright, Director Chen must be tired these few days. Yanyan, hurry up and prepare a plane ticket for Director Chen to return to Jiang City tonight.”
“Alright, I’ll prepare it immediately.”

The Lu family naturally prepared a heavy gift for Chen Yun. Although it was not as expensive as the Qi family’s antiques and treasures, it was still quite expensive. It cost more than 500 to 600 million yuan. Of course, it was expensive in the eyes of ordinary people.
Chen Yun boarded a plane at night and returned to Jiang City.
At Heavenly Dragon Security.
As soon as Chen Yun returned and looked at his brothers, he immediately put down his arrogance. He sat on the chair, crossed his legs, and yawned.
“Brother Yun, you’re back from Mount Shennong. The scenery there is not bad, right?” Zou Runbei walked over and looked at Chen Yun.
“I don’t know if the scenery is good, but I’m not in a good mood.”
“What’s wrong?” Lin Yuhan was stunned.

Chen Yun explained what had happened in the past few days. When everyone heard this, they narrowed their eyes and clenched their fists. “The Qi family and the Park Corporation really have a death wish!”
“That’s right, Brother Yun. Why didn’t you call us?”

“You can’t do this next time. It’s too dangerous,” said Lin Yuhan. When he heard that Chen Yun had shot Divine Doctor Qi at Mount Shennong and kicked down the Qi family’s door, his heart was in his mouth. This was simply too dangerous.
Chen Yun smiled. “With Vigor by my side, you don’t have to worry.”
“By the way, Brother Yun, where’s the instructor?” Zou Runbei asked. The instructor he was talking about was naturally Vigor.
Umm, Vigor was going back to the factory for repair, right?
Chen Yun did not say that and casually lied. “He has something to do and won’t be back for a while. Just train here.”
Everyone nodded. Chen Yun looked at them. “Of course, you still have to relax when it’s time.”
Chen Yun looked at the seventy-odd people. “Let’s go. I’ll bring you guys to experience the corruption of capitalism tonight.”
“Really?” Everyone was excited. After all, they had been training too much recently. Every time they did push-ups, they would wait until their muscles were sore before counting.
They would count to 500!
There was no need to mention other training. Otherwise, how could they have improved so much in such a short period of time?

Of course, this was also thanks to the Heavenly Spirit Water. If not for the Heavenly Spirit Water, the lactic acid accumulated in their bodies after a day of training would be enough for them to not be able to get out of bed for a few days.
With the Heavenly Spirit Water, not only did their soreness disappear, but their strength also increased exponentially. It simply increased their strength without any side effects.
In addition to the tactical strategies that Lin Yuhan and the others had learned from the military and taught them, in just a few days, these people had changed from hooligans to a well-trained team.
The current team was not inferior to the team that had beheaded the Three Spirits Financial Group back then!
At that moment, they set off together. Along the way, those who did not know the situation made way for them.
Among the crowd, two people were worried. One of them was Lin Yuhan. He was blaming himself. It was precisely because of their negligence that Chen Yun was in danger this time.

The other was Zou Runbei. At this moment, his expression was very gloomy. He thought about what Brother Yun had said. Although the Qi family had been destroyed, there was still one person who was at large.
The Park Corporation!
He had to investigate them carefully!

As he thought this, a moment later, Chen Yun called him to his side. “Xiao Bei, help me investigate the Park Group and the Three Spirits Financial Group. I’ll take on both of them. Only by knowing myself and the enemy can I win a hundred battles.”
“Brother Yun, I plan to do the same.”
“However, you don’t have to frown. Have fun tonight and relax.” Chen Yun smiled. When everyone arrived at the bar, Chen Yun pointed at the DJ not far away and then at himself.
The DJ immediately understood what he meant and said loudly, “All the expenses today will be paid by this young master!”
Everyone followed the DJ’s finger and looked over. Then, they all celebrated.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Look at This Cup, It’s Big and Round!
paragraphs: They went to a bar, karaoke, and a spa at the club.
In one night, Chen Yun spent more than a million yuan.
Everyone played until the second half of the night before Chen Yun returned to the Dragon Heaven Villa.
The next day, close to noon, Chen Yun opened his eyes and yawned.
When he went downstairs, they found Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue chatting with a girl.
The girl looked to be about 25 years old. She was wearing a uniform and suit, and she had a business smile on her face. She was a beautiful guest and had a strong aura.
“Hello, Director Chen.”

When the girl saw Chen Yun coming downstairs, she immediately stood up and nodded at him. Chen Mengmeng also waved at Chen Yun. “Brother, why did you sleep until now? Look, you’ve already missed breakfast. Are you hungry? If you’re hungry, I’ll cook for you.”
Chen Yun waved his hand and looked at the girl. “Who are you?”
“Director Chen, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Gong Xiaohan. I’m Miss Chen Mengmeng and Miss Han Xue’s manager now. CEO Ma arranged it.” Gong Xiaohan introduced herself skillfully.

Then, she continued, “Ever since Miss Chen Mengmeng and Miss Han Xue filmed the advertisement, they’ve become quite popular. Coupled with Wang Menghan and Liu Xin’s publicity, they’ve become very popular online.”
“Recently, many production teams have been looking for them to film, so CEO Ma has been considering letting me be their full-time manager.”
She only spoke a few sentences, but they were concise and explained the situation clearly.
Chen Yun nodded. “Don’t leave at noon. Let’s eat together.”
“This... Alright, then I’ll accept it.” Then, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at Gong Xiaohan. “Sister Gong, wait here. We’ll cook. It’ll be done in a while.”
This...
When Gong Xiaohan heard this, she immediately panicked. This way, wouldn’t she have to be alone with Chen Yun?

Speaking of which, Gong Xiaohan was also a professional manager. When she was in university, she became the president of the school’s student union and became the most successful female student president of Jiang City University.

As soon as she graduated, she directly entered Sacred Heaven and became a manager. She received an annual salary of 600,000 yuan and usually did not panic when she encountered trouble. She had seen a lot of the world.
However, she was really panicking now. Although she had seen many directors, investors, and big shots, those people were simply inferior to Director Chen.
Director Chen was her big boss. Legend had it that he was tough and iron-blooded.
Chen Yun looked at Gong Xiaohan and smiled when he saw her reserved expression. He simply did not know what the people in the streets were saying about him. Was he a ferocious beast?
“There’s no need to be reserved. You’ll have to take care of those two girls in the future,” said Chen Yun politely.
An hour later, the fragrance wafted from the kitchen. Chen Yun leaned on the sofa. These two girls were really getting better at cooking, although they were relying on machines.

“Alright, Brother. Are you hungry? Try my and Xiao Xue’s cooking. You’re not allowed to be picky.” Chen Mengmeng knew that Chen Yun usually ate at big restaurants or the First-Grade Restaurant. He must be picky, so she immediately gave him a heads-up.
“What’s there to be picky about?” Chen Yun sat down and ate heartily.
It had been a long time since he had eaten the food cooked by Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue. Chen Yun still missed it a little. Although it was not as good as Old Man Xu’s cooking, it was not bad.
Gong Xiaohan ate in an extremely lady-like manner at the side. However, after the meal, with Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue playing around, she was a little closer with Chen Yun, unlike before.
After dinner, Gong Xiaohan pulled Chen Mengmeng. “Mengmeng, what’s that cauldron made of? It’s golden and really...”
Before she could finish speaking, Chen Mengmeng blinked. “That’s made of gold. It seems to be a cauldron from the Song or Ming dynasties. What’s wrong, Sister Gong?”
Gong Xiaohan was speechless. Erm, sorry to disturb you.
Then, she glanced at the cauldron.
It was such a huge cauldron!
It was pure gold!
It was even from the Song or Ming dynasties!
What an expensive antique!
Was it placed opposite the door just like that?!
Wasn’t he afraid of thieves? Wasn’t he afraid of thieves thinking about him?!
Gong Xiaohan pursed her lips and felt a critical hit worth ten thousand damage in her heart.

Looking at Gong Xiaohan’s expression, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were secretly smug. They were already used to it. After all, they had gone easy on four blue-and-white porcelain vases worth hundreds of millions.
Back then, they had suffered a huge critical hit. Now, someone else could finally experience it.
At that moment, Chen Mengmeng came to Gong Xiaohan’s side. “Sister Gong, did you see that vase?”
“I did.”
“That’s a blue-and-white porcelain vase.”
Sister Gong was speechless. It was a blue-and-white porcelain vase! Wouldn’t that cost hundreds of millions?!
“Sister Gong, that porcelain plate is from the official kiln of Jingde Town in the Qing Dynasty.”
“Sister Gong, look at that teapot. It was made by Gu Jingzhou.”
“Sister Gong...”
Gong Xiaohan was speechless.
She shouldn’t have come today!
What was this?!
They were antiques! Shouldn’t they be kept in a hidden room?
Why were they so brazenly placed here? Wasn’t he afraid of thieves and accidents?!
At that moment, she was enduring ten thousand tons of damage, and her face turned pale. Chen Mengmeng, who was beside her, looked like she had succeeded. When Han Xue saw this, she looked helpless.
“Mengmeng, I... I want to drink some water. Do you have a cup?”
“I’ll pour it for you.” Chen Mengmeng filled a cup with water and handed it to Gong Xiaohan. After the latter took a sip, she heard Chen Mengmeng say leisurely, “Sister Gong, look at this cup.”

Gong Xiaohan’s hands suddenly trembled as she looked at the normal glass-like cup in front of her. “This— This can’t be made of crystal, right? Could it be that this was also from the previous royal family...”
“Oh.” Chen Mengmeng said, “No, no. This is just a normal glass. I just want you to see that the rim is big and round.”
Look at this water. It’s clear and sweet. Then, look at this cup. It’s big and round.
Gong Xiaohan was speechless. She really f*cked up today. She was traumatized.
Chen Mengmeng revealed a smug but polite smile. She finally had a chance today to let others experience their previous shock. Why not?

However, in the next moment, a figure came to the door and pressed the doorbell. “Mr. Chen, someone outside the neighborhood said that it’s an acquaintance of yours. His surname is Qi. He said that he’s here to deliver something to you.”
“Yes, they’re looking for me. Let them in. Sorry to trouble you.”
“Mr. Chen, you’re too polite.” The security guard nodded. After a while, he led a few RVs into the district.
The car stopped and Qi Chuanfeng got out. At this moment, Qi Chuanfeng looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, I brought you the things.”
“This is the list. Take a look.”
Then, he waved his hand, and the people behind hurriedly moved boxes in.

“Slow down, all of you. After putting them away, open all the boxes and let Director Chen inspect them,” said Qi Chuanfeng quickly. Everyone knew how precious the things in their hands were, so they were very careful. They moved them step by step and placed them on the ground without making a sound.
“Director Chen, this is Tang Yin’s authentic Eight Scenes Painting.”
“This is said to be a blood coral carved from top-grade bloodstone that was offered to the royal family back then.”
“This is the ice-crack porcelain from one of the Five Great Kilns, which you saw yesterday.”
“There’s also this. It’s a flawless jade with the Nine Dragons Painting carved on it.”
One treasure after another appeared, making Chen Mengmeng, Han Xue, and Gong Xiaohan stand there as if they were petrified.
What was this?
This... Where did he get so many precious antiques?!
Chen Mengmeng’s eyes couldn’t help but tremble with a bitter expression.
At the side, Gong Xiaohan, who was already numb, leaned close to Chen Mengmeng’s ear. “Hehe, Mengmeng, you have to take a good look at these things.”
The Heavenly Dao was good. The heavens would not spare anyone!
Sister Gong took out her phone on the spot and searched. “This painting costs about 150 million yuan.”
“The market price of this bloodstone looks to be about 80 million yuan.”
“And this ice crack porcelain...”
As she spoke, Sister Gong’s voice trembled. Beside her, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue also began to tremble.
It was as if they had sacrificed 800 soldiers to kill 1,000 enemies!
It’s all because of you guys!

chapters.title: Chapter 185: A House Filled with Treasures!
paragraphs: “Brother!” Chen Mengmeng called out crisply. Then, she looked at Chen Yun. “Did you buy these things from the auction?”
“No, they’re gifts from the Qi family.”
At this moment, Qi Chuanfeng had already put down all the treasures and left with his men. Chen Yun looked at the treasures in front of him and touched his chin. “Come and help.”
“Help me figure out which of these things can be displayed in my home.”
Chen Yun took a look, then grabbed the blood coral made of bloodstone and placed it on the pillar platform. Then, he pointed at the screen. “Mengmeng, move this to your room later.”
As he spoke, the three of them did not reply. He turned around and saw the three of them standing in front of the screen, looking at the palm-sized Southern Pearl embedded in it.
It was round and huge!
Women liked this. At that moment, they could not help but touch it, but they retracted their hands immediately.
Chen Yun looked at them and was amused.

After placing the treasures, he looked at the house and saw that it was different again. The moment he entered, he saw the golden cauldron and the blood coral. There was a jade seal in the study, a Nanzhu screen in the guest room, and Tang Yin’s real painting hanging in the master bedroom. Almost every room was filled with treasures.
Now, Villa No. 3 was worth far more than two billion yuan!
Originally, this building was worth more than a billion yuan, but now, its worth had been forcefully increased to two billion yuan by Chen Yun with rare treasures.

After settling down, Chen Yun sat in the courtyard and looked at the villa in front of him. He was already standing at the top of Jiang City and had power in the east of Jiangbei, but this was not what he wanted. If it was in the past, he would definitely think that his current achievements were enough, but now.
He looked at his hands. What were men’s hands for?
Men’s hands did not just grab food to fill their stomachs or earn money to buy jewelry and decorate women. When men’s hands held a sword, they were about to conquer the world.
As Chen Yun was thinking, Zhou Jingyi sent a message saying that the industrial park in Jiangnan had been bought and renovated.

Jiangbei was not like Jiangnan. Jiangnan was at a higher altitude and had abundant light energy. Moreover, there was a special scientific research park. Chen Yun directly asked Zhou Jingyi to buy an industrial park there to develop the super silicon. However, from the looks of it, it was not as simple as studying super silicon. He also had to develop high-density batteries and laser arms.
It seemed that after he was done with his work, he would go to Jiangnan to take a look and recruit a few more talents.
Then, Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei came to the villa. When they saw Chen Yun drinking tea in the courtyard, they also came over.

“Brother Yun, what kind of tea is this?” Zou Runbei sat down and took a sip. He mocked himself. “Brother Yun’s tea is definitely not rough tea. However, I can’t experience the taste of it yet. I’m just gulping it out.”

“Looks like you haven’t been baptized by the corruption of capitalism. I’ll baptize you a few more times when you come again,” said Chen Yun with a smile. Then, he added some boiled mountain spring water to the pot.

When Zou Runbei heard Chen Yun’s words, he could not help but recall the happy time last night. For the first time in so many years, he truly felt poor. It was also the first time he felt the beauty of money and capitalism.
It was really too corrupt.
It was really too satisfying!
Everyone treated him like a master!
All the women were leaning towards him!
He had wanted these in the past. But now, not only did he want these, but he also wanted to see a higher level of scenery. Therefore, after waking up today, he brought people to investigate quickly.

Then, he took out a document. “Brother Yun, this is the information I found. The Three Spirits Financial Group and Park Group are considered top corporations in Japan and Korea respectively. China is also very close to Japan and Korea, so many of their forces have already infiltrated China.”

“It’s not an exaggeration to say that they’re all over China. Of course, they have businesses on the surface and have invested in many Chinese businesses. Of course, there are also many forces in the dark. Some of them are their own, and some of them are people they recruited from China.”
“After all, the other party is rich. It’s normal for others to work for them.”

Seeing Chen Yun nod, Zou Runbei continued, “I discovered two time points. It seems that ever since you killed Kawakaze Kei, the Three Spirits Financial Group has transferred the power around Jiangbei to Jiangbei and injected its power into Jiangbei.”
“The other thing should be that after Brother Yun distributed the Heavenly Spirit Water widely, the Park Corporation also sent a large number of forces to Jiangbei.”
Lin Yuhan frowned. “These two forces should be targeting you.”
“One of the forces is targeting you, while the other is targeting the thing in your hands.”
Chen Yun nodded. “So many of them suddenly entered. I’m afraid their previous businesses in Jiangbei don’t have that much space to accommodate them, so what do they plan to do?”

“Brother Yun, you’re right. They’re preparing to buy a commercial building in Dongxing City. The location of that building is very strange. It’s in the middle of their original businesses. If we take down this building, it’ll be a nail nailed into their hinterland!”
Chen Yun saw the relevant materials. “Who is Song Jian?”

“Song Jian can be said to be a top-notch figure in Dongxing City. I can’t say anything beyond this, but it’s definitely not a problem for him to be among the top three. Moreover, he has a wide network. Even the nobles and upper echelons there have to be polite to him.”

“However, I heard that he’s almost done negotiating with the Park Corporation. He relied on the trendy clothes of Korea to make a fortune in his early years. He usually boasts that he’s half a citizen of Korea.”

“This guy is an old pervert. He has nurtured no less than five young ladies outside, including female university students and rumored high school students. However, this guy still has some ability. I heard that he’s very loyal to his friends, but he’s also quite black-hearted.”
With that, Zou Runbei’s eyes turned cold. “Brother Yun, what do you think we should do?”
“Go and contact Song Jian. In any case, he hasn’t signed the contract and sold it yet.” Chen Yun stood up and chuckled.
“Yes, I know. Brother Yun, if, I mean if, we can’t reach an agreement with Song Jian, will we...” Zou Runbei stretched out his palm and made a cutting gesture.
Chen Yun narrowed his eyes. “I don’t like people who don’t give me respect.”
The meaning of this sentence was very obvious.
After a day.
Chen Yun brought five to six people to the entrance of the First-Grade Restaurant in Dongxing City on time.
The First-Grade Restaurant branch here had just opened for business.
Chen Yun did not expect the other party to choose this place. The corners of his mouth curled up into a smile. It seemed that the other party had not investigated him deeply.
“Brother Yun, the person in front is the middleman I found. His name is Qu Tianfa. He has some status in Dongxing City, but he pales in comparison to you, Brother Yun,” said Zou Runbei to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun looked over and saw a fat middle-aged man standing at the entrance of the First-Grade Restaurant from afar, looking around.

I can’t say anything beyond this, but it’s definitely not a problem for him to be among the top three.
Moreover, he has a wide network.
Even the nobles and upper echelons there have to be polite to him.”
“However, I heard that he’s almost done negotiating with the Park Corporation.
He relied on the trendy clothes of Korea to make a fortune in his early years.
He usually boasts that he’s half a citizen of Korea.”
“This guy is an old pervert.
He has nurtured no less than five young ladies outside, including female university students and rumored high school students.
However, this guy still has some ability.
I heard that he’s very loyal to his friends, but he’s also quite black-hearted.”
With that, Zou Runbei’s eyes turned cold.
“Brother Yun, what do you think we should do?”
“Go and contact Song Jian.
In any case, he hasn’t signed the contract and sold it yet.” Chen Yun stood up and chuckled.
“Yes, I know.
Brother Yun, if, I mean if, we can’t reach an agreement with Song Jian, will we...” Zou Runbei stretched out his palm and made a cutting gesture.
Chen Yun narrowed his eyes.
“I don’t like people who don’t give me respect.”
The meaning of this sentence was very obvious.
After a day.
Chen Yun brought five to six people to the entrance of the First-Grade Restaurant in Dongxing City on time.
The First-Grade Restaurant branch here had just opened for business.
Chen Yun did not expect the other party to choose this place.
The corners of his mouth curled up into a smile.
It seemed that the other party had not investigated him deeply.
“Brother Yun, the person in front is the middleman I found.
His name is Qu Tianfa.
He has some status in Dongxing City, but he pales in comparison to you, Brother Yun,” said Zou Runbei to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun looked over and saw a fat middle-aged man standing at the entrance of the First-Grade Restaurant from afar, looking around.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Are You Not Going to Give Me Respect?
paragraphs: Seeing that Chen Yun and the others had arrived, Qu Tianfa immediately welcomed them with a smile. “You must be Director Chen. You’re finally here. I’ve been waiting for you for a long time. Please come in!”
Zou Runbei asked from the side, “Is Song Jian here?”
“He arrived early. He’s been waiting for almost half an hour.” As he spoke, Qu Tianfa moved aside and let Chen Yun and the others pass. Then, he followed closely behind.
When they reached the second floor, Qu Tianfa pushed open a private room and smiled at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, please!”
Chen Yun looked into the room. There were six to seven people inside. A bearded person was sitting at the head of the table. It was Song Jian. Chen Yun walked in.
Qu Tianfa quickly introduced him to everyone. He pointed at Chen Yun and said, “Brother Song, this is Director Chen Yun. He’s the number one figure in Jiang City.”
He looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, this is the boss of Hua’an Building, Boss Song Jian.”
Hearing Qu Tianfa’s words, Chen Yun and Song Jian smiled at the same time. The two of them shook hands. Song Jian nodded. “Director Chen, I’ve heard a lot about you.”

As soon as he said this, Chen Yun sneered in his heart. Song Jian had already chosen his address, yet he still said that she had heard a lot about him. If not for Qu Tianfa, Song Jian probably wouldn’t know his reputation.
However, this was good too.

Chen Yun looked at the four people beside him and nodded. These four people should be Song Jian’s subordinates. Xiao Bei had said that Song Jian had some status in Dongxing City. From the figures of these people, they were all martial artists. Moreover, their waists were bulging, and there was something on their backs.
These things fell into his eyes, and were also seen by Zou Runbei and Lin Yuhan. The two of them observed the four people opposite them while thinking of a way.
As Chen Yun and the others observed the other party, Song Jian was also looking at Chen Yun. Seeing that Chen Yun had only brought two brats, he immediately smiled in disdain.
Was he Director Chen of Jiang City?
He was probably the leader of some hooligans.
For a moment, he began to suspect the rumors about Chen Yun that he had heard.
However, he did not show it on his face.
After exchanging a few pleasantries with Chen Yun, he sat down.
Song Jian waved his hand and looked at a man beside him. “Go and find a waiter to serve the dishes. If there’s any good wine, feel free to serve it. Brother Chen and I will get drunk today.”
The person beside him nodded and left.
Chen Yun looked at Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei and asked them to sit down.

After a while, the waiter served the dishes. Song Jian invited Chen Yun and the other two to drink and eat. Everyone chatted as they ate. After the meal, Song Jian cut to the chase. “Brother specially asked Tianfa to invite me out this time. We’re not just having a meal together, right?”
Chen Yun wiped his mouth and smiled. “Of course not. I’ve recently planned to set up a venue in Dongxing City, but I don’t have a foothold here. I hope Brother Song can help me.”

Song Jian looked at Chen Yun and asked curiously, “Brother, do you want me to help you find a foothold? According to what I know, it’s not difficult for you to find a foothold, right? Why are you looking for me?”
Chen Yun shook his head. “I like to get straight to the point. I’ll be straightforward. I like Brother Song’s Hua’an Building.”
When Song Jian and his subordinates heard this, their expressions changed. Their faces darkened. “Brother, what do you mean? Do you want to destroy the Hua’an Building?”
Immediately, his subordinates also reached toward their waists.
Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei’s eyes turned cold as they secretly reached into their pockets.

The undercurrent in the room was surging, and the smell of gunpowder gathered and rose. Qu Tianfa, the middleman, was placed in the middle. He was in a dilemma. He looked at both parties and was so anxious that beads of sweat the size of beans fell from his forehead.

Chen Yun and Song Jian looked at each other for a while before suddenly laughing out loud. The latter was stunned. Chen Yun smiled and said, “Brother Song, what are you talking about? Why would I want to destroy the Hua’an Building?”
Song Jian’s expression softened slightly as he asked, “Then what do you mean, Brother?”
“What I mean is that I want to buy the Hua’an Building.”
“Buy it!” Song Jian was a little surprised. What a bold tone!

However, he smiled and said, “Brother Chen, since you’re interested in Hua’an Building, you should know its situation. Besides its good location, there’s no other building of the same size nearby. Moreover, to be honest, I’ve already promised the Hua’an Building to someone else.”

When Chen Yun saw Song Jian speak, he knocked on the table. “Who beat me to it? Brother Song, aren’t you going to consider it? The price I’ll give you won’t be low. Brother Song, why don’t you tell me who the other party is and what the price is?”

Song Jian was silent for a moment. He knew that Chen Yun was not to be trifled with. He immediately smiled and said, “Alright, I’ll tell you. The Park Corporation will buy it from me for four billion yuan.”
The Park Corporation. Chen Yun smiled when he heard these words. Then, he looked at the two people beside him, his meaning self-evident.
Then, he asked, “What if I add a billion yuan and offer five billion yuan? I wonder if Brother Song will give me respect.”
Then, Zou Runbei took out the contract from his briefcase. “This is the contract for the Hua’an Building. If Boss Song thinks it’s okay, you can sign it.”
Five billion!
When Song Jian heard this, he trembled, let alone the men and Qu Tianfa beside him. They all looked at Chen Yun, their eyes filled with shock.
Five billion!
Needless to say, this number was huge!
However, when Chen Yun said this number, it was as if he had spent 50 yuan on groceries!
Moreover, he wanted to buy it with cash!
At that moment, their gazes towards Chen Yun changed again.

Song Jian also lowered his head and pondered. After all, the number Chen Yun offered was too tempting. Five billion yuan! It was a billion yuan more than the Park Corporation, but he was not a fool. In front of the Park Corporation, what was the chairman of Sacred Heaven? If he relied on the Park Corporation, he might be able to earn a billion yuan in the future.
After all, it was easy to take advantage of a big power.

At that moment, Song Jian looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Chen, the price you offered is indeed very tempting, but I still can’t agree. To be honest, I relied on the Park Corporation to make a name for myself. I also have to rely on the Park Corporation to grow stronger again, so I can’t sell the Hua’an Building. I don’t think Brother Chen will mind.”

Qu Tianfa was at the side. Seeing that Song Jian had also given a reason, he thought that since the deal had failed, there should be some lingering feelings. He immediately mediated the situation. “Everyone, even if the deal doesn’t go through, we can still be friends. Director Chen, don’t you think so?”
Chen Yun looked at Qu Tianfa, then leaned back in his chair and knocked on the table with his hand. His eyes were cold. “In that case, Brother Song doesn’t plan to give me respect, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 187: A Foreigner With a Tang Sword
paragraphs: “In that case, Brother Song doesn’t plan to give me respect, right?”
These words made the entire room tense up again. Song Jian looked at Chen Yun. “What if I don’t want to give it to you?”
Hahahaha!
Chen Yun laughed loudly. Beside him, Zou Runbei took out a gun from his inner pocket and pointed the black muzzle between Song Jian’s eyebrows. “You can’t just refuse to give Brother Yun face.”
You!

Song Jian did not expect Chen Yun to ask his subordinates to bring out their guns. For a moment, even the men beside him were stunned. They did not expect such a change. However, they had no choice. They had short knives on their waists, while the other party had real guns!
How could they dare to take action?

“Brother, you’re so bold!” Even when a gun was pointed at him, Song Jian’s voice did not tremble at all. Instead, he raised his glass and drank. “Brother Chen, do you know that Dongxing City is my territory? If you dare to touch me today, I guarantee that you won’t be able to leave Dongxing City.”
Haha!
Chen Yun also poured a glass of wine and drank it. “It seems that you still don’t know my methods. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have told me this.”
“Back then, the Su family of Jiang City wanted to kill me, but I killed Su Yuncheng and destroyed Su Qingtian.”
“I killed Kawakaze Kei, the person-in-charge of the Three Spirits Financial Group in Jiangbei.”
“Later, the Song family coveted me. I blew up the Song family’s manor, destroyed the Song family’s guards, and even captured Song Jixing, making him disappear from the face of the earth.”
“The Qi family on Mount Shennong provoked me. I went to take the Qi family’s head.”

Chen Yun spoke slowly. He took a sip of wine after saying this. When these words fell into everyone’s ears, the anger in their hearts dissipated bit by bit. At the same time, fear rose in their hearts.
Even Song Jian, who was previously as still as a mountain, started to tremble with the wine glass in his hand. He even spilled a lot of wine.

After Chen Yun’s words, he finally understood why the Park Corporation and the Three Spirits Financial Group would suddenly enter Jiangbei on a large scale. He also realized why Jiang City had stabilized and why Chen Yun had snatched a few business deals from the Song family in a row, but the other party was willing to suffer their losses in silence.
At that moment, the way he looked at Chen Yun changed.

Chen Yun finished his glass of wine and turned it upside down. There was not a drop of wine left. “Boss Song, no matter who it is, I want to crush whoever stands in my way. I’ve already crushed so many people. You’re an understanding person. You don’t want to be the next, right?”
“Or do you still want to be stubborn after hearing so much?”
Chen Yun waved his hand. Zou Runbei handed the gun in his hand to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun stood up and took the document. Then, he took out a black card from his pocket and placed it in front of Song Jian. Then, he pressed the gun against his temple.
“There’s five billion yuan on this card. You don’t have to be afraid that the Park Corporation will find trouble with you. I’ll settle the score with them soon.”
Chen Yun had already said so much. It was useless to say anything else. If Song Jian was a smart person, he would naturally make a choice. Moreover, he had no other choice now.
“Hahahaha.” Song Jian nodded and picked up the pen. “As expected, heroes emerge from young people. We’re all old and useless.”
“In any case, Brother Chen, you didn’t give me any other way, right?” After Song Jian signed, Chen Yun took it and nodded. He brought Zou Runbei and Lin Yuhan away.
In the private room, Song Jian sat there with a dark expression. Then, he looked at the card in his hand and nodded.
“Brother Song, are we going to give up the Hua’an Building just like that?”
A man beside him asked.
Another man sighed. “He’s already signed the contract. It’s useless.”
“Brother Song, what should we do now? Should we stop that kid?”
Song Jian played with the card in his hand and smiled. “Kill him? I wouldn’t dare.”
“Brother Song!”
A man beside him exclaimed. He looked at Song Jian, not knowing why Brother Song would say such aggrieved words.
However, Song Jian looked at him. “You still don’t understand.”
Moreover, it was not that Chen Yun was telling the truth previously. It was just that after signing the contract, Song Jian could not touch Chen Yun. If he did, the Park Corporation would blame him.

Now, he could spread the news and get the Park Corporation to look for Chen Yun. When the two tigers fought, one of them would definitely be injured. As for who was injured, he could obtain benefits from it.
Moreover, he wanted to see how a kid would fight against those two colossi.
After hearing Song Jian’s explanation, everyone felt ashamed. Brother Song was right.
Outside, Chen Yun, Lin Yuhan, and Zou Runbei were walking. Zou Runbei asked curiously, “Brother Yun, why don’t we hurry back to Jiang City? This is Song Jian’s territory after all.”

“He wouldn’t dare. If he was a fool, he wouldn’t have been able to achieve such a position. Moreover, I gave him an additional billion yuan. It’s not considered unfair to him. Now, he can just sit this one out and reap the spoils later.”
Chen Yun said confidently, “Alright, when you return to Jiang City later, I might have to make a trip to Jiangnan.”
“Brother Yun, why are you going to Jiangnan?”

“Our businesses are over there. I’ll go take a look.” Chen Yun looked at the two of them. “We’ll expand Heavenly Dragon Security and choose another group of people from among them. The Park Corporation and the Three Spirits Financial Group will enter Jiangbei and won’t leave easily. In that case, we have to chase them out.”
“Okay.”
Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei quickly nodded.

Along the way, everything was indeed safe and sound. Zou Runbei, who was originally nervous, looked at Chen Yun with admiration in his eyes. He increasingly felt that Brother Yun was like a prophet or a god. What he said could not be wrong, and what he did could not be wrong.
When they arrived at the airport, Lin Yuhan flew to Jiang City while Chen Yun flew straight to Jiangnan.
Suddenly, in the next moment, many exclamations sounded. Chen Yun looked over and saw two young men standing there. The ones who spoke were naturally many girls beside them.
Chen Yun looked over and smiled. This style was quite strange.
Beside him, many girls also saw Chen Yun and exclaimed even more loudly.
“Look, those two foreign handsome men are simply too handsome. They have blond hair, a high nose bridge, and deep eyes. Furthermore, that handsome man is holding a Tang Sword in his hand.”
“Hmph, in your eyes, the moon in foreign countries is even farther away. Look at the handsome man dressed in slim-fit clothes there. He’s much more handsome than them.”
“Ahhh! Today is really a feast for the eyes. I’m twice as happy.”
“I can’t take it anymore. I’m going to the toilet first.”
Amidst the screams at the side, Chen Yun and the young man holding the Tang Sword brushed past each other. The two of them turned their heads and looked at each other with disdain.

After walking far away, the young man holding the Tang Sword looked to the side and said in English, “Did you see that person just now? What clothes was he wearing? One look and you can tell that he’s a country bumpkin who crawled out of a ravine.”

On the other side, Chen Yun, who had passed the security check, also shook his head secretly. “What a fool. He brought a Tang Sword to the airport. If you can pass the security check, I’ll write my name upside down.”

“We’ll expand Heavenly Dragon Security and choose another group of people from among them.
The Park Corporation and the Three Spirits Financial Group will enter Jiangbei and won’t leave easily.
In that case, we have to chase them out.”
“Okay.”
Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei quickly nodded.
Along the way, everything was indeed safe and sound.
Zou Runbei, who was originally nervous, looked at Chen Yun with admiration in his eyes.
He increasingly felt that Brother Yun was like a prophet or a god.
What he said could not be wrong, and what he did could not be wrong.
When they arrived at the airport, Lin Yuhan flew to Jiang City while Chen Yun flew straight to Jiangnan.
Suddenly, in the next moment, many exclamations sounded.
Chen Yun looked over and saw two young men standing there.
The ones who spoke were naturally many girls beside them.
Chen Yun looked over and smiled.
This style was quite strange.
Beside him, many girls also saw Chen Yun and exclaimed even more loudly.
“Look, those two foreign handsome men are simply too handsome.
They have blond hair, a high nose bridge, and deep eyes.
Furthermore, that handsome man is holding a Tang Sword in his hand.”
“Hmph, in your eyes, the moon in foreign countries is even farther away.
Look at the handsome man dressed in slim-fit clothes there.
He’s much more handsome than them.”
“Ahhh!
Today is really a feast for the eyes.
I’m twice as happy.”
“I can’t take it anymore.
I’m going to the toilet first.”
Amidst the screams at the side, Chen Yun and the young man holding the Tang Sword brushed past each other.
The two of them turned their heads and looked at each other with disdain.
After walking far away, the young man holding the Tang Sword looked to the side and said in English, “Did you see that person just now?
What clothes was he wearing?
One look and you can tell that he’s a country bumpkin who crawled out of a ravine.”
On the other side, Chen Yun, who had passed the security check, also shook his head secretly.
“What a fool.
He brought a Tang Sword to the airport.
If you can pass the security check, I’ll write my name upside down.”

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Fang Mengjun Cried
paragraphs: “If you can pass the security check, I’ll write my name upside down.”
Chen Yun looked at the young man’s figure and chuckled in his heart.
Then, he went through security checks and waited for a while before entering the first-class cabin.
The next moment, Chen Yun’s phone rang.
Because it was not time to take off yet, the surrounding people did not pay much attention to it. The air stewardesses were also the same.
Chen Yun picked up the phone. “Mengjun, what’s wrong?”
On the other side of the line, Fang Mengjun was silent for a moment before sighing. “Wan’er has returned from overseas and wants your contact information. Are you... still going to hide from her?”

Wan’er’s full name was Lin Wan’er, and she could be considered Fang Mengjun’s friend. Lin Wan’er had come to their class when they were in junior high school. At that time, Lin Wan’er was already a young beauty. All the boys in the class fell in love with her.

However, Lin Wan’er distanced herself from everyone and loved to stay with the more reclusive Chen Yun at that time. As time passed, the boys in the class also knew that the famous flower was taken. They could only envy Chen Yun.
As for Lin Wan’er, she had also entered their circle and become friends with them.
Those few years were the happiest time for Chen Yun and Lin Wan’er. It was also the time that Fang Mengjun did not want to remember the most.

However, Lin Wan’er’s family background was special. It was said that her father was a big shot, and her mother was only fated to meet him. In other words, Lin Wan’er was an illegitimate daughter. Later on, Lin Wan’er and her mother were taken away to study overseas. She also cut off contact with them and Chen Yun.
At that time, they did not have phones. When Lin Wan’er returned to China a few years later, everyone had already entered university.
Lin Wan’er looked for Chen Yun a few times, but Chen Yun avoided her. Fang Mengjun did not know why.
As Fang Mengjun thought about this, a low voice came from the other end of the phone. “Let me think about it.”
Then, he hung up.
Fang Mengjun’s eyes turned red. Her roommate looked at her. “Mengjun, what’s wrong? Who made you unhappy?”
Her words made her roommates gather around.
“Mengjun, what’s wrong?”
“Say something!”
“Did some scumbag bully you?”
“We’ll avenge you.”
Everyone spoke one after another, making Fang Mengjun cry louder and louder. Then, she looked at their puzzled gazes. “I... I pushed the person I like to someone else.”
“Huh?” This sentence was something no one had expected. They immediately hugged Fang Mengjun. “Don’t cry, don’t cry. You silly girl, why are you so silly?”

“Why did you let him go? Even if you can’t get him, you can’t let him go.” A girl comforted her. “Mengjun has a pretty face, a good figure, a good education background, and comes from a diligent family. Countless people want to marry her. I really don’t know what that person is thinking. Hurry up and come back.”
When Fang Mengjun heard this, the sadness in her heart intensified. Whatever she had, Lin Wan’er also had. She was good at everything, but Lin Wan’er was even better than her.
At this moment, she felt like Zhou Yu, who had met Zhuge Liang. There were always people more talented like her.
However, she still looked up and squeezed out a reassuring smile. “I’m fine. It’s just that, it’s just that...”
Fang Mengjun wanted to say something reassuring, but she cried again.
At this moment, Chen Yun, who was in the first-class cabin, leaned against the backrest and narrowed his eyes.
Was Wan’er back?

In the past few years, Wan’er had looked for him a few times, but Chen Yun also knew the difference between him and the other party. Back then, although he was studying at a university under the 211 Project, the difference between him and the other party was getting greater and greater.
He did not dare to, nor did he want to delay the other party’s future.
But now, Chen Yun looked out of the window and smiled. He made a call. “Ma Ke, help me investigate someone.”
Then, the air stewardess walked over. “Sir, our plane is about to take off. Please turn off your phone or switch to flight mode.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yun’s plane slowly accelerated on the runway. At this moment, on another plane on the tarmac, Lin Yuhan was suffering.
He and Zou Runbei also looked helpless. They looked at each other and then at the two foreign youths in front of them.

One of them was wearing a suit and sunglasses. He also had a large gold chain around his neck. No matter how one looked at him, he looked out of place. He simply looked like a foreign version of a nouveau riche.
In particular, that arrogant smile made the corners of Lin Yuhan and Zou Runbei’s mouth twitch. No matter how they looked at it, they wanted to press this young man to the ground and beat him up.

“I say, you don’t even have your sword, so why are you still so arrogant?” The young man in a long robe looked at the young man with the golden chain. “Lucifer, quickly take off this chain. Also, give me these sunglasses. They’re really ugly.”
As he spoke, the young man in a long robe took off his sunglasses and crushed them with one hand.

“F*ck! These are the Lotos sunglasses that I have kept in my collection. You actually crushed them just like that!” Lucifer looked at the crushed sunglasses and his eyes widened. He grabbed the young man’s collar and said, “Beelzebub, you old hat. I think you’ve been in the manor for too long.”
“I dressed you up so fashionably, but you actually dared to crush the sunglasses I gave you.”
“I think you want me to kill you.”
“Say that again!” Veins popped out on the forehead of the young man called Beelzebub, making one’s heart turn cold.
Lucifer raised his neck and said, “You country bumpkin, who do you think you are? How dare you scare me? I was raised in fear!”

Beelzebub revealed a ferocious expression as he stared at Lucifer in front of him. Then, he looked at the stunned gazes of the people beside him and sighed. He had had enough of this fellow. He was simply a strange person.
He did not look like a f*cking all-powerful person in the West. He was simply a hooligan.
“Lucifer, I advise you not to provoke me again.”
“Heh, what’s wrong?”
Lucifer’s lips curled into a smile, “Let me tell you, I accompanied you to China because I didn’t want to return to the manor. Instead, I wanted to come out to relax. Do you understand?”

Beelzebub looked at Lucifer. He really wanted to smash this arrogant guy’s head. After completing the mission and returning to the West, the first thing he would do was to bring people to beat this guy up.
“Sirs, our plane is about to take off. Can you sit down and fasten your seatbelts?” The air stewardess beside them listened to their English conversation and looked at them differently.

What Beelzebub? What Lucifer? Weren’t they two of the seven devils of the West? How could they use this term to address each other? At that moment, she looked at the two of them and immediately understood that this might be the illness that occurred at night. Um... Yes, it was called chuunibyou1.

Listening to the flight attendant’s English advice, Lucifer squatted down and picked up the broken pieces of sunglasses on the ground bit by bit. He handed them to the flight attendant and said sorry. Then, he hugged the back of his neck with both hands and looked at Beelzebub with a disdainful smile. “You’re just a bumpkin.”
This sentence was said in Chinese.
Beelzebub was speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Plan
paragraphs: After the plane took off, Lucifer looked at Beelzebub beside him. “Why did the Boss ask you to come here to find a Chinese person?”
“Don’t ask what you shouldn’t ask.”
“Tsk.” Lucifer saw Beelzebub’s arrogant expression and closed his eyes to sleep.
This was despite the fact that he would not be able to sleep for long.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun had already arrived at the airport. When he got off the airport, Zhou Jingyi was already waiting at the door.
Beside her were a few young people, all of whom were members of her team.
“Director Chen, you’re here.”
When everyone saw Chen Yun, their expressions became respectful. After all, this was their big boss.
“Why are you still doing this?” Chen Yun smiled. “Let’s go. Get in the car.”
Then, he got into Zhou Jingyi’s Mercedes-Benz E-Class. A few cars drove towards the industrial park.

In the industrial park, the super silicon had already reached a critical stage. Although it was a critical stage, it was actually not a bottleneck. After all, Chen Yun had already given them the blueprint. They just had to develop the super silicon according to the blueprint.
For the entire afternoon, Chen Yun looked at the industrial park. It was considered lively. None of the researchers here were more than 35 years old.
At night, Chen Yun brought these people to Zhengjiang Pavilion for dinner.
Zhengjiang Pavilion was a five-star hotel and the best hotel here. In one night, Chen Yun spent 500,000 yuan, shocking everyone.
After the meal ended, Chen Yun brought Zhou Jingyi to the Dongjiang Lake. Then, he slowly told her about the plan for the high-density storage battery blueprint and the laser arms.

When Zhou Jingyi heard about the high-density storage battery blueprint, she was already shocked. Her entire body became a little numb. Then, when she heard about laser arms, Chen Yun felt that Zhou Jingyi’s legs were weak and she was about to fall.

“Director Chen, Director Chen, where did you get this?” Zhou Jingyi asked softly. Then, she knew that this was not something she should ask. She immediately changed her words. “Director Chen, don’t worry. I’ll definitely choose a good person and complete it as soon as possible.”
“Yes, thank you for your hard work.”
“It’s what I should do.”
The two of them chatted for a long time. When they returned to the hotel, it was already past 10 pm.
The next day.
“Director Chen, do you think there’s anything wrong with this industrial park? If there is, I’ll correct it.”
“No need. You can go and do your work too. I’ll walk around alone.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yun was walking when he looked at the other side of the industrial park. He was stunned. There was actually a technology competition here.
The next moment, someone patted him.
“Brother Yun! It’s really you!”

“I heard from Mengjun and Huaiyao that you’ve changed drastically. Now that I look at you, it’s true. Brother Yun, you’re so handsome now that I almost don’t dare to recognize you. Fortunately, I know your walking posture. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have dared to come up and pat your shoulder.”
Chen Yun looked at the person in front of him and was stunned. “Wang Liang, weren’t you in Jiang City? Why are you in Jiangnan?”

“I came here with the team to participate in the competition this time.” Wang Liang was still wearing sportswear and Nike shoes. He looked at Chen Yun. “On the other hand, Brother Yun, why are you here in Jiangnan? You’re even dressed so formally.”
“I’m here for some things.”
Chen Yun looked beside Wang Liang. There were three women and a man.
At this moment, the three girls also looked at Chen Yun and their eyes lit up.
“Are... Are you Chen Yun?”
A girl came forward and looked at Chen Yun. Her eyes widened, and she simply could not believe what she was seeing.
The other two girls were the same. They looked around as if they did not know Chen Yun in the past.
“Why are you so handsome now?”
“You’re thinner than before and much more handsome. As expected, the class hunk back then was the class hunk.”
“Now that you mention it, I seem to have returned to our junior high school days. At that time, Wan’er occupied Chen Yun. We didn’t even have a chance to attack him.”
Everyone spoke one after another. Then, a girl asked Chen Yun, “Chen Yun, are you still with Wan’er? I haven’t seen her in a long time.”
When Wang Liang heard this, he thought to himself that something was wrong. He immediately laughed. “I didn’t expect everyone to see each other here. We’re really fated.”

“That’s right. To be honest, we all took advantage of Na Na. You don’t know, but Na Na and Zheng Nan are together now. This time, Zheng Nan invited us to travel. We were invited to attend the opening ceremony. Coincidentally, we happened to bump into you while participating in the competition.”
A girl looked at Wang Na beside her. At this moment, Wang Na was holding the arm of the remaining young man.

“You might not know about this, but Zheng Nan is doing very well in Jiangnan now. Zheng Nan, the people who were talking to you just now are all young masters from Jiangnan, right? How do you know them? What have you been doing all these years?”

“Actually, it’s nothing much. I graduated from high school and went to Jiangnan. I accidentally entered the financial industry,” explained Zheng Nan. “I was lucky and almost never lost money in the stocks I invested in. Therefore, these young masters and young ladies in Jiangnan took a fancy to me. They all handed their funds to me. I helped them earn money and earned some myself.”
“I haven’t earned much in the past few years. I only earned about ten million yuan.”
“Of course, don’t think that investing is a simple matter.”
“In our industry, people like me can be counted on only one hand.”
It was only about ten million yuan...
When the few people here heard Zheng Nan say this, other than Chen Yun, everyone else felt extremely envious.
They were clearly in the same junior high school. How could he be so outstanding?
In just a few years, he had earned ten million yuan.
As for them, they were still in university and were spending their family’s money.

As Zheng Nan spoke, he looked at Chen Yun and Wang Liang with a faint smile. The two of them were influential figures in their class back then. Now, he heard that they had also been admitted to good universities, but was it useful?
In the end, they still could not catch up to him.
He could earn 10,000 yuan a day now. These two would only earn about 10,000 yuan a month after leaving school. Few university students nowadays could exceed this number.
It was a cheap price.
Did he have to study? Study my ass!
Would academic qualifications help?

Looking at Zheng Nan’s smug expression, Wang Liang felt upset and a little ashamed of his inferiority. The remaining two girls also chatted and laughed with Zheng Nan, leaving Wang Liang and Chen Yun to the side.
Zheng Nan looked at Chen Yun. “Chen Yun, have lunch with us.”
“Wang Liang has already promised us.”
“That’s right, Chen Yun. Come along.”

The girls also persuaded Chen Yun. Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at Wang Liang. He remembered that his childhood friend was unwilling to participate in such a situation. Besides, they were not close with Zheng Nan. Could it be that his childhood friends had changed their personality?
Wang Liang looked at Chen Yun’s puzzled gaze and sighed inwardly.

I helped them earn money and earned some myself.”
“I haven’t earned much in the past few years.
I only earned about ten million yuan.”
“Of course, don’t think that investing is a simple matter.”
“In our industry, people like me can be counted on only one hand.”
It was only about ten million yuan...
When the few people here heard Zheng Nan say this, other than Chen Yun, everyone else felt extremely envious.
They were clearly in the same junior high school.
How could he be so outstanding?
In just a few years, he had earned ten million yuan.
As for them, they were still in university and were spending their family’s money.
As Zheng Nan spoke, he looked at Chen Yun and Wang Liang with a faint smile.
The two of them were influential figures in their class back then.
Now, he heard that they had also been admitted to good universities, but was it useful?
In the end, they still could not catch up to him.
He could earn 10,000 yuan a day now.
These two would only earn about 10,000 yuan a month after leaving school.
Few university students nowadays could exceed this number.
It was a cheap price.
Did he have to study?
Study my ass!
Would academic qualifications help?
Looking at Zheng Nan’s smug expression, Wang Liang felt upset and a little ashamed of his inferiority.
The remaining two girls also chatted and laughed with Zheng Nan, leaving Wang Liang and Chen Yun to the side.
Zheng Nan looked at Chen Yun.
“Chen Yun, have lunch with us.”
“Wang Liang has already promised us.”
“That’s right, Chen Yun.
Come along.”
The girls also persuaded Chen Yun.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at Wang Liang.
He remembered that his childhood friend was unwilling to participate in such a situation.
Besides, they were not close with Zheng Nan.
Could it be that his childhood friends had changed their personality?
Wang Liang looked at Chen Yun’s puzzled gaze and sighed inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: In Jianghu, One Can’t Help Oneself
paragraphs: Seeing that Wang Liang was silent, Chen Yun could not refuse. After all, he had not eaten with his childhood friend at the First-Grade Restaurant last time. It would be unreasonable if he did not give him respect now.
Everyone immediately set off.

When they arrived at the Nanchen Clubhouse, Chen Yun looked at the clubhouse in front of him and immediately chuckled. This clubhouse was located beside the five-star hotel, Zhengjiang Pavilion, where they had eaten yesterday. The two of them shared a parking lot. Many good cars and sports cars were parked in the parking lot.

However, to be honest, the surrounding decorations and environment were not bad. Mountains and rivers surrounded it, and it was very charming. Compared to a big hotel like the noisy Zhengjiang Pavilion, Chen Yun preferred to come to such a clubhouse.
At the side, the others looked at the Nanchen Clubhouse in front of them. Their eyes widened in surprise. A girl exclaimed, “This is the first time I’ve seen such a luxurious clubhouse.”
“Really? Usually, high-ranking officials and nobles come here.”
“It’s just that the location is not good. Zhengjiang Pavilion is next to it. It’s a five-star hotel. Many customers will be snatched away.”

Hearing the girls’ words, Zheng Nan smiled. “You’re wrong. Those true high-ranking officials rarely go to noisy hotels like Zhengjiang Pavilion. Instead, they’re more willing to come to such clubhouses and enjoy the environment here.”

“Furthermore, this isn’t an ordinary clubhouse. The Nanchen Clubhouse belongs to the Lu family in Jiangnan. The Lu family is enough to be ranked in the top five of the big families in Jiangnan. Legend has it that they have nearly 100 billion yuan in their hands. They’re really a wealthy family.”
The Lu family.
They had 100 billion yuan!
For a moment, everyone looked at this clubhouse again with reverence.
Chen Yun frowned. The Lu family should be the family of Lu Jun and Lu Ying. He still had a deep impression of Lu Ying, who cried when she ate the ginseng worth hundreds of millions.
Seeing that Chen Yun was silent, Zheng Nan became even more smug. “The person we’re meeting today is the young master of the Lu family. You must be more polite when you go in later.”
“Really?”

The remaining two girls were also interested. After all, if they could really be liked by such a young master and marry into a rich family, they would not have to worry about food and clothes for the rest of their lives.

At that moment, Wang Liang looked at the door in front of him and smiled bitterly. He had been persuaded by Zheng Nan to come this time to seek favor with the Lu family’s young master. After all, this competition was organized by the Lu family. Many teams had pulled strings, while they only found out about this situation when they arrived.
Even if their things were better than the other teams, they could not compare with the other party’s connections. If this continued, they would not even be qualified to win the championship award.
Moreover, he was the captain of the team. He was the one who led everyone in this project. He did not expect to encounter such a situation. He did not want everyone’s hard work to go down the drain.
Sigh.
Now, he also felt what it meant to have no choice in the pugilistic world.
“Let’s go in.”
Zheng Nan pointed at the door of the Nanchen Clubhouse and walked in first.
Chen Yun, Wang Liang, and the others entered the Nanchen Clubhouse. Zheng Nan looked around and walked straight towards a private room.
There were six people sitting in this private room, three men and three women.
One of the men sitting in the middle was obviously the leader. He glanced at the people beside Zheng Nan and frowned. “Zheng Nan, what are you doing? Why did you bring other people here?”
In the private room, the other two men and three women also looked over.
When they saw that Zheng Nan had brought other people, their faces revealed dissatisfaction.

A young man sitting in the middle looked at the girls Zheng Nan had brought and realized that they were not bad-looking, so he tacitly agreed. However, he glanced at Chen Yun and Wang Liang with displeasure in his eyes. Then, he looked at Zheng Nan and said coldly, “Zheng Nan, why did you bring others here? Not everyone can join my bureau.”
It could be seen that these people were very arrogant. They even thought highly of their small circle.

Zheng Nan’s status in this group of people was clearly not high. He smiled awkwardly and pulled Wang Liang and Chen Yun over to introduce them. “Brother Hong, let me introduce them. These two are my classmates.”
As he spoke, he leaned close to Brother Hong’s ear and whispered a few words.
The young man’s eyes lit up and he said with some interest, “In that case, please take a seat. However, when that big shot comes later, I hope you won’t cause trouble for us.”
“Don’t worry, we definitely won’t.”
Zheng Nan promised and pulled everyone to the side.

Chen Yun observed the three men and three women sitting at the side. The three men had good temperaments and were dressed in appropriate clothes. Their words and actions were also very refined, so one could not tell that they were profligate.

The three women were not escorts either. They should be from the same circle. They were quite beautiful. Although the brand of the clothes they were wearing could not be seen, the quality was very good. They must be high-end goods.
They were chatting and laughing with the three men, but they kept a certain distance. It was obvious that they were very well-mannered and were not women who came out to play.
However, even so, Chen Yun still felt an arrogant aura from them. Moreover, they looked down on people like them.

As for the three women, although their gazes were filled with admiration when they glanced at Chen Yun, they only felt that he was handsome. Then, there was a hint of mockery in their eyes. They did not take a fancy to him. At most, they felt that he was just a pretty boy.
As for the leader, he did not even look at Chen Yun. He exuded a condescending and arrogant aura.
Seeing this, Chen Yun could not help but find it funny. They were just a few brats, but they were actually so arrogant.
He smiled and said, “Wang Liang, do you know who these people are and why they’re so arrogant?”
“Shh, lower your voice.”

Wang Liang was afraid that the others would hear Chen Yun, so he gestured for him to keep quiet. Only then did he introduce them to Chen Yun in a low voice. “Brother Yun, Zheng Nan told me something before he came. Let me tell you, the backgrounds of the six of them are not simple at all. They’re all very impressive.”
Were their backgrounds impressive? How impressive were they?
Chen Yun smiled and said, “Tell me about it.”
Wang Liang said, “The fathers of the three girls are the vice-president of a listed group, Tianhong Group, the general manager of Lu Industry, and the manager of Xing’an Real Estate respectively.”

As he spoke, Wang Liang pointed at the other two men and continued, “One of them has a large-scale farm and has already been listed. The other person’s father is a shareholder of Zhengjiang Pavilion.”
The people Wang Liang mentioned were indeed very impressive and awesome to ordinary people.
However, such people were nothing to Chen Yun. He did not take them seriously at all.
These people were probably not even comparable to Li Xiao in Yanwei. How could they catch Chen Yun’s eye?

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Reunion After Many Years
paragraphs: “Oh, they’re all pretty good.”
Wang Liang’s words were respectful. Chen Yun could not embarrass him, so he praised them.
However, Wang Liang realized that Chen Yun was very calm. His eyes were calm and he was not surprised by the backgrounds of these people at all.

Wang Liang frowned and pointed at the leader. He said to Chen Yun, “Brother Yun, this person is even more powerful. He’s the young master of the Zhang family. His name is Zhang Hong. I heard from Zheng Nan that the Zhang family’s assets have reached a billion yuan. They also have a huge family business.”

Before meeting Chen Yun, Zheng Nan greeted the young masters of the various families along the way while excitedly introducing them to Wang Liang and the others, so Wang Liang remembered some of them.
Seeing Wang Liang looking at Zhang Hong in awe, Chen Yun could not help but frown.
He changed the topic and said, “By the way, why are they gathered here today?”
“Zheng Nan said that he wants to receive a big shot,” said Wang Liang excitedly.
What kind of big shots could these guys know?
Chen Yun chuckled in his heart, but he could not show it on the surface, afraid that he would agitate Wang Liang.
Instead, he asked, “A big shot? What’s his background?”
“Zheng Nan also said it just now, Brother Yun. What kind of memory do you have? He’s a young master from a branch of the Lu family.”
Speaking of this big shot, Wang Liang seemed very excited and spoke a little louder.
Immediately, the other three men and three women looked over. Clearly, they had heard Wang Liang’s words.

Zhang Hong looked at Chen Yun with disdain in her eyes and said to Zheng Nan, “Zheng Nan, why are you telling your classmates about this? They don’t know the Lu family at all. How would they know how powerful the young master of the Lu family branch is?”
“Brother Hong is right. Although the Lu family is powerful, only the upper echelons know about it. Those people outside don’t know at all,” said a young man beside him seriously.
Was he in the upper echelons?!
This time, Chen Yun finally could not help but laugh softly.
Seeing this, Zhang Hong and the others revealed sullen expressions. One of the women said, “You’re really a country bumpkin. You’re ignorant and actually dare to look down on the Lu family.”
Another woman rolled her eyes at Chen Yun and said angrily, “Kid, do you know how powerful the Lu family is? They can destroy you with a finger.”

Zhang Hong gently knocked on the table, indicating for the others to not speak. Then, he looked at Zheng Nan and said in a low voice, “Zheng Nan, why did you bring such a person here? It’s fine if you’re ignorant, but since you’re not discerning enough, can you bear the responsibility if you offend Young Master Lu later?”
Zheng Nan and Wang Liang looked embarrassed, not knowing how to answer.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun yawned.
He could not be bothered to talk nonsense with these guys anymore. He could also avoid embarrassing Wang Liang. He immediately stood up and said, “Take your time to chat. I’ll go out for a walk.”
“Kid, you’re really arrogant. You actually don’t even take the young master of the Lu family branch seriously.”
Seeing that Chen Yun was about to leave, Zhang Hong looked at him with a cold gaze.

At this moment, a man sitting beside Zhang Hong looked at Chen Yun and said, “In that case, I might as well tell you the background of the Lu family. Don’t be frightened. The Lu family is one of the top families in Jiangnan. Their assets are close to 100 billion yuan, and their forces are spread all over Jiangnan. They are very complicated and huge. Moreover, the Lu family...”
“Oh, the Lu family is very powerful. I know.”
Before the other party could finish speaking, Chen Yun turned around and left.
Looking at Chen Yun’s figure, the atmosphere immediately became a little awkward. They were all stunned by Chen Yun’s indifferent attitude.
It was not until Chen Yun had walked far away that everyone came back to their senses.

The man who was telling Chen Yun about the Lu family’s background was interrupted by Chen Yun. He lost control of his emotions and slammed the table in anger. He said angrily, “Bastard, you actually interrupted me. You simply don’t take me seriously.”
As he spoke, the man pretended to rush forward to chase after Chen Yun.
This man was very tall and had muscles all over his body. On the contrary, Chen Yun looked very thin and even looked weak.
If they fought, in the eyes of ordinary people, Chen Yun would definitely suffer.
Zheng Nan quickly stopped the man and advised, “Brother Yu, forget it. My classmate is like this. He hasn’t seen the world. Don’t lower yourself to his level.”

As the man struggled free from Zheng Nan’s hand, he cursed, “What the hell is this? How dare he put on airs in front of us? This kid has never seen the world. Doesn’t he know that he has to keep a low profile when he’s outside? I must teach him a lesson today.”
Zheng Nan held the man’s hand tightly and sneered at Chen Yun’s figure. This poor loser was putting on airs here. He really did not know about the word ‘death’.
Brother Yu, who was in front of them, was called Wu Yu. Zheng Nan had seen him hit someone last time and simply injure their eyes.
“Wu Yu, that’s enough. Why bother arguing with a country bumpkin?”
At this moment, Zhang Hong spoke.

Clearly, Wu Yu was very respectful to Zhang Hong. When he heard Zhang Hong’s words, although he was still filled with anger, he sat back on the sofa and said gloomily, “What’s going on? I was actually ignored by a country bumpkin.”

Zhang Hong said in a deep voice, “Do you think everyone is like us, living in the upper echelons of the world? After all, most of them are ordinary people. They can just live their own lives. Naturally, they don’t care about the Lu family’s background. That brat just now will only understand when he really suffers. There are many things in this world that he can’t come into contact with.”
At this moment, Zhang Hong’s tone was very arrogant, as if he was the top figure in the world.
Unfortunately, all of this was because he thought too highly of himself.
Wu Yu was so angry that he could only flare up at Zheng Nan. He snorted coldly and said, “Zheng Nan, your classmate really has guts.”

Seeing that Wu Yu did not chase after Chen Yun and beat him up, Zheng Nan was a little disappointed. As for Wu Yu’s anger towards him, he did not take it to heart. He smiled and said, “Brother Yu, it’s not appropriate to flare up today. Just treat him as a country bumpkin who crawled out of the village. He has never seen how big the sky is. He’s ignorant and fearless.”
When Wang Liang heard Zheng Nan’s words, he glared and could not say anything. After all, he had a favor to ask.
“Let’s forget about this matter.”

Zhang Hong helped Wu Yu answer Zheng Nan’s question. Then, he changed the topic and looked at Zheng Nan. “But Zheng Nan, should I inform you about the activities of our circle in the future? I have to consider this carefully.”
“Brother Hong, don’t.”

Zheng Nan said gloomily. He cursed Chen Yun’s ancestors in his heart. He immediately regretted bringing Chen Yun here. He had originally planned to show off in front of Chen Yun, but he did not expect that his relationship with others would be ruined by Chen Yun’s words.
Zhang Hong said, “If you want to continue playing with us, fine. That depends on whether you can serve Young Master Lu well later.”
“Don’t worry, Brother Hong. Young Master Lu likes to drink. Although my alcohol tolerance isn’t good, my friend is fierce. I’ll leave the toast to him later.”
Zheng Nan quickly promised.
Everyone looked at Wang Liang. They saw that Wang Liang and Chen Yun were very close and immediately sneered in their hearts.
Zhang Hong nodded and regained his smile. He patted Zheng Nan’s shoulder and said, “We’re all good friends. If anything good happens in the future, I’ll definitely bring you along.”
Hearing Zhang Hong’s words, Zheng Nan nodded.

Meanwhile, Chen Yun walked out of the clubhouse. Then, Ma Ke called him. “Director Chen, I’ve found the person you’re looking for. I’ve sent it to your phone. If you need it, I can try my best to find out where she is now.”
“There’s no need, Ma Ke. I’ve already seen her.” Chen Yun looked at the parking lot not far away and at the beautiful figure.
At this moment, it was as if he was waiting with great anxiety.
