Wu Yu was so angry that he could only flare up at Zheng Nan.
He snorted coldly and said, “Zheng Nan, your classmate really has guts.”
Seeing that Wu Yu did not chase after Chen Yun and beat him up, Zheng Nan was a little disappointed.
As for Wu Yu’s anger towards him, he did not take it to heart.
He smiled and said, “Brother Yu, it’s not appropriate to flare up today.
Just treat him as a country bumpkin who crawled out of the village.
He has never seen how big the sky is.
He’s ignorant and fearless.”
When Wang Liang heard Zheng Nan’s words, he glared and could not say anything.
After all, he had a favor to ask.
“Let’s forget about this matter.”
Zhang Hong helped Wu Yu answer Zheng Nan’s question.
Then, he changed the topic and looked at Zheng Nan.
“But Zheng Nan, should I inform you about the activities of our circle in the future?
I have to consider this carefully.”
“Brother Hong, don’t.”
Zheng Nan said gloomily.
He cursed Chen Yun’s ancestors in his heart.
He immediately regretted bringing Chen Yun here.
He had originally planned to show off in front of Chen Yun, but he did not expect that his relationship with others would be ruined by Chen Yun’s words.
Zhang Hong said, “If you want to continue playing with us, fine.
That depends on whether you can serve Young Master Lu well later.”
“Don’t worry, Brother Hong.
Young Master Lu likes to drink.
Although my alcohol tolerance isn’t good, my friend is fierce.
I’ll leave the toast to him later.”
Zheng Nan quickly promised.
Everyone looked at Wang Liang.
They saw that Wang Liang and Chen Yun were very close and immediately sneered in their hearts.
Zhang Hong nodded and regained his smile.
He patted Zheng Nan’s shoulder and said, “We’re all good friends.
If anything good happens in the future, I’ll definitely bring you along.”
Hearing Zhang Hong’s words, Zheng Nan nodded.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun walked out of the clubhouse.
Then, Ma Ke called him.
“Director Chen, I’ve found the person you’re looking for.
I’ve sent it to your phone.
If you need it, I can try my best to find out where she is now.”
“There’s no need, Ma Ke.
I’ve already seen her.” Chen Yun looked at the parking lot not far away and at the beautiful figure.
At this moment, it was as if he was waiting with great anxiety.

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Wan’er
paragraphs: Under the tree at the entrance of the clubhouse, Chen Yun leaned against the tree and looked at the parking lot not far away.

In the parking lot, a beautiful figure was standing beside a Mercedes-Benz. She was wearing a pure white dress and light blue high heels. Her figure was slender, her long hair reached her waist, her eyes were bright, and her lips were like peaches and plums. Her skin was like ice and jade. She was so beautiful that she did not belong to the mortal world.
Although he had not seen her for a few years, that face, those eyes, that...
Just like before, even in the crowd, Chen Yun could recognize her at a glance.

At this moment, Lin Wan’er was standing beside the Mercedes-Benz. Beside her, a Maserati slowly stopped. Then, a woman in her thirties got out of the car. Lin Wan’er welcomed her. The two of them chatted as they walked towards Zhengjiang Pavilion.
When Chen Yun saw this situation, the corners of his mouth curled up into a smile. Then, he turned around and walked back.
“Sister Liu, please.” Lin Wan’er had a fake smile on her face as she led the woman beside her towards Zhengjiang Pavilion.

“Wan’er, you don’t have to be so polite to me. You’re a rising star of the Lin family. Sister Liu might have to rely on you in the future.” The woman smiled. Lin Wan’er waved her hand. “Sister Liu, don’t laugh at me.”
Lin Wan’er humbly spoke and couldn’t help but look away. In the next moment, she was stunned as she looked into the distance. That walking posture and back view were so familiar.
For a moment, a figure appeared in her mind, causing her eyes to suddenly turn red.

“Wan’er? What’s wrong? Who did you see?” Seeing that Lin Wan’er was not moving, Sister Liu came over and asked. Lin Wan’er immediately coughed and secretly wiped the corners of her eyes. Then, she smiled widely. “Sister Liu, no one. It’s just that the sand blinded my eyes just now.”
Lin Wan’er looked back three times with every step until she walked into the Zhengjiang Pavilion.
At this moment, in the Nanchen Clubhouse, Zheng Nan looked at the man wearing Bluetooth earpieces and a suit that could not hide his bulging muscles. His eyes were filled with confusion.
“Brother Hong, are these all the staff of this clubhouse? Why do they all look like...”
Although he did not finish his sentence, everyone understood.

Zhang Hong glanced at the burly men and said, “What’s so strange about that? The Lu family doesn’t lack such people at all. I heard that the old master of the Lu family was born during the war. Although he has passed away, this tradition has been well preserved in the Lu family. The young masters of the Lu family have to go to the military to train for a few years.”

“It’s rumored that Young Master Lu has been practicing his martial arts since he was young. When he arrived at the military, he even trained his spearmanship diligently. Now, the bodyguards on the market who earn millions a year might not be able to withstand Young Master Lu.”
When Zheng Nan heard this, he gasped and said, “Young Master Lu? Are you talking about the Young Master Lu who you’re going to introduce to us later?”

Zhang Hong said, “No, this is the eldest young master of the Lu family, Lu Jun. He’s going to become the head of the Lu family in the future. Although the young master Lu Jie from the Lu family branch that we’re going to meet later is already very powerful, compared to him, there’s a world of difference. A person like Lu Jun is not someone we can come into contact with.”
At this moment, a man in a suit walked towards them.

When Zhang Hong saw this person, he quickly stood up to welcome him. At the same time, he turned around and looked at Zheng Nan and the others. Then, he said in a low voice, “Young Master Lu is here.”
Zheng Nan’s eyes lit up. How could he care about Lu Jun? This was an opportunity to befriend a big shot of the Lu family.
Even Wang Liang stood up. After all, whether he won an award or not was closely related to this person.
“Young Master Lu, come, sit here.”
Zhang Hong went forward. The arrogance on his face was gone. Instead, it turned into respect.

However, Lu Jie waved his hand and quickly walked to the top seat to sit down. He said to Zhang Hong, “In this place, don’t call me Young Master Lu. If someone with ulterior motives hears us, won’t we become a joke? Since everyone here is your good friend, Xiao Hong, you can call me Brother Jie.”

The Nanchen Clubhouse was considered the territory of the Lu family’s young master, Lu Jun. Lu Jie was a member of the Lu family branch, so he naturally did not dare to call himself a young master here.
“Sure, Brother Jie.”
Zhang Hong called out. Then, he turned to the others and said, “Let me introduce you to the young master of the Lu family, Lu Jie.”
“Brother Jie.”
“Brother Jie.”
Immediately, the men and women greeted him respectfully. Lu Jie enjoyed it very much. He had an arrogant expression on his face as he smiled and nodded at them.
Zhang Hong glanced at Wang Liang and said in a low voice, “Don’t just stand there. Hurry up and toast.”
For a moment, the entire table was filled with toasts.

Chen Yun entered the Nanchen Clubhouse and entered the leisure area. He ate desserts and drank coffee as he recalled the beautiful figure just now. It seemed that Wan’er was developing well. If it were the previous Chen Yun, he would probably still avoid her and not dare to approach her. However, now that he had already crossed Jiang City and was famous in Jiangbei, there was naturally no need for him to do that.

The coffee entered his throat. Although it was not as good as wine, it still made Chen Yun sigh with emotion. The past reverberated in his mind one by one. Although the happy times in the past were good in the past, Chen Yun preferred his current life. He had greater ambitions and wanted to pursue a better future.
After a long time, Chen Yun could not be bothered to stay in the clubhouse anymore. He stood up and walked out of the lounge area, looking in the direction of Wang Liang.
Other than those people just now, there was also a man in a suit where Wang Liang was.
This man in a suit had replaced Zhang Hong and became the leader of that table. Everyone surrounded him like stars surrounding the moon.
The three girls from wealthy families, who had been a little reserved previously, also approached him. One of the girls even stuck to him and moved her body from time to time to rub against his arm.
Actually, Chen Yun did not pay attention to these things, nor was he interested in going over to steal the limelight from this young master of the Lu family branch.
However, when he saw Wang Liang sitting there with a drunk and slightly pale face, he could not help but frown.
He looked at Wang Liang again. There were wine bottles on the table and by his feet. It was obvious that he had drunk a lot and his body could not take it anymore.
When he saw this, his gaze instantly changed and revealed a coldness.
If the others drank like Wang Liang, Chen Yun would naturally ignore them.
However, the other young men’s faces were slightly red and they were chatting and laughing calmly. There was even a smile on their faces, forming a sharp contrast with Wang Liang’s condition.
Clearly, the other seven people did not drink much. Wang Liang had been tricked by them.
Chen Yun’s eyes were cold as he walked towards them.
From afar, he heard Zhang Hong shout, “Wang Liang, what’s wrong? Didn’t you want to make friends with Brother Jie? Show your sincerity and toast Brother Jie a few more times.”
“Burp.”
Wang Liang burped. Although his mind was no longer clear, he still grabbed the wine glass on the table.
Lu Jie glanced at Wang Liang with a teasing smile on his face and said, “Zhang Hong, your friend Wang Liang is interesting.”

Zheng Nan also smiled and said, “Brother Jie, to be honest, this kid wants to rely on you to help him win an award for some technology competition. It’s really ridiculous. How can a big shot like you do such a small thing for him? The reason why I asked him to come today is to make you happy.”
“Zheng Nan, you did a good job today.” Zhang Hong also laughed loudly. The young men beside him also smiled. They could tell that Lu Jie was very happy.
Lu Jie looked at the drunk Wang Liang and smiled at the others. “Hehe, we’re out to play. Without a clown to liven up the atmosphere, it’s indeed a little monotonous.”
Wu Yu said, “Brother Jie, not only is this kid a fool, but he also brought a country bumpkin friend today. He’s also a fool.”

Lu Jie smiled and said, “Oh, in that case, let his friend come over and liven up the atmosphere for us. After all, I think Wang Liang, this clown, is about to fall drunk. Someone has to take over his job.”

Wu Yu had been ignored by Chen Yun just now. He had the intention to sow discord between Lu Jie and Chen Yun, so he said, “Brother Jie, Wang Liang’s friend is called Chen Yun. He’s a little arrogant. He was originally sitting with us, but when he heard that you were coming, he left. Before he left, he even looked arrogant, as if he looked down on the Lu family.”

Zhang Hong chimed in from the side. “That’s right. When we were introducing the Lu family, this kid looked indignant. He even stood up. Before he left, he even said to us, ‘I understand. The Lu family is very impressive.’”
“Look at his attitude.”
When Lu Jie heard this, he knew that Wu Yu was instigating him, but he did not expose him. After all, he was just dealing with a small fry. He did not take it seriously.
Moreover, the feeling of making a self-righteous person bow down in front of him was quite good.

He said to Wu Yu, “In that case, when that person comes later, let me see how arrogant he is. Hehe, he doesn’t even care about the Lu family. In the entire Jiangnan, is there a family that he cares about?!”

Wu Yu sought favor with him and said, “Brother Jie, if that kid sees you, the young master of the Lu family, no matter how much he shows off, he’ll probably pee his pants in fear. Moreover, if he doesn’t pee his pants in fear, Brother Jie, you have so many bodyguards here. Any one of them can beat him until he pees his pants. At that time, let’s see if he’s still arrogant.”
“Hahaha, that’s true. The Lu family’s reputation is not just for show.”
Lu Jie spoke proudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: You’ll Disappear Within Three Days!
paragraphs: At this moment, Wang Liang held a full glass of beer and stood up to raise his glass. He said with a tongue-tied voice, “Brother... Brother Jie, it’s my honor to meet you today. I hope... Burp, I hope you can take care of me in the future so that I can win an award at the technology competition organized by the Lu family. I know that this... is all up to you.”
Lu Jie, Zhang Hong, and the others looked at Wang Liang with mocking expressions, as if they were looking at a fool.

The three women even mocked him. “Wang Liang, since you performed so well, Brother Jie will definitely take care of you in the future. He can give you any award. If he is going to give an award, he’ll give you the first place!”
“However, if you want Brother Jie to take care of you, you’re not sincere enough. How can you drink a glass of wine? It’s only sincere enough to take a bottle of beer.”
As she spoke, a girl picked up the entire bottle of beer and stuffed it into Wang Liang’s hand. Then, she snatched his glass away and teased, “Come, drink directly from the bottle.”
If it was just the beginning, a bottle of beer would not be a big deal.
However, in Wang Liang’s current state, he would probably collapse after drinking a bottle of beer.
Even though Wang Liang’s senses were already blurry, he still hesitated when he looked at the beer.

Seeing this, Lu Jie said with a straight face, “Wang Liang, what’s wrong? Are you unwilling to drink? You’re not giving me face and not taking the Lu family seriously. Then about this award, I think...”
Although he did not finish his sentence, it was self-evident.
Zhang Hong mocked, “Wang Liang, whether you can make friends with Brother Jie depends on this bottle of wine of yours.
“Alright, Brother Jie. Come, let me toast you.”
Wang Liang gritted his teeth, picked up the beer bottle, and placed it in his mouth. He closed his eyes tightly and planned to finish the beer in one gulp.
However, just as he raised the beer bottle, a hand reached out and snatched it away.
Wang Liang turned around and saw Chen Yun.
“Brother Yun.”
Wang Liang shouted reflexively.
“Kid, what are you doing? What do you mean?”
Lu Jie did not know Chen Yun. Seeing Chen Yun snatch Wang Liang’s wine bottle, he shouted angrily.
Zhang Hong’s expression darkened. “Brother Jie, this person is Chen Yun, Wang Liang’s country bumpkin friend.”
“Oh, so the other clown you’re talking about is him. It seems that he’s quite tactful. He knew that this clown, Wang Liang, was about to die of alcohol, so he came over to take over.”
Lu Jie sneered and looked at Chen Yun mockingly.
Wu Yu glared at Chen Yun and shouted, “Kid, why aren’t you coming over to pay your respects to Brother Jie? Brother Jie is the young master of the Lu family. It’s your fortune to see him.”
Lu Jie looked at Chen Yun and smiled. “Are you a little frightened to know my identity? Hahaha! I heard that you looked down on the Lu family previously. Let me see how impressive you are.”
A descendant of the Lu family branch actually dared to be so arrogant to Chen Yun. He was simply courting death.
Even the eldest young master of the Lu family would not dare to treat Chen Yun like this, let alone Lu Jie.
Chen Yun glanced at the people present and ignored them. He helped Wang Liang, who was staggering, sit down on the sofa.

Wang Liang looked up at Chen Yun and frowned. He retched and said in a low voice, “Brother Yun, I can’t drink anymore. However, our team can’t be kicked out by the unspoken rules. That’s our hard work for the past few months. I still have to drink.”
Hearing Wang Liang’s words, Chen Yun was touched.
“Don’t worry. The alcohol has to be drunk, but you won’t be the one drinking it.”
Chen Yun patted Wang Liang’s shoulder and smiled. “Leave the rest to me. I’ll get them to toast you.”
Was Chen Yun going to get them to toast him?
Wang Liang was stunned for a moment, not understanding what Chen Yun meant.
There was a young master from the Lu family branch here. How was it possible for them to toast him?
Under Wang Liang’s puzzled gaze, Chen Yun walked in front of everyone.
Chen Yun’s actions stunned everyone present. Then, they angered Lu Jie and the others.

Zhang Hong’s expression turned cold as he said in a low voice, “Chen Yun, what do you mean? Are you angry? Hmph, even if you’re angry, you have to hold it in. Do you dare to shout in front of Brother Jie?”
Wu Yu had always disliked Chen Yun. He stood up and pointed at Chen Yun. “Kid, Brother Jie is the young master of the Lu family. If you anger him, he can kill you ten times with a finger.”
Hearing these two people’s words, Chen Yun looked up and glanced at the people present.
Chen Yun did not say anything and picked up a bottle of foreign wine from the table.

When Lu Jie saw Chen Yun’s actions, he knew that Chen Yun had ill intentions. However, he did not take Chen Yun seriously at all. He sneered and said, “Your name is Chen Yun, right? Interesting. Why are you taking the wine? Are you planning to drink it yourself?”
Zhang Hong said, “Chen Yun, you’d better restrain your temper. If you’re arrogant in front of Brother Jie, you’ll die a tragic death.”

Chen Yun turned around and looked at Wang Liang. Then, his gaze landed on Lu Jie. He said calmly, “Give Wang Liang a toast now and finish it in one gulp. I’ll pretend that nothing happened. Otherwise, I’ll continue to play with you slowly.”
“It’s the same for the few of you.” Chen Yun also swept his gaze across the men and women around him, his eyes extremely cold.
An ordinary person’s alcohol tolerance was only four to five drinks. It was almost impossible to finish the one liter of foreign wine on the table, let alone finish it in one gulp.
If they really drank it all in one gulp, even if they didn’t die, they would lose half of their lives.
Lu Jie looked at the wine bottle on the table and looked up at Chen Yun. His gaze was very cold as he said, “Kid, do you know what you’re doing?”
Chen Yun acted as if he did not hear Lu Jie’s words. He pointed at the wine and smiled faintly. “Either you drink it yourself, or I’ll let you drink it. Choose.”
The people present were stunned. They did not expect Chen Yun to be so domineering that he ignored Lu Jie. Everyone’s expressions turned cold.

After all, Lu Jie was invited by Zhang Hong. He could not let Lu Jie be embarrassed. He threatened Chen Yun, “Chen Yun, you have to understand that the people sitting in front of you now are all big shots from Jiangnan, especially Brother Jie, the young master of the Lu family branch. Think carefully. If you offend us, you will definitely suffer a very miserable outcome.”
“It seems that you want me to force you to drink it.”
Instantly, everyone looked at Chen Yun.
Wu Yu was usually very arrogant. Now that he saw Chen Yun being so domineering, he was immediately furious. He stood up and was about to attack Chen Yun.
However, when he looked at Chen Yun’s cold gaze, his heart could not help but tremble and he lost his confidence.
Chen Yun gave him the feeling that Chen Yun was a bloodthirsty ferocious beast that could take his life at any time.
What kind of gaze was that? It made him tremble with fear just by looking at it.
He swallowed his saliva and wanted to divert his attention. He said to Lu Jie, “Brother Jie, this kid is so arrogant. He doesn’t take you seriously at all. He doesn’t take the Lu family seriously.”
Lu Jie’s expression became uglier and uglier. Although he was only the young master of the Lu family branch, everyone treated him respectfully.
Today, he met a hothead. After knowing his identity, not only did he not give him respect, but he even forced him to drink. This was simply a blatant slap to his face.
At the same time, it was also a slap to the Lu family’s face.

Therefore, Lu Jie was full of confidence. No matter what the other party’s identity was, no matter how big the matter was, it involved the dignity of the Lu family. With the Lu family backing him, he was not afraid of anyone.

After figuring this out, Lu Jie looked at Chen Yun calmly and said, “Chen Yun, we won’t drink the alcohol. As for you, you offended me and dare to underestimate the Lu family. I guarantee that you will disappear from the world within three days.”

sentences.text: At this moment, Wang Liang held a full glass of beer and stood up to raise his glass.
He said with a tongue-tied voice, “Brother...
Brother Jie, it’s my honor to meet you today.
I hope...
Burp, I hope you can take care of me in the future so that I can win an award at the technology competition organized by the Lu family.
I know that this... is all up to you.”
Lu Jie, Zhang Hong, and the others looked at Wang Liang with mocking expressions, as if they were looking at a fool.
The three women even mocked him.
“Wang Liang, since you performed so well, Brother Jie will definitely take care of you in the future.
He can give you any award.
If he is going to give an award, he’ll give you the first place!”
“However, if you want Brother Jie to take care of you, you’re not sincere enough.
How can you drink a glass of wine?
It’s only sincere enough to take a bottle of beer.”
As she spoke, a girl picked up the entire bottle of beer and stuffed it into Wang Liang’s hand.
Then, she snatched his glass away and teased, “Come, drink directly from the bottle.”
If it was just the beginning, a bottle of beer would not be a big deal.
However, in Wang Liang’s current state, he would probably collapse after drinking a bottle of beer.
Even though Wang Liang’s senses were already blurry, he still hesitated when he looked at the beer.
Seeing this, Lu Jie said with a straight face, “Wang Liang, what’s wrong?
Are you unwilling to drink?
You’re not giving me face and not taking the Lu family seriously.
Then about this award, I think...”
Although he did not finish his sentence, it was self-evident.
Zhang Hong mocked, “Wang Liang, whether you can make friends with Brother Jie depends on this bottle of wine of yours.
“Alright, Brother Jie.
Come, let me toast you.”
Wang Liang gritted his teeth, picked up the beer bottle, and placed it in his mouth.
He closed his eyes tightly and planned to finish the beer in one gulp.
However, just as he raised the beer bottle, a hand reached out and snatched it away.
Wang Liang turned around and saw Chen Yun.
“Brother Yun.”
Wang Liang shouted reflexively.
“Kid, what are you doing?
What do you mean?”
Lu Jie did not know Chen Yun.
Seeing Chen Yun snatch Wang Liang’s wine bottle, he shouted angrily.
Zhang Hong’s expression darkened.
“Brother Jie, this person is Chen Yun, Wang Liang’s country bumpkin friend.”
“Oh, so the other clown you’re talking about is him.
It seems that he’s quite tactful.
He knew that this clown, Wang Liang, was about to die of alcohol, so he came over to take over.”
Lu Jie sneered and looked at Chen Yun mockingly.
Wu Yu glared at Chen Yun and shouted, “Kid, why aren’t you coming over to pay your respects to Brother Jie?
Brother Jie is the young master of the Lu family.
It’s your fortune to see him.”
Lu Jie looked at Chen Yun and smiled.
“Are you a little frightened to know my identity?
Hahaha!
I heard that you looked down on the Lu family previously.
Let me see how impressive you are.”
A descendant of the Lu family branch actually dared to be so arrogant to Chen Yun.
He was simply courting death.
Even the eldest young master of the Lu family would not dare to treat Chen Yun like this, let alone Lu Jie.
Chen Yun glanced at the people present and ignored them.
He helped Wang Liang, who was staggering, sit down on the sofa.
Wang Liang looked up at Chen Yun and frowned.
He retched and said in a low voice, “Brother Yun, I can’t drink anymore.
However, our team can’t be kicked out by the unspoken rules.
That’s our hard work for the past few months.
I still have to drink.”
Hearing Wang Liang’s words, Chen Yun was touched.
“Don’t worry.
The alcohol has to be drunk, but you won’t be the one drinking it.”
Chen Yun patted Wang Liang’s shoulder and smiled.
“Leave the rest to me.
I’ll get them to toast you.”
Was Chen Yun going to get them to toast him?
Wang Liang was stunned for a moment, not understanding what Chen Yun meant.
There was a young master from the Lu family branch here.
How was it possible for them to toast him?
Under Wang Liang’s puzzled gaze, Chen Yun walked in front of everyone.
Chen Yun’s actions stunned everyone present.
Then, they angered Lu Jie and the others.
Zhang Hong’s expression turned cold as he said in a low voice, “Chen Yun, what do you mean?
Are you angry?
Hmph, even if you’re angry, you have to hold it in.
Do you dare to shout in front of Brother Jie?”
Wu Yu had always disliked Chen Yun.
He stood up and pointed at Chen Yun.
“Kid, Brother Jie is the young master of the Lu family.
If you anger him, he can kill you ten times with a finger.”
Hearing these two people’s words, Chen Yun looked up and glanced at the people present.
Chen Yun did not say anything and picked up a bottle of foreign wine from the table.
When Lu Jie saw Chen Yun’s actions, he knew that Chen Yun had ill intentions.
However, he did not take Chen Yun seriously at all.
He sneered and said, “Your name is Chen Yun, right?
Interesting.
Why are you taking the wine?
Are you planning to drink it yourself?”
Zhang Hong said, “Chen Yun, you’d better restrain your temper.
If you’re arrogant in front of Brother Jie, you’ll die a tragic death.”
Chen Yun turned around and looked at Wang Liang.
Then, his gaze landed on Lu Jie.
He said calmly, “Give Wang Liang a toast now and finish it in one gulp.
I’ll pretend that nothing happened.
Otherwise, I’ll continue to play with you slowly.”
“It’s the same for the few of you.” Chen Yun also swept his gaze across the men and women around him, his eyes extremely cold.
An ordinary person’s alcohol tolerance was only four to five drinks.
It was almost impossible to finish the one liter of foreign wine on the table, let alone finish it in one gulp.
If they really drank it all in one gulp, even if they didn’t die, they would lose half of their lives.
Lu Jie looked at the wine bottle on the table and looked up at Chen Yun.
His gaze was very cold as he said, “Kid, do you know what you’re doing?”
Chen Yun acted as if he did not hear Lu Jie’s words.
He pointed at the wine and smiled faintly.
“Either you drink it yourself, or I’ll let you drink it.
Choose.”
The people present were stunned.
They did not expect Chen Yun to be so domineering that he ignored Lu Jie.
Everyone’s expressions turned cold.
After all, Lu Jie was invited by Zhang Hong.
He could not let Lu Jie be embarrassed.

He threatened Chen Yun, “Chen Yun, you have to understand that the people sitting in front of you now are all big shots from Jiangnan, especially Brother Jie, the young master of the Lu family branch.
Think carefully.
If you offend us, you will definitely suffer a very miserable outcome.”
“It seems that you want me to force you to drink it.”
Instantly, everyone looked at Chen Yun.
Wu Yu was usually very arrogant.
Now that he saw Chen Yun being so domineering, he was immediately furious.
He stood up and was about to attack Chen Yun.
However, when he looked at Chen Yun’s cold gaze, his heart could not help but tremble and he lost his confidence.
Chen Yun gave him the feeling that Chen Yun was a bloodthirsty ferocious beast that could take his life at any time.
What kind of gaze was that?
It made him tremble with fear just by looking at it.
He swallowed his saliva and wanted to divert his attention.
He said to Lu Jie, “Brother Jie, this kid is so arrogant.
He doesn’t take you seriously at all.
He doesn’t take the Lu family seriously.”
Lu Jie’s expression became uglier and uglier.
Although he was only the young master of the Lu family branch, everyone treated him respectfully.
Today, he met a hothead.
After knowing his identity, not only did he not give him respect, but he even forced him to drink.
This was simply a blatant slap to his face.
At the same time, it was also a slap to the Lu family’s face.
Therefore, Lu Jie was full of confidence.
No matter what the other party’s identity was, no matter how big the matter was, it involved the dignity of the Lu family.
With the Lu family backing him, he was not afraid of anyone.
After figuring this out, Lu Jie looked at Chen Yun calmly and said, “Chen Yun, we won’t drink the alcohol.
As for you, you offended me and dare to underestimate the Lu family.
I guarantee that you will disappear from the world within three days.”

chapters.title: Chapter 194: It Takes a Thousand Days to Nurture an Army
paragraphs: “I guarantee that you will disappear from this world within three days!”
Chen Yun turned to Lu Jie and nodded. “The last person who told me this is already dead.”
“I don’t believe that you dare to do anything to me. Let me tell you, I’m from the Lu family!”
Lu Jie slammed the table and stood up. He stared at Chen Yun with a stern gaze and spoke firmly, looking very impressive.
When the others saw this, they knew that Chen Yun had completely angered Lu Jie, so they stopped talking and only looked at Chen Yun mockingly.
In their eyes, Chen Yun was already a dead person.
“Guards!”
At that moment, Lu Jie shouted. A few burly men beside him hurriedly ran over. When they saw Lu Jie, they immediately recognized him. “Young Master Lu.”
“Drag this kid away and break his legs!”
This...
At that moment, a burly man looked at Lu Jie. “Young Master Lu, we listen to Young Master Lu Jun.”
For a moment, Lu Jie’s eyes widened. “Are my words useless?!”
Beside him, Wu Yu also sneered. “What kind of security guards are you? You don’t even dare to touch a country bumpkin. He looked down on the Lu family’s dignity. What are you waiting for?”
Zhang Hong also sneered. “That’s right. If you don’t touch him today and word gets out, Young Master Lu Jun will lose all his pride!”
When a security guard heard their words, he looked at Chen Yun and weighed his options.
Then, he glared at Chen Yun and said angrily, “Men, attack!”
As soon as he finished speaking, two of the dozen or so security guards surrounding Chen Yun walked out.
In the eyes of these security guards, Chen Yun was thin and weak. It was completely enough for the two of them to deal with him. It was even a little unnecessary.
“Kid, be good and don’t move. We’ll be gentler. According to the rules of the Nanchen Clubhouse, we’ll break one of your legs and you can leave.”
The security guard pulled out his truncheon from his waist, his face filled with ferocity.
The other security guard pounced on Chen Yun, planning to control him and break his legs.
Chen Yun snorted in his heart. His figure moved and he took the initiative to charge at the other party.
The burly man in the lead said angrily, “Good fellow, how dare you resist!”
“You don’t know what’s good for you. Do you think you can defeat us?”
The security guard who pounced on Chen Yun revealed a disdainful expression. He raised his right fist and smashed it down on Chen Yun’s face.

However, just as his fist was about to touch Chen Yun, Chen Yun’s figure moved and he happened to dodge the security guard’s fist. Then, Chen Yun’s shoulder sank and collided with the security guard’s chest.
With a crack, the other party’s sternum was broken by Chen Yun and he fell out. He was supported by the security guards behind him before he stopped.
However, his sternum was broken and he had lost his combat strength.
“Be careful. This kid is a martial artist.”
The security guards immediately revealed vigilant expressions and did not dare to underestimate Chen Yun.
Of course, there were more than ten of them in total, and they were all experts from the military. They did not think that Chen Yun could resist them alone.
However, just as they reacted, Chen Yun had already rushed into the crowd.
Bang, bang, bang. Chen Yun punched them one by one. No one could dodge, and no one could stand up after being hit.
Chen Yun was like a gust of wind as he swept past the group of security guards. When he stopped, more than ten security guards were already lying on the ground.
However, none of the security guards’ attacks hit him.
It was as if he had eyes on his back. He could always dodge the sneak attack behind him when he attacked.
After the security guards were all on the ground, they realized how stupid they were for thinking that Chen Yun could not compete with them.
This was because Chen Yun was not resisting, but crushing them.
These security guards were not ordinary people. When more than ten of them joined forces, their combat strength was definitely extraordinary.
However, these dozen or so people were unable to withstand a single blow from Chen Yun.
When the security guards attacked, Lu Jie and the others behind had teasing smiles on their faces. In their eyes, Chen Yun could no longer escape the fate of having his legs broken.
“This kid is simply too arrogant. We’re already letting him off easy by breaking one of his legs...”

Lu Jie looked at Chen Yun’s aura, which seemed to be in control of everything. He was so angry that his lungs were about to explode. He had never seen anyone dare to treat him like this when he came out to play.
At that moment, he could not help but curse.
Beside him, Zhang Hong also said in a low voice, “Brother Jie, don’t be angry. This kid is just an idiot who hasn’t seen the world. If we argue with him, it will only lower our status.”
“Now you let these security guards break his legs. How can he escape?”
Upon hearing this, Lu Jie looked proud, but his heart was beating like a drum.
The Nanchen Clubhouse was indeed the Lu family’s business, but it didn’t belong to Lu Jie. It belonged to Lu Jun.

Moreover, the rules of the Nanchen Clubhouse were very strict. Security guards could not attack customers. He could get the security guards here to deal with Chen Yun, but if Lu Jun found out about this, Lu Jie would be in trouble.
However, at this moment, in front of Zhang Hong and the others, Lu Jie could not lower his prestige.
However, as Chen Yun knocked down the security guards one by one, the expressions on everyone’s faces gradually froze and their smiles gradually disappeared. What kind of f*cking person was this?!
There were so many security guards, but none of them could withstand two moves from him!
The most shocked person was definitely Lu Jie, because as a member of the Lu family, he knew better than others how powerful the security here was.
Zhang Hong frowned and said, “Brother Jie, what’s going on? Did these security guards not use their full strength?”
At that moment, the lobby manager looked at the situation here and panicked. He quickly called Lu Jun.
“Young Master Lu, bad news. People from the Nanchen Clubhouse are causing trouble. The security guards have been beaten up.”

At this moment, Lu Jun was inviting guests from other provinces to a banquet in Zhengjiang Pavilion. When he heard this, he immediately frowned. “Someone beat up the security guards? Who’s so fierce that they can’t deal with him alone? Then find a few more people to deal with him. How do you work?!”
“It’s said that it takes a thousand days to nurture an army. I’ve raised you for so long, but you still have to call me for such a small matter!”

Hearing Lu Jun’s reprimand, the lobby manager’s face darkened. “Young Master Lu, you don’t know the situation here. It’s not that one bodyguard can’t beat that person. Instead, all the bodyguards went up, but none of them even survived a single move from the other party. I suspect that this person is here to destroy your place. Come over quickly.”

Upon hearing the lobby manager’s words, no matter how gentle and refined Lu Jun was, he could not hold it in anymore. Anyone would get angry over this, let alone if someone was actually ruining his place!
At that moment, he stood up. “Wait for me. I want to see who this Holy One is. He didn’t even give me respect! He even deliberately came to destroy my place!”
He had to get back at them. Otherwise, the Lu family would simply not be able to survive here!

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Brother Yun!
paragraphs: Seeing that Chen Yun was so good at fighting, despair rose in everyone’s hearts.
“Brother Jie, what should we do?”
Zhang Hong, Wu Yu, and the others looked at Lu Jie. Lu Jie was their only hope now.
Of course, they could also slip away now.
However, if they slipped away today, they would not be able to survive in Jiangnan in the future. The other second-generation heirs would look down on them.
A girl had a long face and said timidly, “Why don’t we slip away? If I drink that wine, I’ll definitely die.”
Wu Yu said angrily, “No, if we leave, how can we raise our heads in the future?”
“Then what should we do? Why don’t we beg Zheng Nan to help us plead? Chen Yun is his friend. If he pleads, this kid should listen, right?”
Someone suggested. Everyone looked at Zheng Nan, making Zheng Nan, who was still a little confused, feel helpless.

At that moment, he was about to cry. He was not close to Chen Yun. Moreover, he had pulled Chen Yun over to show off. Now, he had even offended Wang Liang. With Chen Yun and Wang Liang’s relationship, it would be strange if he did not get slapped far away when he spoke now!
Zhang Hong slammed the table and said coldly, “Go beg that kid. We won’t have the face to survive in Jiangnan in the future.”
“You asked us to come. What do you think we should do about this?”
One of the girls snapped.
What should he do?
Zhang Hong was already dumbfounded. How could he know what to do?
He could only look at Lu Jie and say in a low voice, “Brother Jie, since things have turned out like this, it’s better for you to make the decision.”
While the others were arguing, Lu Jie had already thought of a countermeasure. That was to contact Lu Jun and let him settle the matters here.
With Lu Jun, the eldest young master of the Lu family, stepping forward, he did not believe that Chen Yun would dare to act recklessly.
“Looks like I can only contact Brother Jun.”
As Lu Jie spoke, he took out his phone.
Brother Jun? Which Brother Jun? Of course, it was Lu Jun.
When the others heard Lu Jie’s words, they looked excited, as if they had seen hope.
In their opinion, as the eldest young master of the Lu family, could Lu Jun not deal with Chen Yun?
Zhang Hong relaxed and clenched his fists. He looked at Chen Yun and said coldly, “Hmph, when Lu Jun comes later, let’s see if you still dare to attack.”
Lu Jie called Lu Jun. Everyone looked at him and he said, “Brother Jun...”
“I’m very busy now. If there’s anything, contact me tomorrow.”
Beep, beep, beep...
Lu Jie had just called out “Brother Jun” when Lu Jun hung up the phone after saying a few words. His face instantly turned green.
At such a critical moment, he actually said that he was very busy!
If not for the fact that he had the same ancestor as Lu Jun, Lu Jie would have really cursed Lu Jun’s ancestor.
“How’s it going, Brother Jie?”
Everyone asked.
Lu Jun had a bitter expression on his face. His hand that was holding the phone was trembling as he said, “Brother Jun said... he has something on and can’t come.”
Upon hearing this, everyone’s hearts that had just relaxed immediately hung in their throats, and their faces turned green.
Wu Yu could not help but curse, “F*ck, what should we do then?”
“I think we should leave quickly,” said a girl.
Although everyone was unwilling to embarrass themselves here, they were even more unwilling to lose their lives. After hesitating for a moment, they nodded in agreement with the girl.
However, just as everyone was about to sneak away, Lu Jie suddenly pointed at the entrance of the clubhouse. His face was filled with surprise as he said excitedly, “Brother... Brother Jun is here.”
The others looked in the direction he was pointing at. When they saw a noble young man appear, their eyes lit up.
Zhang Hong was puzzled. “How can that be? Brother Jie, didn’t you say that he’s not free?”

“He said that he’s very busy and definitely has to deal with the clubhouse’s matters. Hmph, Chen Yun hit the clubhouse’s security guards and smashed so many things. Brother Jun will definitely not let him off easily.”
Lu Jie had a sinister smile on his face as he said, “Now, let’s wait for a good show.”
When everyone saw Lu Jun appear, they were really relieved. They looked at Chen Yun mockingly.
Didn’t he want to play? Then go play with Lu Jun. They would see who was impressive.
“Who’s so arrogant? How dare they cause trouble in Young Master Lu’s clubhouse and injure the security guards? They’re simply courting death.”
The people in the clubhouse looked at Chen Yun, who was not breathing heavily. Before they could recover, a sudden shout came from the entrance of the clubhouse.
Right on the heels of that was a voice. “What’s going on?!”
“Young Master Lu, you’re finally here.”
The lobby manager appeared out of nowhere and walked towards the entrance of the clubhouse.
A young man in a navy blue suit walked into the clubhouse under the protection of three or four burly men in black.
This person had a delicate appearance and a calm and steady gaze. He was the eldest young master of the Lu family, Lu Jun.
Seeing Lu Jun appear, Chen Yun looked over and said, “Why? I was the one who hit them. What do you want?”
“Why? I was the one who hit them. What do you want?”
Chen Yun’s words immediately caused a huge commotion in the clubhouse.
Almost all the regulars of Nanchen Clubhouse had seen Lu Jun before and knew that he was the eldest young master of the Lu family.

At this moment, Lu Jun had personally appeared. Everyone thought that Chen Yun wanted to take a step back, but they did not expect Chen Yun to actually dare to be so arrogant. He even went against Lu Jun in public. He was simply courting death.
No matter how good he was at fighting, could he defeat the entire Lu family?
When Lu Jie saw this, he sneered and said, “This kid actually dared to talk back to Brother Jun. Looks like he’s dead meat today.”
Zhang Hong smiled and said, “This kid even wanted to force us to drink just now. He’s quite awesome. However, in my opinion, he’s about to become a fool.”
Zheng Nan, who was at the side, also sneered. So what if he could fight? How could Lu Jun not pursue this matter?
Moreover, he actually went against Lu Jun in public. How could he leave?
Just wait for death!
At this moment, everyone thought that Chen Yun was going to suffer.
Lu Jun, who had just walked into the clubhouse, was furious when he heard Chen Yun’s voice. In Jiangnan, no one dared to be so arrogant to him, the young master of the Lu family.
He was different from a young master of the family branch like Lu Jie. He was the future heir of the Lu family. In other words, he represented the Lu family.
If the other party went against him, it meant that he ignored the Lu family.
This was intolerable.
Lu Jun’s heart was burning with anger. He followed the voice just now and suddenly turned his head to look. He wanted to see which ignorant fellow was so arrogant.
However, when he saw that face, his expression immediately changed.
How could it be him?!
Lu Jun’s heart skipped a beat as he hurriedly walked towards Chen Yun.
When the security guards beside him saw this, they also moved with him. They were aggressive and looked like he wanted to take Chen Yun down for questioning.
When the others saw this, they also thought that Chen Yun was dead for sure.
They watched as Lu Jun walked up to Chen Yun in three steps and his body paused. His face immediately became awkward. Then, he said to Chen Yun in awe, “Brother Yun.”

“Brother Jie, what should we do?”
Zhang Hong, Wu Yu, and the others looked at Lu Jie.
Lu Jie was their only hope now.
Of course, they could also slip away now.
However, if they slipped away today, they would not be able to survive in Jiangnan in the future.
The other second-generation heirs would look down on them.
A girl had a long face and said timidly, “Why don’t we slip away?
If I drink that wine, I’ll definitely die.”
Wu Yu said angrily, “No, if we leave, how can we raise our heads in the future?”
“Then what should we do?
Why don’t we beg Zheng Nan to help us plead?
Chen Yun is his friend.
If he pleads, this kid should listen, right?”
Someone suggested.

Moreover, he had pulled Chen Yun over to show off.
Now, he had even offended Wang Liang.
With Chen Yun and Wang Liang’s relationship, it would be strange if he did not get slapped far away when he spoke now!

One of the girls snapped.
What should he do?

How could he know what to do?
He could only look at Lu Jie and say in a low voice, “Brother Jie, since things have turned out like this, it’s better for you to make the decision.”

That was to contact Lu Jun and let him settle the matters here.
With Lu Jun, the eldest young master of the Lu family, stepping forward, he did not believe that Chen Yun would dare to act recklessly.
“Looks like I can only contact Brother Jun.”

Brother Jun?
Which Brother Jun?
Of course, it was Lu Jun.

If not for the fact that he had the same ancestor as Lu Jun, Lu Jie would have really cursed Lu Jun’s ancestor.

Brother Jun is here.”

Brother Jie, didn’t you say that he’s not free?”

Hmph, Chen Yun hit the clubhouse’s security guards and smashed so many things.
Brother Jun will definitely not let him off easily.”

Then go play with Lu Jun.
They would see who was impressive.

How dare they cause trouble in Young Master Lu’s clubhouse and injure the security guards?
They’re simply courting death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Alcohol Is Made from the Essence of Food. The More You Drink, the Younger You Get
paragraphs: What, Brother Yun?!
Upon hearing this title, everyone in the clubhouse, except Chen Yun and Lu Jun, was stunned.
What the f*ck was going on? The dignified young master of the Lu family actually called this person Brother Yun!
Moreover, from the looks of it, this person was not older than Lu Jun.

“Why? Lu Jun, didn’t you want to deal with me?” Chen Yun smiled and looked at the young man in front of him. The last time they met was at the First-Grade Restaurant in Jiang City. Last time, he had given the dregs of a thousand-year-old medicine to Lu Jun. He believed that with Lu Jun’s strength, he should have already investigated his identity.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been so cold just now.
“Brother Yun, you really know how to joke. How would I dare to teach you a lesson?”
Lu Jun wiped the sweat off his forehead. At this moment, he was very uncertain.

As the heir of the Lu family, he was naturally not a fool. Ever since he returned from Jiangbei, he had started to investigate Chen Yun’s identity. How could he be an ordinary person if he could casually use a thousand-year-old medicine worth hundreds of millions to make soup?
However, he would not have known if he had not investigated. When he did, he was shocked. Lu Jun took the investigation report and read it. Then, his entire body trembled.
Later on, he had been paying attention to Chen Yun. He knew very well what Chen Yun had done along the way.
He destroyed the Su family!
He had reached the peak of Jiang City!
He distributed the Heavenly Spirit Water!
He blew up the Song family’s manor!
He challenged the Qi family of Mount Shennong!
Everything was paved with money and blood.
How could Lu Jun dare to provoke such a figure?

The person in front of him looked fair and clean, but he was definitely a person who killed without batting an eyelid. Originally, he still called Chen Yun “Brother Chen”, but now, he had directly called him Brother Yun. It could be seen that he respected Chen Yun.
Chen Yun did not know that Lu Jun was so afraid of him. He patted Lu Jun’s shoulder and smiled. “Lu Jun, don’t be nervous. I won’t hit you.”
Lu Jun laughed dryly, but he did not know how to respond to Chen Yun.
He felt depressed and suddenly turned to look at the lobby manager. He shouted, “Lobby manager, come over and explain what’s going on.”
The lobby manager was already dumbfounded. When he heard this cold shout, he came back to his senses and hurriedly ran over.

He glanced at Chen Yun and was so frightened that his face turned green. He said to Lu Jun in fear, “Young Master Lu, I... This has nothing to do with me. I don’t know why the security guards suddenly taught him a lesson. I only called you in a hurry. Who knew that he would hit them? After that...”
Pa.
Lu Jun did not wait for the lobby manager to finish speaking. He slapped the lobby manager’s face and shouted, “You’re really muddle-headed. How can Brother Yun be that kind of person?”

Lu Jun simply cursed 18 generations of the lobby manager’s ancestors in his heart. F*ck, he didn’t know anything, yet he dared to call Lu Jun. He even spoke seriously. From his tone, Lu Jun was certain that the other party was here to cause trouble for him.
“Forget it. He was tricked too. There’s no point beating him up.”
At this moment, Chen Yun raised his gaze and looked at the table beside him. He shouted, “Why? Do you want to leave? You haven’t drunk the wine yet. Don’t be anxious.”
When everyone saw this, they followed his gaze. Then, they saw a group of men and women standing up and tiptoeing. It was obvious that they were about to slip away.
Lu Jie, Zhang Hong, and the others originally thought that Chen Yun would definitely suffer when Lu Jun came.
However, he did not expect Lu Jun to call him “Brother Yun”.
In the entire Jiangnan, other than those who were related to Lu Jun, there were not many people who could make him call them “Brother”.
For ordinary people, even if they were 20 to 30 years older than him, he would at most call them “Old Chen” or “Old Liu”. He would never call them “Brother”.
However, if he called Chen Yun “Brother Yun”, then Chen Yun’s identity was self-evident. He was definitely impressive.
Seeing this, Lu Jie and the others did not dare to stay here. While Chen Yun and Lu Jun were talking, they quietly stood up and planned to sneak out of the Nanchen Clubhouse.
However, they did not know that Chen Yun had been paying attention to them. Just as they moved, they were stopped by Chen Yun.
“You’re leaving without even drinking. Aren’t you being too anxious?”
Chen Yun shouted and temporarily threw Lu Jun and the others aside before walking towards Lu Jie, Zhang Hong, and the others.
Seeing this, Lu Jun looked over and couldn’t help but frown. Wasn’t that guy over there Lu Jie, who had just called him? So he was here.
“D*mn, he was so frightened by Chen Yun. Did he look for me just now to deal with Chen Yun?”
Lu Jun’s heart skipped a beat when he saw Lu Jie’s ugly expression. He quickly followed Chen Yun over.
Meanwhile, Lu Jie and the others were stopped by Chen Yun and did not dare to move at all. They stood rooted to the ground in a daze, their faces turning pale from fear.
This group of self-righteous second-generation heirs had just criticized and played with Wang Liang, as if they were the number one in the world.
However, at this moment, they were all stunned. One of the girls was so frightened that tears flowed down her face.
Chen Yun did not have any pity for the three girls. If they had said anything good when Wang Liang was teased and forced to drink just now, Chen Yun might have let them off.
However, they did not. Chen Yun could imagine how mean and heartless these girls were just now. It was disgusting.
At this moment, the entire clubhouse was brightly lit and silent. It was a stark contrast to the darkness and noise just now.
Chen Yun had a teasing smile on his face as he walked to the table unhurriedly.
“My matter has been resolved. Now, it’s time for you to drink.”
He spoke coldly.
Lu Jie and the others had ugly expressions and did not even dare to breathe loudly. They only stared at Chen Yun, at a loss.
Chen Yun sneered and said, “Why are you so afraid? I’m not beating you up. I’m just letting you drink.”
When he heard that they were drinking, Lu Jun heaved a sigh of relief. He thought to himself that it was not a big deal. These guys were so frightened by Chen Yun. They were really useless.
He walked forward and looked at a young man lying on the sofa. He thought that this should be Wang Liang, whom Chen Yun had mentioned.
He said to Lu Jie and the others, “What are you waiting for? It’s your honor to drink for Brother Yun. What’s the big deal? Hurry up.”
“What’s the big deal?”
This was simply too f*cking big.
Try drinking one liter of strong foreign wine in one gulp and see if you will die.
Lu Jie and the others were complaining in their hearts. Lu Jie looked at Lu Jun and said with a long face, “Brother Jun, this wine... is fatal.”

At this moment, everyone in the clubhouse was looking over. Seeing that Lu Jie and the others were unwilling to drink, they were a little puzzled. At this moment, when they heard him say that the wine was fatal, everyone was even more puzzled.
Could it be that Chen Yun had poisoned the wine?

“Bullsh*t. Who told you that wine can kill people? Alcohol is made from the essence of food. The more you drink, the younger you become. If Brother Yun wants you to drink, drink. Don’t talk so much nonsense.”
Lu Jun was furious and kicked Lu Jie. He thought to himself, “Kid, don’t anger Brother Yun. When the time comes, he’ll even attack me. No one will be able to stop him.”
Moreover, it was useless for him to fight. He could not take revenge.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: What Are You Waiting For?!
paragraphs: After Song Jixing provoked him, he hid in the manor guarded by a hundred people. However, Chen Yun brought people into the manor and kidnapped Song Jixing. He even blew up the manor. Now that the Song family had yet to find any traces of Song Jixing, his whereabouts were obvious.
He definitely went face to face with God.
It was rumored that Chen Yun had an extremely powerful force under him.

Lu Jie took a few steps back after being kicked and looked at Lu Jun with an aggrieved expression. He originally wanted to ask Lu Jun for help, but who knew that Lu Jun would really come and target him instead?
“Alright, drink up.”
Chen Yun picked up the bottle of strong foreign wine on the table and handed it to Lu Jie.

Lu Jie looked at the one-liter bottle of strong foreign wine and the corners of his mouth twitched. He did not want to take this bottle of wine, but he did not dare to. He could only take it in his hand.

“Isn’t it just a bottle of strong foreign wine that contains one liter? There are so many of you. Even if each of you takes one cup, it won’t amount to 150 milliliters. Wouldn’t it be over after drinking it?”
Lu Jun glared at Lu Jie and the others with a disdainful expression. He muttered, “A bunch of idiots. They don’t even dare to drink a few cups of wine.”
At this moment, everyone present looked at Lu Jie with disdain.
How dare he come to the clubhouse with such a low alcohol tolerance? He was courting death.
At this moment, Chen Yun waved at the waiter beside him. “Take a few more bottles of this wine. Don’t worry, all the expenses for this table today will be on me.”
The waiter immediately brought over a few more bottles.
Chen Yun took out another bottle of strong foreign wine and stuffed it into Zhang Hong’s hand. He smiled and said, “This bottle is yours.”
What was this?

Seeing this, everyone was stunned. Before they could recover, Chen Yun picked up another bottle of strong foreign wine and stuffed it into Wu Yu’s hand. “This bottle is yours. By the way, drink it in one gulp.”
Wait, what was going on?
Everyone looked at the table and realized that there were still a few bottles of strong foreign wine on the table. Coincidentally, the others did not have any wine in their hands.
After thinking for a moment, everyone immediately came back to their senses.
Damn, what Chen Yun meant was that these people each had a bottle of strong foreign wine.
There was indeed no poison in this wine, but if they drank it, they would still die.
Moreover, what was even more dangerous was that Chen Yun actually wanted them to finish it in one go.
At the thought of drinking one liter of strong foreign wine, the surrounding people felt their scalps tingle. They thought to themselves that Chen Yun was simply ruthless.

The corners of Lu Jun’s mouth twitched. He glanced at the smiling Chen Yun and suddenly felt that he was too naive. Since Lu Jie and the others had provoked Chen Yun, how could a fierce person like Chen Yun let them split a bottle of strong foreign wine?
Chen Yun gave each person a bottle and they had to finish it in one gulp. This was Chen Yun’s style.

Chen Yun ignored the surprised gazes around him and distributed a bottle of strong foreign wine to Lu Jie and the others. He said, “Alright, drink now. Don’t make me do anything, or the consequences will be very tragic.”
Finally, a girl could not withstand the pressure and burst into tears.
A look of disgust flashed across Chen Yun’s eyes as he shouted coldly, “Shut up. Stop pretending. Why weren’t you like this when you bullied Wang Liang just now?”
His fierce gaze immediately made the girl stop crying. The other two girls, who were about to cry to gain sympathy, hurriedly stopped their tears from falling, afraid that they would anger Chen Yun.
“F*ck you, I’ll fight you to the death.”
Among the group, Wu Yu was the most brainless and rash. He shouted and waved the strong wine bottle in his hand, smashing it at Chen Yun’s head.
Bang.
Chen Yun kicked down and stepped on Wu Yu’s face, forcing him to the ground. His head hit the floor with a bang and he fainted on the spot. Bright red blood flowed out from the back of his head.
Chen Yun was indifferent. His feet were still stepping on Wu Yu’s face. A cold glint flashed across his eyes as he swept his gaze across the other six people and shouted coldly.
“Drink up!”
Chen Yun stood there with Wu Yu under his feet. His eyes were cold, as if he would explode and kill someone at any moment.
At this moment, the remaining six people, including Lu Jie, truly felt fear.

Zhang Hong was the first to come back to his senses. He did not want to end up like Wu Yu. He opened the bottle and waved his hand. He gritted his teeth and said, “Brother Yun, I was wrong just now. Let me toast you to this bottle of strong foreign wine.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Zhang Hong closed his eyes tightly and raised his head to drink.
Seeing this, the other five hesitated for a moment, but they did not dare to fall behind. They opened their wine bottles one after another.
“I’ll drink.”
“Brother Yun, let me toast you with this bottle of wine.”
There were a total of ten people. They stood in front of Chen Yun in a line and drank respectfully. Then, they raised their heads and drank the strong foreign wine.
The one liter of strong foreign wine was very explosive, but when six people drank it at the same time, it was even more explosive.
The entire venue was silent. Only the sound of drinking could be heard. Everyone was shocked by this scene.
There was less and less strong foreign wine in the six bottles. The first to collapse was a girl. Halfway through drinking, she vomited.
Her face was flushed as she shouted at Chen Yun, “Brother Yun, please let me go. I can’t drink anymore.”
The girl’s head was dizzy as she begged for mercy.
“Drink it all. Not a single sip less.”
Chen Yun narrowed his eyes. He had never taken back his words.
In a short period of time, Lu Jie, Zhang Hong, and the others’ faces were already red from drinking. Their stomachs felt like they were on fire, and their heads felt like they were about to explode.
In short, it was extremely uncomfortable.
This strong foreign wine was really difficult to swallow, but under Chen Yun’s gaze, they did not dare to stop.
After drinking more than half a bottle, the few of them were already dizzy and could not stand steadily.

Lu Jie finally could not take it anymore. He did not care about his male dignity anymore. He put down the wine bottle and said to Chen Yun, “Brother Yun, as long as you don’t let me drink, from now on, you’re my brother. I’ll listen to you.”

“I told you to drink, so drink. What are you dawdling for?!” Lu Jun, who was beside him, looked at Lu Jie. His eyes suddenly widened as he shouted angrily. He had just heard a security guard talking to him.

Today, Lu Jie was the one who provoked Chen Yun. Otherwise, as for the security guards, Lu Jie was the one who asked them to break Chen Yun’s legs. Fortunately, Chen Yun was a martial arts practitioner. If he really broke Chen Yun’s legs here, it would really not be a small matter. His father, the head of the Lu family, would probably have to personally go to Jiangbei to give him an explanation!
At the thought of this, Lu Jun looked at the group of people in front of him as if they were enemies. How could he let them off just like that?!
Lu Jie shuddered and quickly covered his mouth with the bottle, forcing himself to drink the remaining strong foreign wine.
Zhang Hong and the other person originally wanted to beg for mercy, but when they saw this, they dispelled this thought and gulped down the strong wine.
They did not dare to stop for a moment!

sentences.text: After Song Jixing provoked him, he hid in the manor guarded by a hundred people.
However, Chen Yun brought people into the manor and kidnapped Song Jixing.
He even blew up the manor.
Now that the Song family had yet to find any traces of Song Jixing, his whereabouts were obvious.
He definitely went face to face with God.
It was rumored that Chen Yun had an extremely powerful force under him.
Lu Jie took a few steps back after being kicked and looked at Lu Jun with an aggrieved expression.
He originally wanted to ask Lu Jun for help, but who knew that Lu Jun would really come and target him instead?
“Alright, drink up.”
Chen Yun picked up the bottle of strong foreign wine on the table and handed it to Lu Jie.
Lu Jie looked at the one-liter bottle of strong foreign wine and the corners of his mouth twitched.
He did not want to take this bottle of wine, but he did not dare to.
He could only take it in his hand.
“Isn’t it just a bottle of strong foreign wine that contains one liter?
There are so many of you.
Even if each of you takes one cup, it won’t amount to 150 milliliters.
Wouldn’t it be over after drinking it?”
Lu Jun glared at Lu Jie and the others with a disdainful expression.
He muttered, “A bunch of idiots.
They don’t even dare to drink a few cups of wine.”
At this moment, everyone present looked at Lu Jie with disdain.
How dare he come to the clubhouse with such a low alcohol tolerance?
He was courting death.
At this moment, Chen Yun waved at the waiter beside him.
“Take a few more bottles of this wine.
Don’t worry, all the expenses for this table today will be on me.”
The waiter immediately brought over a few more bottles.
Chen Yun took out another bottle of strong foreign wine and stuffed it into Zhang Hong’s hand.
He smiled and said, “This bottle is yours.”
What was this?
Seeing this, everyone was stunned.
Before they could recover, Chen Yun picked up another bottle of strong foreign wine and stuffed it into Wu Yu’s hand.
“This bottle is yours.
By the way, drink it in one gulp.”
Wait, what was going on?
Everyone looked at the table and realized that there were still a few bottles of strong foreign wine on the table.
Coincidentally, the others did not have any wine in their hands.
After thinking for a moment, everyone immediately came back to their senses.
Damn, what Chen Yun meant was that these people each had a bottle of strong foreign wine.
There was indeed no poison in this wine, but if they drank it, they would still die.
Moreover, what was even more dangerous was that Chen Yun actually wanted them to finish it in one go.
At the thought of drinking one liter of strong foreign wine, the surrounding people felt their scalps tingle.
They thought to themselves that Chen Yun was simply ruthless.
The corners of Lu Jun’s mouth twitched.
He glanced at the smiling Chen Yun and suddenly felt that he was too naive.
Since Lu Jie and the others had provoked Chen Yun, how could a fierce person like Chen Yun let them split a bottle of strong foreign wine?
Chen Yun gave each person a bottle and they had to finish it in one gulp.
This was Chen Yun’s style.
Chen Yun ignored the surprised gazes around him and distributed a bottle of strong foreign wine to Lu Jie and the others.
He said, “Alright, drink now.
Don’t make me do anything, or the consequences will be very tragic.”
Finally, a girl could not withstand the pressure and burst into tears.
A look of disgust flashed across Chen Yun’s eyes as he shouted coldly, “Shut up.
Stop pretending.
Why weren’t you like this when you bullied Wang Liang just now?”
His fierce gaze immediately made the girl stop crying.
The other two girls, who were about to cry to gain sympathy, hurriedly stopped their tears from falling, afraid that they would anger Chen Yun.
“F*ck you, I’ll fight you to the death.”
Among the group, Wu Yu was the most brainless and rash.
He shouted and waved the strong wine bottle in his hand, smashing it at Chen Yun’s head.
Bang.
Chen Yun kicked down and stepped on Wu Yu’s face, forcing him to the ground.
His head hit the floor with a bang and he fainted on the spot.
Bright red blood flowed out from the back of his head.
Chen Yun was indifferent.
His feet were still stepping on Wu Yu’s face.
A cold glint flashed across his eyes as he swept his gaze across the other six people and shouted coldly.
“Drink up!”
Chen Yun stood there with Wu Yu under his feet.
His eyes were cold, as if he would explode and kill someone at any moment.
At this moment, the remaining six people, including Lu Jie, truly felt fear.
Zhang Hong was the first to come back to his senses.
He did not want to end up like Wu Yu.
He opened the bottle and waved his hand.
He gritted his teeth and said, “Brother Yun, I was wrong just now.
Let me toast you to this bottle of strong foreign wine.”

They opened their wine bottles one after another.
“I’ll drink.”

chapters.title: Chapter 198: The Great Families of Jiangnan!
paragraphs: After a while, the men each finished one liter of strong foreign wine, and the women also drank more than half a bottle each.
After drinking so much wine, how could they still stand steadily? All of them staggered and fell to the ground. Their faces were green, and they looked like they were seriously ill.
This was especially true for Zhang Hong. He seemed to have a poor alcohol tolerance and was already exhaling more than he was inhaling.
Seeing this scene, everyone gasped in shock and looked at Chen Yun with reverence.
At this moment, Chen Yun picked up a bottle of strong foreign wine on the ground. This was what Wu Yu had used to attack him just now.
He opened the wine bottle, squatted down, and poured it into Wu Yu’s mouth. As he drank, he said, “Don’t think that you don’t have to drink just because you fainted.”
Seeing this, everyone was stunned.
They already felt that Chen Yun was ruthless, but this time, Chen Yun’s ferocity refreshed their understanding.
However, Chen Yun did not care about the gazes of others at all. Even if he killed all these people, he felt that it was not too much.
This kind of second-generation heirs who bullied others would only harm more people if they were allowed to live.
This time, Chen Yun had taught them an unforgettable lesson. They would definitely restrain themselves in the future.
Therefore, Chen Yun was actually contributing to society.
Halfway through drinking, Wu Yu choked and woke up. However, Chen Yun pressed his head and made him unable to move. He forcefully finished the entire bottle of strong foreign wine.
After drinking it, Wu Yu was paralyzed.
After doing all of this, Chen Yun acted as if nothing had happened. It was as if he had just eaten quietly.

He raised his hand and waved at the lobby manager. Then, he pointed at the man and woman on the ground and said calmly, “Send them to the hospital. I’m a kind and law-abiding citizen. I can’t stand such a scene.”
Was he still a kind and law-abiding citizen?
Based on what he said, all of them were philanthropists, right?
Hearing Chen Yun’s words, everyone criticized him silently.
Even Lu Jun pursed his lips. He was the person who knew Chen Yun’s actions the best here. His face immediately darkened. Chen Yun was simply lying without blushing.
The lobby manager quickly nodded and said, “Yes, I’ll send them to the hospital now.”
The people watching from the sidelines were stunned when they saw the scene in front of them. This young man was too ruthless!
This!
He was simply like a jinx. Even the eldest young master of the Lu family did not dare to touch him.
Lu Jun looked at Chen Yun in front of him and smiled bitterly. “Brother Yun, it looks like we didn’t eat much for lunch. Let’s go upstairs and have another meal.”

Ever since he finished investigating Chen Yun’s abilities, his understanding of Chen Yun had increased to another level. Chen Yun’s status was tied with the heads of the big families in Jiangbei and even surpassed them.
Chen Yun nodded and the two of them went upstairs. Lu Jun got someone to serve the best food and drinks in the clubhouse.
After all, he had to serve such people with suitable dishes.
As soon as the dishes were served, Lu Ying hurriedly walked into the private room and looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Chen Yun, why are you in Jiangnan?”
“I came here to take a look at my business.”

These words stunned Lu Jun and Lu Ying, especially Lu Jun. He looked at Chen Yun and thought to himself, “I didn’t hear that Chen Yun has already expanded his business to Jiangnan. Moreover, if Chen Yun expands it, then...”
Wouldn’t he snatch their jobs?

Putting everything else aside, Chen Yun’s First-Grade Restaurant was very attractive. Food was the priority of the people. Chen Yun’s First-Grade Restaurant was the best restaurant he had ever eaten in his life.
The taste was simply unforgettable.
Lu Jun glanced at Lu Ying, then pouted at Chen Yun. This dumbfounded Lu Ying.
What did this mean?
Lu Jun was speechless. Why was she so stupid?
Lu Ying looked at her brother’s gaze. She was simply dumbfounded.

At that moment, Lu Jun’s lips moved and Lu Ying immediately understood. She leaned towards Chen Yun and looked at him with a money-grubber gaze. “Brother Chen Yun, what industry are you working in in Jiangnan? Can you bring me along? I can invest in it.”
Lu Jun was speechless.
This brat was monopolizing everything!
At that moment, he also came over and asked Chen Yun. He was still very interested in joining the First-Grade Restaurant.
When Chen Yun heard what the two of them meant, he immediately smiled. What was going on?
Although the First-Grade Restaurant was not bad and did well in Jiangbei, it was only the smallest business under Chen Yun.
He had super silicon!
He had the super high-efficiency storage battery
He had laser arms!
He also had the Heavenly Spirit Water!
If he casually took out these few things, wouldn’t they all cost tens of billions or even hundreds of billions of yuan? The income of the restaurant was simply too small.
Of course, Chen Yun did not reveal these trump cards to them. Instead, he raised his glass. “You guys are thinking too much. My research parks are here, so I came to take a look.”
“That’s it?”

“That’s it.” Chen Yun nodded, causing a disappointed expression to appear in Lu Jun’s eyes. After all, he was prepared to use Chen Yun’s business to increase his status in Jiangnan. Now, it seemed that there was no need to think about it.

However, the scientific research park in Jiangnan was indeed famous. Chen Yun’s arrival in the park did not cause any waves in his heart. After all, the Lu family also had scientific research projects and occupied a place in the park. Moreover, what good projects could Chen Yun have? The Lu family’s projects had been launched for a few years or even more than ten years.
It was precisely these projects that succeeded one by one, allowing the Lu family to continue to prosper.

“Brother Lu, I have something to ask of you. I have a friend here. Help me take care of her.” As Chen Yun spoke, he handed a few documents to Lu Jun. The latter took them and looked a little shocked. “Is she from the Lin family?”
“There’s no need for me to take care of this. We can completely rely on the Lin family’s strength.”

“Is this Lin family very famous?” Chen Yun had just obtained Lin Wan’er’s information and had yet to investigate the Lin family. However, he immediately recalled the scene of Wan’er being picked up. At that time, a Rolls-Royce and a few bodyguards in black had come to pick her up.

At that time, he did not know such a car, but the goddess statue in front of him was deeply imprinted in his mind. This was also the reason why he avoided Lin Wan’er after he grew up. At that time, he was just a poor boy, and Lin Wan’er was someone who could sit in such a luxury car.

Lu Jun nodded and immediately said, “Brother Yun, although the Lin family doesn’t have the reputation of being in the top few in Jiangnan like our families, this family is located at the border of the three provinces and is a hundred-year-old family. In terms of strength, they’re definitely not inferior to us. However, they don’t have many businesses in Jiangnan, so they’re not among the first-tier families.”
