chapters.title: Chapter 199: Who Dares To Touch Me?!
paragraphs: Lu Ying also nodded and said, “I heard from Dad that the Lin family is a hundred-year-old family. A hundred years ago, they stood on the right side, so they received a lot of support. Later on, they soared to the sky. However, hmph.”
Chen Yun looked at Lu Ying. When he heard the latter stop halfway, he immediately raised his eyebrows. “What’s wrong? Did something happen to the Lin family?”

“It’s not just an unforeseen event. I heard that the Lin family is getting worse with each generation. This generation is even worse. After entering the family business, not only did they not achieve anything, but they even made an investment mistake, causing the Lin family to lose billions of yuan in vain.”
“Well ...”
Even Chen Yun smiled silently.

Unexpectedly, the Lin family was quite helpless. Originally, a descendant of a hundred-year-old family should have been nurtured from a young age and could be promoted, especially if they were a direct descendant. However, the Lin family did not seem to be like this. They had nurtured their descendants. However, it seemed that the direct descendants of the Lin family had a bad start.
After Lu Jun finished speaking, he pondered for a moment. “Brother Yun, I’ll help you take care of her.”
“Thank you.” Chen Yun clinked glasses with Lu Jun and drank the wine in one gulp.
Lu Ying, who was beside them, saw that the two of them were drinking happily. She immediately picked up the bottle and prepared to pour herself a glass.
“Brother Chen Yun, let me toast you!”

Lu Ying downed the wine in one gulp, causing Chen Yun and Lu Jun to look sideways. Lu Jun’s lips curled into a cold smile as he looked at his sister and coughed. “If some people drink too much and lose their composure in front of Brother Chen Yun, hehe.”

Lu Ying immediately glanced at him, making Lu Jun swallow the rest of his words. Ever since this girl returned from Jiangbei, she had been thinking about Chen Yun. She even said that she wanted to go to Jiangbei to look for Chen Yun a few times.

Lu Ying also took the documents and looked at them. The smile on her face gradually froze. The girl in the photo was too beautiful. Even she might not be able to compare to her. Moreover, the fullness of her chest was completely incomparable to her. Just this alone made Lu Ying despair.
Then, she looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Chen Yun, why don’t you use your strength? Why don’t you move to Jiangnan? My brother and I can help you. Of course, we can also invest in your businesses.”
“Yes, yes, yes. We can invest in your businesses.” Lu Jun’s eyes lit up.

Although he was the eldest young master of the Lu family, he was also short of money, let alone Lu Ying. When she thought of how Chen Yun had stewed soup with a thousand-year-old ginseng that day, she wanted to cry. She was touched by Chen Yun’s actions.

They had also heard of Chen Yun’s deeds. In a short period of time, he had established such a huge industry. This person was definitely an investment genius. If they worked for him, they would not lose any money.
Chen Yun finished the wine in his glass and looked at them. “I’ll move to Jiangnan.”
“Really?” Lu Ying and Lu Jun were stunned. Then, they looked at Chen Yun. “When?”
“After I stand at the top of Jiangbei,” said Chen Yun calmly.
“After I stand at the top of Jiangbei!”
His voice was not loud, but it stirred up a storm in Lu Ying and Lu Jun’s hearts. Their eyes widened, and they could not believe what they had heard.
Chen Yun actually said that he wanted to dominate Jiangbei!
He would become the number one person in Jiangbei!
This goal was too far-fetched!
Putting aside the fact that there were so many families in Jiangbei, just the five major families and a few foreign forces were terrifying enough.
Be it the financial resources, connections, or private power of any of the families, they had been tested over time. Every family was the best in Jiangbei in every aspect.
It was really not easy for Chen Yun to step on them.
“Brother Yun, your target...”
Seeing Lu Jun smile bitterly, Chen Yun asked, “You don’t believe me?”
Lu Jun was speechless.
He couldn’t help but believe this.
After the three of them ate and drank their fill, Lu Jun suggested bringing Chen Yun to a good place.

They arrived at a pavilion on a mountain. Standing here, it was incomparably dark. In front of them was the bustling Jiangnan. The lights were blinking, and the traffic was heavy. The nightlife had just begun, and it was noisy.
When they stood here, it was as if they were standing in another world.
“I often stand here. I can have another kind of experience here, and I can also relieve my stress,” said Lu Jun slowly. Then, he looked at Chen Yun, who nodded. Standing here, he could be meticulous.
Beside them, Lu Ying looked at the two of them and pursed her lips. She thought to herself that these two were like otherworldly experts.
However, her face was also slightly red, and she swayed as she stood.
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yun said. Then, he felt someone beside him fall forward.
Chen Yun was shocked. If she fell, wouldn’t her face be ruined?
Immediately, he hugged Lu Ying.
Beside him, Lu Jun’s forehead was also covered in cold sweat. He was stunned just now. If anything happened to his sister, needless to say, his father would skin him alive.
“Alright, I’ll carry her. It’s not easy to walk down the mountain.”

Chen Yun took the initiative to say this. Moreover, Lu Ying had also toasted him today and ended up like this. Lu Jun originally wanted to carry her, but when he thought of the exciting expression on Lu Ying’s face when he told her about tonight’s happenings tomorrow, he held back.
On the way, the two of them chatted as they walked. Lu Jun looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, is the dispute between you and the Song family that’s spreading like wildfire in Jiangbei true?”
“Did you really blow up the Song family’s manor and make Song Jixing disappear from the face of the Earth?”
As soon as these words were spoken, Chen Yun smiled. “There’s no smoke without fire.”
These five words immediately made Lu Jun understand. His reverence for Chen Yun was even higher.
Chen Yun looked at Lu Jun’s expression. “Why? Are you frightened? In that case, bring more bodyguards when you go out in the future.”
“Haha.”

Lu Jun laughed out loud. “You’re such a big shot. You’re the number one person in Jiang City and the number one young master in Jiangbei. You’re so carefree when you go out. You’re not even afraid of coming to Jiangnan alone. What’s there to be afraid of?”

Then, he looked at Chen Yun and patted his chest proudly. “I’m not bragging, but in Jiangnan and Qing City, I still have the absolute right to speak. This is my territory. No one dares to touch me in my territory!”
These words were so heroic that Chen Yun could not help but look sideways.
However, in the next moment, on the deserted road in front of the two of them, a car flew past with a roar.
The car doors immediately opened, and a few burly men jumped out of each car. There were more than ten men. They unsheathed their short knives and rushed towards Chen Yun, Lu Jun, and Lu Ying.
Lu Jun was instantly dumbfounded. F*ck your mother. Couldn’t they let him show off completely?!
“That’s him. Kill them all!”

sentences.text: Lu Ying also nodded and said, “I heard from Dad that the Lin family is a hundred-year-old family.
A hundred years ago, they stood on the right side, so they received a lot of support.
Later on, they soared to the sky.
However, hmph.”
Chen Yun looked at Lu Ying.
When he heard the latter stop halfway, he immediately raised his eyebrows.
“What’s wrong?
Did something happen to the Lin family?”
“It’s not just an unforeseen event.
I heard that the Lin family is getting worse with each generation.
This generation is even worse.
After entering the family business, not only did they not achieve anything, but they even made an investment mistake, causing the Lin family to lose billions of yuan in vain.”
“Well ...”
Even Chen Yun smiled silently.
Unexpectedly, the Lin family was quite helpless.
Originally, a descendant of a hundred-year-old family should have been nurtured from a young age and could be promoted, especially if they were a direct descendant.
However, the Lin family did not seem to be like this.
They had nurtured their descendants.
However, it seemed that the direct descendants of the Lin family had a bad start.
After Lu Jun finished speaking, he pondered for a moment.
“Brother Yun, I’ll help you take care of her.”
“Thank you.” Chen Yun clinked glasses with Lu Jun and drank the wine in one gulp.
Lu Ying, who was beside them, saw that the two of them were drinking happily.
She immediately picked up the bottle and prepared to pour herself a glass.
“Brother Chen Yun, let me toast you!”
Lu Ying downed the wine in one gulp, causing Chen Yun and Lu Jun to look sideways.
Lu Jun’s lips curled into a cold smile as he looked at his sister and coughed.
“If some people drink too much and lose their composure in front of Brother Chen Yun, hehe.”
Lu Ying immediately glanced at him, making Lu Jun swallow the rest of his words.
Ever since this girl returned from Jiangbei, she had been thinking about Chen Yun.
She even said that she wanted to go to Jiangbei to look for Chen Yun a few times.
Lu Ying also took the documents and looked at them.
The smile on her face gradually froze.
The girl in the photo was too beautiful.
Even she might not be able to compare to her.
Moreover, the fullness of her chest was completely incomparable to her.
Just this alone made Lu Ying despair.
Then, she looked at Chen Yun.
“Brother Chen Yun, why don’t you use your strength?
Why don’t you move to Jiangnan?
My brother and I can help you.
Of course, we can also invest in your businesses.”
“Yes, yes, yes.
We can invest in your businesses.” Lu Jun’s eyes lit up.
Although he was the eldest young master of the Lu family, he was also short of money, let alone Lu Ying.
When she thought of how Chen Yun had stewed soup with a thousand-year-old ginseng that day, she wanted to cry.
She was touched by Chen Yun’s actions.
They had also heard of Chen Yun’s deeds.
In a short period of time, he had established such a huge industry.
This person was definitely an investment genius.
If they worked for him, they would not lose any money.
Chen Yun finished the wine in his glass and looked at them.
“I’ll move to Jiangnan.”
“Really?” Lu Ying and Lu Jun were stunned.
Then, they looked at Chen Yun.
“When?”
“After I stand at the top of Jiangbei,” said Chen Yun calmly.
“After I stand at the top of Jiangbei!”
His voice was not loud, but it stirred up a storm in Lu Ying and Lu Jun’s hearts.
Their eyes widened, and they could not believe what they had heard.
Chen Yun actually said that he wanted to dominate Jiangbei!
He would become the number one person in Jiangbei!
This goal was too far-fetched!
Putting aside the fact that there were so many families in Jiangbei, just the five major families and a few foreign forces were terrifying enough.
Be it the financial resources, connections, or private power of any of the families, they had been tested over time.
Every family was the best in Jiangbei in every aspect.
It was really not easy for Chen Yun to step on them.
“Brother Yun, your target...”
Seeing Lu Jun smile bitterly, Chen Yun asked, “You don’t believe me?”
Lu Jun was speechless.
He couldn’t help but believe this.
After the three of them ate and drank their fill, Lu Jun suggested bringing Chen Yun to a good place.
They arrived at a pavilion on a mountain.
Standing here, it was incomparably dark.
In front of them was the bustling Jiangnan.
The lights were blinking, and the traffic was heavy.
The nightlife had just begun, and it was noisy.
When they stood here, it was as if they were standing in another world.
“I often stand here.
I can have another kind of experience here, and I can also relieve my stress,” said Lu Jun slowly.
Then, he looked at Chen Yun, who nodded.
Standing here, he could be meticulous.
Beside them, Lu Ying looked at the two of them and pursed her lips.
She thought to herself that these two were like otherworldly experts.
However, her face was also slightly red, and she swayed as she stood.
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yun said.
Then, he felt someone beside him fall forward.
Chen Yun was shocked.
If she fell, wouldn’t her face be ruined?
Immediately, he hugged Lu Ying.
Beside him, Lu Jun’s forehead was also covered in cold sweat.
He was stunned just now.
If anything happened to his sister, needless to say, his father would skin him alive.
“Alright, I’ll carry her.
It’s not easy to walk down the mountain.”
Chen Yun took the initiative to say this.
Moreover, Lu Ying had also toasted him today and ended up like this.
Lu Jun originally wanted to carry her, but when he thought of the exciting expression on Lu Ying’s face when he told her about tonight’s happenings tomorrow, he held back.
On the way, the two of them chatted as they walked.
Lu Jun looked at Chen Yun.
“Brother Yun, is the dispute between you and the Song family that’s spreading like wildfire in Jiangbei true?”
“Did you really blow up the Song family’s manor and make Song Jixing disappear from the face of the Earth?”
As soon as these words were spoken, Chen Yun smiled.
“There’s no smoke without fire.”
These five words immediately made Lu Jun understand.
His reverence for Chen Yun was even higher.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Clearing the Park Corporation!
paragraphs: When these cars stopped in front of him, Chen Yun felt that something was wrong. When he looked up, he saw more than ten people rushing towards him with weapons in their hands. He knew that they were not here to greet him. He was stunned for a moment before running.
Meanwhile, Lu Jun was stunned for a moment before he turned around and ran.
The dozen or so people were waiting for a few people. It was not easy for their prey to appear, so how could they give up? They immediately chased after them.
“Run up there!”
Chen Yun spoke. Then, he rushed up with Lu Jun following behind.

There were a bunch of question marks above his head. What kind of body did Chen Yun have? He was carrying a person who weighed 45 kilograms and could still walk as if he was flying. He could jump up five or six steps with a single step.

Fortunately, Lu Jun usually liked to exercise. Now that he finally had a place to show off his abilities, he quickly ran towards the stairs. At the intersection of the stairs, more than ten people rushed up from the opposite side. There were close to 30 people in total.
At this moment, Lu Jun’s handsome face turned pale. What kind of grudge did he have? Why did he need 30 people to block him?!
Moreover, from the looks of it, they would not rest until one party died!

The more Lu Jun ran, the angrier he became. No matter what, he was the young master of the Lu family. When had he ever been chased like this? Moreover, they were running up the mountain. If they reached the pavilion, they would have nowhere to retreat.
However, Chen Yun was right. After all, if they ran on the road, the other party had cars and could tire them out.
After thinking about it, he suddenly stopped and turned around to look at the people chasing after him. He asked loudly, “Where are you from? You need a reason to mess with me, right?!”
This shout did manage to stop the other party. However, the other party’s words stunned Lu Jun.
What the f*ck, were they Korean?!
The next moment, the other party came over with knives.
Lu Jun was speechless.
F*ck! He was asking them a question. Did they think that he was challenging them?!
When they arrived at the pavilion, Chen Yun placed Lu Ying down. Beside him, Lu Jun was panting, as if he was about to collapse. The men chasing after them were not much better.
At this moment, Lu Jun looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, what should we do?”
“What should we do? Let’s deal with them!” Chen Yun looked at Lu Ying. “Take good care of your sister.”
“Deal with them?!” Lu Jun was stunned. He looked at Chen Yun. What the hell was he thinking?!
There were so many people on the other side!
“I’ll go with you!”

Lu Jun looked at the pavilion behind him. The road here was extremely narrow, just like the street battles in the past. Even if the other party had many people, they would not be able to display their advantage in numbers. Instead, they would be more careful for fear of hurting their own people.
At that moment, he understood why Chen Yun had brought him here.
However, just as he finished speaking, Chen Yun suddenly rushed forward and instantly arrived in front of a burly man.
That person only saw a black shadow flash in front of him. Then, he felt someone grab his wrist and his neck went numb.
After that, he didn’t know anything else.

Chen Yun snatched the short knife from the person’s hand and waved his hand to flip him down. The person rolled all the way down the mountain. Even if he was alive, he probably could not escape from a fracture. If he was sent to the hospital early, he should have been able to survive. However, from the looks of it, there was no way out.
The people beside him also suddenly reacted and swung their knives at Chen Yun.
Chen Yun faced the knives and ran towards them.
Ding, ding, ding!
In an instant, he blocked the three knives that the other party slashed at him. Then, he kicked the two of them to the ground.

Chen Yun looked down from above. Coupled with the fact that the other party could not use the advantage of having more people on the steps, they were scattered by Chen Yun a few times. Blood splattered everywhere.
Behind him, Lu Jun was stunned when he saw this scene. His mouth was wide open. He could not believe what he was seeing. What the f*ck!
Even if he could fight, there had to be a limit!
Was Chen Yun so good at fighting?!
Previously, he had planned to live and die with Chen Yun, but now, he was a burden!
In a short while, 30 people were knocked down by Chen Yun. Ordinary people simply died. The remaining people also exhaled more than they inhaled, looking like they could not survive.
Chen Yun squatted on the ground and pulled a man’s head. Then, he looked at the double-winged dragon tattoo on his neck and sneered. Some people really tried to push their luck.
If a tiger didn’t show its might, others would treat it as a sick cat.
Then, he stood up and patted Lu Jun’s shoulder. “Young Master Lu, it looks like you’re useless in your own territory.”
Lu Jun’s face instantly turned red. How embarrassing!
Most importantly, he had just said those words, but he was slapped in the face every minute.

“Damn, I’ve never provoked the Koreans before. What’s wrong with these Koreans? Why are they looking for me?” Lu Jun was also very puzzled, but he still looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, stop talking. I owe you a favor.”
Chen Yun touched his nose and replied. This was a favor that was given to him. It would be a waste not to accept it.
“Call someone over and deal with this place. Otherwise, it’ll be troublesome.”
“Okay.”
After returning to the hotel, Chen Yun lay on the bed and took out his phone to call Lin Yuhan.

Lin Yuhan took the phone and said first, “Brother Yun, how is it in Jiangnan? The Heavenly Dragon Security has already expanded to more than 500 people. I’m here under your name. We simply have a hundred answers to a single call...”

Chen Yun did not say anything and quietly listened to Lin Yuhan. He did not expect Lin Yuhan to make such a move. In a short period of time, the number of Heavenly Dragon security guards had increased to more than 500. Moreover, the original 70 people had also increased to 100. The training had not stopped for the past few days, and everyone’s strength had increased by another level.
“Brother Yun, why aren’t you saying anything?” Lin Yuhan asked excitedly. Then, when he heard the silence on the other end, his heart skipped a beat.

“Damn it, I was blocked by more than 30 people tonight and almost died,” said Chen Yun with a chuckle. He was exaggerating. Although the other party had more than 30 people, he had no problem dealing with them. After all, the other party was already dead or injured before he could take out the Longquan Tang Sword and his gun.
Lin Yuhan knew that Chen Yun rarely swore. Something must have happened. He hurriedly asked, “Brother Yun, what’s going on?”
Although Chen Yun chuckled, the anger in his heart did not decrease. The other party wanted to kill him.

When Lin Yuhan heard this, the blood in his entire body seemed to burn. He rushed to his head and kicked a chair in the room. He roared, “F*ck the Park Corporation. They’re too bold. Brother Yun, I’ll go find my brothers now. If we tigers don’t show our might, they’ll treat us as sick cats!”
When Lin Yuhan was angry, the smile on Chen Yun’s face widened. “Tonight, clean up the secret forces of the Park Corporation in the east of Jiangbei. Be clean.”
“Alright, I’ll get Xiao Bei to bring his brothers. Early in the morning is the time when people are most relaxed. I’ll make sure they won’t see the sun tomorrow!” Lin Yuhan vowed.
